1-2-3-pattern.text: Finds alternating swing highs and lows using Period bars on each side, and tracks the last three. A bullish 1-2-3 is drawn when a high breaks above pivot 2 with pivot 3 between pivots 1 and 2; the bearish case mirrors it. Green and red break shapes, a dashed line and 1, 2, 3 labels appear. Period defaults to 10.

10x-bull-vs-bear-vp-intraday-sessions.text: When an intraday session ends (four six-hour UTC ranges by default), its range is split into levels and each bar's volume is shared over the levels its wick covers, as bull volume (close above open) or bear volume (close below). Bull and bear profiles are drawn from the session start, with the value area in stronger colours. Main inputs: Profile Rows 100, Value Area % 70, Live on.

12-26-ema-inflection-zones-by-korax.text: Plots a 12-period and a 26-period EMA of the close. The background is green while EMA 12 is above EMA 26 and red while it is below. A green circle under a bar marks EMA 12 crossing above EMA 26, and a red circle above a bar marks it crossing below. It has no inputs.

15-minute-squeeze-scalper.text: Compares Bollinger Bands with Keltner Channels and plots a momentum histogram, a linear regression of the close against the mid of its range and its average. Squeeze Status crosses at zero are red when the bands sit inside the channels, green when outside, blue otherwise. Alerts: Squeeze Fired, Long Momentum, Short Momentum. Inputs: BB Length 20, BB MultFactor 2, KC Length 20, KC MultFactor 1.5.

1m-trend-continuation-signals-ssl-bb-fil.text: Combines a Trend EMA of the close, an SSL channel built from moving averages of the high and low, and Bollinger Bands. A buy marker appears when the close is above the Trend EMA, SSL Up crosses over SSL Down and the close is above BB Upper; a sell is the mirror case with BB Lower. Inputs: Trend EMA Length 200, SSL Channel Length 10, BB Length 150, BB Std Dev 2.

24-hour-volume.text: Shows as columns the traded value over the last 24 hours: the sum of price times volume of lower-timeframe bars (1 minute, 5 minute or 60 minute depending on the chart), or of chart bars as an estimate if those are missing. Each column is the rolling sum at that bar. Inputs: Price Source (close) and Target Currency (Default, no conversion).

2b-reversal-pattern.text: Finds swing highs and lows using Period bars on each side (20), then watches for a close beyond one that fails. If the close crosses back through the break bar's low (or high) within Minimum Break Length (3) to Maximum Break Length (10) bars, a solid line and triangle mark the pattern: below the bar for up, above for down. Alerts: Breakout Up, Breakout Down.

3-bar-reversal.text: Tracks how many bars have passed since a close at or above, and at or below, the prior close. When either count hits 3, the bar two back is coloured purple and the Market Reversal alert fires. A lime triangle below a bar appears when the down-side count reaches 4, a red triangle above when the up-side count reaches 4.

3-confirmation-bear.text: Plots an EMA of the close and a hidden RSI line. A red label appears above a bar when the close is below the EMA, the RSI is below the threshold, and the bar's high and low are both under the highest high and lowest low of the prior lookback bars. Inputs: EMA Length (15), RSI Length (14), RSI Threshold (50), Downtrend Lookback Period (5).

3-confirmation-bull.text: Marks a green label below a bar when the close is above its EMA, the RSI is above a threshold, and the bar makes both a higher high and a higher low than the prior lookback window. It plots the close, EMA 15 and a hidden RSI Value. Inputs: EMA Length (15), RSI Length (14), RSI Threshold (50), Uptrend Lookback Period (5).

3-in-1-custom-moving-average-indicator.text: Combines Bollinger Bands (a chosen average of the source plus and minus a standard deviation multiple) with up to three EMA or SMA lines. MA1 and MA2 are yellow when the close is at or above them and red otherwise; MA3 is off by default. Defaults: Length 26, StdDev 2, MA1 EMA 21, MA2 EMA 55, MA3 EMA 100. Spike Alert fires when a candle's open-to-close move reaches Candle Move % (2).

3-lines-rci-psy-signal-rsi-background.text: Plots three rank-correlation (RCI) lines of the close against time, at lengths RCI 短期 (9), RCI 中期 (26) and RCI 長期 (52), from -100 to 100. Columns show the share of up closes over サイコロジカル期間 (12): red above サイコロジカル買われすぎ (70), green below サイコロジカル売られすぎ (30). ADX is blue when weak, yellow when mid, red above; the background turns red when RSI exceeds RSI 買われすぎライン (68) and green below RSI 売られすぎライン (32).
names: サイコロジカル買われすぎ
サイコロジカル売られすぎ
RSI 買われすぎライン
RSI 売られすぎライン

3rd-wave.text: Builds a zigzag from highest or lowest bars over ZigZag Period (8) and looks for a third-wave start: wave 2 retraces between Min/Max Retracements (0.382 and 0.786) of wave 1, then price breaks wave 1's end. A breakout draws a zone box, waves labelled 0, 1, 2, a triangle and dashed target lines. Check Volume Support (true) requires rising volume trend on the breakout bar.

5-minute-buy-sell-signal.text: Plots an EMA of the close and prints BUY or SELL labels. BUY needs MACD line above signal, RSI below RSI Oversold Level (30), close above EMA 50 and volume above its average; SELL is the mirror, with RSI above RSI Overbought Level (70). Uses EMA Length 50 and Volume Moving Average Length 20.

50-body-candle.text: Finds candles whose body, the distance between open and close, is at most a set percentage of the high-low range. A small white square is drawn at the middle of the body on each such candle, flagging indecisive bars with small bodies. Minimal Body Size (%) sets that percentage and defaults to 50.

abandoned-baby-bearish.text: Detects a three-candle pattern: a white candle in an uptrend, then a doji whose low sits above the first candle's high, then a black candle whose high stays below the doji's low. It places an AB label on a match, and the alert fires on each new pattern. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the uptrend is judged.

abandoned-baby-bullish.text: Detects a three-candle pattern: a black candle in a downtrend, then a doji whose high sits below the first candle's low, then a white candle whose low stays above the doji's high. A match gets an AB label, and the alert fires on each new pattern. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the downtrend is judged.

abc-on-recursive-zigzag.text: Builds a zigzag of pivots with Length (13) and stacks higher-level zigzags from it, then looks for A-B-C swings whose C retraces 0.618 to 0.786 of A-B. Entry, target and stop are projected from the ABC extension or BC retracement (Base) using Entry Ratio (0.3), Target Ratio (1) and Stop Ratio (0), and drawn as red stop and green target boxes. Trade Condition filters by pivot type.

abdullah.text: Combines a zero-lag least-squares line (ZLSMA, Length 32), a Chandelier Exit and an EMA. Long Stop and Short Stop trail the highest or lowest close by ATR Multiplier (3) times ATR (ATR Period 22); a direction flip gives Buy or Sell labels. The EMA has Length 9 and an optional smoothing Type, default None.

absolute-strength-index.text: Ranks the latest return over Returns Lookback bars against the recent one-bar returns, scaled between a loser and winner percentile threshold to run from -1 to 1. ASI is drawn with ASI-based MA as its signal line, and bands sit at 8, 0 and -8; readings above 5 or below -5 get gradient shading. With Divergence on, Bull and Bear labels appear. Defaults: Returns Lookback 15, Signal Line SMA, Signal Length 14.

absorption-arrows-v2.text: Ranks each bar's volume against percentiles over a Short Window (20), Medium Window (50) and Long Window (100), at Small (75), Medium (90) and Big (97) levels, with Consensus Mode deciding how many windows must agree. A down arrow above the high marks a bar whose midpoint lies in the upper wick, an up arrow below the low a lower-wick midpoint. Arrow distance is ATR Length (14) times ATR Multiplier (0.3).

absorption-bubbles.text: Divides volume by its standard deviation over Lookback Period (100). When a bar's midpoint lies in the upper wick a green bubble marks selling absorption; in the lower wick a red one marks buying absorption. Bigger bubbles mean higher scaled volume above Absorption Threshold (0.1). Show Bubbles? toggles them.

abusuhil-bullish-candles.text: Labels six bullish candle patterns below the bar: Hammer, Bullish Engulfing, Morning Star, Piercing Line, Three White Soldiers and Three Inside Up. They count only after a decline, with the close and two previous closes under the 20-period EMA. Optional filters, off by default: Enable Stochastic Filter (K Period 14, D Period 3, Smooth 3) and Enable Volume Filter (Volume Multiplier 1).

acceleration-bands-htf.text: Three simple moving averages over the same window: Upper averages the high stretched upward by four times the bar's range relative to high plus low, Lower averages the low shrunk the same way, and Middle averages the close. Price pushing toward or beyond Upper or Lower shows it moving far from its average. The only input is Lookback Window (20,80), default 80.

accumulation-distribution.text: Keeps a running total of each bar's money flow volume: the close's position within the high-low range, scaled from -1 to +1, multiplied by volume. Bars with no range add zero. A rising Accumulation/Distribution line means closes are mostly near the highs on volume; a falling one means closes near the lows. It has no inputs.

accurate-swing-trading.text: Tracks the highest high and lowest low over Swing Length bars (3). A close above the prior high sets an up direction and below the prior low a down direction; TSL follows the swing low when up, else the swing high. The line is green when the close is at or above it, red otherwise. BUY and SELL labels mark closes crossing the TSL, matching the Buy Signal and Sell Signal alerts.

activity-and-volume-orderflow-profile.text: Builds a volume profile over the last Profile Lookback bars (70), split into Profile Resolution rows (20). Bars that closed up add to buy volume and down bars to sell volume for each row their range touches. Comparison shows buy and sell rows on opposite sides of an axis; Net Order Flow shows one net row per level. A heatmap shades busier rows.

actually-engulfing-candlesticks.text: Flags bullish bars when volume beats its average, the prior low is the lowest of the last Reversal Lookback (5) bars, close tops the highest high of the last Engulfing Lookback (2) bars, and RSI is under 50 but above its average. Bearish mirrors this. Lime circles sit below bullish bars, fuchsia above bearish; RSI Lookback is 14.

ad-money-flow.text: Money flow is the RMA over ADMF period length (9) of volume, optionally times hlc3, times the close change divided by true range. It is smoothed by MA smoother for ADMF (EMA, length 2) into A/D Money Flow smoothed, then again into Signal (EMA, length 2); the Histogram is their difference. Ribbon, histogram and bars are green when the histogram is positive, red otherwise; circles mark crossings of the two lines.

adaptive-alma-2-0.text: An ALMA whose window, offset and sigma adapt to how efficient the recent price movement is: short and responsive in clean trends, longer and smoother in noise. Adaptive ALMA is drawn with optional Medium ALMA and Long ALMA, noise bands, and ALMA Bollinger bands; triangle and circle markers flag trend turns and band crosses. Min. Length is 3 and Max. Length is 21.

adaptive-average-sentiment-oscilator.text: Measures bar and group-of-bars buying pressure from the Data Source, weights it by volume, smooths it with an adaptive ALMA, and by default turns it into a percentile rank. Adaptive Bulls is lime above the gray zone and red below; Adaptive Bears is its mirror. Key inputs: Min. Length 3, Max. Length 14, Overbought Level (OB) 68, Oversold Level (OS) 32.

adaptive-convergence-divergence.text: A MACD-style oscillator from two adaptive averages whose smoothing speed varies with the MA Type (default ARSI). ACD is fast minus slow (Length: Fast 12, Slow 26), or a percent difference with Use PPO (vs MACD); Signal (9) smooths it and Histogram is the gap. Colour follows whether ACD is above Signal.

adaptive-ehlers-filtered-percentile.text: Builds a volatility-adaptive EMA, smooths it with a weighted Ehlers filter, and adds bands at a percentile of the price distance from that filter. A close beyond a band sets a bullish or bearish regime; the Adaptive Ehlers Filter takes its colour, and Long Signal and Short Signal mark changes. Percentile Length is 50, Percentile Level 75.

adaptive-entropy-trend.text: An EMA of the close whose speed adapts to the Shannon entropy of recent log returns, with inner and outer ATR bands that widen when returns are more concentrated. The trend turns up when the close is above Inner Upper and down when below Inner Lower; lines, fills and candles take the trend colour. Inputs: Entropy Lookback 25, Fast Band Multiplier 1.8, Slow Band Multiplier 3.5.

adaptive-friction-filter.text: A step line that stays flat until price moves away from it by more than a friction threshold: the average absolute bar change over Friction Window (20) times Friction Coefficient (1.5). Then it closes a share of the gap set by Catch-Up Sensitivity (0.5). A rising line is bullish, a falling one bearish, with stronger colour for steeper slopes.

adaptive-gaussian-afr.text: A 4-pole Gaussian filter of hl2 whose length shrinks or grows with the ratio of short to long ATR, plus a trailing level that ratchets at ATR times a factor from the filter. The Adaptive Gaussian AFR line and candles are blue when the close is above the prior level, purple otherwise. Inputs: ATR Period 14, ATR Factor 1.5, Gaussian Base Length 20, Adaptive Lookback 10.

adaptive-heikin-ashi.text: Draws Heikin Ashi candles whose open blends the prior open and close with a weight near 0.5, shifted by ATR relative to its own average. Candles are green when the HA close is above the HA open, else red. Main inputs: ATR Length 14, Oscillation Range 0.2, Adapt Sensitivity 6. Show Adaptive Weight plots the weight, off by default.

adaptive-hull-ma.text: A Hull moving average whose length shrinks toward Minimum Period (172) when the Charger (Volatility by default: ATR 14 above ATR 46) is on and grows toward Maximum Period (233) otherwise. Its colour shows slope: bright for strong trends, yellow when the slope is under Consolidation Slope Threshold (17). A faster Minor HMA+ and optional zones at Distance Multiplier (2.7) ATRs are available.

adaptive-kinetic-ribbon.text: Follows price with a kinetic line whose speed adapts: big moves over the Lookback Period (20) pull it closer, while volatility scaled by Volatility Sensitivity (1.5) slows it. Fast Ribbon Period (3) and Slow Ribbon Period (8) averages of it form the ribbon. The colour shows fast above or below slow and whether the fast line is rising, with bars matching.

adaptive-macd.text: A MACD built recursively from close changes, where the damping factor depends on R², a trend-strength measure from correlating price with bar index. Signal is an EMA of MACD, and Histogram is the gap between them, with brighter shades when it is growing in its direction. Inputs: R² Period 20, Fast Length 10, Slow Length 20, Signal Length 9.

adaptive-ml-trailing-stop.text: An ATR trailing stop whose distance widens when the efficiency ratio of the close is low, nudged by a nearest-neighbour forecast and smoothed, so the long stop only rises and the short stop only falls. Long Stop shows while the trend is up, Short Stop while down; a close through the opposite stop flips the trend. Key inputs: ATR Period 21, Base ATR Multiplier 2.5, Adaptive Strength 1, K Neighbors 7.

adaptive-nadaraya-watson.text: Fits a Gaussian-weighted kernel regression of the source over the Lookback Window (50) to draw a fair value line, with inner and outer bands set by the average absolute error times the multipliers (1.5 and 2.8). Line colour shifts with slope strength. Triangles mark rejections of a band by a reversing candle, filtered by weakening momentum. Base Bandwidth (h) is 8.

adaptive-pivot-zones.text: Takes the range between the last pivot low and last pivot high and draws three levels inside it, each smoothed by an SMA, with fills between them. The lines turn bullish when the close is above the highest level and bearish below the lowest, otherwise keeping the prior colour. Alerts fire on crosses of the middle line. Main inputs: Pivot Length (10), Smoothing Length (1), and the levels 0.382, 0.5 and 0.618.

adaptive-rolling-z-score-channel.text: Computes a rolling z-score of the source over the Rolling Window (80) and turns z-based band levels back into price bands around the Basis average. In Adaptive Band Mode the levels come from the Upper Percentile (95) and Lower Percentile (5) of the z-score. Price beyond the Upper Band or Lower Band is stretched; triangles mark re-entries back inside.

adaptive-rsi-lyro-rs.text: Rescales RSI around 50 to a -100 to 100 range (or uses fast minus slow EMA of RSI in the old style), drawn as ARSI columns with a Signal Line and Upper Band and Lower Band from its standard deviation. Column colours depend on where ARSI or the signal sits relative to the bands. Inputs: RSI Length 20, Signal Smoothing 15, Band Length 22.

adaptive-support-and-resistance-zones.text: Turns confirmed pivot highs and lows into resistance and support lines with ATR-sized zones, skipping weak pivots and ones too near an existing level. A close beyond a level by the break buffer turns it into a grey dotted broken level with a "< Break" label. Key inputs: Pivot Length (5), Min ATR Strength (0.1), Max Active Levels Each (5), Break Sensitivity (ATR x) (0.1).

adaptive-trend-channel.text: Smooths high, low and close with linear regression, then tracks a bull or bear regime that flips on trail breaks. Mid channel only rises in bull and only falls in bear; Lower band shows in bull, Upper band in bear, at ATR-based distance. Circles mark flips. Linear regression span is 7, Envelope reaction length 2, Half-channel ATR factor 2.

adaptive-trend-finder.text: Fits a regression line to the logarithm of the source over 19 candidate periods (20 to 200 bars) and keeps the one with the highest Pearson correlation. That line becomes the channel midline, with outer lines at Deviation Multiplier (default 2) times the residual deviation. A table shows the period, strength and annualized return. Use Long-Term Channel switches to 300 to 1200 bars.

adaptive-trend-flow.text: Averages a fast and a slow EMA of hlc3 into Basis, and builds bands around it from smoothed standard deviation times Sensitivity (2). Trend turns bullish when close rises above the upper band and bearish when it drops below the lower. Level is the lower band in uptrends and the upper in downtrends. Alerts fire on trend changes. Main Length is 10 and Smoothing Length is 14.

adaptive-volatility-scaled-oscillator.text: Takes the log of source times a chosen volatility measure, scales it, and shows its Z-score over Bars to Analyze as columns in Scaled Volatility, with Adaptive Smoothing, an EMA that lengthens as the Z-score grows. Readings beyond the High Volatility (level 2) or Low Volatility (level -2) lines tint the background. Volatility Measure defaults to Standard Deviation, Bars to Analyze 20, Smoothing Period 5.

adjusted-rsi.text: Takes RSI minus 50, smooths it with an SMA and clamps it to -10..10. It is then rescaled to its recent range, exponentially smoothed, rescaled and smoothed again, and re-centred around zero. The line is blue when rising or flat and purple when falling, with a fill toward Zero. RSI Length defaults to 42, RSI Smoothing Length 34, Smoothing Length 34, Smoothing Factor 0.2.

adr.text: Averages each bar's high-minus-low range with a simple average over Length bars (default 14) and shows it as ADR in its own pane. A higher line means bars have recently been wider; a lower line means tighter ranges. It carries no direction.

adr-average-daily-range-by-mikec.text: Averages the ratio of each day's high to its low over the last length bars, then converts it to a percentage: 100 times the average minus 1. A higher ADR line means days typically span a wider percentage range, so it reads as a volatility gauge. On intraday charts it uses the latest completed day. length defaults to 20.

adr-bars.text: Counts up bars (close at or above open) and down bars over the last length bars, then divides up by down; if there are no down bars it shows the up count. Values above the Equality Line (level 1) mean more up bars than down bars, below 1 the reverse. length defaults to 9.

adr-contraction-tightness.text: Divides the short average of each bar's range as a percentage of its low by the long average of the same figure. The Contraction Ratio line is lime at or below the Super-tight threshold, yellow at or below the Tight threshold, otherwise dark orange; lower means a tighter recent range. Lengths are 20 and 50, thresholds 0.7 and 0.5.

advanced-dual-hull-cross-suite-v6-precis.text: Plots two Hull-type averages, each with its own Variation (Hma, Thma or Ehma) and Length, defaulting to Hma 14 for suite 1 and Thma 16 for suite 2. Each line takes its up colour while rising and its down colour otherwise. BUY and SELL labels appear on Suite 2 Line when it crosses above or below Suite 1 Line.

advanced-macd-pro-t3-themed.text: MACD Line is the Fast EMA Length (12) EMA minus the Slow EMA Length (26) EMA of the source. MACD Histogram is MACD minus its signal EMA, with colours for strong or weakening bullish and bearish momentum. Extra T3 Signal Line turns green after MACD crosses above it, red after a cross below. Signal Line is hidden by default.

advanced-volume-driven-breakout-signals.text: Splits volume by candle direction and signals when bull or bear volume crosses above its moving average times Breakout Multiplier for VF (2). BUY VOL and SELL VOL labels show when no volume spike occurs; spikes use Threshold Multiplier for VS (4). Optional filters are Use Relative Volume Filter and Use CNV Filter, and Show Overextension Signals marks spikes without a breakout.

advancedlines-paskal.text: Draws an Upper Band at the highest high and a Lower Band at the lowest low of the last Bands Period bars, a Midline halfway between, and Fibonacci levels placed between the bands by ratio. Price near the bands or levels shows where it sits inside the recent range. Fibo 0.764, 0.618, 0.5, 0.382 and 0.236 show by default; the extension levels above and below the range are off. Bands Period is 300.

adx.text: Measures trend strength regardless of direction, from the gap between the positive and negative directional indicators relative to their sum, smoothed into ADX in its own pane. Higher values mean a stronger trend, lower values a weaker one. Inputs are DI Length 14 for the directional indicators and ADX Smoothing 14.

adx-and-di.text: Computes directional movement from highs, lows and true range, each smoothed with a Wilder-style sum over len (14). DI+ and DI- show the strength of upward and downward movement as a percentage of range. ADX averages the gap between them over len bars, rising when one side dominates. A horizontal line is drawn at th (20).

adx-and-rsi-combo.text: Plots two RSIs of the close, with rises and falls averaged by an SMA or RMA, plus DI+, DI- and an ADX built from Wilder sums over ADX Length. Levels at 85 and 15 mark the extremes; with Show RSI Triggers, a green triangle appears on RSI2 when it rises from below 15, a red one when it falls from above 85. Defaults: RSI1 Length 2, RSI2 Length 5, ADX Length 5.

adx-by-cobra.text: Computes DI+ and DI- from Wilder-style sums of directional movement over true range, then ADX as the average of the directional index over Length. A dashed line marks the threshold, and the background shows when DI+ or DI- is above 60 or when one side has led over the last Length1 bars. Defaults: Length 3, Length1 1, threshold 20.

adx-cobra.text: Computes +DI, -DI and ADX with Wilder-style smoothing over ADX Length bars. ADX is teal when it rose from the prior bar and red otherwise; a dashed Strong Trend level sits at 25. The background turns lime when -DI is above 60, orange when +DI is above 60, otherwise green if +DI leads and red if -DI leads. ADX Length defaults to 14.

adx-di-gu5.text: Computes Wilder-smoothed Di+ and Di- directional lines and an ADX from them. ADX is orange at or below Range Level 20; above it, green when Di+ leads and red when Di- leads, darker while ADX rises. Markers flag trend entries and exits, and a Trend Level of 35 gives a strong-trend threshold for alerts. Other inputs: ADX Smoothing 14, DI Length 14, Bar Coloring on.

adx-extreme-zones-divergences.text: Computes the ADX from the directional movement system, with optional +DI and -DI lines. The ADX turns the extreme colour and is filled at or above ADX extreme (highlight ≥), default 60; a dashed line marks ADX cutoff (line), default 40. Divergences compare ADX pivots with price pivots; regular bullish and bearish are shown, hidden ones are off by default. Main inputs: DI length 7, ADX smoothing 7.

adx-trend-strength-filter-trama.text: Draws TRAMA, an adaptive average that speeds up when the highest high or lowest low of TRAMA Length (99) bars keeps changing, plus an SMA of the close (SMA Length 200, shown with Show SMA). Bars turn green when the close is above TRAMA, the RSI's EMA is above its SMA and ADX exceeds ADX Threshold (30); red for the opposite; orange when the close sits between TRAMA and the SMA.

adx-trend-visualizer-with-dual-threshold.text: Computes the Average Directional Index: directional movement and true range are smoothed, giving +DI and -DI, then their normalized difference is smoothed into ADX. The ADX line is green above the Strong Trend Threshold (25), red below the Weak Trend Threshold (15) and yellow between; +DI and -DI are hidden. ADX Length defaults to 14.

adx-valma.text: DI+, DI- and an ADX built with volume-weighted ALMA smoothing, optionally scaled 0 to 100 over the Normalization Lookback (50) in Normalized ADX mode. ADX Final is green when not falling and red when falling; the area between DI+ and DI- is green when DI+ is higher. Triangles on the price chart mark DI crosses. Main inputs: Length 14, Trend Threshold 22.5, DI Smoothing Mode Fast.

adx-with-shaded-zone.text: Computes +DI, -DI and ADX from smoothed true range and upward and downward movement, using Wilder-style smoothing over ADX Length (default 14). +DI above -DI shows upward movement dominating; a higher ADX means a stronger trend. Dotted lines mark 20 and 25, and the background is shaded grey where ADX is below 25.

aegis-prime-flow.text: A WaveTrend-style oscillator: the distance of price from its EMA, scaled by the EMA of that distance, then smoothed. Main Flow Oscillator is teal above its 4-bar average and red below; Overbought Boundary and Oversold Boundary sit at 60 and -60. Inputs: Oscillator Calculation Period 14, Signal Smoothness Length 3.

ag-fx-watermark.text: Draws a text watermark on the chart: a title (Tittle, default AG FX TRADING) above a subtitle, plus, when Show Symbol Info is on (default), the close date of the last bar above the ticker and timeframe. It calculates nothing and gives no signals. Each block's corner or centre placement is set by the Vertical Position and Horizontal Position inputs.

aggregated-scores-oscillator.text: Adds a 5-bar average of the Omega ratio to a 7-bar average of the Sortino ratio, both from bar returns over the Calculation Period (150). Aggregated Score turns red above Upper Threshold (overbought) and green below Lower Threshold (oversold), otherwise white. The thresholds blend expanding and rolling deviation bands, using Rolling Window 200 and Upper Band Sensitivity 0.9.

aggressive-pullback-indicator.text: Flags bullish engulfing candles above the EMA and bearish engulfing candles below it that follow a pullback and pass swing and EMA-touch checks. On a signal, Long Stop Price or Short Stop Price sits at the 5-bar swing extreme plus an ATR buffer, and the target price is the stop distance times R:R:, drawn on the signal bar and the next. Defaults: EMA Length: 50, Stop Distance (ATR): 1, R:R: 1.

aggressive-volume.text: Estimates the aggressive part of each bar's volume as volume times body-to-range ratio, signed by bar direction. Grey Volume Comum columns show total volume; green Volume de Compra (Agressão) shows up-bar estimates and red Volume de Venda (Agressão) shows down-bar estimates. Média Móvel do Volume de Agressão averages the buy part; set by Período da Média Móvel (14) and Tipo de Média Móvel (SMA).
names: Média Móvel do Volume de Agressão

ai-adaptive-oscillator.text: Combines up to five normalised oscillators (RSI, CCI, Stochastic, MACD, volume momentum), weighting each by how often its sign predicted the next close change, then smooths the sum adaptively and scales it to about +-6. Blue above zero, amber below; labels mark turns beyond adaptive thresholds, with cooldown. Inputs: Base Length (14), Learning Lookback Period (150), Ensemble Size (5).

ai-breakout-bands.text: Smooths the close with a Kalman filter, then averages recent estimates weighted by closeness, and sets bands at Band Multiplier (2.1) times the mean absolute error over Band Lookback (MAE) (100). The Smoothed Kalman Trend line takes the positive colour when the close is above the Upper Band, the negative colour below the Lower Band, otherwise by its slope over Slope Calculation Window (20).

ai-engulfing.text: Plots a simple average of closes over Trend Length bars and marks engulfing candles that go against it. A Bull arrow appears below a bar when a bullish candle engulfs the prior bearish one while the close is under the SMA. A Bear arrow appears above a bar for the reverse, with the close above the SMA. Trend Length defaults to 20.

ai-infinity.text: Colours candles by whether the MACD (12, 26, 9) is above its signal, with shade scaled by the MACD gap in Gradient mode. It also draws levels at 0, 10, 40, 50, 60, 90 and 100% of the 100-bar range, ATR glow bands beyond RSI 100 and RSI 0, optional Alligator lines and EMAs. Alerts cover MACD crosses and RSI crossing 80 or 20. Inputs: RSI Length (14), ATR Length (14).

ai-moving-average.text: Builds a moving average and classifies it with nearest-neighbour voting on past values: lime means bullish, red bearish, blue neutral. A slope line is fitted since the last switch, and AI(2) averages the closest past values. Key inputs: Select MA SMA, Neighbors 5, DataPoints 10, Number of Closest Values 15, Smoothing Period 20.

ai-source-switching-moving-average.text: Scores open, high, low and close with a nearest-neighbour search over past feature patterns plus an online neural score, then feeds the best-ranked, smoothed source into a moving average and an adaptive ATR trail. AI Supertrend Up and Down show the trail side; flips and source changes can alert. Main inputs: MA Type EMA, MA Length 50, Analog Count 9, ATR Length 10, ATR Multiplier 1.7.

ai-trading-assistant-v2.text: Draws VWAP, Resistance (highest high) and Support (lowest low) over Structure Lookback (50), plus an EMA volume-delta proxy smoothed by Delta Smoothing (14). LONG and SHORT labels mark breaks of the prior resistance confirmed by delta and VWAP; TRAP labels mark failed pierces of support or resistance. A dot marks volume above average times Volume Spike Multiplier (1.5).

ai-trend-navigator.text: A nearest-neighbour moving average: from recent Price Value readings it keeps the Number of Closest Values nearest the Target Value and averages them, then smooths this into the Knn Classifier Line, coloured by rising, falling or flat. Average Knn Classifier Line is a slower smoothing. Defaults: hl2, length 5; Price Action, length 5; 3 closest values; Smoothing Period 50.

ai-volume-signals.text: Compares each bar's volume with its EMA and calls a spike when volume exceeds the EMA times a multiplier. A spike on a rising candle closing above the 50 EMA prints a green BUY label below the bar; a spike on a falling candle closing below it prints a red SELL label above. Inputs: Volume EMA Length (20), Multiplier (for spike detection) (2), Show Volume EMA (false) to draw Volume EMA.

ai-weighted-rsi.text: Predicts the next RSI from five prior-bar features (return, RSI, ATR ratio, volume change, volume) using their correlations over the Learning Window, then turns it into a weight from -2 to 2 plotted as AI-Weighted RSI, with an SMA Signal Line. Dashed levels sit at 0.5, 0 and -0.5; fills shade the area to zero. Defaults: RSI Length 14, Signal Length 20, Learning Window 20.

ak-trend-id.text: Plots the gap between a fast and a slow EMA of the Source, multiplied by 1.001, as Spread against a flat Zero Line. Spread is green above zero and red below, and price bars are coloured the same way by its sign. Fast EMA defaults to 3, Slow EMA to 8, Source to close.

al-brooks-ii-ioi-oo.text: Finds inside bars (lower high, higher low than the prior bar) and outside bars (higher high, lower low), then the sequences ii, OO and ioi. Each sequence gets a letter above the bar and a light background; every inside bar gets a blue I and every outside bar a red O below. Toggles 显示 ii 模式, 显示 OO 模式 and 显示 ioi 模式 default on; alerts: ii Pattern Alert, OO Pattern Alert, ioi Pattern Alert.

al-po-s-arithmetic-mean.text: Cumulative arithmetic mean of the Sum source (default close), from the first bar to the current one, drawn as Nocachy Arithmetic Mean on the price pane. Two counters give how many bars the source stayed above or below the mean; equality resets both. They show only in the status line and data window.

algo-market-structure.text: Tracks swing highs and lows from the sequence of bullish and bearish candles on the chart or on Timeframe 1, labelling HH, LH, HL and LL points. Lines mark ILQ, TLQ with BOS breaks, and EPA levels, plus Extreme boxes, VTA ranges and MSU arrows. Show ILQ ?, Show TLQ ?, Show EPA ?, Show Extreme ? and Show VTA ? toggle each part.

all-candlestick-patterns.text: Scans each bar and the few bars before it for 33 candlestick patterns, using body-to-range ratios, shadow lengths and relative opens and closes. Bullish patterns get a green arrow below the bar, bearish ones a red arrow above it, each with the pattern name; the Doji gets a white circle below. It has no inputs, and the Close plot is hidden.

all-in-one-ma-stack-scalper.text: Plots five simple averages of the close: MA 100, MA 48, MA 36, MA 24 and MA 12. A BUY triangle shows when the close is above all five and filters on volatility, candle body, volume, distance from each average, RSI above 55 and ADX above 20 pass. SELL mirrors it below all five with RSI under 45. Signals are more than 10 bars apart. It has no inputs.

all-in-one-rsi-system.text: Plots RSI with an EMA base line, a cloud between them tinted by zone (OS Start 44, OS Extreme 25, OB Start 70, OB Extreme 85), Stoch K and Stoch D, divergence markers and a shifted Williams Vix Fix histogram. BUY and SELL labels appear when RSI crosses these levels. Defaults: RSI Period 14, RSI Base EMA 14.

all-in-one-sessions-weekly-monday-previo.text: Draws key levels on the last bar: Monday high/low, previous day, current and previous week, and current and previous month high/low, each with an optional 50% line, label and extension. It also boxes the Asia, London and New York sessions as they develop, and can draw custom time-range levels. Show Monday High/Low, Show Prev Day High/Low and Show Previous Week High/Low are on by default; Abbreviate Labels is on.

all-patterns.text: Combines 44 candlestick pattern detectors, drawing labels below bullish bars and above bearish ones. Pattern Type (default Both) filters bullish or bearish ones, and each pattern has an on/off toggle; Abandoned Baby, Doji, Dragonfly Doji, Engulfing and Hammer start on. Detect Trend Based On defaults to SMA50.

allma-trend-radar.text: Plots a Fast MA (default DEMA, length 14) and a Slow MA (default SMA, length 14) of the close, each selectable from many types. Buy and Sell triangles mark fast/slow crossings (Up/Down Signal, on by default) or fast above/below slow (Greater/Less Signal), with Min Bars spacing (3 and 5). Optional RSI, MFI and Stochastic filters can restrict signals.

alma.text: Plots a Gaussian-weighted moving average of the close over Length bars (default 9) on the price pane. Offset (default 0.85) sets where the weighting peaks in the window, and Sigma (default 6) sets how narrow that weighting is. The ALMA line tracks price with less lag than an equal-weight average.

alma-bands.text: Plots two Arnaud Legoux moving averages of the chosen source, each with its own length, offset and sigma. The fill between ALMA 1 and ALMA 2 is cyan when ALMA 1 is above ALMA 2 and red otherwise; alerts fire when ALMA 1 crosses over or under ALMA 2. Defaults: ALMA 1 Length 20, Offset 0.85, ALMA 2 Offset 0.77, Sigma 6.

alma-sd-bands-rakoquant.text: Draws an ALMA of the source with bands at a multiple of a smoothed standard deviation. A bullish regime starts when the close exceeds the ALMA Basis plus a deadband and a bearish one when it falls below minus the deadband; the bands turn lime or red and hold until the opposite crossing. Alerts fire on each regime start. Key inputs: Mode Daily / Swing, Source high, Band Multiplier (σ) 0.4, Deadband (in σ) 0.35.

alpha-sutte-model.text: Draws Alpha-Sutte, a forecast from the relative changes among the previous four closes, weighted by those closes. Adaptive Alpha Sutte averages it with a line from the close, the prior close and the bar's range. Sutte Low MA and Sutte High MA are moving averages of the two range-based lines. Sutte MA length defaults to 1, which leaves them unsmoothed.

alpha-trading-signal-up-side-down.text: A SuperTrend: lines set at the Source minus or plus ATR Multiplier times the ATR, which only tighten while the trend holds. The Up Trend line shows in an uptrend, the Down Trend line in a downtrend; Buy and Sell labels mark where the trend flips, and a fill to OHLC4 is green or red. Defaults: ATR Period 10, ATR Multiplier 3, Source hl2.

alpha-trend.text: AlphaTrend builds a trailing line from the low minus, or high plus, an average true range band, using the money flow index to pick the side and only letting it move in the trend's direction. It is drawn with a copy of itself two bars back; AlphaTrend crossing AlphaTrend[2] gives BUY or SELL labels. Inputs: Multiplier (1), Common Period (14), Show Signals? (on), Use RSI instead of MFI (off).

alphatrend-screener.text: AlphaTrend trails below price by ATR times Multiplier (default 1) when money flow is 50 or more, else above price; Trigger is the line two bars back. Their crossings give BUY and SELL labels, and the fill is green while the line rises. A label list after the last bar shows direction and bars since change for up to 20 symbols. Length defaults to 14.

amd-po3-with-live-edge-stats.text: Follows an accumulation, manipulation, distribution cycle: it anchors a range after narrow compression, flags a sweep beyond a boundary, and opens a reference trade when the close returns inside. Boxes, labels and entry, stop and target lines mark it. Inputs: Min range maturity, bars 12, Max range age, bars 96, Max bars until return 6, Fib extension target 1.5.

anchored-bollinger-band-range.text: Collects bars between Start Period and End Period within the last 1001 bars. Four high targets sit above the latest high by 1 to 4 standard deviations of highs. Four low targets sit below the latest low by the same steps of lows. OBR High is the mean of average high and low, shown by Plot Breakout Range Moving Average.

anchored-vwap-pro.text: Volume-weighted average price accumulated from an anchor date, with volume-weighted standard deviation bands. Nothing is drawn before the anchor. Price above Anchored VWAP means it trades over the average paid since the anchor; the bands show distance in deviations. Inputs: Anchor Year 2022, Anchor Month 11, Anchor Day 21, VWAP Source hlc3, Band 1 Multiplier 1.5, Band 2 Multiplier 2.5.

anchored-vwap-with-buy-sell-signals.text: Computes a volume-weighted average of the typical price (high, low, close) accumulated from the Anchor Date onward, with nothing drawn before it. A BUY label appears when the close crosses above AVWAP and a SELL label when it crosses below, each with a faint green or red background on that bar. Anchor Date sets the starting bar.

andromeda-trendsync.text: Plots two moving averages of the close and calls an uptrend when the MACD histogram is positive, Média Móvel 1 is above Média Móvel 2 and the latter rises (downtrend is the mirror). Lines turn blue, red or grey by trend. Buy Signal is a low crossing under either average in an uptrend; Sell Signal is a high crossing over in a downtrend. Defaults: periods 9 and 20, Período RSI 6.

angle-attack-follow-line-indicator.text: Builds a follow line that steps up or down when the close breaks Bollinger bands, then plots its angle in degrees over Angle Period (8), scaled by ATR, as a line and histogram with four levels. Blue means up trend, red otherwise. Labels mark trend changes, adds and reduces; Max Angle Level 1 is 40 and Level 2 is 65.

anti-volume-stop.text: Sets a trailing stop at the close minus or plus an ATR of Length bars, scaled by current volume divided by its Length-bar average. Stop Level is teal below price in an uptrend and red above price in a downtrend; it flips side when the close crosses it, and otherwise only moves in the trend's favour. Length defaults to 14.

apex-volatility-squeeze-breakout.text: Draws Bollinger-style bands around the close average, smoothed by an EMA, and flags a squeeze when band width falls below the ATR-based width. Trend turns bullish on a close above the smoothed upper band and bearish below the lower band, outside a squeeze; colours follow bullish, bearish or squeeze state. Lookback Length is 20, Band Multiplier (StDev) 2, Squeeze Multiplier (ATR) 1.5, Band Smoothing 5.

arnaud-legoux-gaussian-flow-alphanatt.text: A Gaussian-weighted average of recent closes, smoothed by an EMA, with an envelope of ten fading levels per side whose width comes from ATR, scaled by momentum. The ALMA Gaussian line is cyan when the close is above it and magenta otherwise; Upper Envelope and Lower Envelope mark the outer bands. Key inputs are ALMA Period (21), Envelope Mode (Adaptive) and Envelope Multiplier (1.5).

aroon.text: Measures how many bars ago the highest high and the lowest low occurred within the lookback, scaled to 0-100. Aroon Up near 100 means a recent high; Aroon Down near 100 means a recent low. Values near 0 mean the extreme is old. Input: length (14).

aroon-oscillator.text: Aroon Up minus Aroon Down over Length bars (default 14), based on how recently the highest high and lowest low occurred. It ranges from -100 to 100 in its own pane. Green above or at zero and red below show which extreme is more recent; dashed levels sit at 0, 90 and -90.

aroon-with-rsi-confirmation.text: Computes Aroon Up and Aroon Down from bars since the highest high and lowest low, and compares RSI with its moving average. A BUY circle appears below the bar when Aroon Down is near 92.86, RSI is above its average and within Max RSI Difference (pts) of it; a SELL circle above when Aroon Up is near 92.86 and RSI is below. Inputs: Aroon Length (14), Max RSI Difference (pts) (4.6), Aroon 92.86 Tolerance ± (0.2).

asdqwe123-2-0.text: Combines a volume-weighted trend filter with a running mean of the close to flip between buy and sell states, marking changes with BUY and SELL labels and colouring bars green or red. Upper ATR Band and Lower ATR Band sit at the close plus or minus ATR times a multiplier. Key inputs: Period (40), Alpha (0.9), ATR Period (14), both multipliers 1.5.

asian-london-session-high-low.text: Tracks the highest high and lowest low of bars opening in the Asian session (00:00-08:00) and the London session (09:00-16:30), in Europe/Sofia time. Asian High, Asian Low, London High and London Low are drawn as price-pane lines that hold their values until bars at or after 16:30 reset them. They show each session's range as reference levels; there are no inputs.

asiasessionhighlowmidlines.text: Tracks the running high and low of a daily Session (default 1800-0200, exchange time) and draws them as lines with a middle line and a shaded box from the session start. When the session ends, the high, low, box and middle line stay on the chart, and the next session starts fresh levels. The high and low read as the session range.

ask-weighted-averages.text: Volume-weighted average price of each bar's mid-price, counting only ask volume: full volume on an up close, none on a down close, half otherwise. Continuous Weighted Avg is drawn on every bar over Continuous Length (20). Conditional Weighted Avg, over Conditional Length (20), appears only where rounded dollar volume exceeds Dollar Volume Threshold (1).

asset-risk-metrics.text: Divides the risk source by the running all-time high, then scales by an RSI value, giving a risk figure from 0 to 1 split into 5% bands. Each band has its own colour, shown as a circle at the chosen price or as a coloured bar; Risk since ATH can draw the last all-time high. Inputs include Risk source (high), RSI Length (14), Enable VWAP of RSI and Enable MA of RSI (both off).

asymmetric-volatility-trend-line.text: A trend line based on standard deviation times a multiplier. In an up trend it ratchets higher when price is half a threshold above it and flips down when price falls a full threshold below; a down trend mirrors this. The line is coloured by trend, and a marker shows the line value before each reversal. Threshold Multiplier 1.5, Volatility Lookback 20.

atr.text: Computes each bar's true range, which includes gaps from the prior close, and smooths it into ATR in its own pane. Higher values mean larger typical bar movement, lower values mean quieter trading; it does not show direction. Length defaults to 14 and Smoothing to RMA, with SMA, EMA and WMA as alternatives.

atr-bands.text: Draws bands at the close plus and minus ATR times a scale factor, giving the Upper ATR Band and Lower ATR Band as stop-style levels. With the opposite bands option on, the Upper Take-Profit Band and Lower Take-Profit Band mirror the distance to the other band, multiplied by Take-Profit Scale Factor. Inputs: ATR Period 3, ATR Band Scale Factor 2.5, Take-Profit Scale Factor 1.5.

atr-based-zigzag-w-ema.text: Tracks a trend with an ATR zigzag: in an uptrend it follows the highest high and turns down when the low falls more than ATR Multiplier times ATR below it; a downtrend mirrors this. Trend Line is the EMA of the high-low midpoint, coloured by trend, and bars take the same colour. Defaults: ATR Length 14, ATR Multiplier 5, Line Smoothness (EMA Length) 50.

atr-fibonacci-trend-envelopes.text: Builds a moving average of the close with envelopes of ATR times a multiplier; the trend flips up when the close crosses over the upper envelope and down when it crosses under the lower one. Trend MA follows the lower envelope in an uptrend, the upper in a downtrend, with Fib 0.5, Fib 0.618 and Fib 0.786 measured from it. Defaults: MA Type RMA, MA Length 100, ATR Length 100, ATR Multiplier 3.

atr-hema.text: Draws a Holt-style exponential average of the Source (hl2), with level smoothing from Alpha Length and trend smoothing from Gamma Length (both 20). The HEMA line is bullish when rising and bearish when falling, keeping its previous colour if the change is below ATR Length (14) times Neutral Zone Multiplier (ATR) (0.04). L and S triangles mark colour flips; Colour Candles? (off) paints candles.

atr-normalized-vwma-deviation.text: Divides the gap between ohlc4 and its VWMA by ATR, giving ATR-Normalized Deviation, drawn against Zero, Upper Band and Lower Band lines. Background colours mark a new extreme in both deviation and price beyond a band, confirmed by a candle in the signal direction; Use MAD filter adds a MAD requirement. Defaults: Lookback (extremes), ATR Length and VWMA Length 100; bands 5 and -5.

atr-plus.text: Measures stop sizes in whole price units: ATR rounded, plus long and short entry sizes from the close to the lowest low or highest high over Lookback bars, plus a stop (ATR times Stop Distance when Use ATR Multiplier is on). Target sizes are entry sizes times R/R. Defaults: R/R 1, ATR Length 14, Lookback 3, Stop Distance (pips or ATR) 1.

atr-rope.text: Computes a rope that follows the source but moves only by the part of each move exceeding ATR Len times Multi (defaults 14 and 1.5). The Rope is coloured by direction and turns to the flat colour when the source crosses it. While flat, Consolidation Ranges (on) shade the running averages of the channel. ATR Channel (off) shows Upper and Lower.

atr-scaled-deviation-oscillator.text: Divides the close change over Momentum Length (20) by its root mean square over Deviation Length (20), scaled by ATR against its average times ATR Reaction Multiplier (1.5), and smooths it with a 2-bar EMA into Oscillator. Crossing above Upper Threshold (1) sets a long trend, below Lower Threshold (-1) a short one, shown by the Zero Line fill and candle colours.

atr-stop-loss-finder.text: Computes a smoothed average true range times a multiplier, then adds it to src1 for ATR Short Stop Loss and subtracts it from src2 for ATR Long Stop Loss. Read the two lines as stop distances above the high and below the low. Defaults: Length 14, Smoothing RMA, Multiplier 1.5, src1 high, src2 low.

atr-trailing-colored.text: Draws a trailing stop at a Multiplier times ATR distance from the close; it only ratchets in the trend's direction and restarts at the new distance when the close crosses it. The line is blue until the first cross, green after a cross above, red after a cross below. Defaults: ATR Length 5, Multiplier 3.5.

atr-trailing-stop-with-atr-targets.text: A trailing stop set ATR Multiplier times ATR below the highest high in an up trend, or above the lowest low in a down trend. A close through the stop flips the trend, shows a Buy or Sell label, and fixes Target 1 ATR, Target 2 ATR and Target 3 ATR at 1, 2 and 3 ATR from the flip close. ATR Period is 14, ATR Multiplier 2, Starting Trend Bullish.

atr-trailing-stoploss.text: Plots a trailing stop: the highest value over the last HHV Period bars of the high minus Multiplier times the ATR over Atr Period, with the close used on the first 15 bars. The line and bars are green while the close is above the stop, red below it and dark grey on a tie. Close crossing the stop triggers the Buy Signal and Sell Signal alerts. Defaults: Atr Period 5, HHV Period 10, Multiplier 2.5.

atr-trailing-stops.text: Builds an ATR from a true range that weights candle body and wicks by percentage, smooths it, and multiplies it. Running mode draws low minus ATR and high plus ATR on each bar. Trailing mode draws a long stop that only rises and a short stop that only falls, flipping sides when the Flip Trail on: source passes the opposite stop. Defaults: ATR Lookback Period 14, ATR Multiplier 3.

atr-trend-color.text: An ATR trailing stop: it follows the close at a distance of ATR times a multiplier, ratcheting in the trend's direction and flipping to the other side of price when the close crosses it. ATR Trail Stop is lime while the close is above it, red while below, gray if equal. Inputs: ATR Period 7, ATR Multiplier 3.1.

atr-volatility-and-trend-analysis.text: Draws three pairs of bands at the close plus and minus the ATR times a multiplier. A circle marks the first bar where the ATR exceeds its average times the Volatility Threshold. Up and down labels mark a new trend state, when the ATR is above its Trend Smoothing average and the close is above or below its average. Defaults: ATR Length 14, multipliers 1, 2, 3, threshold 1.5, smoothing 21.

atr-zlema.text: Computes a zero-lag EMA that only moves when its change exceeds ATR times Noise Filter Threshold, then trails it with an ATR band that flips sides when the ZLEMA crosses it. The trend colours the ATR ZLEMA line and cloud, and triangles mark flips up or down. Defaults: ZLEMA Length 14, ATR Length 14, ATR Multiplier 3.5, Noise Filter Threshold 0.3.

atr20-sma-x3-5-trailing-line.text: Averages the true range with a simple moving average over ATR Length bars, then subtracts ATR Multiplier times that average from the highest high of the last High Lookback bars. The single line trails below price and moves with recent highs and volatility. Defaults: ATR Length 20, ATR Multiplier 3.5, High Lookback 20.

aura-adaptive-statistical-smoother.text: Aura MA is a double-EMA target that moves toward it by R squared, the squared correlation of close with bar index, only when R squared exceeds 0.5. Upper Band and Lower Band sit Volatility Multiplier times the standard deviation around it. Colour follows close above or below the line; Buy Signal and Sell Signal mark crossings when R squared exceeds 0.3. Defaults: Statistical Window 20, Forward-Backward Smoothing 10, Volatility Multiplier 1.5.

aura-sentiment-risk-flow.text: Sentiment Aura is the RSI minus 50, averaged over Smoothing Factor bars, drawn as columns that shade from bearish to bullish and turn grey when momentum fades. Signal Edge traces the same value, and a cross of Zero Line gives a BUY or SELL label; a grey background marks readings beyond 40 either way. Sentiment Length is 14, Smoothing Factor 3, Risk Lookback 22, Risk Multiplier 3.

aura-trend-candlestick-matrix.text: Draws a fast and a slow EMA of the close as a cloud: green when the fast is above the slow, red otherwise. It also plots the latest confirmed pivot high as Dynamic Resistance and pivot low as Dynamic Support, and marks hammers, shooting stars, engulfing patterns and morning or evening stars only when they match the trend. Inputs: Fast EMA Length (20), Slow EMA Length (50), Pivot Detection Length (10).

aura-vortex-oscillator.text: Takes the close's z-score over Vortex Sensitivity (20) bars, multiplies it by Vortex Intensity (2), squashes it with an arctangent to about -100 to 100, then smooths it with an EMA of Aura Smoothing (8) bars. Vortex Pulse is green above 0 and red below; circles mark zero crosses, and background shades beyond the 50 and -50 boundaries.

auto-avwap-with-breakout-screener.text: Draws two self-anchoring volume-weighted averages: High, anchored at the highest high, and Low, at the lowest low, re-anchoring via High Next and Low Next using a smoothed stochastic RSI. A triangle and Breakout Above High Overlay circle mark a close crossing above High. Alerts fire when the open (or close) is beyond either line. Defaults: K Mode WMA, K 4, D 4, RSI 55, Stochastic 21.

auto-fib.text: Draws Fibonacci levels (0, 0.236, 0.382, 0.5, 0.618, 0.786, 1, 1.618) across the highest high and lowest low of the last Fibo Period bars, shown at the latest bar with dashed lines. Levels rise from the low in green when the high is older, else fall from the high in red. Alerts fire on closes crossing 0.236 to 0.786. Defaults: Fibo Period 144, Plot 1.618 Level? on.

auto-fib-channels-by-dgt.text: Finds zigzag pivots using Depth (11) and Deviation (3, a multiple of ATR relative to close), then draws parallel Fibonacci channel lines and horizontal retracement or extension levels from the last pivots. Labels show each level and price; a crossing of a shown level by the close triggers an alert. Historical Channels (0) picks older pivots.

auto-fib-extension.text: Finds swing pivots using Depth (default 10), then takes the latest A-B-C swing whose B-C retracement is 0.236 to 1 of A-B. It projects horizontal extension levels from C by ratios of the A-B move, with labels showing ratio and price. Reverse flips the direction; Show Prices and Show Levels (both on) control label content.

auto-fib-retracement.text: Builds a zigzag from pivots, with a swing threshold based on ATR scaled by Deviation (default 3) and pivot size set by Depth (default 10). Fibonacci retracement levels are drawn across the latest leg, with labels showing ratio and price and fills between levels. Reverse swaps the leg's start and end; Show Prices and Show Levels are on.

auto-fib-retracement-alerts.text: Builds a zigzag of pivots and draws Fibonacci levels over its last leg, with ratio and price texts. The Start, End and Target plots follow the leg ends and the level at the retracement ratio (0.618). Buy Retrace and Sell Retrace mark the first touch of the target after the leg end changed, in an up or down leg. Deviation (5) and Depth (10) set pivot sensitivity.

auto-fib-speed-resistance-fans-by-dgt.text: Builds a zigzag of pivots, using Depth and a Deviation multiple of ATR(10) as the minimum move, then draws Fibonacci fans from the start of the last leg (or an older one via Historical Fans). Price fans and time fans give levels with grid lines, labels and shaded bands. Reverse Fan Levels uses 1 minus each level. Defaults: Deviation 3, Depth 11, Historical Fans 0.

auto-fib-theyangguizi.text: Takes the highest and lowest close of the last fiblength bars and plots Fibonacci levels between them, with coloured fills between neighbouring levels. The 1 line is the highest close and 0 the lowest, with 0.764, 0.618, 0.5, 0.382 and 0.236 in between; the lines move as the window moves. fiblength defaults to 265.

auto-fibo-indicators.text: Computes a chosen oscillator (RSI by default) and takes its highest and lowest values over Auto Fibo Length bars as LOW and HIGH. Fibonacci levels are plotted between them, measured upward from LOW if the price high is older than the price low, otherwise downward from HIGH. IND is the oscillator itself. Defaults: Auto Fibo Length 144, Indicator Length 14, Target Indicator RSI.

auto-key-levels.text: Finds confirmed pivot highs and lows, where a bar's high or low is beyond that of the Pivot Length bars on each side, and keeps the most recent ones. Each is drawn as a dashed horizontal line extending right with its price: red for highs (resistance) and green for lows (support). Pivot Length defaults to 20 and Max Levels to 6.

auto-pattern-detector-targets.text: Tracks pivot highs and lows, set by Pivot Lookback Left and Pivot Lookback Right (10 each), and tests them for chart patterns such as double tops, head and shoulders, flags, wedges and cups. A pattern is drawn with boundary lines, a name label and entry, stop and target lines once price breaks out and Min Risk:Reward Ratio (1) is met. Breakouts use Breakout Threshold (ATR) of 1 and Pattern Cooldown (Bars) of 5.

auto-pitchfan-fib-extension-retracement-.text: Finds zigzag swings from a Depth window (11) and a Deviation (3) times ATR(10) relative to close. From the last three swings it draws a pitchfan: a median line through the middle of the last leg, plus rays at chosen fractions of half that leg, with price labels. Optional Fibonacci retracement or extension levels and the zigzag can be shown. Historical PitchFan/Fibonacci Levels (0) shifts the swings back.

auto-pitchfork.text: Draws a pitchfork from the last three confirmed zigzag pivots, with pivot size set by Depth (default 10). The median line runs through the middle of the last two pivots; parallel lines at chosen levels (0.5 and 1 on by default) mark channel edges, filled between. Type picks Original, Schiff, Modified Schiff or Inside; default Original.

auto-pitchfork-fib-retracement-zig-zag.text: Builds zigzag swings from Deviation (5) and Depth (34), then draws a pitchfork from the last three swings, with a median line, parallel level lines and fills. It also draws Fibonacci extension levels and Camarilla R3-R6 and S3-S6 levels of the prior higher-timeframe period. The Second Pitchfork Type and zigzag lines are off by default.

auto-support.text: Plots pairs of lines: Resistance is the highest close and Support the lowest close over Sensitivity times a multiplier of bars, with multipliers from 1x up to 500x. Short pairs hug recent price, longer ones mark wider extremes. Input: Sensitivity, default 10.

auto-support-resistance.text: Finds pivot highs and lows of the close and plots their closes as step levels: Quick Res and Quick Sup use a short confirmation, Res 1 to Res 3 and Sup 1 to Sup 3 are the latest three regular pivots. A level is green while the close is at or above it, red below. Defaults: Left Bars 50, Right Bars 25, Quick Right 5.

auto-trend-detector.text: Detects confirmed pivot highs and lows, a bar being a pivot when it is beyond the Pivot Length bars on each side. It draws a red line through the last two pivot highs and a green line through the last two pivot lows, both extended right, with triangles marking the pivots. Pivot Length defaults to 10.

auto-trendline.text: Finds fractal highs and lows over the Fractal Period (default 10) and draws dashed lines through the two latest fractals on each side, extended per Which way to extend lines. HL, LH, LL and HH labels mark each new fractal against the previous one; HL and LH show by default. Max pair of lines is 1 by default, and Show crosses marks closes crossing a line.

auto-trendlines-support-resistance-signa.text: Builds a zig zag of pivot highs and lows, classes the points as major or minor, external or internal, and draws up or down trend lines from the last two points of each type when closes stay on the right side. A close through a line gives a Break triangle; a touch that closes back gives a React signal. Pivot Period defaults to 5.

automated-z-scoring.text: Z-Score of the source: its distance from the simple average over length bars, divided by the standard deviation over the same window. The line is blue when above zero and purple otherwise, with a gradient fill toward zero, so readings show how far price sits from its recent mean. Defaults are length 3000 and src close.

average-bullish-bearish-percentage-chang.text: Averages the percentage size of recent up-closing bars and of recent down-closing bars separately. Bullish 𝜟 columns appear on up bars and Bearish 𝜟 columns on down bars, brighter when the average rose since the last bar of that kind. Defaults: Bar Metrics Net Move, Averaging Type Exponential, Past Bullish Bars Count and Past Bearish Bars Count 10. Alerts fire when one average crosses over the other.

average-candle-bodies-range.text: Smooths the candle body (close minus open by default) with a moving average to form Average Candle Bodies Range, plus a Signal Line averaging it again. Upper Baseline and Lower Baseline are its highest and lowest over the period divided by Donchian Calculated Height. Smoothing Type HMA, Period 55, height 3.

average-sentiment-oscillator.text: Marks each bar as bullish (close at or above open) or bearish (close below open), then averages those flags over the last Length bars and scales to percent. Bulls shows the share of up bars and Bears the share of down bars, with a dashed midline at 50, so the higher line shows which side dominated. Length defaults to 10.

awesome-accelerator-zone-oscillator.text: Computes AO as a fast minus slow moving average of the chosen price, and AC as AO minus its own moving average. Zone columns show AO, green when AO and AC both rise, red when both fall, gray otherwise, and bars take that colour. AO and AC are hidden by default. Defaults: Moving Average Type SMA, Fast MA Length 5, Slow MA Length 34, AC MA Length 5, Price Type hl2.

awesome-oscillator.text: Subtracts a 34-bar simple average of the bar midpoint (high plus low, halved) from a 5-bar one, drawn as columns around zero. Columns are green when the value rose from the prior bar and red when it fell or was unchanged. Alerts fire when the bar-to-bar change turns positive (AO color changed to green) or negative (AO color changed to red). It has no inputs.

awesome-oscillator-v2.text: AO is the 5-bar simple average of the bar midpoint minus its 34-bar average, and Signal is a simple average of AO. Positive AO means short-term midpoints sit above the longer average; AO crossing Signal or the zero line shows momentum shifts. Inputs: Fast Period (5), Slow Period (34), Signal Period (7).

b-a-d-v0-4.text: Combines a momentum oscillator (RSI of EMA differences minus 50, with a smoothed line and a long-term histogram), DI+/DI-/ADX, a trend line at 0 (white up, black down) and an EMA Core line. A DI cross becomes a circle on the smoothed line once the long-term reading sits on the matching side of 0. Inputs include ADX Length 14, ADX Threshold 20 and EMA Length 50.

bacap-price-structure-21-ema-trend.text: Draws 21-period EMAs of the high, close and low, with a cloud between the high and low EMAs. EMA Close takes the uptrend colour when all three EMAs rise and the downtrend colour when all fall. With Change Bar Color on (default), bars turn bullish when the close is above all three EMAs and bearish when the high is below EMA Low.

backtesting-trading-engine.text: Simulates trades bar by bar: an entry strategy triggers, the fill comes at the next open, and an entry stop sets the risk unit X. An in-trade stop trails and exits on a close beyond it. Results show as markers, stop levels and data-window stats. Defaults: Main Entry Strat 1. Random, Trade Direction Both, 10. Chandelier filter on.

balanced-price-range.text: Finds overlaps between a bearish and a bullish fair value gap that occur within Bars to Look Back for BPR (10) bars of each other, and draws the overlap as a box. Green boxes are bullish and red boxes bearish; a box keeps extending while price stays outside it and stops once price enters. BPR Threshold (0) sets the minimum height; Only Clean BPR and Delete Old BPR are off.
names: Bars to Look Back for BPR

balanced-price-range-flux-charts.text: Finds three-bar fair value gaps, turns invalidated ones into inverted gaps, and marks a balanced price range when an opposite gap overlaps one. Each is drawn as boxes labelled BPR with a dashed middle line, and triangles mark retests. Main inputs: Sensitivity 2, FVG Invalidation Method Close, BPR Invalidation Method Wick, Show Historic Zones off.

banker-fund-flow.text: Compares two 0-100 normalized series: a double-smoothed stochastic of close over Normalization Length (27), and an EMA of a weighted typical price ranked within Typical Price Length (34) bars. Candles span the two values: green when fund flow is above the other line, red when below, with white and blue variants. A yellow candle marks a cross up while the line is under Entry Threshold (25). EMA Length is 13.

bar-replay-fix.text: Draws on each bar the candle of the previous bar, so candles lag the chart by one bar. Body, wick and border colours depend on whether the previous bar closed above its open, below it, or equal. Candle Body Color, Candle Wick Color and Candle Border Color each hold bullish, bearish and doji settings; the bullish body is fully transparent by default.

bb.text: Draws a moving average of the Source as the Basis, with Upper and Lower bands set StdDev times the rolling standard deviation of the source above and below it. Wider bands mean larger price dispersion; price near a band is far from the Basis in deviation terms. Defaults: Length 20, Basis MA Type SMA, StdDev 2.

bb-bandwidth.text: Measures the distance between the upper and lower Bollinger bands as a percentage of the middle average. Low readings mean narrow bands, high readings mean wide bands. Two extra lines mark the highest and lowest bandwidth over a lookback. Inputs: Length (20), Source (close), StdDev (2), Highest Expansion Length (125), Lowest Contraction Length (125).

bb-bars.text: Redraws each price bar as a two-layer candle rather than computing any bands. A navy outline spans the bar's low to high, and the body from open to close is green when the close is above the open and red otherwise. It has no inputs.

bb-breakout-oscillator.text: Flags bars whose Source is above or below Bollinger-style bands (moving average plus or minus StdDev Mult times deviation), then counts them over Length bars as a percent. Bull is the share of bars above the upper band and Bear the share below the lower band; a higher value means more recent breakouts. Defaults are Length 14, StdDev Mult 1 and close.

bb-fibonacci-ratios.text: Draws a simple moving average of the close as Basis, with three upper and three lower bands set at the average true range multiplied by Fibonacci ratios. Price reaching outer bands means a larger stretch from the Basis. Inputs: Length (20) for both averages, Fib Ratio 1 (1.618), Fib Ratio 2 (2.618), Fib Ratio 3 (4.236).

bb-percent-b.text: Shows where the source sits between the lower and upper Bollinger bands: 0 at the lower band, 1 at the upper band, 0.5 at the middle average. Readings above 1 mean price is above the upper band, below 0 means below the lower band. Inputs: Length (20), Source (close) and StdDev (2) for band distance.

bb-stoch-rsi.text: Draws Bollinger Bands on price (BB Basis, BB Upper, BB Lower) and marks reversals using a smoothed Stochastic RSI. A green up triangle appears when the close returns above the lower band after a close below it with K and D under Lower Limit; a red down triangle mirrors it at the upper band above Upper Limit. Defaults: Bollinger Band Length 20, StdDev 2, Upper Limit 90, Lower Limit 10.

bbtrend.text: Compares short and long Bollinger Bands on close: the gap between the lower bands minus the gap between the upper bands, divided by the short middle band, times 100. BBTrend columns above the Zero Line are green, below are red, with stronger shades when the value is moving away from zero. Inputs are Short BB Length (20), Long BB Length (50) and StdDev (2).

beep-boop.text: Computes a MACD histogram from Fast Length (12), Slow Length (26) and Signal Smoothing (9), then shows only its sign as columns: tall for positive, slightly shorter for negative. A positive column is teal when close, open and low are all above the EMA Trend (50) line, otherwise white. A negative column is red when close, open and high are all below that line, otherwise white.

bernoulli-process-entropy.text: Ranks a measurement of the close over Averaging Length (88) bars and sums a binary entropy term over Entropy Length (22) bars. Bernoulli columns turn green above or red below the Trade Band - confirmation (0.67), with triangles at extreme ranks set by Percent Rank Limit (5). Measurement Type defaults to Contribution.

best-support-and-resistance-indicator-v1.text: Finds swing pivots and builds resistance or support zones when a newer pivot lands between an earlier pivot's extreme and its candle body edge. Zones extend until a close breaks them, turning grey, or they expire. Labels mark retests and candle patterns inside zones. Main inputs: Swing Lookback (Bars) 10, Pivot Tests for Valid Zone 2, Zone Expiry (candles, 0 = never) 200.

better-volume.text: Splits each bar's volume into buy and sell parts from range and open-close, then checks many volume and range measures for a highest or lowest value over Lookback bars (8). Columns turn red for climax up, white for climax down, green for churn, dark magenta for climax churn, yellow for low volume, else cyan; SMA averages volume.

big-snapper-alerts.text: Plots a Coloured MA plus Fast, Medium and Slow moving averages of selectable types, with an optional SuperTrend line and Bollinger bands. The Coloured MA's rise or fall, combined with the chosen Signal Filter (default SuperTrend), decides the buy and sell arrows. Key inputs: Coloured MA Length 18, Fast MA Length 21, Medium MA Length 55, Slow MA Length 89.

big-trades-bubbles.text: Splits each bar's volume by close position into buy and sell proxies and scores them against the previous Lookback bars (default 2) as z-scores. Bubbles mark scores above Base Sigma Threshold (1.5), sized by strength; diamonds mark absorption bars with small bodies; dots mark deep pressure from smoothed net pressure (Deep Pressure Length 10, Pressure EMA Length 20).

big-trades-detector-by-hf.text: Splits each bar's volume into a buying share (close within the range) and a selling share. A share is flagged when it exceeds the prior bar's average plus a number of standard deviations. Circles come in small, medium and large tiers; Lookback Period defaults to 2 and Sensitivity (Sigma) to 3.

big-trades-whale-detector-by-hk.text: Splits each bar's volume into a buy part and a sell part by where the close sits in the high-low range. A part is a big trade when it exceeds the average of the previous Lookback Period (5) bars by Sensitivity (Sigma) (3) standard deviations. Circles in three sizes mark stronger outliers, buys near the close-low midpoint and sells near the close-high midpoint.

biggest-volume.text: Draws volume as a histogram and compares each bar's volume with the highest volume of the last Accuracy bars. A bar that equals that highest volume is cyan, all others are grey, so cyan bars flag the largest volume in the window. Accuracy defaults to 14; Enable Alert (true) controls the Big Volume alert on those bars.

bilateral-filter-for-loop.text: Smooths price with a bilateral filter over Window Period (14), weighting past values by distance and by price difference, then scores how many offsets from Calculation Start (1) to Calculation End (45) the filter sits above. A score over Long Threshold (40) turns the trend long; a cross under Short Threshold (-10) turns it short. The For Loop line follows the trend colour, with optional threshold lines.

binary-option-arrows.text: Detects harami candle patterns: an up arrow on a bullish harami (with the open five bars back above the open) and a down arrow on a bearish one. Expiry bars after a signal, the background turns green if the close moved the signal's way, red if not. Input: Expiry, default 1.

bitcoin-2y-sma-bands-astral-vision.text: Takes the 730-bar SMA of the close, scales it into an Investor Bottom and an Investor Top, and plots the log of close divided by the bottom as Price / Investor Bottom. The pane fills when the ratio drops below 1 or rises above the top multiplier, and candles are recoloured. Bottom Multiplier (2y-SMA ×) is 0.6 and Top Multiplier (Bottom ×) is 6.5.

bitcoin-bull-bear-market-support-resista.text: Plots up to four moving averages, each with its own type (SMA, EMA, SMMA, WMA or VWMA), source and length. The area between MA #1 and MA #2 is filled red when MA #1 is at or above MA #2, and green otherwise. By default MA #1 is a 20-bar SMA and MA #2 a 21-bar EMA of the close; MA #3 and MA #4 (lengths 100 and 200) are off.

bitcoin-kill-zones.text: Shades the chart background by clock time for four sessions: New York, London Open, London Close and Asia. Each has a faint wide window, and a darker short window inside it if Real Open Session Alert Bar is on. Each zone can be switched on or off; all default to on.

bitcoin-log-curves.text: Draws a top and a bottom growth curve for Bitcoin, based on days since the 2010 genesis date, with each curve's log value set by an intercept and slope. Between them it plots Fibonacci levels from 0% - Bottom to 100% - Top, with 50% - Mid in the middle, shaded in bands. Inputs: Top Curve Intercept 1.06930947, Top Curve Slope 0.00076, Bottom Curve Intercept -3.0269716, Bottom Curve Slope 0.001329.

bitcoin-mayer-multiple.text: Plots close divided by its SMA as the Mayer Multiple histogram, coloured by the highest fixed reference level it is above. Horizontal lines sit at 0.55 (Smash Buy), 0.70, 0.85, 1.00, 1.20, 1.45, 1.90, 2.20, 2.60 and 3.00. Input: Price SMA Length 200.

bitcoin-pi-cycle-top-bottom-indicator-z-.text: Computes 2 minus twice the 350-bar average of the close divided by the 111-bar average, then rescales it into a Z-Score using fixed top 1.05 and bottom -1.10 thresholds. Read the Z-Score against the dashed levels at 0, 1, 2, 3 and -1, -2, -3: higher values mean the pi-cycle reading is nearer its top, lower values nearer its bottom. Both averages are also drawn on the price pane. No inputs.

bjorgum-autotrail.text: A trailing stop built from the lowest low or highest high over Lookback (5) bars, pushed away by an offset. The Trail only ratchets in the favourable direction. When the close crosses it, the trail flips side and a Stop cross is marked, triggering Long Trail or Short Trail. Trail Type sets the offset: ATR (default, ATR Length 14, ATR Multiplier 1), Percent (2) or Price.

bjorgum-key-levels.text: Builds support and resistance zones around pivot highs and lows, with height set by ATR times Zone Width (ATR), capped by Max Zone Percent. The last Number of Pivots zones stay tracked and flip colour when the close moves above or below them. Defaults: Look Left 20, Look Right 15, Number of Pivots 4, ATR Length 30, Zone Width (ATR) 0.5. Optional breakout, false-break and candle-pattern signals are off.

bjorgum-mtf-ma.text: Plots up to three moving averages (EMA, SMA, HMA, WMA, DEMA, VWMA, VWAP, T3, HEMA or IT), each optionally on a higher timeframe. A line takes the bull colour while it rises and the bear colour while it falls, or an RSI gradient. Bars can be coloured from the close versus an average. MA Length #1 is 50; MA Length #2 and #3 default to 0, which hides them. Smooth is on.

bjorgum-superscript.text: Colours price bars by one of four strategies chosen in Select a Strategy (default Bj Reversal): two T3 averages, three moving averages, a TSI and RSI combination, or RSI bands. Bar colour shows bull, bear or reversal state, and T3 Fast and T3 Slow are drawn for Bj Reversal. Optional SAR circles, arrows and a rating table can be switched on. T3 Alpha is 0.7.

bjorgum-triple-ema.text: Plots three EMAs of the Heiken Ashi open, with a hidden fast EMA used for fills. Each line is blue when rising and red when falling; fills between them show their ordering, and bars are coloured by close versus EMA-5 and EMA-9. Alert Signal fires when the close crosses both on one bar. EMA-Fast, EMA-Medium, EMA-Slow default to 5, 9, 21.

bjorgum-tsi.text: Plots the True Strength Index, a double-smoothed momentum ratio, with Signal as an EMA of it. Bar Hi and Bar Lo show the gap between TSI and Signal above or below zero. Overbought 30 and Oversold -30 lines mark extremes; alerts cover crosses, curls and moves in those zones. Speed picks Fast (25, 5, 14) or Slow (25, 13, 13) lengths.

blacklab84-panel.text: Chande Momentum Oscillator (CMO Length 14) with a 5-bar EMA line, CMO Sig, shaded when CMO passes Overbought (50) or Oversold (-50). Dots mark divergences between price pivots and CMO or RSI. Trend Strength maps ADX, turning amber above Strong Trend > (25), and Volatility State ranks current ATR against the last Percentile Window (100) bars.

bnf-25-50-ma-pullback-screener.text: Plots a fast and a slow moving average (25 and 50, SMA unless Use EMA Instead of SMA is on). A BUY label appears in an uptrend when the close is at least Long Threshold % (20) below both averages; a SELL label in a downtrend when it is at least Short Threshold % (20) above them. Require MA Slopes needs rising or falling averages over Slope Lookback (bars), default 5.

bollinger-adaptive-trend-navigator.text: Builds an adaptive average whose smoothing speeds up as price moves away from the Bollinger middle, blends it with an EMA of that middle, and trails it inside an ATR band. The Bollinger Adaptive Trend Line is bullish while it last rose and bearish while it last fell. Key inputs: Bollinger Band Period 20, BB Standard Deviation 2, Volatility Period 14 and Volatility Multiplier 1.5.

bollinger-awesome-alert.text: Draws Bollinger Bands around a basis (SMA, or EMA if chosen), a fast EMA, and Buy or Sell arrows.
