A Buy shows when the Fast EMA crosses above the Basis Line with close above it and the Awesome oscillator rising; Sell is the mirror. Optional filters use the bands and squeeze. Defaults: Bollinger Length 20, Base Multiplier 2, Fast EMA length 3.

bollinger-bands-flux-charts.text: Builds Bollinger bands on the typical price (fixed 20, 75 and 100 bar lengths), each smoothed with a Gaussian kernel over its last 500 values. Upper Band and Lower Band are the smoothed first band; shaded zones lie between the further bands, and triangles mark when the Label Source reaches the band. Smoothing Factor is 6, Label Source is Close, and Band Breaks (off) enables alerts.

bollinger-free-bars.text: Draws Bollinger-style bands: the average of the source over 周期 (20) plus and minus 标准差倍数 (2) standard deviations, as Upper Band and Lower Band. A blue triangle marks a bar whose open and close are both beyond a band; a red flag above or green flag below marks a bar whose entire range, high and low, lies outside the band. 数据源 sets the source (close).

bollinger-heatmap.text: Computes 30 Bollinger Bands of the close with lengths from 14 to 364 and shows where the close sits inside each, from 0 at the lower band to 1 at the upper. Each band is a horizontal line (Band 1 to Band 30) coloured in ten steps: warm colours near the lower band, cool colours near the upper. Standard Deviation defaults to 2; each Band Length has its own input.

boom-hunter-pro.text: Runs three Ehlers-style filtered oscillators, each normalized and put through a quotient transform. Quotient1 is read against its Trigger, an average of it, and its colour shifts with crossings and deep lows. Q3, Q4, Q5 and Q6 are the other waves, and markers label long, short and overbought setups. Inputs: EOT1 LPPeriod (6), Trigger Length (2), EOT2 LPPeriod (27).

bop.text: Calculates, for every bar, the close minus the open divided by the high minus the low, and plots it as BOP in its own pane. Positive values mean the bar closed above its open, negative values below it, and readings near 1 or -1 mean the body fills most of the bar's range. It has no inputs.

bos-choch-demand-supply.text: Finds pivot highs and lows on several lookbacks at once. A close above the last pivot high marks a bullish break, and a close below the last pivot low a bearish one. Labels mark BOS or CHOCH demand and supply on the last opposite pivot candle; zones turn grey when mitigated and vanish when broken. Inputs: Pivot Lookback Periods (comma-separated) and Max Number of Active Boxes per Type (50).
names: Max Number of Active Boxes per Type

breakaway-fair-value-gaps.text: Finds fair value gaps that also break beyond the highest high or lowest low of the prior Trend Length bars, and boxes them. With Show Mitigation Levels, a line marks the far edge until a close beyond it, with a bar count; open gaps are dropped after Maximum Duration. A dashboard shows mitigation share, bars and totals. Defaults: Trend Length 20, Maximum Duration 60.

breakdown-or-buyable-dip-pullback-depth-.text: Counts how many bars back the most recent bar had a lower low than the current low, searching at most Max Lookback Bars (125). If none is found, the count equals the search length. It is plotted as a negative histogram under a zero line: a deeper bar means the current low is the lowest in a longer time.

breaker-blocks-order-blocks-confirm-bbob.text: Finds pivots, structure breaks and order blocks, turns broken blocks into opposite breaker blocks, and draws zones where an order block overlaps a same-side breaker block. Zones extend until price hits the mitigation level or the validity ends. Pivot Period of Order Blocks Detector defaults to 9; Order Block Validity Period (Bar) to 500; Mitigation Level OB to Proximal.
names: Pivot Period of Order Blocks Detector

breaker-blocks-with-signals.text: Finds zigzag swings with Length bars on the left (default 5). When a close breaks the latest swing high or low and the prior swing sits beyond the earlier one, it boxes the last opposite candle as a breaker block with a dashed centre line. Arrows mark signals, a cross marks a cancel, and Enable TP (default off) adds three reward-ratio target lines.

breakout-an-reversal-signal-detector-wit.text: Plots the highest high (MAX of Last X Period) and lowest low (MIN of Last X Period) of the previous bars, excluding the current one. A close above the max gives a green up triangle, a close below the min a red down triangle; a repeat on the same side needs the close beyond the last opposite breakout close. Candles stay green after a bullish signal, red after a bearish one. Número de velas anteriores (X) is 10.

breakout-and-retest-signals.text: Tracks pivot highs and lows (Period bars left, Period divided by Confirmation Multipler right), keeping Swing Points Memory of each. A new pivot within ATR Multiplier times the ATR of the nearest opposite swing, with its wick beyond that swing, draws a zone box, mid line and delta label. Defaults: Period 7, ATR Multiplier 2.

breakout-boxes.text: Finds pivot highs and lows over Pivot Detection Length bars per side (5). When a new pivot lies within 0.2 ATR(200) of the previous one, a box extends from it by Upper Box Width or Lower Box Width tenths of ATR (both 5), with inner boxes showing the volume share of rising and other bars. A close beyond the box edge ends it and draws a BreakUp or BreakDn label.

breakout-finder.text: Tracks recent pivot highs and lows. An up bar closing above the highest high of the last Period bars and above a cluster of at least Minimum Number of Tests pivot highs draws a rectangle and a triangle below it; the mirror case with pivot lows draws a triangle above. Defaults: Period 5, Max Breakout Length 200, Threshold Rate % 3, Minimum Number of Tests 2. Alerts: Breakout, Breakdown.

breakout-indicator.text: Draws a horizontal Long Breakout Price line and Short Breakout Price line from the chosen Breakout Time, shifted right by Offset bars (default 5). A price of 0, the default, hides its line. The Breakout Alert! fires when the close is above the long price or below the short price.

breakout-pattern-setup.text: Finds converging channels (wedges or triangles) from swing pivots and signals a Long when price closes above the upper line, or a Short below the lower line, with a strength grade. Trade levels (entry, stop, three targets) are drawn after a breakout. Key inputs: Pivot Detection Length 5, Min Touches per Boundary 2, Max Channel Width (bars) 120, Min Convergence Rate 0.02.

breakout-probability.text: Counts across history how often a bar reaches above the previous high or below the previous low, plus up to four extra steps, separately after green and red bars. The last bar shows lines and percentage labels for each level, and a table with wins and losses. Percentage Step is 1 and Number of Lines is 5; Disable 0.00% hides levels with zero probability.

breakout-targets.text: Finds ranges when the weighted average of candle body size crosses under its exponential average over Range Detection Period (99). It draws a channel from the latest pivot. When the close leaves it, a label appears and a trade is drawn with entry at the close, a stop at Stop Loss ATR Multiplier (5) times the ATR, and three targets at TP1 Multiplier (0.5), TP2 Multiplier (1) and TP3 Multiplier (1.5) times the risk.

breakout-volume-delta-flux-charts.text: Marks swing highs and lows, found with Swing Left and Right bars, as dotted level lines, keeping the Show Nearest newest per side. A level breaks when the close (or wick, per Breakout by) passes it; the line then turns solid and the candle is outlined and split into buy and sell shares with a volume label. Breakout Volume Filter, off by default, drops levels lacking enough dominance.

breakouts-with-tests-retests.text: Tracks swing lows and highs and draws a box one ATR(200) tall times Width from each pivot. A close through the box is a breakout and starts a second box; bars that poke into a box and close back out are marked as tests (▲, ▼) and retests (▽, △). Display picks which sides follow, Left 10 and Right 1 set the swing, Maximum Bars is 500.

btc-logarithmic-regression-quantile-band.text: Fits a linear regression to log price from the Anchor Date over up to Regression Length (bars) (default 1200), then adds percentile bands of the residual and converts back to price. Q99 and Q1 are the outer bands, QHi and QLo the inner pair set by Inner Quantile Pair (default 5), and Q50 the median. Background and candle colours show where the close sits among the bands.

btcusdshorts-btcusdlongs-bitfinex-btc-sh.text: Plots the closing values of the Bitfinex BTC margin short and margin long position series, read on the chart timeframe. Bitfinex Shorts is drawn in red and Bitfinex Longs in green, so a trader can compare how the two position totals move over time. It has no inputs.

bull-bear-power.text: Takes an exponential average of the close, then sums how far the high and the low sit from it (high plus low minus twice the average). BBPower columns are green at or above the Zero Line and red below it. Length sets the average period and defaults to 13.

bull-bear-power-trend.text: Measures the close's distance from the 50-bar low (Bull Trend) and from the 50-bar high (Bear Trend, negative), both divided by a 5-period ATR. Trend is their sum. Histograms show how far each power sits from the 2 and -2 levels. Show Regression Trend (off) swaps Trend for a linear regression of it over Regression Length (8).

bull-market-support-band.text: Plots the 20-week simple moving average and the 21-week exponential moving average of the close, with a filled band between them. Values come from weekly bars and appear on the chart bar that completes each week. Read the band's width and the price's position relative to the 20w SMA and 21w EMA lines. It has no inputs.

bullish-engulfing-finder.text: Flags a two-bar bullish engulfing pattern: a down bar followed by an up bar whose body covers the prior bar's body and is longer than it. Bars that complete the pattern are coloured yellow on the price chart, and an alert named Bullish Engulfing Formed fires once per bar close. It has no inputs.

bullish-volume-anomaly.text: Signs volume by an ATR zigzag trend, then compares its cumulative sum and the close using z-scores over 480 bars. It draws an EMA with Upper Band and Lower Band around it, scaled by average candle body size and delayed one bar. A green triangle under a bar marks a volume-anomaly setup that also triggers the alert. Defaults: ATR Length 14, ATR Multiplier for ZigZag 3, Band Multiplier 5, Band Length 288.

bulls-bears-control.text: Counts bars since the close was last above (Price Down Based On Midpoint or Close, red) or below (Price Up Based On Midpoint or Close, lime) the prior bar's midpoint, or its close when midpoint use is off. Optional lines show the highest, standard deviation and average of these counts, with a dashed Horizontal Line at 4. Key inputs: Highest Bar Look Back Period 50, Standard Dev Length 50, Moving Average length 20.
names: Price Down Based On Midpoint or Close
Price Up Based On Midpoint or Close

bulls-v-bears.text: Compares how far the high sits above, and the low below, a moving average of the close, then takes bull minus bear pressure as columns: green at or above zero, red below. Normalized scales each side over Normalized Bars Back (120) with Line Height (80) thresholds; Raw uses percentile thresholds. Dots mark bars beyond the thresholds. BvB Period is 14.

butterworth-filtered-median.text: Takes the rolling median of the close, smooths it with a one-pole low-pass filter, then applies an EMA to get one line on the price pane. Filtered Median (Butterworth) is cyan when it sits below both the close and the previous close, and magenta otherwise. Inputs: Median Length 50, Cutoff Frequency 0.1, EMA Length 7.

buy-low-sell-high-composite-upgraded-v6.text: Scales RSI, an EMA 5 minus EMA 35 difference, CMO, MACD histogram, MFI and direction-signed ADX to about -1 to +1, sums the enabled ones and smooths them with an EMA, or a triple EMA if Use TEMA is on. Composite Inner is an area, red at or below zero and lime above. Composite Outer is lime, red or gray by the smoothed slope against Slope Threshold (0.02). Composite Smoothing Length defaults to 4.

buy-on-volume.text: Plots a DEMA of the close and a stepped Lorentzian Line, an SMA over 80% of the set length. A BUY label appears below the bar when the DEMA crosses above that line on volume more than 1.3 times its recent average. Inputs: DEMA Period (6), Volume Lookback Period (20), Lorentzian Length (21).

buy-sell-accurate-signals.text: Computes a volatility-based trailing stop: the highest close over the period minus ATR times a multiplier for longs, and the lowest close plus the same amount for shorts. Green Long Stop shows while direction is long, red Short Stop while short; a flip prints a Buy or Sell label. Inputs: ATR Period (22), ATR Multiplier (3).

buy-sell-hull-crossover-signals.text: Plots a fast and a slow Hull moving average of the chosen Source. A ribbon between them is green when Fast HMA is at or above Slow HMA, otherwise red. BUY triangles mark Fast HMA crossing above Slow HMA, SELL triangles the opposite, and the Buy Signal and Sell Alert-style alerts follow them. Fast HMA Length is 20 and Slow HMA Length is 55.

buy-sell-pressure.text: Estimates bull and bear price pressure from each bar's range and neighbouring bar, then scales it by volume. SELLING and BUYING columns show the dominant side positive, with SPAvg and BPAvg as smoothed lines. VPO1 and VPO2 are buy-minus-sell oscillators, and VPH is their difference. Inputs: FastMA Periods 3, Conv/Div Lookback 27.

buy-sell-signal-kelfry98.text: Compares a Fast EMA (5) with a Slow EMA (13) of the close. When the fast crosses above the slow it marks a BUY, below it a SELL, optionally needing a matching candle (Require candle confirmation). The stop sits beyond the signal bar by ATR Period (14) ATR times SL Multiplier (ATR) (0.5); the target is Risk:Reward (R:R) (3) times the risk.

buy-sell-signals-with-support-resistance.text: Plots a short and a long simple moving average of the close, plus their difference as the MACD Oscillator histogram. A green triangle below the bar marks the short average crossing above the long one, a red triangle above marks a cross below. Swing High and Swing Low diamonds mark pivots confirmed after Lookback Period for S&R bars (20). Short MA Period is 12 and Long MA Period 26.

buy-sell-volume-totals-for-period.text: Splits each bar's volume into a buy part (volume times close minus low over the bar range) and a sell part (the remainder up to the high), and sums them from Start Time onward, or until End Time when Use End Time? is on. BUY+SELL V shows bar volume and BUY V the buy part as columns; the background is green while buy total exceeds sell total, red otherwise, only inside the period.

buy-the-dip-sell-the-rip.text: Computes an RSI of the close and a moving average of that RSI. A green DIP triangle appears below a bar when the previous RSI was under Oversold (30) and the RSI rises. A red RIP triangle appears above when both the RSI and its average exceed Overbought (70) and the RSI falls. RSI Length and RSI SMA Length both default to 14.

buyers-sellers-range.text: Measures buying and selling pressure per bar against the true range, smooths each with an EMA and a Gaussian filter, and scales to percent. BP/ATR and SP/ATR change colour with direction, and fills show which leads and whether it is growing or falling. Inputs: BSP Length 10, Body / Range off.

buyers-vs-sellers.text: Sums bullish and bearish candle bodies over recent bars, scales them by ATR and averages them, then shows Average Bullish Move above and Average Bearish Move below the Zero Line, plus The Sum of Bullish & Bearish Moves as a smoothed net. Background tints blue when Directional Bias exceeds Bullish Bias Threshold (0) and pink below Bearish Bias Threshold (0). Number of Bars To Include In The Calculation is 6, Length of The ATR 288, Net Move Average Length 3.
names: The Sum of Bullish & Bearish Moves
Number of Bars To Include In The Calculation

buying-and-selling-volume-pressure-s-r.text: Splits each bar's volume into buying and selling shares by where the close sits in the range, then sums both over Cumulative Lookback (10 bars). A buying cross above selling resets Support to the low; a cross below resets Resistance to the high. MidLine averages their midpoint over Mid Line Length (20), with UpperLine and LowerLine at Deviation Multiplier (2) deviations. Buy Signal and Sell Signal mark closes crossing MidLine.

buying-selling-pressure.text: Averages candle measures over a Period: buying pressure is the close minus the lower of the low and previous close, selling pressure the higher of the high and previous close minus the close. Each line changes colour as it rises or falls. Bars are coloured when buying pressure falls on an up close or selling pressure falls on a down close. Defaults: Averaging Type HMA, Period 14, Range Type Pressure.

buying-selling-volume.text: Splits each bar's volume into buying and selling parts by where the close sits in the high-low range, plotting BuyVolume and SellVolume columns (the dominant side positive, the other negative) plus BuyVolume% and SellVolume% as circles. VolumeIndex is volume divided by its 20-bar EMA, shown once 20 bars exist. Volume Index Length (default 1) is the level above which VolumeIndex counts as elevated.

buying-vs-selling-moving-averages.text: Splits each bar's volume into buying and selling parts by where the close sits in the high-low range, then smooths each with a moving average chosen by MA Type (default EMA). Buying Vol MA and Selling Vol MA are lines, with a fill that is teal when buying is larger and red otherwise. Volume Histogram shows total volume. Both lengths default to 14.

buysell-imtiazh-v2.text: Splits each bar's volume into a buying part, scaled by where the close sits within the high-low range, and plots it against total volume. SELL V columns show total volume, BUY V columns the buying part, and Buy % the buying share. 30-Day Avg Vol Line is a 30-bar volume average; Breakout Vol Line sits above it by Breakout Threshold (%) (default 40).

buysell-volume-bar-chart.text: Splits each bar's volume by where the close sits in the high-low range: Buy is volume times the close's distance above the low, Sell the distance below the high. Buy columns rise above zero and Sell columns fall below; the larger side is drawn in stronger colour. Δ Volume (buy minus sell) shows in the data window only.

buyside-sellside-liquidity.text: Tracks a zigzag of pivot highs and lows and marks a buyside or sellside liquidity level when more than two earlier pivots of the same side lie within an ATR-based margin. A solid line marks the level, a dotted line follows price until breached, and a zone box then grows. Detection Length is 7, Margin 6.9, and # Visible Levels 3.

cabal-dev-indicator.text: A stochastic momentum index: the close's distance from the middle of the recent high-low range, divided by half the range, with both parts EMA-smoothed and scaled to 100. The Stochastic line is its SMA (Smoothing Period 5) and EMA is a smoothed signal of it (EMA Signal Length 15). Areas beyond Overbought (40) and Oversold (-40) are filled. Percent K Length is 15, Percent D Length 3.

candle-breakout-oscillator.text: Classifies each bar as a bullish breakout (close above the prior high), bearish breakout (close below the prior low) or sideways, tallies each kind over the Window, scales it to 0-100 and smooths it. Bullish and Bearish cross markers show momentum shifts; readings above Top 80 or below Bottom 20 are filled. Defaults: Window 100, Smoothing Method RMA, Smoothing Length 2.

candle-buy-sell-support-resistance.text: Draws Support at the last pivot low and Resistance at the last pivot high as step lines. BUY labels sit below bullish engulfing candles or hammers, and SELL labels above bearish engulfing candles or shooting stars. Pivot Length is 5 bars each side. Alerts Candle BUY and Candle SELL fire on these signals.

candle-channel.text: Draws a channel around an SMA of the candle midpoint (high plus low, halved). The half width is the SMA of candle height times the scaling percent. Triangles mark a candle closing back inside the Upper Band or Lower Band after a close outside it; circles mark closes crossing the Candle Midpoint SMA. Inputs: SMA Length for Candle Midpoint 20, Band Scaling (% of Average Candle Height) 200.
names: Band Scaling (% of Average Candle Height)

candle-color-flip.text: Marks failed continuation after a coloured bar. A green triangle below the bar appears when the previous bar was red and the current low is not under the previous low; a red triangle above appears when the previous bar was green and the current high is not above the previous high. Only closed bars signal. Alerts: Red to Green Candle Flip, Green to Red Candle Flip.

candle-count-rsi.text: Plots a Standard RSI of the close and a Candle Count RSI built from up and down candle counts, stretched away from 50 by the current run of same-direction candles; both are WMA-smoothed by default. A fill between them is green when both rise, red when both fall, yellow otherwise. Backgrounds mark divergences using Bullish RSI Threshold (45) and Bearish RSI Threshold (55); RSI Length is 32.

candle-range-theory-by-lucas.text: Each bar is checked against the previous candle's range. Prev High and Prev Low draw that range. Bullish Manipulation (Buy) puts a triangle below a bar whose low breaks the previous low while open and close stay inside the range with a smaller body than the previous one. Bearish Manipulation (Sell) mirrors it above the bar for a high break. A bar meeting both gives no signal. No inputs.

candle-range-theory-flux-charts.text: Looks for a large completed higher-timeframe candle, then waits for a bar to wick beyond its high or low and close back inside. It then enters on a fair value gap or order block, with a take profit and stop loss, and marks Buy or Sell labels, TP and SL exits and a results table. Main inputs: Higher Timeframe (240), HTF Candle Size (Big), Entry Mode (FVGs), TP / SL Method (Dynamic).

candle-range-trading.text: Detects a two-candle pattern. A bearish one has a bullish candle followed by a bearish one that makes a higher high but closes inside the prior range; a bullish one is the mirror. A triangle marks the bar, and CRT High and CRT Low show the two-candle extremes on that bar. Input: Show CRT High/Low, default on.

candle-spread-oscillator.text: Measures the candle body as a fraction of the bar range, (close - open) / (high - low), smoothed with a Hull moving average over Smoothing Period (500). It is drawn as an area around a zero line, with colour fading from fuchsia at -0.1 and below to aqua at 0.2 and above. Cross Up and Cross Down alerts fire when it crosses zero.

candle-state.text: Compares each bar's high and low with the previous bar. A higher high puts a green up triangle above the bar, a lower low a red down triangle above it. A bar with both (an outside bar) gets both triangles, with the one matching the candle colour drawn on top. It has no inputs.

candlestick-patterns-identified.text: Scans each bar for 15 candlestick patterns, including Doji, Harami, Engulfing, Piercing Line, Kickers, Morning and Evening Star, Hammer and Shooting Star, and marks them with text arrows or shapes. Bullish patterns sit below the bar, bearish ones and the Doji above it. Most need a prior trend, set by Trend in Bars (5), and a Doji is a body within Doji size (0.05) of the bar range.

candlestick-reversal.text: Looks for reversal bars using four optional tests: wick-to-body ratio, a large prior body followed by an opposite bar, an outside bar, and a doji breakout. Blue up triangles below bars mark long signals after a recent low, red down triangles above bars mark short signals after a recent high; Long Signal and Short Signal alerts match. Main inputs: Length to Highest/Lowest 5, Wick Multiplier 2.5; SMA optional.

candlestick-structure.text: Labels 16 candlestick patterns (hammer, engulfing, stars, harami, tweezers and more) only when they go against the minor trend, a Donchian channel of Minor Trend Length (10), and agree with the major trend. The Major Uptrend and Major Downtrend lines follow the Major Trend Method (SuperTrend), with a dashboard of pattern counts.

candlestick-trend-indicator.text: Plots a moving average (HullMA, Moving Average Length 20) that is green when rising and red otherwise, plus the last five-bar fractal high and low as Top Fractal Level and Bottom Fractal Level. Candle patterns such as engulfing, harami and pin bars get arrows; those following the trend and confirmed by MACD colour the candle lime or maroon and add a dot.

candlesticks-patterns-identified.text: Scans each bar for nine candlestick patterns: a Doji star when the body is at most the Doji size share of the bar range, plus Harami, Engulfing, Piercing Line, Belt and Kicker patterns. Bullish patterns show an arrow below the bar and bearish ones above it, and all but the Doji also need the open from Trend in Bars back to sit on the matching side. Defaults: Trend in Bars 5, Doji size 0.05.

cardwell-rsi-by-tq.text: RSI of the source with three moving averages of the RSI, plus fixed levels at 80, 60, 40, 20, 55, 45 and dotted bands at 70, 50, 30. A shaded core zone sits between 60 and 40, and throw zones extend outward to Upper Zone Top and Lower Zone Bottom. Alerts fire when RSI crosses a moving average. Inputs: RSI Length 14, MA Type on RSI WMA, Fast MA Length 9, Custom MA Length 20, Slow MA Length 45.

carrier-volatility.text: Takes an RSI by default, or its SMA, the close or a custom source, and smooths it twice with an exponential average using a fractional length. EMA is the second average, EMA offset is a copy shifted one bar left with shading between them, and source shows the raw input. Input Mode picks the series (default Defaut (RSI)); factor and factor2 default to 0.1, RSI Length to 14, and Show on Main Chart? moves it to price.

cbc-flip-with-volume.text: Tracks a bull or bear state that flips when a candle closes beyond the previous bar's high (bullish candle) or low (bearish candle) on more volume than the previous bar. Triangles mark each flip, larger and with a stronger background when volume exceeds its average over Volume MA Lookback (50) bars. Bull in Control (% gain) and Bear in Control (% gain) give the move since the flip candle's open.

cci.text: Measures how far Source (default hlc3) sits from its average over length bars (default 20), divided by 0.015 times the mean deviation, and plots it as CCI. Dashed levels mark 100 and -100 with a middle line at 0. Type (default SMA) adds CCI-based MA over Length 14, or optional Bollinger Bands using BB StdDev (default 2).

cci-hash-capital.text: A smoothed CCI of the Source over CCI Period (default 20, hlc3), then smoothed by an EMA of Smoothing (default 5) and a second 2-bar EMA. The CCI Main Line is green above zero and red below, with a glow and a fill to the Zero Reference; zones past +100 and -100 are shaded. Calculate Divergence (off by default) adds Bull and Bear labels, and Signal Sensitivity (6) scales the Buy Signal and Sell Signal alerts.

cci-obv.text: Plots on-balance volume, which adds volume on up closes and subtracts it on down closes. The line is green when the CCI of the close is at or above the threshold and red otherwise, with EMA of OBV as a smoothing line. Inputs: CCI Length 20, CCI threshold for OBV coding 0, EMA length 13.

cci-stochastic.text: Applies a stochastic to the CCI, smooths it into K and then D, and plots one as the Moving Average. The line is red above Overbought (80), green below Oversold (20), gray between. Arrows mark crossings of those levels as Enter or Exit, plus optional Center crossings of 50. CCI Period and Stoch Period default to 28.

cct-bbo.text: Places price inside Bollinger-style bands (average plus or minus two standard deviations) on a 0 to 100 scale. CCTBBO is smoothed by the EMA line, and levels sit at 100 (Upper), 50 (Mid) and 0 (Lower), so readings near the ends mean price is near a band. Length is 21, EMA Length is 13, Source is close.

cd-average-daily-range-zones-highs-and-l.text: Takes the daily open and adds and subtracts half of the average daily range (high minus low) of the previous 10 days and of the previous 5 days. ADR High10 and ADR High5 sit above the open, ADR LOW10 and ADR LOW5 below it, drawn as circles. A maroon fill joins the two highs and a lime fill joins the two lows. The levels stay fixed through each day. There are no inputs.

cdc-action-zone.text: Smooths the source with a 2-period EMA, then draws Fast and Slow EMAs of that line. Fast above Slow is bullish, below is bearish; bars turn green or yellow when bullish and red or blue when bearish, depending on whether the smoothed price is above or below Fast. Inputs: Source (ohlc4), Short MA Period (12), Long MA Period (26).

cdc-actionzone-v3-2020.text: Computes a fast and a slow EMA of the optionally smoothed source and sorts each bar into six zones by where price sits against both. Bars take the zone colour, and a buy circle marks the first green bar after a sell, a sell circle the first red bar after a buy. Main inputs: Fast EMA period (12), Slow EMA period (26), Smoothing period (1 = no smoothing).

chaikin-mf.text: Weights each bar's volume by where the close sits within the high-low range, then divides the sum of that over the window by the sum of volume. CMF above the zero line means closes tended toward the highs, below means toward the lows. Input: length (20).

chaikin-osc.text: Builds a running total of close-location-weighted volume (accumulation/distribution), then subtracts a slow exponential average of it from a fast one. Above the Zero level, recent money flow is stronger than its longer trend; below, weaker. Inputs: Fast Length (3) and Slow Length (10).

chakra-riss-engulfing-candlestick-strate.text: An RSI of Length (8) colours bars green above UpLevel (50) and red below DownLevel (50), and a 50-bar SMA of the close is drawn as MA. BUY or SELL labels appear when RSI crosses a level with the close above or below that MA. While a trade is open, Stop Loss (Long) and Stop Loss (Short) follow the previous low and high, and Take Profit (Long) and Take Profit (Short) sit 3% above and below the entry close.

chande-kroll-stop.text: Takes the highest high and lowest low over the ATR length, offsets them by the ATR times a coefficient, then takes the extreme of those offsets over a further window. Stop Long is the lowest of the raised lows; Stop Short is the highest of the lowered highs, both drawn on the price chart. Inputs: ATR Length (p) 10, ATR Coefficient (x) 1, Stop Length (q) 9.

chande-mo.text: Over the last window of bars, adds up the price rises and the price falls, then scales their difference by their total to a range of -100 to +100. Chande MO is above the Zero Line when rises dominate and below when falls do; it reads 0 if there was no movement. Inputs are length (9) and Source (close).

chandelier.text: Trails exit levels from price extremes by a multiple of ATR. Long exit is the highest high over Length minus ATR times ATR multiplier; Short exit is the lowest low over Length plus the same amount. Defaults are Length 22, ATR length 22 and ATR multiplier 3.

chandelier-exit.text: Chandelier Exit sets a long stop at the highest value over ATR Period minus ATR Multiplier times ATR, and a short stop at the lowest plus that amount; the stops only ratchet in the trend's favour. Direction flips when the close crosses the opposite stop, with Buy and Sell labels on the flip bar. Defaults: ATR Period 22, ATR Multiplier 3, Use Close for Extremums on.

chandelier-stop.text: Draws a ratcheting ATR stop on the price chart: the highest high over Lookback minus ATR times ATR Multiplier while long, or the lowest low plus that amount while short. The stop only moves in its favourable direction and flips when the close crosses it. Stop Dots and Stop Line show it, cyan when long and magenta when short. Defaults are 22, 22 and 3.

change-in-state-of-delivery.text: Starts a level at the open of a bullish candle after a bearish one, or the reverse. A close back through it, after Minimum CISD Duration bars (default 0), recolours the line and adds a CISD label. Detection Method is Classic by default, or Liquidity Sweep using Swing Length 10. Maximum Swing Validity is 100.

change-in-state-of-delivery-cisd.text: Marks swing highs and lows (Swing Period 12) as liquidity levels that extend until price touches them or they pass Expiry Bars (100). A thick line appears when the close breaks back through a recent opposite candle's open and the move passes the Noise Filter (0.7); candles take the trend colour. A CISD within Liquidity Lookback (10) bars of a touched swing level is marked with an arrow label.

change-point-detection.text: Runs a CUSUM on the z-score of close log returns. When the positive sum exceeds the threshold or the negative sum falls below minus the threshold, the Regime Price resets to the close and triangles mark the shift up or down. Bullish Pressure and Bearish Pressure show the sums scaled by price deviation around the Regime Price. Inputs: Lookback Period 50, Threshold (h) 4, Slack (k) 0.5.

channels-with-patterns.text: Builds a channel from swing pivots, sized as Size (4) times a smoothed true range and sloped by the Average H/L Length (18) average, with zones, a dashed centre line and fills. A bar fully outside the channel ends it with a Break Up or Break Down label. Hammer, inverted hammer and engulfing marks appear only inside the reversal zones. Pivot Length is 10, Pivot Look Forward 15.

chn-buy-sell-with-ema-200.text: Draws an EMA of the close and colours bars by a short RSI: yellow at or above the overbought level, purple at or below the oversold level. A BUY label appears when the close is above the EMA on a yellow bar, a SELL label when below it on a purple bar, spaced by the Signal Cooldown (candles). Defaults: RSI 7 Length 7, EMA Length 200, levels 70 and 30, cooldown 5.

chop-zone.text: Measures the slope of a 34-period EMA of the close, scaled by the 30-bar high-low range, and turns it into an angle. Chop Zone draws a constant-height column per bar, coloured by that angle: turquoise and greens for rising slopes, yellow for flat, oranges to dark red for falling ones. It has no inputs.

choppiness.text: Compares the sum of one-bar true ranges over the last length bars with the highest high minus lowest low of that window, on a log scale from 0 to 100. High readings mean price is moving sideways; low readings mean it is moving in a trend. Levels sit at 61.8, 50 and 38.2. Inputs: length (14) and Offset (0), which shifts the line in bars.

cisd-with-alerts.text: Tracks a simple high/low structure and pullbacks against it, using the open of the last opposite-coloured bar as the pullback level. When structure breaks, that level becomes a +CISD or -CISD line extending Line Extension Bars (default 5) ahead; a close through the newest level completes it, fires the matching alert and flips the state. Keep old CISD levels (default off) keeps earlier lines.

clean-buy-sell-pro.text: Compares a fast and a slow EMA of the close. A buy condition is the fast above the slow with the close above the fast; a sell condition is the opposite. With Use RSI Confirmation on, RSI (RSI Length 14) must also be above 50 for buys or below 50 for sells. A BUY or SELL label marks the first bar of each condition; Fast EMA is 20, Slow EMA 50, and Show BUY / SELL toggles labels.

clean-volume-bars.text: Shows volume as columns, green when close is at or above open and red otherwise, with Avg Volume as the simple average of volume. Above Avg Highlight repeats the column on bars where volume exceeds that average, white on bullish bars and black on bearish ones. Volume SMA Length (20) sets the averaging window.

climax-volume-reversal-radar.text: Shows volume columns coloured by climax: green for a down bar closing below the close from several bars ago on volume above 10-bar average times a factor, red for the mirror up bar, gray otherwise. Volume MA is an optional average line. Defaults: Show Volume MA on, Volume MA Length 10, Reference Close Bars Back 5, Risk Factor 1.618. Alerts: Bullish Climax Watch, Bearish Climax Watch.

clustering-volatility.text: Combines ATR, ADR (average bar range) and a Chaikin oscillator of the accumulation/distribution line, each normalized over a window, into a weighted score scaled to 0..1 and smoothed. The line is lime below 0.2, red above 0.8, yellow between. Key inputs: Fixed Window Size 500, Normalization Method MinMax, EMA Period for Score Smoothing 5.

clusters-volume-profile.text: Groups the hl2 prices of the last Lookback Period (200) bars into Number of Clusters (5) using volume-weighted K-means, run for K-Means Iterations (50) passes. Each cluster gets its own volume profile right of the last bar, with Rows per Cluster VP (20) rows. The most-volume row (POC) is solid, with a dashed line back to the window start and labels for its volume and the cluster total.

cm-ema-trend-bars.text: Computes an EMA of the close and compares each bar's average of high, low and close to it. Bars and the EMA turn green when that average is at or above the EMA and red when below, giving a quick trend colouring. Inputs: EMA Length (34) and Show EMA (on), which toggles the line.

cm-enhanced-ichimoku.text: Draws Ichimoku lines from midpoints of highest high and lowest low: Tenkan-Sen over 9 bars, Kijun-Sen over 26, and a Senkou Span B midpoint over 52. Senkou Span A is the Tenkan/Kijun average, and both spans are shifted forward by Displacement (26); Chikou Span is the close shifted back. The cloud is lime where Span A is at or above Span B, red otherwise. Show Tenkan/Kijun Crosses (off) adds yellow arrows.

cm-gann-swing.text: Compares the close with the prior bar's moving averages of highs and lows to set a swing direction. After a down swing the average of highs is drawn as the swing high (fuchsia); after an up swing the average of lows is the swing low (lime). Red or green background marks closes crossing these levels. Moving Average Period defaults to 3; circles and background highlights are on by default.
names: Plot Circles at Top and Bottom of Candles/Bars?
Show Background Highlights at Cross Up or Cross Down?

cm-guppy-ema.text: Plots twelve exponential averages of the chosen Source: six short ones (3, 5, 8, 10, 12, 15) and six long ones (30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 60), with a shaded band across each group. Short lines are aqua when both groups are stacked in rising order, orange when both are stacked falling, gray otherwise. Long lines are lime when rising-ordered, red when falling-ordered. Source defaults to close.

cm-heikin-ashi.text: Draws smoothed candles over price: close is the average of open, high, low and close, and open is the average of the previous smoothed open and close. High and low extend to cover the real extremes and these values. Candles are teal when the smoothed close is at or above its open, red otherwise; bars are tinted aqua or red. It has no inputs.

cm-high-low-open-close-weekly-intraday.text: Plots the open, close, high and low of the current and previous bar of the weekly, daily, 4-hour, 2-hour and 1-hour timeframes, as circles for current values and crosses for previous ones. Every chart bar of a period shows that period's values; a zero value is not drawn. Only Show Todays OHLC? is on by default; each other group has its own switch, such as Show This Weeks OHLC? and Show Previous Weeks OHLC?.

cm-laguerre-ppo.text: Runs the close through a four-stage Laguerre filter, turns the stage differences into an RSI-like value, and subtracts 50 to get Laguerre PPO. It also ranks it over Percentile Length (50) as columns: Percentile Rank Top and the negative Percentile Rank Bottom. Columns reach the warning level at Warning Threshold (70) and the extreme at Extreme Threshold (90). Gamma defaults to 0.7.

cm-macd-custom-mtf.text: MACD is the fast EMA of close minus the slow EMA, the Signal Line is a simple average of it, and the Histogram is their difference, on the chart or another timeframe. The MACD line is green above the signal and red below, the histogram uses four colours by sign and direction, and Cross circles mark crossings. fastLength is 12, slowLength 26, signalLength 9.

cm-macd-custom-mtf-v5.text: MACD is the fast moving average minus the slow one (Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26) of Source, with a Signal line smoothed over Signal Smoothing 9 and a Histogram of their difference. It can be computed on another timeframe via Indicator TimeFrame. The MACD line changes colour by whether it is above or below Signal; the Histogram uses four colours for rising or falling above or below zero, and Dots mark each cross.

cm-oldschool-projected-high-low.text: Projects the next period's low and high from the prior period: twice the average of high, low and close, minus the high for the low and minus the low for the high. Each level is yellow, turning red when the close is below the projected low and lime when above the projected high. Show Daily Projected High Low? is on by default; weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly are off.

cm-parabolic-sar.text: Computes a Parabolic SAR whose dots trail price and flip sides when price crosses them. Dots are lime while the close is at or above the SAR (up trend) and red while it is at or below (down trend). Start, Step Setting and Maximum Step default to 2, scaled by 0.01, 0.01 and 0.10.

cm-pivot-points-custom.text: Classic pivot levels from the previous bar of each timeframe: Pivot is the average of high, low and close, with R1, S1, R2 and S2 as resistance and support levels around it. Every chart bar shows the prior daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly levels, so the lines stay flat through the period. Only Show Daily Pivots? is on by default; the other timeframes and Show R3 & S3? are off.

cm-pivot-points-filtered.text: Takes the previous completed hourly, 4 hour, daily, weekly, monthly or yearly bar and computes its pivot as (high + low + close) / 3, with R1/S1, R2/S2 and a 3-bar pivot average. With Show Filtered Pivots on, only the pivot, R1 and S1 draw, and R1/S1 widen when the pivot moves clearly up or down. Defaults: Show Monthly Pivots? on, Show Pivot Average on, other timeframes off.

cm-price-action.text: Colours price bars by pattern: pin bars (lime up, red down) using Pin Bar Wick % (66) and PBar Lookback (6); shaved bars (aqua close near high, fuchsia near low) within Shaved Bar % (5); inside bars yellow; outside bars orange. Each type can be switched off, and Check Box To Turn Bars Gray? (off) greys unmatched bars.
names: Check Box To Turn Bars Gray?

cm-rsi-2-lower.text: Computes a 2-bar RSI of the close from smoothed gains and losses. The RSI line is lime when the close is above its 200-bar average, below its 5-bar average and RSI is under 10; red for the mirror case with RSI above 90; silver otherwise. Level lines mark 100, 0, 90 and 10, with the area between 90 and 10 shaded.

cm-rsi-2-upper.text: Plots the 5 SMA and 200 SMA of the close, both lime while the 5 is at or above the 200 and red below it. Bars turn lime for long entries (close above 200, below 5, 2-bar RSI under 10) and red for short entries (the mirror, RSI over 90). Yellow bars mark exits after an entry within the four prior bars.

cm-rsi-ema.text: Computes an RSI of the chosen Source and a smoothed exponential average of that RSI. The RSI line and the EMA of RSI line are read together: the RSI moving above or below its average shows momentum turning, and the dashed lines at 80 and 20 mark overbought and oversold zones. Main inputs are RSI Length (20) and EMA of RSI Length (10).

cm-sling-shot.text: Plots a fast and a slow EMA of the close, with a filled cloud between them. Lines are green when the fast is above the slow, red when below. Bars turn yellow on pullbacks against the trend and aqua when the close crosses back over the fast EMA in trend direction, with entry arrows. Fast EMA Length is 38, Slow EMA Length 62; Show Letters adds B and S marks.

cm-stoch-highlight.text: Computes a smoothed Stochastic K and a D line, then marks the price chart instead of drawing lines. Bars turn orange when K is above Upper Line Value (80) and fuchsia when below Lower Line Value (20); B and S letters appear when K crosses D from beyond those levels. Length for Stochastic is 14, SmoothK for Stochastic 3, SmoothD for Stochastic 3; other inputs toggle backgrounds and any-cross letters.

cm-stochastic-mtf.text: Computes Stoch K as a smoothed stochastic of close, high and low over Length for Main Stochastic (14), then Stoch D as its average, on the chart or another timeframe. Upper Line (80), Lower Line (20) and Mid Line frame it. B and S letters mark K crossing D after K was beyond the lower or upper line on the prior bar. A second stochastic can be shown with Show 2nd Stoch?.

cm-time-lines.text: Shades the background of every bar whose time falls inside up to six daily session windows, read in the exchange time zone. Each window has its own colour, and where windows overlap the later one is painted. Only Custom 1 is on by default, with the window 0000-0100; Custom 2 to 6 are off and each has its own Show toggle and time range.

cm-ultimate-ma-mtf-v2.text: Plots a moving average of the close on the chart or another timeframe, with a type choice of SMA, EMA, WMA, Hull, VWMA, RMA, TEMA or Tilson T3. Multi-Timeframe Moving Avg is lime when rising versus the value Color Smoothing bars back and red when falling. An optional second average and MA Cross marks show where the two cross. Length defaults to 20, type to 1 (SMA), and the second length to 50.

cm-ultimate-ma-mtf-v4.text: Plots a fast moving average and an optional slow one, each on the chart or a higher timeframe, with a chosen type such as SMA, EMA or Hull MA. The fast line can turn bull or bear coloured by its slope or by its position versus the slow line, with a fill between them. Defaults: Fast MA Length 20, Fast MA Type SMA, Slow MA Length 50, Show Slow MA? off.

cm-ultimate-rsi-mtf.text: Computes RSI from Wilder averages of up and down closes, on the chart timeframe or another one, with an optional second RSI. The RSI is drawn with Upper Line, Lower Line and Mid Line; red background marks RSI above the upper line, green below the lower, and B or S letters mark a return back across a line. Length is 14, Upper Line Value? 70, Lower Line Value? 30.

cm-vix-fix-v3.text: Measures how far the low sits below the highest close over WVF Length (22 bars), as a percentage, and plots it inverted as the Williams Vix Fix histogram. Bars are green when the value reaches its Bollinger upper band or a share (Pct Highest 0.85) of its recent peak, else grey. Spike, spike-ended and filtered-entry lines mark states. Inputs: BB Length 20, BB Multiplier 2.

cm-vix-fix-v3-upper-text-plots.text: Computes the percent gap between the highest close of a lookback and the current low, and flags it when it reaches its upper Bollinger band or a share of its recent high. Arrows below bars mark filtered and aggressive entries. Inputs: LookBack Period Standard Deviation High (22), Bolinger Band Length (20).

cmo-for-loop-quantlapse.text: Chande Momentum Oscillator: 100 times (sum of rises minus sum of falls) over their total across Length bars of the Source. The CMO For Loop histogram is green once the value passes Long Threshold and red once it drops below Short Threshold, holding that colour between them; triangles mark trend changes and candles share the colour. Defaults: Length 14, thresholds 25 and -25.

code-for-all-4-forex-sessions-w-backgrou.text: Shades the chart background during four forex sessions, in exchange time on weekdays: New York 08:00-17:00, Australia 17:00-02:00, Asia 19:00-04:00 and Europe 03:00-12:00. Each session has a lighter shade, plus stronger shades for its first and last ten minutes, marking open and close. Each of the twelve windows has an on switch, such as NY Open On, NY Session On and NY Close On, all on by default.

code-plots-high-low-open-close-daily-wee.text: Draws the open, close, high and low of the current and previous day, week and month on the price pane. Current values show as circles and previous ones as crosses, held across every chart bar of the period; zero values are skipped. Only Show Todays OHLC? is on by default; Show Yesterdays OHLC?, Show This Weeks OHLC?, Show Previous Weeks OHLC?, Show Monthly OHLC? and Show Previous Months OHLC? start off.

cog-channel.text: Draws a linear-regression line, COG, with an inner channel BB+ and BB- at Num Deviations (2.5) standard deviations, and an outer channel Starc+ and Starc- at twice the average true range. Cross markers, Squeeze Hi and Squeeze Lo, appear when the outer channel lies wider than the inner one on both sides. Length is 34 and Source is close.

colored-volume.text: Draws volume as columns coloured by comparing the close and volume with the bar Lookback bars earlier: green for price and volume up, red for price down and volume up, blue for price up and volume down, orange for both down. Early bars are gray. Optional Volume MA line when Show MA is on. Lookback is 10, MA Length is 20.

combined-up-down-with-volume.text: Marks bars where the one-bar percentage change of the close is at least % check (5) in either direction, and bars where volume is at least Volume above (1000000). With --Combine the conditions? on, a purple circle below the bar appears only when both are true. With it off, a circle below the bar marks large moves and a circle above marks large volume.

combo-oscillator-macd-stoch-rsi-ema.text: Averages four scaled parts, an EMA gap and MACD histogram (both divided by ATR), RSI and smoothed stochastic, then smooths the result. Combo Oscillator is lime at or above 0 and red below; labels mark zero crossings. Combo Smoothing is 3, EMA Fast 21 and EMA Slow 55.

community-moneyline.text: An ATR trailing stop built on Heikin Ashi prices (or plain prices), set Trend Depth times the ATR from the close. MoneyLine is green in an uptrend and red in a downtrend, and it breaks on the bar where the trend flips; Bullish and Bearish labels mark flips. Key inputs: ATR Sensitivity (7), Trend Depth (3.5), Use Heikin Ashi Smoothing (true), Enable Momentum Filter (false).

composite-indicator.text: Combines the CCI of hlc3 with an ATR volatility filter. A B marker appears when CCI crosses above minus CCI Threshold with ATR above its SMA times the buy multiplier; an S marker when it crosses below plus the threshold with the sell multiplier. Long Stop Loss and Short Stop Loss plot only on those bars. Defaults: CCI Length 20, CCI Threshold 100, ATR Length 14, buy 1, sell 0.95, stop 1.5.

comprehensive-trading-toolkit.text: Plots a 24-period RSI with dashed Oversold (30), OverBought (70) and Level (50) lines, shading red below oversold and lime above overbought. On the price pane it draws support and resistance lines with zone boxes from large-candle pivots. Main inputs: RSI 24, OS/OB 30 and 70, Support/Resistance 30.

connors-rsi.text: Averages three parts: a short RSI of the close, an RSI of the count of consecutive up or down closes, and the percent rank of the one-bar rate of change over a long window. The result runs 0 to 100 in CRSI, with lines at 70, 50 and 30 for high, middle and low readings. Inputs are RSI Length 3, UpDown Length 2 and ROC Length 100.

consecutive-candles-devisso.text: Plots the 50% level and the 23.6% level of the body of each of the three previous candles. Three candles with lows above the prior candle's 50% level set the Long Pullback Level to the low; three with highs below it set a short level. The pullback line is the mean of both; a close crossing it gives a CR triangle. It has no inputs.

consecutive-higher-lower-closings.text: Counts consecutive bars where the chosen price (close by default) is above or below the previous bar's value; an unchanged value resets the counts. A green BUY triangle appears when the up count reaches Consecutive Higher Values for Buy (3), a red SELL triangle when the down count reaches Consecutive Lower Values for Sell (3). Signals alternate, so a BUY follows only a SELL and vice versa.

consolidation-range-with-signals.text: Detects ranging markets with the ADX below a threshold or with compressed volatility, and follows the close with a range filter. While a range is shown, Trend marks the filter and MID1 to MID4 step lines sit at one third and two thirds of the bands. A filter step gives entry, SL and TP lines, spaced by SL/TP Cooldown (Bars), 20. Range Detection Method is ADX, Range Period 10, Range Multiplier 1.8.

consolidation-zones.text: Tracks swing pivots over Loopback Period (10) and counts bars while the pivot stays inside the current range. Once the count reaches Min Consolidation Length (5), it marks the highest high and lowest low as a zone, with dashed lines over the consolidation, shaded when Paint Consolidation Area is on. Breakout Up and Breakout Down fire when a pivot leaves the zone.

coppock-curve.text: Adds a long and a short rate of change of the close, then smooths the sum with a weighted moving average. Readings above or below zero and the direction of the curve show momentum shifting. Inputs: WMA Length (10), Long RoC Length (14), Short RoC Length (11).

coral-trend.text: Coral Trend runs the source through six chained exponential smoothers and blends the last four stages with fixed weights set by Constant D, giving one smooth line on the price pane. The line is teal when it rises, red when it falls and blue when flat. Main inputs are Smoothing Period (21), Constant D (0.4) and Source (close).

corrected-moving-average.text: Plots the CMA, which follows the SMA of the source with a gain that depends on source variance versus the CMA's distance from the SMA, so it lags less in calm stretches and moves quicker on larger deviations. A ribbon between SMA and CMA is green when the SMA is above the CMA and red otherwise; Long Signal and Short Signal alerts fire when the SMA crosses above or below the CMA. Inputs: Length (35), Source (close).

correlation-coefficient.text: Pearson correlation between the chosen Source of the chart symbol and the same Source of another symbol over the last Length bars. Correlation plots between +1 (moving together) and -1 (moving opposite), with dashed levels at 1, 0 and -1. Symbol defaults to GOOG, Source to close and Length to 20.

cov-bands-c-h-i-p-a.text: Builds bands around a moving average of the close, widened by the coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by the mean). A close above the Upper Band turns the candles blue, and a close below the Lower Band turns them red; the colour holds until the other band is crossed. Period Length is 46, Upper Band Multiplier 1.2, Lower Band Multiplier 0.3, Standard Deviation length 31.

crosby-ratio-quantumresearch.text: Measures the slope angle of an SMA of a 5-bar average of the Heikin-Ashi close, scaled by Length times ATR, and shows it in degrees-style units as Crosby Ratio. The line fades in toward the up or down colour as it moves away from zero. Shaded zones sit at fixed levels, and the price background is coloured when the ratio is above 18 or below -15. Length defaults to 30.

crossover-emmm.text: Plots a fast and a slow EMA of the bar's high-low midpoint. Each line is green while rising and red while falling. Triangles mark crossovers and crossunders of the two lines, and circles mark where the fast line turns while the slow line already points the same way. Fast EMMM Length defaults to 9 and Slow EMMM Length to 33.

crt-indicator.text: Detects two-candle reversal patterns. A bearish pattern is a bullish candle followed by a bearish one with a higher high and higher low that closes inside the first body. A bullish pattern is the mirror case with a lower low. Triangles mark each pattern, and CRT High and CRT Low show the two candles' extremes on that bar when Show CRT High/Low is on (default on).

cumulative-delta-volume.text: Splits each bar's volume into buying and selling parts from the candle shape, then sums the signed delta over all bars. It is drawn as candles from the previous sum to the current one (Heikin Ashi by default) or as CDV Line when Style is Line. Optional SMA 1, SMA 2, EMA 1 and EMA 2 (50 and 200 bars) average the candle close.

cumulative-volume-delta-divergence-perio.text: Splits each bar's volume by where the close sits in the bar range into buying and selling, then sums the difference over CVD Period bars (21) or smooths it with an EMA, shown as green columns above zero and red below. Lines and labels marked -RD or +RD flag price and oscillator divergences between fractals. Divergence Fractal Periods is 2; Cumulative Mode is Periodic.

cumulative-volume-delta-strategy-flux-ch.text: Sums bar volume delta from the start of each Anchor Period (1D); a cross of the total under zero starts a sell setup, over zero a buy setup. The trade enters on a later fair value gap or order block per Entry Mode, after a retracement if Require Retracement is on, with exits set by TP / SL Method (Dynamic). CVDS Line is green after a buy, red after a sell.

cup-finder.text: Searches for cup shapes: a half circle drawn from an earlier high or low to the current bar, whose breakout is judged by Source for Breakout (Close default). A cup is kept when at least Contained Bar Rate % (75) of its bars lie in the band set by Channel Width of the Cup (5), looking back Number of Bars to search (150). Green marks bullish cups, red bearish.

curved-trend-channels.text: Builds a step trend line that follows the close, with bands set at the line plus and minus a volatility-based buffer. The Trend Line is teal when rising and red otherwise; a close beyond the buffer pulls the line toward price. Key inputs: Band Multiplier (1.8), Slope (25), Curved Channel Mode (false).

custom-buy-and-sell-signal-with-body-rat.text: Combines candle body size, RSI and volume. BUY appears below a bull bar after a bear bar when RSI is under 40; SELL appears above a bear bar after a bull bar when RSI is between 60 and 100. Either needs a body 0.9 to 9 times the previous body and volume above Volume Coefficient (1.05) times the mean of the 24-bar volume high and low. RSI Length defaults to 14.

customizable-rsi-stochrsi-double-confirm.text: Computes RSI and a Stochastic RSI whose K line is a smoothed position of RSI within its recent range. Labels mark RSI or StochRSI crossing above the buy level or below the sell level, and Double Buy or Double Sell when both cross on the same bar. Defaults: RSI Length 7, StochRSI Length 5, Smooth K 3, thresholds 20 and 80.

cvd.text: Accumulates each bar's volume delta (up minus down volume) within an anchor period, restarting at zero when a new period begins. Each candle opens at the running total and closes at total plus the bar's delta; teal means it rose, red means it fell, around the zero line. Inputs: Anchor period (1D), Use custom timeframe (off), Timeframe (1).

cvd-big-trade-detector-by-hk.text: Splits each bar's volume into buy and sell parts by where the close sits in the range, and accumulates their difference as cumulative delta, drawn as floating candles from the previous value to the current one. A circle on the candle close marks a big buy or sell, whose volume exceeds the average plus a number of standard deviations of the prior bars. Lookback Period is 50, Sensitivity (Sigma) 2.

cvd-divergence-background-by-hk.text: Estimates each bar's volume delta from where the close sits in the bar's range: buy volume is the share above the low, sell volume the share below the high, and delta is buy minus sell. The background takes the bearish colour when a green bar has negative delta, and the bullish colour when a red bar has positive delta, flagging price and volume pressure that disagree.

cvd-polarity-indicator.text: Signs each bar's volume by candle direction and sums it over CVD Cumulation Length (default 14) to get a rolling delta. Each bar then counts as plus volume when that delta rises and minus volume when it falls, with flat candles counting zero. Polarity (Rolling Smoothed) sums this over Polarity Rolling Length (default 14), and EMA smooths it with EMA Length (default 10).

cvd-reversal-divergence.text: Builds a cumulative volume delta (volume added on up candles, subtracted on down candles) and compares it with price at each confirmed pivot. A red down triangle above a pivot means price and CVD disagreed with the prior high; a green up triangle below means the same at a low. Faint crosses flag possible pivots, filtered by Filter 1 and Filter 2 (both on). Pivot Confirmation Period (Lookback) is 10.
names: Show Potential Reversal Pre-Alerts (faint X marks)
Filter 1: Require candle reversal character (bearish close at highs / bullish close at lows)

cvd-rupward.text: Cumulative sum of each bar's volume delta: the bar's volume is added when the close is above the open and subtracted when below. The CVD line is green at or above zero and red below, and three moving averages (MA A, MA B, MA C) of it are drawn. Defaults are Moving Average Length_A 34 (HMA), Length_B 89 (WMA) and Length_C 816 (SMA).

cycle-flow-indicator-d-quant.text: Averages three votes: a Schaff-style cycle direction, the Parabolic SAR side of the close, and the sign of a smoothed Ease of Movement. An average above Bullish Threshold (0.2) gives a bullish state, below Bearish Threshold (-0.2) a bearish one. Baseline, a Hull average, takes the state colour; Upper Volatility shows in bullish and Lower Volatility in bearish states.

cycle-low-v5-john-k.text: Flags a cycle low on the price chart when an RSI cross up through its oversold level and a StochRSI %K cross up through %D happen on the same bar or within one bar, after an oversold previous bar and a score at the threshold. Triangle markers show signals. RSI Length 14, RSI Oversold (0–100) 33, Score threshold (0–4) 3.

cycle-synced-channel-breakout.text: Draws a Keltner channel (EMA of close plus or minus a multiple of ATR) and marks engulfing candles with triangles. BUY or SELL labels appear when an engulfing or strong-body candle closes beyond the Upper Keltner or Lower Keltner while a cycle-power measure rises, with a pause after each signal. Defaults: Keltner Length 20, Keltner Multiplier 1.5, Cycle Lookback 20, Signal Cooldown (bars) 5.

daily-weekly-monthly-yearly-opens.text: Draws a horizontal line at the opening price of each enabled higher timeframe (day, week, month and year by default), labelled at its end, only when that timeframe is above the chart's. Lines run Offset (20) bars past the last bar; Show Tails extends the current open left, Show Projections carries earlier opens right.

dan-s-ironclad-ob-simple.text: Tracks the latest pivot high and low, then marks order-block zones when the close breaks them. A close above the last pivot high turns the last down candle of the prior 50 bars into a buy zone; a close below the last pivot low makes the last up candle a sell zone. A zone disappears when the close moves through it. Structure Lookback (default 5) sets the pivot bars on each side.

dark-cloud-cover.text: Flags a two-candle bearish reversal: after an uptrend, a long up candle is followed by a down candle that opens at or above the prior high and closes below the prior body midpoint but above the prior open. A DCC label marks it. Detect Trend Based On defaults to SMA50.

darvas-box.text: Tracks a box whose top is set when a bar's high equals the highest high of the last Box Length (5) bars, with the bottom at the lowest low of that window. Box Top and Box Bottom hold their levels until a close above the top starts a new box search, or a close below the bottom resets the box to the current window's extremes.

dead-simple-reversal.text: Detects two-bar reversals. A buy needs a bearish prior bar, then a bullish bar closing above the prior open, while one of the long-period lows from 1 to 4 bars back is above the near-term low; a sell mirrors this with highs. Buys draw a triangle below the bar, sells a triangle above, and they trigger the Buy Signal and Sell Signal alerts. Inputs: Near Term Period (3) and Long Term Period (50).

decisionpoint-volume-swenlin-trading.text: Breadth oscillator: (advancing volume - declining volume) / (their sum) times 1000, smoothed by a 4-bar EMA then a 5-bar average, drawn as DSTO-Volume around the grey MidLine at 0. Histo is green above 0 and rising, red below 0 and falling, orange otherwise. Market picks the volume symbols (default 1, NYSE); Show Histo defaults on.

decode-moving-average-toolkit.text: Draws up to five EMAs and five SMAs of the source, each with its own length and show toggle. Five crossover alerts each compare a chosen Fast MA with a Slow MA: a cross up draws a green triangle below the bar, a cross down a red triangle above. Defaults show EMA 1 (10), EMA 2 (20), SMA 3 (50) and SMA 5 (200); Alert 1 uses EMA 1 over EMA 2.

delta-flow-profile.text: Splits the price range of the last Lookback Length / Fixed Range bars (360) into Number of Rows (25) and spreads each bar's volume times price across the rows it touches. Long rows show where money flow concentrated; the Delta Profile shows each row's net bullish versus bearish flow, coloured by the dominant side. Level of Significance marks the largest row, as Developing by default.

delta-ladder.text: Splits each recent bar into rows and estimates buy minus sell volume per row from lower timeframe bars, counting a bar as buying when it closes above the prior close. Boxes show each row's delta, with the largest framed and a total label per bar. Key inputs: Lower TF For Delta Calculation (1), Divide Bars Into How Many Rows ? (10) and Data Display Method (Classic).
names: Divide Bars Into How Many Rows ?

delta-manipulation-footprint.text: Computes a per-bar volume delta (positive on flat or up candles, negative on down candles) and its change from the previous bar. Bars where that change's size exceeds the average size times a multiplier get coloured: green for an up candle with rising delta, red for a down candle with falling delta, yellow when they disagree. Moving Average Length is 20, Threshold Multiplier 1.9.

delta-rsi-oscillator.text: Measures the slope of the RSI: a polynomial is fitted to the last Frame Length (18) RSI values, and its derivative at the latest bar is drawn as D-RSI columns. Green columns sit above the Zero Line and red below it; darker or lighter shades show whether the value is rising or falling. Signal Line is an EMA of D-RSI. Defaults: RSI Length 14, Polynomial Order 2, D-RSI Signal Length 9.
names: Frame Length (must be greater than Order)

delta-volume-candles.text: Rebuilds candles from volume delta measured on lower-timeframe intrabars, splitting each bar's volume into up and down. Bodies can be coloured by bar polarity or by balances such as Bar Balance or Average Balance, with tops and bottoms sized by the delta share. Inputs: Color bodies on (Bar polarity (like normal candles)), Display for tops and bottoms (Volume delta on winning side only), Tolerance (%) 1.

delta-volume-rsi.text: An RSI built on a tick-rule volume delta: volume counts as positive on an up close and negative on a down close. Gains and losses are smoothed with an RMA over RSI Period (14). The Delta Volume RSI line is green at 50 and above and red below, with dashed lines at 70, 50 and 30.

delta-zones-buy-sell-pressure.text: Computes each bar's delta from open, high, low and close, and flags buy pressure (triangle below) or sell pressure (triangle above) when it exceeds a multiple of the delta standard deviation. Each flagged bar draws a zone on a wick; the latest ones stay. Standard Deviation defaults to 3.5, Standard Deviation Lookback to 20, Max Boxes Visible to 3.

deltaflow-volume-profile.text: Splits the high-low range of the last LookBack + 1 bars into Bins equal price levels and sums each bar's volume into levels near its close, as buy volume (close at or above open) or sell volume. On the right of the chart, each level shows a volume bar with buy and sell parts, a delta percentage label, a heat map band and a box marking the largest-volume level. Defaults: LookBack 200, Bins 30, offset 5.

dema.text: Applies an exponential average to Source twice and plots twice the first minus the second, which cuts the lag of a single exponential average. The DEMA line sits on the price pane and turns faster than a plain average of the same length. Inputs are length (default 9) and Source (default close).

dema-flow.text: Computes a double exponential moving average of the close, smooths it with a running median, and places ATR bands around it. The trend turns bullish when the close is above the upper band and bearish below the lower band; Smooth DEMA Trend, candles and bars take the trend colour. Inputs: DEMA Length (23), HL Median Filter Length (4), ATR Length (14), Upper ATR Multiplier (2.1), Lower ATR Multiplier (1.5).

demand-index.text: Builds buy and sell power from volume relative to its average, weighted by the move in high + low + 2 × close, and smooths both with EMAs. The Demand Index is 100 times the gap between the ratio of the weaker to stronger power and 1, positive when buy power leads. It is green at or above the Zero Line and red below, with DI SMA averaging it over Smooth Demand Index (SMA) (10) bars.

demand-supply-zones.text: Finds runs of same-direction candles whose move from the run's first open to the close reaches Min % change, and boxes the candle before the run as a demand zone (bullish run) or supply zone (bearish run), cut to Max % zone height. A zone turns transparent with a dotted border once price hits it. Active zones within % line of the close get level lines and price labels, up to Max line per type.

deviation-symmetry-breaker-c-h-i-p-a.text: A double median of the Source (First Median Length 33, then Second Median Length (Smoother) 34) forms a hidden centre. Upper Band and Lower Band are the centre plus and minus the deviation over Deviation Band Length (25) times Upper Band Multiplier (1.72) and Lower Band Multiplier (-1.12). Candles turn blue after the source crosses above the Upper Band, red after it crosses below the Lower Band.

deviation-trend-profile.text: Plots an SMA of the close with six levels above and below it at 1, 2 and 3 times a 200-bar ATR. The SMA shades from the down colour to the up colour with its 5-bar slope, and a circle marks each trend turn when the slope crosses 0.1 or -0.1. On the last bar a profile counts closes since the trend began. Inputs: SMA Length 50, Standart Deviation 1, 2, 3 at 1, 2, 3, Bins Amount 50.

dip-buy-sell-signals.text: Combines three tests: a Vix Fix reading (drop from the recent highest close) at or above its upper Bollinger band or a share of its recent peak, close deviation from a moving average beyond a percent, and a true-range-scaled distance from a moving average past a level. When all agree on the buy side, a green label appears below the bar. Key inputs: Length of MA (200), Deviation Percent (10), TRMAD Buy Level (-3).

dip-rip-patterns-the-quant-science.text: Compares each bar's high and low with the lowest low and highest high of the previous bars in the analysis window. A rip is a high at least Rip Threshold [%] (5) above that lowest low; a dip is a low at least Dip Threshold [%] (-5) below that highest high. Dip-only bars turn red with a circle below; rip-only bars turn green with a circle above. Analysis Period [Bars] is 2.

directional-indicator-crossovers-v1.text: Calculates +DI and -DI from smoothed directional movement over smoothed true range, plus an ADX from their normalised gap. The area between the lines is shaded green while +DI leads and red while -DI leads; dots mark crossings, firing Bullish DI Crossover or Bearish DI Crossover, optionally only when ADX is above ADX Threshold (20). Inputs: DI Length (20), ADX Length (20), Smoothing (EMA).

directional-logistic-oscillator.text: Turns +DI, -DI and ADX into logistic probabilities against their long averages, then combines them into a tanh-bounded strength between -1 and 1. Columns are strong when strength is beyond its EMA and weak otherwise; markers flag percentile extremes and cycle turns. Inputs: DI Length 14, Mean Lookback 360, Oscillator Smoothing Length 7.

disparity-index.text: Measures the percent distance of the close from three EMAs: 100 times close minus EMA, divided by the EMA. Values above the dotted zero line mean the close is above that average, below means under it; larger values mean a wider gap. Defaults are LengthFirst 200, LengthSecond 50 and LengthThird 20, and each of DIX 1, DIX 2 and DIX 3 can be hidden.

divergence-for-many-indicator-v3.text: Compares new price highs and lows with the last confirmed pivot and with up to 11 indicators, such as RSI, MACD and OBV. Each indicator that disagrees counts as one divergence. A red line and label mark negative ones above price, a green line and label mark positive ones below, showing the count. Key inputs: Left Bars 5, Right Bars 5, Show Hidden Divergences off, Minimum Number of Divergence 1.

divergence-for-many-indicators-v4.text: Compares price pivots with up to eleven indicators (MACD, RSI, Stochastic, CCI, OBV and others) and draws a line on price wherever the indicator and price disagree. Regular divergences are solid and hidden ones dashed by default; a label lists the indicators and their count. Pivot Period is 5, Divergence Type is Regular, and Minimum Number of Divergence is 1.

divergence-indicator.text: Finds pivot highs and lows of the Indicator source (ohlc4) using Pivot Lookback Left and Right (5 each) and compares them with price extremes at the previous pivot, 5 to 60 bars back. Regular Bullish and Regular Bearish are on by default; the hidden versions are off. Labels mark each divergence, drawn on price if Plot on price is enabled.
names: Plot on price (rather than on indicator)

divergence-screener.text: Plots an oscillator (RSI 14 by default) and builds a zigzag on it with Length (13). When price and oscillator pivots disagree, it draws divergence lines labelled D, or H for hidden ones, with green and red for bullish and bearish and lime and orange for hidden ones. Trend Detection Method (Zigzag) decides regular versus hidden; Repaint (on) uses the latest pivot.

dmi.text: Measures directional movement against smoothed true range to give +DI for upward pressure and -DI for downward pressure, plus ADX, a smoothed measure of how far the two apart, showing trend strength. Higher ADX means a stronger trend; +DI above -DI favours upward movement. Inputs: ADX Smoothing (14) and DI Length (14).

dmi-adx-levels.text: Computes Wilder-style directional movement: +DI and -DI from smoothed up and down moves relative to smoothed true range, and ADX from the smoothed gap between them relative to their sum. A flat Key Level line (23) is drawn for comparing ADX; +DI above -DI indicates upward pressure dominating. Inputs are ADX Smoothing (14), DI Length (14) and key level for ADX.

dmi-delta-by-0xjcf.text: Histogram of DI+ minus DI- from the directional index. In Delta Highlight mode bars are coloured by trend strength: ADX against Trending Threshold 25, and delta beyond DMI Upper Limit 30 or DMI Lower Limit -30. Volume Analysis mode shows signed volume instead. Inputs include DMI Length 14.

dmi-histogram-indicator.text: Computes directional movement with Wilder smoothing, then plots +DI minus -DI as DI Histogram. Green means +DI leads and red means -DI leads, with shade set by ADX versus its average and fading as ADX falls. Triangles mark ADX crossing under its average. DI Length is 14, ADX Signal Length 20.

dn-macd.text: Computes MACD as the fast minus slow moving average of the source, a signal line from the MACD, and a histogram of twice their difference drawn as candles from zero. Green borders mark a histogram at or above zero, red below; the background is green when Signal is above zero. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9, both MA types EMA.

doji.text: Marks single candles whose open and close are nearly equal, signalling indecision. Dragonfly-type and gravestone-type dojis, those with one shadow no longer than the body, are excluded. A neutral D label is placed on matching candles.

doji-star-bearish.text: Finds a long white candle in an uptrend followed by a doji whose body sits entirely above the first candle's body. A match is marked with a DS label, and the alert fires on each new pattern. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the uptrend is judged.

doji-star-bullish.text: Finds a long black candle in a downtrend followed by a doji whose body sits entirely below the first candle's body. A match is marked with a DS label, and the alert fires on each new pattern. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the downtrend is judged.

dominance-signal-apex.text: Tracks a Heikin-Ashi body state (bull or bear) that is cleared when four smoothed closes lose their ordered stack, plus a Hull MA of the source drawn as HMA, lime when rising and red otherwise. Circles appear below bars in a bull state with a rising HMA and above bars in a bear state with a falling HMA, fading over Steps bars. Main inputs: Length 50, Source close, Steps 8.

donalt-smart-money-toolkit.text: Three tools on the last 400 bars. Levels are horizontal lines at pivots of candle bodies, coloured one way while the close is above them and another below. Order blocks are boxes over the last opposite candle after a gap. Trend lines join the two latest pivots. Period is 20 for levels and 10 for trend lines; Extend is 10.

donchian.text: Tracks the highest high (Upper) and lowest low (Lower) over the last length bars, with Basis as the midpoint of the two. Price near Upper or Lower shows it is at the edge of its recent range, and the shaded area between them is the channel. Defaults are length 20 and Offset 0, which shifts the lines in time.

donchian-custom.text: A Donchian channel with different lengths per side: the upper line is the highest high of the last Upper Channel (4) bars and the lower line the lowest low of the last Lower Channel (60) bars. Mid-Line Average is their midpoint, and the space between the outer lines is shaded. Price near either line shows where it sits within recent extremes.

donchian-reversal-signals-with-labels.text: Computes two Donchian channels from highest highs and lowest lows over two lengths. A yellow B label below a green candle appears when the previous red candle's low was at or below either lower band; a green S label above a red candle appears when the previous green candle's high was at or above either upper band. Inputs: Donchian Channel Length 1 (20) and Donchian Channel Length 2 (34).

donchian-trend-ribbon.text: Donchian Trend Ribbon runs ten Donchian breakout trend checks, with lengths from the period down to nine less. A close above the prior channel high turns a layer bullish, and below the prior low turns it bearish. Each row, Layer 1 to Layer 10, is bright green or red when it agrees with Layer 1, dimmer when not. Input: Donchian Channel Period (20).

dope-dpo.text: Averages ten detrended price values (close minus a lagged WMA) for two ribbons, then smooths each. Final DPO 1 is columns, green when rising versus Bars back for short DPO (5), else red; Final DPO 2 is a line using Bars back for long DPO (15).
