Bullish and Bearish mark divergences with price when Show Divergence is on. Smoothing length is 5.

double-ema-with-pullback-buy-sell-signal.text: Plots two exponential averages, EMA 1 (period 50) and EMA 2 (period 200), each on its own source (close). A Buy label appears when the close crosses above EMA 1 while EMA 1 is above EMA 2 and the close Backstep of Pullback bars ago (default 5) was above EMA 1; Sell is the mirror case. Buy Signal and Sell Signal are also alerts.

double-macd.text: Plots two MACDs, each as a line and a histogram: 12/26 and 5/15, the difference of two EMAs of the Source. Bull and bear divergence labels come from fractal peaks and troughs of the 5/15 line, and Buy, Sell, CT Buy and CT Sell triangles mark its zero or 12/26 crosses. Inputs: MACD1 Fast 12, MACD1 Slow 26, MACD2 Fast 5, MACD2 Slow 15, Signal 9 each.

double-median-atr-bands-misinkomaster.text: Takes the median of the source, then builds bands by taking a short median of that median plus and minus ATR times a multiplier. The source crossing over Upper Band turns the lines and fill blue (up trend); crossing under Lower Band turns them purple (down trend); before any signal they are white. Inputs: Median Length 23, ATR Length 17, ATR Multiplier 1.05.

double-median-sd-bands-misinkomaster.text: Builds bands at the source plus and minus its standard deviation times a multiplier, then smooths each twice with medians. The source crossing above the Upper Band turns the lines and fill purple (up trend); crossing below the Lower Band turns them amber. Before any signal they are white. Length is 27, Band Multiplier 1.4, src ohlc4, Use Biased SD? on.

double-rsi.text: Computes DRSI as twice the RSI of the close minus the RSI of that RSI, similar to a DEMA. The state turns long when DRSI is above Long Threshold (59) and short when below Short Threshold (52), otherwise it keeps its last state. The line takes the state colour (lime or red) and triangles mark switches. DRSI Length is 13.

double-top-bottom-ultimate.text: Builds a zig-zag from highest-high and lowest-low pivots over length bars (default 10) and looks for a lower high or higher low after a prior extreme, when risk is below MaxRiskPerReward percent (default 30). It labels Double Top or Double Bottom, then marks confirmation when the middle pivot is crossed and invalidation when the outer pivot is crossed. showPivots adds HH/LH/HL/LL labels and showStats a count table.

double-zig-zag-with-hhll.text: Builds two zig zags from pivots: a bar is a pivot high when its high is the highest of the period, a pivot low when its low is the lowest. Lines join the last two points, and labels HH, LH, LL or HL compare each new point with the one two steps back. Main inputs are ZigZag Period 1 (8) and ZigZag Period 2 (20).

downside-tasuki-gap.text: Detects a three-candle pattern in a downtrend: a long black candle, a small black candle with its body gapped below it, then a white candle closing inside the gap without fully closing it. A match gets a DTG label, and the alert fires on each new pattern. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets the trend test.

dpo.text: Subtracts from the current close a simple moving average of the close taken from about half its length plus one bars earlier, which removes the trend and leaves cycles around the DPO Zero Line. Values above zero mean price is above that shifted average. Inputs are Length (21) and Centered (false), which shifts the line back to the left when turned on.

dr-idr-v1.text: Marks the defining range of three New York sessions: the high and low of the session (DR) and the highest and lowest candle body (IDR), with optional middle lines, an opening line and a box. Lines follow the session and extend through the lines time; STD lines are drawn every half IDR range from the regular session. Main inputs: RDR Time 0930-1030, ADR Time 1930-2030, ODR Time 0300-0400, Box DR or IDR ? IDR.

dragonfly-doji.text: Flags a single candle with a doji-sized body whose upper shadow is no larger than the body, so the open and close sit near the high. A match gets a DD label, and the alert fires on each new pattern. It uses no trend test.

dtfx-algo-zones.text: Finds swing highs and lows using Structure Length (10), then draws a shaded zone with Fibonacci level lines whenever a close breaks the last swing high or low. Grey circles mark swing points when Show Swing Points is on. Zone Display (Both) filters bullish or bearish zones, Show Last limits zones unless Display All Zones is on, and Clean-Up Level Overlap trims older levels.

dual-bayesian-for-loop.text: Scores how often the Source is above its values from Loop Start (1) to Loop Lookback (70) bars ago, turns that score and its Length (14) bar average into Bayesian probabilities, and smooths them into a signal. Signal is drawn as +1 (green) when the smoothed value is above 50 and -1 (red) otherwise; flips across zero trigger the cross alerts and L or S markers.

dual-ema-trend-ribbon.text: Plots four EMAs of the close, forming two ribbons: one filled between Fast EMA 1 and Slow EMA 1, another between Fast EMA 2 and Slow EMA 2. A ribbon is green when its fast EMA is above its slow EMA and red otherwise, so the two ribbons show whether both pairs agree. Periods: Fast EMA 1 Period (10), Slow EMA 1 Period (30), Fast EMA 2 Period (40), Slow EMA 2 Period (50).

dual-ma-sd-oscillator.text: Takes the spread between a fast and a slow EMA of the Source, smooths it, and shows it as Histogram columns inside Upper SD Band and Lower SD Band, set by its standard deviation. The state turns bullish when the spread closes above the upper band and bearish below the lower; BULL and BEAR triangles mark changes. Fast Length 1, Slow Length 30, SD lengths 25.

dual-rsi-smoother.text: Two RSIs of the close, with RSI Length 1 (5) and RSI Length 2 (6), are smoothed by SMAs (Smooth Length RSI 1 6, Smooth Length RSI 2 13), stretched around 50 and clamped to 0-100. RSI2 turns green when the two lines sum below 55. Green dots below RSI1 mark low readings, red dots above it mark a high RSI1 well above RSI2 or above 95, and each triggers an alert.

dynamic-flow-ribbons.text: Builds supertrend-style bands around a 15-bar EMA of hlc3, offset by Length times the 200-bar average bar range. The TrendLine, the midpoint of the bands, takes the Up Color or Down Color with the trend. Fading ribbons surround the active band. Length defaults to 3.

dynamic-fractal-flow.text: Measures where the close sits between the last down and up fractal, smooths it with a WMA and EMAs, and scales it to -5..5 as DFF Signal. Above zero is bullish, below is bearish; Upper Threshold and Lower Threshold sit at plus and minus Signal Threshold (0.3), with standard deviation bands around the signal. Noise Threshold (1) damps the signal in choppy markets.

dynamic-linear-regression-channels.text: Fits a least squares line through the closes from a start bar to the current bar, with upper and lower bands at a multiple of the standard deviation of closes around that line. When a close breaks outside the bands, the finished channel is kept as a filled band and a new one starts on that bar. Inputs: Upper Deviation (2) and Lower Deviation (2).

dynamic-liquidity-heatmap-profile.text: Builds liquidity levels above recent 2-bar highs and below 2-bar lows, spaced by ATR scaled by relative 10-bar volume, then bins the volume resting on them. Lines and boxes to the right show each bin's volume and share, with the largest bin in the max colour; green bins sit below the close, blue above. Inputs: Calculated Bars (300), Resolution (50), Profile (true).

dynamic-score-psar.text: Measures the close's distance from a Parabolic SAR, scaled by the 21-bar average high-low range, and draws it as columns. A trend score counts how many of the last bars were below the current value. Green columns mean uptrend, red downtrend, grey neutral; arrows mark zero crossings inside a confirmed trend. Key inputs: Window Length (60), Uptrend Threshold (30), Downtrend Threshold (-20).

dynamic-stop-loss-take-profit.text: Places Stop Loss and Take Profit levels around the close at multiples of the ATR. For Long, Stop Loss sits below the close and Take Profit above; Short mirrors them. Inputs: ATR Length 14, Stop Loss Multiplier 1.5, Take Profit Multiplier 3, Trade Type Long.

dynamic-structure-indicator.text: Finds swing highs and lows and builds resistance (R1, R2) and support (S1, S2) zones, kept only if no wider than Max Zone Size (ATR) (2.5) times ATR. A zone goes live after price moves ATR Movement (1) ATRs away; broken zones show as PS1/PS2 and PR1/PR2. Lookback is 25; New Structure Reset is 25.

dynamic-supply-and-demand-zones.text: Builds a volume profile of the bars since the last major pivot, splitting the price range into Resolution bins (40). Bins with clearly less volume than both neighbours, under Zone Tolerance (0.93) times each, become boxes labelled with their volume deficit. Boxes turn green below the close and red above it. Pivot Point Detection Period is 200.

dynamic-support-resistance.text: Plots three EMAs of close and fills the zone between the 20 and 50 EMAs. Red means EMA 200 above 50 above 20, a bearish stack; lime means the reverse order, a bullish stack. The 200 EMA shows only in those cases. Inputs: Longterm EMA Length 200, DSR 1 EMA Length 50, DSR 2 EMA Length 20.

dynamic-support-resistance-zones.text: Counts the prices of recent pivot highs and lows into price bins, weighted by Weighting (Linear by default), then smooths the scores. Local peaks become support and resistance lines, green below the close and red above, with bounce markers where candles reject a level. Main inputs: Number of Pivots 50, Filtering 3, Manual Precision 75 bins. Pivot Level Average plots MA, off by default.

dynamic-swing-anchored-vwap.text: Finds swing direction from whether the highest high or lowest low of the last Swing Period bars (50) is more recent. At each flip it labels the prior swing point (HH, LH, HL, LL) and anchors a new VWAP line there. Adaptive Price Tracking (20) sets the VWAP's half-life in bars; Adapt APT by ATR ratio (off) scales it with Volatility Bias (10).

dynamic-testing.text: A WaveTrend oscillator on hlc3: WT1 is a smoothed, volatility-normalised distance of price from its EMA, and WT2 is a 4-bar average of WT1. A circle and thick mark appear at WT2 where WT1 and WT2 cross, in red when WT2 is above WT1 and lime otherwise; WT1 - WT2 shows the gap. Levels sit at Zero Line and the overbought/oversold pairs; Channel Length is 10 and Average Length is 21.

dynamic-trailing.text: Averages a supertrend of the bar midpoint, a smoothed support or resistance curve, and the lowest or highest close plus ATR into one trailing line, Smart Trailing, with a Cloud offset one ATR times Cloud width from it. The line and cloud are green when the close is above the trail and red otherwise, and the line is hidden when the supertrend direction changes. Mult defaults to 7.5, Len to 26, ATR Length to 100.

dynamic-trend-bands.text: Builds a double Hull moving average of close and offsets it by ATR(100) times Distance to get upper and lower bands. The lower band shows only while rising or flat versus Size bars ago, the upper only while falling or flat, each as two lines with a fill and a middle line. Length (40) sets the average; Size (2) sets the comparison offset; Momentum Shift (off) colours bars orange.

dynamic-trend-channel.text: A Trend line is the EMA of the close over Channel Length (30), with Upper Band and Lower Band set ATR Multiplier (1.5) times the ATR (ATR Length 14) above and below it. The trend line and bars are lime when the close is above the EMA, red otherwise. A BUY label marks a close crossing over the upper band, a SELL label one under the lower band.

dynamic-volatility-filter.text: A filter line that moves toward the source by a fraction of the gap only when the gap exceeds an ATR-based noise threshold, otherwise staying flat. Rising means up trend, falling means down trend; flat keeps the last direction unless Show Neutral is on. Upper Band and Lower Band sit at the line plus and minus the threshold. Noise Filter 2, Volatility Period 20, Catch-up Speed 0.3.

dynamic-volume-clusters.text: Builds an upper and lower zone from the highest high and lowest low over Range Lookback Period (500), each zone Zone Width (% of Range) wide (1.5). VPMA Upper and VPMA Lower restart on closes in their zone, then average later closes. Retest Signals (on) show triangles when close crosses a line with the short trend agreeing; candles are coloured by an adaptive price cluster.

dynamic-volume-profile-oscillator.text: Scores how far price sits from the volume-weighted mean of the last Lookback Period bars (50), as 50 plus a scaled distance in average deviations, smoothed by Smoothing Length (5). The Volume Profile Oscillator is bullish above the Adaptive Midline or when Fast Signal is above Slow Signal; Upper Zone and Lower Zone lie a stdev times Zone Width Multiplier (1.5) from the midline.

dynamic-vwap-fair-value-divergence-suite.text: A VWAP anchored at the last swing low, with bands at ±1 and ±2 standard deviations of the close, and +3 to +5 above it. Fills show which zone the open or close sits in. Markers flag a higher high with a falling VWAP slope, a low-volume close above the VWAP, and a close back under +1σ after one above +3σ. Inputs: Standard Deviation Length (20), Swing Low Lookback Bars (50), VWAP Slope Length (20).

e9-bollinger-range.text: Draws Bollinger-style bands on price: a Basis moving average of the source with four band pairs at 1, 2, 3 and 3.5 standard deviations, plus EMA1 (20) and EMA2 (150) of the close. Triangles mark closes crossing the Basis. Main inputs are Length 40 and Basis MA Type EMA.

eagles-compass.text: Looks for candle reversals at 20-bar extremes. A bullish signal is a green candle whose low reaches the prior 20-bar lowest low with a limited upper wick; a bearish one is a red candle whose high reaches the prior 20-bar highest high with a small lower wick. A green triangle below the bar or a red triangle above it marks the first bar of each signal. No inputs.

early-macd-reversal-indicator.text: Plots the MACD histogram: fast EMA minus slow EMA, less an EMA of that difference. Bars change colour with the sign and whether the histogram is rising or falling. A buy triangle at the top and green background appear when a negative histogram turns up after five falling bars; a sell triangle at the bottom and red background mark the mirror case. Inputs: Fast EMA Length 12, Slow EMA Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9.

early-pivot-alert-v1a.text: Tracks the extreme of the current trend and a reversal threshold from the Methode (default Percent, 0.5 %; ATR, Points or StdDev also possible). An up triangle appears when the close climbs that threshold above the last low in a downtrend, a down triangle when it drops that far below the last high in an uptrend. Trigger Up and Trigger Down show the active level; Minimum bars tussen 2 signalen defaults to 3.

easy-trend-colors.text: Computes a MACD from fast and slow EMAs of the Source, wraps it in Bollinger-style bands (Upper Band, Lower Band) around its average, and draws a Zero Line. MACD Up marks bars where MACD is at or above the upper band, otherwise MACD Down. Bull and Bear labels mark crossings of the upper band. Inputs: BB Periods 10, Deviations 1, Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26.

edward-smart-channel-reversal.text: Plots a channel of the highest high and lowest low over Channel Length (default 20) with its middle line, plus an EMA set by Trend EMA (default 100). A BUY label appears when the low touches the lower channel, the bar closes up and back above it, RSI (RSI Length, default 14) is below 40 and the close is above the EMA. SELL is the mirror: high at the upper channel, red bar, RSI above 60, close below the EMA.

effective-fvg-indicator-imran.text: Finds fair value gaps: bullish when the low two bars back is above the current high, bearish when the high two bars back is below the current low. Only gaps with volume over 1.5 times its 20-bar average and a body above its 20-bar average count. BUY Signal shows green below, SELL Signal red above; FVG Debug adds a purple circle. No inputs.

effective-volume-z-score.text: Multiplies volume by the close-open share of the bar's range, smooths it with an EMA, and plots its z-score over Z-Score Length (300) as Effective Volume Z-Score. Lines mark zero and the Upper threshold (2) and Lower threshold (-2). Optional Bull and Bear divergence labels come from Plot Bullish and Plot Bearish, both off.

efficiency-ratio-trend.text: Draws a step line that jumps to the source only when it moves beyond a band around the line. The band blends two standard deviations of twice the source, weighted by the Kaufman efficiency ratio. The line is cyan after an upward step and purple after a downward one, once the step is large enough versus ATR. Inputs: Length (200), Fast Length (100), Slow Length (400), Src (close).

ehlers-adaptive-rsi.text: An RSI whose length changes with volatility: relative ATR sets a smoothed period, and the RSI length is half of it, limited to 3 to 30, using Wilder averages. Adaptive RSI is read against fixed levels: Overbought at 65, Oversold at 35 and Midline at 50, with green shading above 65 and red below 35. The only input is Source (close).

ehlers-adaptive-trend-indicator.text: Ehlers Basis averages the last Ehlers Length (p1) source values (default 30), each weighted by its difference from the value Momentum Length (p2) bars earlier (25). Bands sit at the basis plus or minus smoothed standard deviation times Sensitivity. The trend flips on a close beyond a band, and Trend Level trails the opposite band, with colours following the trend.

ehlers-instantaneous-trend.text: Runs the midpoint of each bar's high and low through a second-order recursive filter to get a smooth trend line, plus a Trigger line equal to twice the trend minus its value two bars earlier. The Trigger above ITrend is bullish (teal), below is bearish (red), with shading between them. Alpha (0.07) sets responsiveness; Color Bars (false) can tint price bars.

ehlers-maclaurin-ultimate-smoother.text: Smooths the source with a two-pole low-pass recursion; Plot Type picks the original smoother or a Maclaurin version that first high-pass filters the source over hpLength and uses a series-approximated cosine. The line takes the colour of the original smoother's direction, rising or falling, or in Intensity mode a shade scaled by change versus ATR. Length defaults to 30, hpLength to 10.

ehlers-mesa-ma.text: Computes an adaptive moving average pair: a Hilbert-transform cycle measurement sets a smoothing factor between Slow Limit and Fast Limit, driving MAMA, with FAMA as a slower follower of it. MAMA crossing FAMA marks a change in direction; optional crossover arrows, fill and bar colours show this. Source defaults to hl2, Fast Limit 0.5, Slow Limit 0.05.

ehlers-regime-dynamic-candles.text: Redraws candles after Super Smoother filtering and measures trend strength through autocorrelation, optionally weighted by volume. Colour blends from the choppy shade to bullish or bearish as trend strength rises. Cycle Length (7) and Trend Detection Threshold (3) matter most.

ehlers-reverse-ema.text: Runs an EMA of the close through an eight-stage reverse-EMA cascade, and plots the EMA minus Alpha (default 0.1) times the last stage as Reverse EMA, after a 75-bar warm-up. It is green above zero and red below; MA is a 14-length SMA of it by default (MA Type, MA Length). With Show Signals on, triangles mark zero crosses, MA crosses, or both, per Signal Type.

ehlers-stochastic-cg.text: Computes the center of gravity of closes over Length bars (default 8), then rescales it to a 0 to 1 range against its own recent high and low, plotted as CG. Trigger is that value one bar earlier, slightly adjusted. CG crossing above or below Trigger shifts the shaded fill; dotted lines mark 0.8 (OB Level) and -0.8 (OS Level) with a dashed Zero line.

elder-force.text: Multiplies each bar's close-to-close change by its volume, then smooths it with an exponential average. Elder Force Index above the Zero level means volume-weighted buying pressure has been dominating, and below it selling pressure. length sets the smoothing period and defaults to 13.

elite-oscillator-pro.text: A stochastic or RSI of the source (Calculation Mode, Length 14), smoothed twice by EMAs (Smoothing 1 and 2, both 3) and drawn as Elite Oscillator against Overbought 70, Oversold 30 and Midline 50. Dots mark entries into overbought, oversold, the neutral band, and bullish momentum crosses of a signal line (Signal Line Length 9) above the midline.

elliot-wave-impulse.text: Builds a zig-zag from pivots over zigzagLength bars and looks for the start of an impulse wave: wave 2 must retrace 0.5, 0.618, 0.764 or 0.854 of wave 1 within errorPercent. A match draws both waves (green if wave 2 falls, red if it rises) plus entry, stop, trailing stop and four target lines. Defaults: zigzagLength 10, errorPercent 5, entryPercent 30.

elliott-impulse-engine.text: Tracks one Elliott impulse count (points 0 to 5, then A, B, C) as a state machine seeded by a change of character from swing pivots. It draws the path, point labels, Fibonacci grid, target boxes and a dashed projection, and a count ends on invalidation or completion. Key inputs: Swing Detection Length 10, Point Confirmation, bars 5, Show Projection on.

elliott-wave.text: Runs up to three zig-zags with pivot lengths 4, 8 and 16 and tests the last six points for a five-wave motive pattern (1)-(5), then an (a)-(b)-(c) correction within level 4 of it. Lines turn dotted or dashed when a pattern fails; a circle marks a possible new start, and a cross marks a break of the correction box. The latest motive wave gets Fibonacci levels at 0.5, 0.618, 0.764 and 0.854 (level 1 to level 4).

elliott-wave-oscillator.text: Subtracts a slow simple average from a fast one, by default as a percentage of the current source value, and draws it as a histogram. Teal bars mean the value is above zero, red bars mean zero or below. Inputs: Source (close), SMA 1 Length (5), SMA 2 Length (35), and Show Dif as percent of current Candle (true).
names: Show Dif as percent of current Candle

elliott-wave-oscillator-lazybear.text: Computes the difference between a 5-period and a 35-period exponential moving average of the close, drawn as a histogram in EWO. Bars are lime when the value is above zero and red when it is at zero or below, so the colour shows which average is on top. It has no inputs.

elliott-wave-oscillator-signals-by-dgt.text: Computes an oscillator from the 5-bar average of close over its 34-bar average, in percent, plus a signal line over Signal Delay bars (5). A cross above the signal marks a long label, a cross below a short one; labels are stronger beyond Signal Strength Threshold (13). Smoothing picks EMA (default) or SMA.

elliptic-curve-sar.text: A Parabolic-SAR-style stop whose acceleration comes from a point moving along an elliptic curve, between Initial acceleration 0.02 and Max acceleration 0.2. EC-SAR is blue in an uptrend and red in a downtrend, and reverses when the close crosses it; Extreme Point is the trend's highest high or lowest low. Triangles mark reversals, and the curve is set by Curve parameter a 0 and Curve parameter b 1.

ema.text: Plots an exponential moving average of Source over Length bars (default 9) on the price pane, weighting recent bars more heavily. Type (default None) can add EMA-based MA, an average of the line over Length 14; the SMA + Bollinger Bands option also draws an Upper Bollinger Band and Lower Bollinger Band at BB StdDev (default 2).

ema-9-26-cross.text: Plots the 9-period and 26-period exponential moving averages of the close, with no inputs. A blue X mark is drawn on the EMA 9 value on bars where it crosses above or below EMA 26, so a fast line moving through the slow one marks a possible trend shift. Alerts fire on each cross.

ema-cloud-trend.text: Plots three EMAs of the close with shaded clouds between them; the outer cloud is green when the fast EMA is above the slow one and red otherwise. A fast cross over the slow gives a BUY triangle and label, a cross under gives SELL. Defaults: Fast EMA 8, Medium EMA 18, Slow EMA 36.

ema-cross-signals.text: Plots a 20-bar Fast EMA and a 50-bar Slow EMA of the close. A BUY triangle appears below the bar when the Fast EMA crosses over the Slow EMA, and a SELL triangle above the bar when it crosses under. It has no inputs.

ema-enveloper.text: Draws an EMA of the Source with an envelope made from an EMA of the highs (Upper) and an EMA of the lows (Lower). Price closing above or below the envelope, or moving inside it, shows whether the trend is pushing past its usual range. The background is tinted by whether the bar's high and low sit above both bands, below both, or in between. Length defaults to 20 and Source to close.

ema-ma-crossover.text: Plots an exponential and a simple moving average of the Source. Bars are tinted by which line is higher: green-teal while the EMA is below the SMA, red while it is above, and blue only if the two are equal. A crossing of EMA and SMA marks a change of that state. EMA Length defaults to 12, SMA Length to 26 and Source to close.

ema-macd-strategy-with-sl-tp.text: Builds a channel from an EMA of the highs and an EMA of the lows, plus a long EMA of the close and the MACD histogram. A BUY or SELL triangle appears when the channel sits above or below EMA 200, the histogram agrees, and price and histogram crosses fall within the window. Stop Loss and Take Profit lines follow, set by 条件成立の有効期限 (本数) 3, リスクリワード比 (利確/損切) 1.5, EMAチャネル期間 15.
names: 条件成立の有効期限 (本数)
リスクリワード比 (利確/損切)

ema-multi.text: Draws four exponential moving averages of the Source with fixed lengths of 20, 50, 100 and 200. The space between each neighbouring pair is shaded green when the shorter average is above the longer one and orange when it is below, so the ordering of the lines shows at a glance. Each line starts after its own length in bars. Source defaults to close.

ema-oscillator.text: Computes a z-score of how far the close sits from its EMA, scaled by the standard deviation of that distance, and draws it as a histogram coloured by zone. Threshold lines are, by default, percentages (25, 50 and 95) of the highest absolute z-score over Range Lookback Period (43). Circles mark crossings of the extreme level. EMA Period defaults to 50.

ema-ribbon.text: Draws eight exponential moving averages of the Source, with fixed lengths of 5, 8, 13, 21, 34, 55, 89 and 144, as a ribbon. Lines fanning apart show the averages separating, while lines bunching together show them converging. The order of the lines from shortest to longest shows how price sits relative to each. Source defaults to close.

ema-rma-clouds-by-alpachino.text: Computes EMAs and RMAs of the high and low over Ma length (50) and shades clouds between them. Single cloud (on by default) spans the two EMAs: lime when both rise, red when both fall, else grey. Double cloud, which overrides it, pairs each EMA with its RMA: bullish when both EMAs sit above their RMAs, bearish when below.

ema-rsi-autotrade-webhook-varun.text: Plots two EMAs of the close, EMA 9 and EMA 21, and an RSI of the close. A green triangle below the bar marks the fast EMA crossing above the slow one with RSI above the long threshold; a red triangle above the bar marks a cross below with RSI under the short threshold. Defaults: Fast EMA 9, Slow EMA 21, RSI Length 14, RSI Long Threshold 52, RSI Short Threshold 48.

ema-supertrend.text: Plots five EMAs (EMA 9 to EMA 200) on EMA Source, a SuperTrend from ATR Length 10 and SuperTrend Factor 4, plus a NovaWave cloud of two EMAs and a signal average. Up Trend is the band while the trend is up, Down Trend while it is down. BUY and SELL labels mark NovaWave Fast EMA (9) crossing above or below NovaWave Slow EMA (21).

ema-vwma-atr-smoothed-buysell-tom-zeng-2.text: Draws four EMAs, a VWMA, and an ATR trailing stop that follows the close at ATR Multiplier times the ATR and flips side when the close crosses it. A Buy label marks a cross above the stop and a Sell label a cross below; bars are coloured by position, and ATR-VWMA Avg is the midpoint of the VWMA and the stop. Defaults: ATR Period 21, ATR Multiplier 6.3, VWMA Smooth 100.

ema-wave.text: Measures how far the Source sits above its EMA, smoothed with a simple average over Wave SMA Length, at three EMA lengths: Wave A Length 5, Wave B Length 25 and Wave C Length 50. WaveA, WaveB and WaveC are drawn as histograms around zero. With Identify Spikes/Exhaustions on, WaveC Spike and WaveB Spike redraw a bar when its wave is more than Cutoff (10) times the next shorter wave. Source defaults to hlc3.

ema21-pullback-buy.text: Plots an EMA and an SMA of the close. A test candle is a bar in an uptrend whose previous close was above the EMA, whose low touches it and which closes back above it; it is painted white with a circle below. A Buy triangle marks the first bullish candle that takes out the latest test's high. Inputs: EMA length 21, SMA length (trend) 50, Trend Sensitivity Strict.

emergent-rays-novathemachine.text: Draws ten filled bands, each between the EMA of the high and the EMA of the low, at lengths 21 to 65. Wider spread of bands suggests a stronger trend. With Auto Trend Colors on, a band turns green when close is above its high EMA and red below its low EMA. Color Scheme defaults to Rainbow, Transparency 75.

engulfing-bearish.text: Detects a two-candle pattern in an uptrend: a small white candle followed by a long black candle whose open and close cover the prior body, with at least one exceeding it. A match gets a BE label, and the alert fires on each new pattern. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets the trend test.

engulfing-bullish.text: Flags a two-candle bullish engulfing: a small black candle followed by a long white candle whose body takes over the prior body, with the close at or above the prior open and the open at or below the prior close. It only fires after a downtrend and puts a label BE on the price pane. Trend is judged by Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50).

engulfing-candle-indicator.text: Tracks the open of the last bullish and last bearish candle. A green triangle below the bar marks a close above the last bearish candle's open and above the previous low. A red triangle above marks a close below the last bullish candle's open and below the previous high. Repeated same-direction signals are skipped. It has no inputs.

engulfing-sweep-v6-bars-only.text: Finds a bullish candle after a bearish one that closes above the previous body and dips below the previous low, or the mirror bearish case with a higher high. The engulfing candle is coloured only once the next bar confirms it; with Require next candle confirmation on (default), that bar must close in the same direction. Min candle body size (0 = any size) defaults to 0; alerts fire on the confirming bar.
names: Min candle body size (0 = any size)

engulfing-sweeps-milana-trades.text: Marks a bullish bar whose low goes under the previous low and closes above the previous open, and a bearish bar whose high goes over the previous high and closes below the previous open. Display Style chooses arrows or a highlighted candle. Strong Only (Volume Filter) is off by default; when on, volume must exceed its average over Volume MA Period (20) times Volume Multiplier (1.5).

enhanced-klse-banker-flow-oscillator.text: Scores where the close sits in its 27-bar range, smooths it and blends it with a Fisher transform into Fund Trend, which is compared with Bull Bear Line, a smoothed volume-aware price position. Signal Strength columns show their gap. Dotted levels mark 80, 20, 10 and 90. Markers flag Banker Entry, Position Increase and Exit. Entry Threshold defaults to 25.

enhanced-vfi-buyer-seller-pressure.text: Shows each bar's buyer and seller pressure (body relative to range) as histograms, strong when at or above Pressure Threshold (0.75), plus a volume flow line, VFI, with an EMA signal, VFI EMA. Circles mark VFI crossing its EMA, and the background shows buying, selling or neutral. Other inputs: VFI Length 130, Signal Length 5, Smooth VFI? on.

enhanced-vsa-volume-candle-colors-with-m.text: Draws volume columns sorted into classes: extreme above the Extreme Volume Percentile (90) of the lookback, high above the selected average times High Volume Multiplier (1.5), low below it times Low Volume Multiplier (0.5), otherwise neutral. The column colour shows the class, and price bars take it too. Selected MA (SMA, EMA, or VWMA) uses Volume Lookback Period (200); the reference EMA uses 400.

entropy-bands.text: A moving average of the close forms the Midline. Band width is Band Multiplier times the sum of the average bar range relative to the close and the ATR, giving the Upper Band and Lower Band. Candles with a large enough body turn green above the upper band, magenta below the lower, gray between. Inputs: Entropy Length 20, ATR Length 14, Band Multiplier 1.5, Moving Average Type SMA.

entry-points.text: Computes an EMA of the close over Period (default 100) but does not draw it; it only places markers. A green Buy arrow appears below a bar that closes above the EMA after opening below it or touching it from above. A red Sell arrow appears above a bar that closes below the EMA after opening above it or touching it from below.

entry-signals-long-short.text: Combines RSI and two EMAs. An RSI cross above its SMA arms a pending long, and a Long signal prints when the fast EMA then crosses above the slow EMA, unless an RSI or EMA cross down cancels it first; shorts mirror this. Inputs: RSI Period 14, Fast EMA (Short-Term) 5, Slow EMA (Long-Term) 20.

entry-tp-sl-alert-bands.text: Places an Upper Alert Band and Lower Alert Band between a trade's Entry Price and its Take Profit and Stop Loss prices, at set percentages of each distance, with Price plotting the close. Trade Direction (Long) picks the geometry. Alerts fire when close crosses over the upper band or under the lower. Entry 150, TP 160, SL 140, both percentages 50.

envelope.text: Draws a moving average of the source with an upper and lower line set a fixed percentage above and below it, with the area between them shaded. Price relative to Upper and Lower shows how far it has moved from the average. Inputs: Length (20), Percent (10), Source (close), Exponential (false, so a simple average).

envelope-rsi.text: Draws a percentage envelope around a moving average of the bar midpoint (Basis, with Upper and Lower), plus an RSI of the same midpoint. A Buy label appears when close crosses up through the lower band with RSI under RSI Oversold (25); Sell when it crosses down through the upper band with RSI over RSI Overbought (80). Key inputs: Envelope Length 8, Envelope Percent 0.22, RSI Length 8, TP % and SL % 0.15.

eom.text: Multiplies the change in the bar midpoint by the bar's high-low range divided by volume (scaled by Divisor), then averages it with a simple moving average. Positive EOM means price rises with little volume resistance, negative means it falls easily; the line is read around zero. Inputs: length (14) and Divisor (10000).

eqh-eql-liquidity-zones.text: Compares each pivot high or low (Pivot Left Length 10, Pivot Right Length 2) with the last 50 pivots; if two lie within Equality Threshold (%) of 0.03, a box marks equal highs (EQH) or equal lows (EQL) with each pivot's volume. A zone stops and is labelled Swept when a later high or low passes it; Delete on Sweep removes it. Max Active Zones is 60.

equalhigh-japanese-triple-rci.text: Three rank correlation lines (RCI 9 — impulsion, RCI 26 — swing, RCI 52 — tendance) score from -100 to +100 how steadily the source rose or fell. R markers flag the short line leaving an extreme as the medium line turns; A markers flag all three crossing zero together. Niveau extrême is 80.

erd-effort-result-diagnostic.text: Over the Lookback Period, Upper Band is the high of the bullish bar with the highest volume and Lower Band is the low of the bearish bar with the highest volume. Middle Line is their average, and the area between the bands is filled. Break beyond a band shows price leaving the high-volume bars' range. Lookback Period defaults to 30; Flip Logic swaps the volume sets.

erema-signals.text: Builds a Reverse EMA from an EMA of close (Alpha, 0.1) passed through eight reverse stages, then a moving average of it (MA Type SMA, MA Length 14). Triangles below the bar mark buys and above mark sells, with a faint background, when it crosses zero, its average, or both, chosen by Signal Type (Zero Cross). Enable Alerts is off by default.

euclidean-range.text: Measures the Euclidean distance between the source and its moving average over the window, giving bands of average plus and minus that distance on the price pane. The pane shows z-scores of distance/source (High-volatility Z-Score) and source/distance (Low-volatility Z-Score). The price background turns red when the low one exceeds the high one and 0.5. Inputs: Window Length 14, Z-Score Length 100, Average Type HMA.

eurusd-swing-high-low-projection.text: Draws fixed horizontal levels from a Projection Price (150) and a range from Minimum Price (Range Start) 100 to Maximum Price (Range End) 200. Five families are computed: regular, logarithmic, linear, quadratic and natural log, each giving an upward and downward target plus a midpoint. Read them as targets around the projection.

evasive-supertrend.text: A SuperTrend band on the hl2 midpoint plus or minus ATR times Base Multiplier (3), using ATR Length (10). If the close is within Noise Threshold (xATR) (1) ATRs of the band, it is pushed Expansion Alpha (xATR) (0.5) ATRs away. Green means up trend, red down; a close through the band flips it, with a dot and BULL or BEAR label. Dotted Band marks noisy bars.

evening-doji-star.text: Flags a three-candle bearish pattern in an uptrend: a long white candle, a doji whose body gaps above it, then a long black candle whose body gaps below the doji and closes at or below the first candle's body midpoint, but above its body low. Labelled EDS on the price pane. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets the trend test.

evening-star.text: Flags a three-candle bearish pattern in an uptrend: a long white candle, a small-bodied candle gapping above it, then a long black candle that closes at or below the first body's midpoint but above its low. Labelled ES on the price pane. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the uptrend is judged.

evil-macd-trading-system.text: MACD of the close: DIF is the fast EMA minus the slow EMA, DEA is an EMA of DIF, and MACD Bar is their difference, green above zero and red otherwise. The background is green when close is above the trend EMA and red below. Buy triangles mark DIF crossing above DEA in an uptrend, sell triangles the reverse, optionally needing volume 1.2 times its 20-bar average (启用成交量过滤).

evwma-envelope.text: Computes a volume-weighted moving average of the close in which each bar's volume, relative to the volume of the last length bars, sets how far the average moves. Heavy-volume bars shift it more. Draw Envelope (off by default) adds evwma+ and evwma-, the same average of highs and lows. Use Cumulative Volume swaps the window for total volume; length defaults to 20.

exhaustion-zone.text: Builds a rebound line under price from the highest of low minus twice a smoothed ATR and the lowest of low plus twice it, offset by a factor, averaged with an SMA, and shifted by the prior ATR. Scaled Line 1 and Scaled Line 2 sit at the Rebound Line times Line Scale. Bars and background turn green when the low is at or below the Rebound Line. Inputs: ATR Length 14, ATR Smoothing 34, SMA Length 55, Line Scale 0.86.

extrapolated-pivot-connector-lets-make.text: Plots pivot highs and lows with length bars on each side as circles on their own bar. A blue line through two chosen pivot highs and an orange line through two chosen pivot lows extend to the right; positions count from the newest pivot (0). Inputs: length (100), A-High Position (1), B-High Position (0), A-Low Position (1), B-Low Position (0).

extreme-trend-reversal-points.text: Nests Level moving averages, each averaging the previous one, then counts how many pairs are in descending order; this Strength is ranked against its own history. The Moving Average line is green or lime when strength is high, red or orange when low, silver between; triangles mark source crossings of the line right after maximum or zero strength. Inputs: Type (sma), Length (20), Level (10), Percentile History (1000).

fair-value-bands-flowly-indicators.text: Plots a fair value basis (default 20-bar SMA of OHLC4) with threshold bands from the median high and low ratios to the basis, and 1x to 3x deviation bands from median pivot distances. Trend flips when price breaks a threshold band and colours the basis. Inputs: Threshold band width (1), Deviation band width (1), VWAP anchor (1D).

fair-value-gap-absorption-indicator.text: Finds a fair value gap when a bar's low sits above the high two bars back (or the mirror for bearish), wider than ATR(144) times the filter. Only the newest gap is active: a box shows the unfilled part, a grey box the part price has entered, and a percentage shows how much is filled. A gap ends once filled. Fair Value Gap Width Filter defaults to 0.5; Historical Fair Value Gaps (on) keeps ended gaps.

fair-value-gap-luxalgo.text: Detects three-bar gaps: a bullish gap when the low is above the high from two bars back, a bearish gap in the mirror case, with size above a threshold. Gaps are boxes; a gap is removed once a close passes its far edge. Bullish FVG Top/Bottom and Bearish FVG Top/Bottom track open gaps. Main inputs: Threshold % (0), Auto (off), Timeframe (chart), Extend (20).

fair-value-gaps-by-dgt.text: Finds three-bar fair value gaps on the chart or a higher timeframe and draws each as lines and a shaded zone, in one colour for bullish and another for bearish. Zones extend forward, show the percentage filled, and vanish once price reaches the fill level set by the fill method. Set #1 is on, using Chart and Wick Sweep, with Max Bars Back 360; set #3 uses lower-timeframe bars with FVG Filter Threshold 0.7.

fair-value-gaps-flux-charts.text: Finds three-bar fair value gaps, filtered by bar size against the ATR or by a short versus long volume average, and draws each as a zone split into bull and bear volume bars with a total volume label. A zone ends when a close (or wick) crosses it. Key inputs: Zone Invalidation (Close), Zone Filtering (Average Range), FVG Detection (Same Type), Detection Sensitivity (Extreme).

faith-indicator.text: Plots the gap between a fast and a slow exponential average of the close as a histogram, Grade of Faith, with Signal as a 9-bar average of that gap. The histogram is blue above zero and red below it; Signal is a line over it. Inputs are Fast Length 14 and Slow Length 28.

falling-three-methods.text: Flags a five-candle bearish continuation in a downtrend: a long black candle, three small white candles whose opens and closes stay inside the first candle's high-low range, then a long black candle closing below the first close. Labelled FTM on the price pane. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets the trend test.

falling-window.text: Flags a two-candle bearish continuation: during a downtrend, the current candle's high sits below the previous candle's low, leaving a gap, and both candles have a non-zero range. Labelled FW on the price pane. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the downtrend is judged.

false-breakout.text: Watches the highest high and lowest low over False Breakout Period (20), optionally smoothed by Smoothing Type (none). After repeated new highs, a close back below the level marks a False Up signal; repeated new lows then a close above marks False Down. Signals must come within Signal valid for X bars (5); Aggressive swaps highs and lows.

faraz-perfect-structure-scalper-long-sho.text: Draws the last swing low and high as structure levels, stop levels offset by Stop buffer (points) (5), and breakout and breakdown levels over the prior Breakout / Breakdown Lookback (10) bars. Long and Short markers need a close beyond those levels and RSI past Base RSI Long Trigger (40) or Base RSI Short Trigger (60); XL and XS add a Trend EMA length (200) slope test.

fast-wma.text: Draws a WMA with an Upper Band and Lower Band at fixed multiples of it, plus NMA, the source divided by a longer WMA, minus 1. The signal turns long when source minus its deviation is above the Upper Band and NMA exceeds Long Threshold (0.03), short when source plus deviation is below the Lower Band and NMA is under Short Threshold (0.032). Colours and candles follow it. Inputs: WMA Length 10, Length 26.

fastlane.text: Marks bars whose one-bar percentage change of the close is at least % check (5) in size, and bars whose volume is at least Volume Above (500000). With Combine the conditions? on, a yellow circle below the bar appears only when both hold, and the Fastlane alert fires there. Off, a blue circle below marks big moves and a blue cross above marks high volume.

fibo-levels-with-volume-profile-and-targ.text: Builds a pivot and six Fibonacci levels from the prior bar of the Fibo Timeframe (D), then counts closes since the start of the week into Volume Levels (12) rows between the outer levels. Rows shade from the bear to the bull colour, a POC box marks the row with the highest written volume, and an arrow with a Possible Target label points to one of the levels. Volume Type (All) picks which volume the rows show.

fibonacci-auto-trend-scouter.text: Tracks swing points with a long and a short lookback, keeping the last 7 swings of each. From them it draws top and bottom trend lines, coloured by slope, and Fibonacci levels (0 to 1) between the lowest and highest swing price, marking the next resistance and support from the close. It also plots EMAs from three other timeframes. Main inputs: Length: ‍‍Long (21), Short (8), Source data: (hlc3).

fibonacci-bollinger-bands.text: Plots a volume-weighted moving average of the typical price (Basis) with six band pairs placed at 0.236, 0.382, 0.5, 0.618, 0.764 and 1.0 times Multiplier times the standard deviation. Price near Upper 6 or Lower 6, the outer red and teal lines, is at the widest extent. Length is 200 and Multiplier is 3.

fibonacci-confluence-toolkit.text: Finds short, intermediate and long-term swings and marks a CHoCH when a close breaks the last long-term swing against the current structure, with a line, a box for the area of interest and Fibonacci retracement lines drawn after the next long-term swing. Levels shown by default are 0, 0.382, 0.5, 0.618, 0.786 and 1. Key inputs: Bullish Structures and Bearish Structures (on), Highlight Area of Interest (Enabled), Engulfing Candle Patterns (Structure Based).

fibonacci-entry-bands.text: Builds a basis from a double EMA of the Source over Length (default 21), with bands at 0.618, 1.0, 1.618 and 2.618 times ATR (ATR Length 14, or standard deviation if Use ATR is off). Bands sit below the basis while it rises and above it while it falls. Labels mark basis turns, crosses mark closes through the take-profit band set by TP Aggressiveness, and triangles mark basis bounces.

fibonacci-extension-retracement-pivot-po.text: Builds a zigzag of swings, then draws Fibonacci pivot points of a higher timeframe, or retracement or extension levels of the last leg, plus time zones spaced from the last leg. Each level sits at the pivot, or leg, offset by its Fibonacci ratio. Inputs: Pick a Fibonacci Tool defaults to Pivot Points, Deviation 3, Depth 11, Pivot Points Timeframe Auto. Alerts: Volume Spikes and High Volatility.

fibonacci-hh-ll-trama-band.text: Computes an adaptive moving average of the high and of the low, speeding up when the highest high or lowest low of the window sets a new extreme. The Midline, their mean, is lime when above its value 5 bars earlier, otherwise red. Bands H1 to H6 above and L1 to L6 below sit at Fibonacci multiples of the half-gap between the averages. Input: length (55).

fibonacci-levels.text: Draws an exponential average of each bar's body-edge price as Mid Line, with six bands above and six below. Distances are the standard deviation times Fibonacci-derived multipliers of a smoothed maximum body deviation. Wider bands show price stretching further from the mid. Inputs 50 MA (50) and 100 MA (100); only 100 MA sets the calculation lengths.

fibonacci-levels-mtf.text: Builds Fibonacci levels from the open, high, low and close of a higher timeframe candle. Levels are measured down from the high when that candle closed up, and up from the low when it closed down. Higher Time Frame defaults to D, and Current or Last HTF Candle defaults to Last (completed candle). Level 0 to Level 6 are on, Level 7 and Level 8 off.

fibonacci-moving-averages.text: Plots seven moving averages of the source with lengths 5, 8, 13, 21, 34, 55 and 89, all of one type. Shorter lines hugging price and longer ones lagging show the trend at several speeds; each line can be hidden. MA Type defaults to EMA and MA Source to close; optional alerts fire when price crosses the 21, 34, 55 or 89 average, all off by default.

fibonacci-optimal-entry-zone.text: Tracks swing highs and lows using pivots of Structure Period (10) bars and marks a CHoCH when price breaks the tracked high or low against the prior structure. After a break it draws retracement lines of the new swing at the 0.5 and 0.618 levels, with an optional dotted swing line and price labels. Fill Golden Zone shades between the two levels; Extend keeps them to the current bar.

fibonacci-projection-with-volume-delta-p.text: Finds the swing high and swing low over the last Period bars, draws lines at both, five retracement lines (0.236 to 0.786) from the newest swing, and a three-segment projection ahead using the Projection Level. A volume profile with Rows price rows splits up and down volume between the swings; Fib Volume Delta adds up-minus-down volume per Fibonacci band. Defaults: Period 100, Projection Level 0.618, Rows 10.

fibonacci-ranges.text: Builds a Fibonacci channel from the two latest swings, found with pivots L bars before and R bars after (defaults 5 and 1). It draws levels from -0.382 to 1.382 of the swing distance, optionally shaded, and keeps them until the close stays outside the Break level pair (default 0.000 - 1.000) for more than Break count bars (default 2). A label marks the break up or down.

fibonacci-structure-engine.text: Tracks market structure from confirmed pivots, marking breaks as BOS or CHoCH, and draws a Fibonacci grid on the leg that follows a break. A scenario becomes a confirmed signal when price touches the setup zone and a sweep, engulfing or CHoCH retest trigger fires. Key inputs: Pivot length 10, Setup zone start ratio 0.5, Setup zone end ratio 0.786.

fibonacci-support-resistant-trendline.text: Marks pivot highs and lows with diamonds, found with Pivot Detection: Left Bars (10) and Right Bars (5). When a pivot high exceeds the one before, it draws an arrow along the swing, Fibonacci levels from 0 to 1, a support zone and a dotted trendline. Find entry Short (off by default) mirrors this on pivot lows.

fibonacci-time-price-zones.text: From two user points A and B, draws Fibonacci levels from B onward as arcs, L-shapes, sloped or horizontal lines, filled between neighbouring levels. Read the levels as zones of price and time around B; Level 0 to 6 Upper and Lower are the plots. Zone Type (Retracement) picks the side and Shape (Circular) the form; Fill % defaults to 15.

fibonacci-trend.text: A SuperTrend with factor Trend (4) and ATR length 25 gives the trend, drawn as Trend. After each trend change, it tracks the lowest low and highest high of that trend and draws a Fibonacci retracement of that range, with levels 0, 1, 0.5 and four set by inputs 1 to 4 (0.236, 0.382, 0.618, 0.786). Lines and labels extend Extend (15) bars past the current bar, and a shaded area spans the deeper levels.

fibonacci-weighted-moving-average.text: Computes a weighted moving average in which the newest bar gets the largest Fibonacci weight and the oldest the smallest. The FWMA line is green while it rises and pink while it falls, and bars can be coloured the same way. Alerts fire when that colour changes. Main inputs are Length (14) and Source (close).

fibonacci-zone.text: Takes the highest high and lowest low over Length bars (default 50) and draws High Border, Low Border and four levels between them at 23.6%, 38.2%, 61.8% and 76.4% of the range, measured down from the high. Fills shade the top, middle and bottom zones, so price location within the recent range can be read.

fibsync-dynamicfibsupport.text: Draws Fibonacci retracement levels (0.236, 0.382, 0.618, 0.786) between the lowest low and highest high of the last Static Fib Period bars (250), and a second set between the latest confirmed swing low and swing high, shown when Show Dynamic Fibonacci Levels is on. Traders read the lines as possible support or resistance zones. Swing Strength (bars left/right) defaults to 10.

filter-ribbon.text: Draws a ribbon of Linear Regression plus and minus 0.1 times ATR(14). Over the last Lookback Period regression values it counts rising versus falling pairs; the ribbon is bull colour when the score exceeds Range Tolerance (%) of all pairs, otherwise bear colour, and is more opaque when the trend is stronger. Defaults: Lookback Period 12, Range Tolerance (%) 90, Linear Regression Length 90.

filter-wave.text: Scores a linear regression line by comparing every pair of its last Lookback Period values, adding +1 when the newer is higher and -1 when lower. The state is bullish or bearish when the score passes Range Tolerance (%) of the pair count, grey otherwise. Wave and Wave Floor sit above the close, offset by the smoothed intensity times ATR. Defaults: Lookback Period 12, Range Tolerance (%) 90, Linear Regression Length 90.

fisher-mpz.text: Blends three Fisher transforms of hl2 (Short Period 8, Medium Period 13, Long Period 26) into a weighted Composite Fisher, using Short Weight 4, Medium Weight 2, Long Weight 1. Each transform uses a clipped robust z-score, Kalman smoothing and optional winsorization. Trigger is the prior composite, EMA-smoothed; the composite crossing it marks momentum shifts, with Zero Line as the midpoint.

fisher-transform.text: Places the midpoint of each bar within its recent high-low range, smooths it, and applies a Fisher transform to stretch turning points. Trigger is the Fisher value from one bar earlier, so crossings of the two lines show turns. Horizontal levels sit at 1.5, 0.75, 0, -0.75 and -1.5. Input: Length (9).

fisher-volume-transform-alphanatt.text: Blends the close with a volume-weighted close, scales it within its recent range, applies a Fisher transform, then smooths it with an EMA and multiplies by 25 to form the Fisher Transform line. Signal is a slower EMA of that line; the Histogram and shaded layers show it above or below Zero. Inputs: Fisher Period (10), Volume Weight (0.7), Smoothing (3).

fixed-range-volume-profile-zones.text: Builds a volume profile from the closes of the last Lookback Days bars, split into Number of Bins price bins. The lowest volume bin gives VAL, the highest-volume bin in the middle third gives POC, and the top third gives VAH; Min Price and Max Price are the window extremes. Triangles mark closes beyond VAH or VAL plus the VAH Percentile (95) and VAL Percentile (5) buffers. Defaults are 30 and 30.

flow-control-oscillator.text: Blends the Money Flow Index rescaled to -1..+1 with Chaikin Money Flow, weighted by Weighting Mode, then smooths the result into FCO (Control) and a Signal Line. Momentum (ADX-Weighted) columns show the FCO change over Momentum Length bars, scaled by ADX; the FCO crossing zero, Signal Line, or the 0.7 and 1 levels marks flow shifts. MFI Length defaults to 14, CMF Length to 20.

flowshift-oscillator.text: Measures how far hl2 sits from a baseline moving average, normalizes its 14-bar change by smoothed volatility, squashes it to -1..1 and smooths it. FlowShift Area and Line are green above Zero and red below; Top Guide and Bottom Guide mark the 88th percentile of its size. BUY/SELL triangles appear on crosses beyond the guides. Inputs: Type (SMA), Length (40).

fluidtrades-smc-lite.text: Marks supply zones at swing highs and demand zones at swing lows, each as a box about ATR(50) scaled by the box width, with a POI line at its middle. Zones extend right until the close reaches the supply top or demand bottom, then the zone is replaced by a BOS line. Inputs: Swing High/Low Length (10), History To Keep (20), Supply/Demand Box Width (2.5).

follow-line.text: Draws a Trend Line that jumps to the low minus ATR when the close breaks above the Bollinger upper band, or to the high plus ATR when it breaks below the lower band. It never retreats against its direction. It is blue while rising and red while falling, and a label marks each turn. Inputs: BB Period 21, BB Deviations 1, ATR Filter on, ATR Period 5.

footprint-iq-pro.text: Builds a footprint from lower-timeframe bars, spreading each bar's volume over price levels as buy or sell volume, and draws a box per level with delta, delta %, total, buy and sell volume. The level with the largest delta is highlighted, and levels at or above Imbalance Percentage (70) get marks, turning yellow at Stacked Imbalance Count (3) in a row. Granularity (1-Minute) sets the source bars.

for-loop-vote-trailing-stop-miesoncharts.text: Scores the source against its value 1 to 70 bars back, each comparison voting +1 or -1, and averages the votes. A vote at or above Long Threshold turns the regime long, at or below Short Threshold short, and Vote Stop trails by ATR distance, green when long and red otherwise. Defaults: Source hl2, Long Threshold 0.6, Short Threshold -0.2, ATR Length (stop offset) 14, ATR Multiplier 1.75.

force-pulse.text: Sums the bodies of up candles and of down candles over Calculation Period, scales their imbalance to 0 to 100 and smooths it with an EMA to give Force Pulse, plus an SMA called MA. Readings are against the midline 50, with triangle signals when it crosses Overbought Level 73 or Oversold Level 27; Bull and Bear labels mark pivot divergences. Other inputs: Calculation Period 20, Smoothing Length (EMA) 3.

forecast-oscillator.text: Measures how far the source is from its linear regression value over the window, as a percentage of the source. FOSC is drawn around a dashed Zero line: above zero means price is over the regression value, below means under. The line is green when rising, red when falling. Length is 14, Source is close.

fourier-series-model-of-the-market.text: Passes the source's 2-bar momentum through bandpass filters tuned to the Period divided by 1, 2, 3 and so on, then combines them, weighting higher harmonics by relative energy, into the Wave. Rate of Change is a scaled two-bar change of the Wave; optional Threshold + and Threshold - bands are drawn around a zero line. Defaults: Period 20, Bandwidth 0.1, Harmonics 3, Threshold Mode MAD.

fractal-exhaustion-band.text: Draws a trailing trend line set away from price by ATR(10) scaled by Band Width Multiplier (1.2) and a fractal dimension measured over FDI Period (20) bars. The trend flips when close breaks the line plus or minus the buffer, marked by a circle. Fractal Line is the trend line, Band Edge the extreme since the flip, Band Mid their average; colours follow the trend.

fractal-strength-oscillator.text: Plots an RSI of the Source (Use Smoothing, default off, replaces it with a moving average of the chosen MA Type and MA Length) and a flat FDI line fixed by Length and MA Length. RSI above 55 turns the trend bullish, below 45 bearish, with a level at 50; FDI and bars take the trend colour. Defaults: Length 20, Trend Threshold 1.45, RSI Length 14.

fractals-trend.text: Detects fractal highs and lows (a bar whose high or low is the extreme of the surrounding bars), keeps the latest ones, and builds an upper and lower band from their average, min/max or median. The Fractal Line shows the lower band in an up trend and the upper band in a down trend; the trend flips when close crosses the opposite band. Main inputs: Fractals Detection Length 5, Fractals Storage Qty 3, Bands Type avg.

fractals-v9.text: Finds five-bar fractals, tops and bottoms, and joins alternating ones into a ZigZag line. Triangles mark fractals, and with Show Patterns? on, labels at the top or bottom of the pane name harmonic shapes (Bat, Gartley, Crab and others) found from the last five ZigZag points. Optional channels, HH/LL labels and higher-timeframe fractals (Timeframe: 240) can be shown.

fractional-ema-kalman-filter.text: Smooths the source with two chained EMAs of fractional length, then tracks that with two adaptive Kalman filters whose noise settings follow the squared residual relative to ATR. Kalman Base and Kalman Fast are the smoothed filter lines; the fill between them is aqua when fast is above base and red otherwise. Key inputs: factor 0.5, factor2 0.5, R base 50, R fast 50, q multiplier base 0.002, q multiplier fast 0.005.

fsvzo.text: Computes a volume-weighted momentum oscillator from smoothed price change and relative volume, turned into a ratio of positive to negative momentum, blended with a Fourier-style weighted average and clamped to -100..100. Enhanced Volume Dynamics is the oscillator, Enhanced Signal Line its SMA, and Enhanced Flow Momentum the gap to its EMA; divergence lines and flip markers appear. Key inputs: VZO Length 9, Signal Line Length 3, Flow Momentum Lookback 14.

full-candle-higher-lower.text: Marks a bar as Higher when its close is above the previous high and the previous low is at or below the high two bars back. It marks Lower when the close is below the previous low and the previous high is at or above the low two bars back. A green Higher label sits below the bar and a red Lower label above it; the two alternate, so a repeat of the same signal is skipped. Alerts: Higher Flag and Lower Flag.

function-savitzky-golay-filter-with-7-ve.text: Smooths the close with a 7-point Savitzky-Golay polynomial. regular uses consecutive bars; scaling spaces the points window (5) bars apart; duopass and tripass re-filter the scaling result; multipass repeatedly blends the scaling filter of recent closes into the close, over multipass (10) offsets. All five lines follow price and are read as smoothed trend curves.

futech-v-spike-v-highlighter.text: Flags a volume spike when volume exceeds its EMA times Volume Spike - Multiplier (1.5). The spike candle takes the up or down colour from the close versus the previous close. The highest-volume bar of Volume Highlighter - Lookback Candles (20) gets a background and bottom circle.

future-trend-channel.text: Turns the trend up when the close crosses above the Trend Length (100) average plus a volatility measure, and down when it crosses below the average minus it. Each change starts a three-line channel around the bar's midpoint, width set by Channel Width (3). A label projects the middle line Index of future price (50) bars ahead.

fvg-breakout-breakdown.text: Builds two levels from a fixed pair of 2024 bars: the gap between one bar's close and a later bar's open, projected up as NWOG High and down as NWOG Low from that open. Labels mark bullish and bearish fair value gaps between bars. BUY appears when the close is above NWOG High on a bullish gap, SELL when below NWOG Low on a bearish gap, matching the Fresh Buy Signal and Fresh Sell Signal alerts.

fvg-candle-highlighter.text: Detects three-bar fair value gaps: bullish when a bar's low is above the high two bars earlier, bearish when its high is below the low two bars earlier. The middle bar of the gap is tinted translucent lime for a bullish gap or translucent red for a bearish one. No inputs.

fvg-ifvg-ict-inversion-fair-value-gap-si.text: Finds three-bar fair value gaps and draws each as a zone with proximal and distal edges, a middle line and a fill, extending until price reaches the chosen mitigation level. A close beyond a stopped gap's distal edge turns it into an inversion zone of the opposite side. Main inputs: FVG & IFVG Validity Period (Bar) (500), Mitigation Level FVG (50 % OB), FVG Filter (on).

fvg-instantaneous-mitigation-signals.text: Finds a fair value gap that the very next bar wins back: a three-bars-back gap that bar two closes beyond and the current close returns through. Each signal draws a box, a triangle label and a dashed middle line; Trailing Stop plots an ATR-based stop until a close crosses it. FVG Width Filter (0) sets the minimum gap size; Multiplier for the stop defaults to 3.

fvg-order-blocks.text: Finds fair value gaps, where a bar's low sits above the high of two bars earlier (bullish) or its high sits below that bar's low (bearish), and the gap is larger than Filter Gaps by % (0.5). Each gap gets a small box with its size, plus a one-ATR order block that extends to the right. Blocks turn grey or vanish when price breaks through; Blocks Amount (6) limits how many stay.

fvg-positioning-average.text: Finds bullish and bearish fair value gaps larger than a fraction of ATR, then averages the gap levels kept within the lookback. Bull Average and Bear Average are drawn as lines, with shaded gaps; a line is hidden when price has not reached it recently. Inputs: FVG Lookback (30), Lookback Type (Bar Count or FVG Count), ATR Multiplier (0.25).

fvg-sessions.text: Finds the first fair value gap of each day, a three-bar gap between a bar's range and the one two bars back, and draws it as a box with a dashed middle line, plus a day separator and the running high and low of the day. The gap is mitigated when a close passes its far side, which starts a lighter box. Alerts cover new, mitigated, price-inside and middle-cross events.

fx-market-sessions.text: Marks up to four trading sessions (London, New York, Tokyo, Sydney) by the hours in each Time input, read in the chosen Timezone. It draws a box from session high to low, plus a label, and the sess1_high and sess1_low style lines per session. Session 4 is off by default; History keeps 10 sessions and Opening range, Fibonacci levels and Extend default to No.

fx-sniper-t3-cci.text: Computes a CCI of the chosen Source, then smooths it with a six-stage exponential cascade combined into a T3 value. T3-CCI is the line; CCIH is the same value as a histogram, green at or above zero and red below, around a zero line. Inputs: CCI Length 14, T3 Length 5, T3 Factor 0.618, Source close.

fx-sniper-t3-cci-copy-strategy.text: Takes the CCI of the close over CCI_Period (14) and smooths it with a six-stage Tillson T3 using T3_Period (5) and factor b (0.618). T3-CCI is the line and CCIH repeats it as a histogram, green at or above zero and red below, around a zero level. Price bars turn green while T3-CCI is above zero and red while below.

fxn-asian-session-range.text: Tracks the running high and low of the Asian (20:00 to 02:00), London (03:00 to 07:00) and New York (08:00 to 12:00) sessions, in New York time, on intraday bars. Each range is shaded and boxed with a middle line, and Asian levels extend to 11:30. Labels give each range size in pips. Alert: Asian Range Break.

fxn-week-and-day-separator.text: Draws vertical separators on intraday charts: a week line on the bar that opens the trading day (17:00 exchange time) on the chosen weekday, optional day lines on the other days, and weekday names near the bottom. Background bands can replace the lines. Key inputs: Week Separator on Day (Sunday), Show Week Separator Line (on), Show Day Separator Line (off), Show days of week (on).

fxshare-cc-reversal.text: Counts consecutive same-direction candles whose body meets a minimum size. A BUY label appears when enough bearish candles are followed by a bullish one closing above the EMA; a SELL label for the mirror case below it. Inputs: Min consecutive candles (4), Min candle body (points) (20), EMA length (2).

g-score-nal.text: Smooths a z-score of the source (Price Z) and compares it with thresholds from a smoothed z-score of GARCH volatility, mirrored around zero. It turns bullish above Upper Threshold and bearish below Lower Threshold, holding between, with triangles at flips. Inputs: GARCH Lookback 30, Z-Score Length 48, Smoothing 10.

gabriel-s-andean-oscillator.text: Builds exponential envelopes of close and open. Bullish Open Component is the deviation of the lower envelope, Bearish Close Component that of the upper one, and Signal is an EMA of the larger of the two. Bullish above bearish means buyers lead, and Break fills the square root of the gap when bullish leads. Inputs: EMA Envelope Length (Regular) 50, Signal Length 9.

gamma-fibonacci-ema-bands.text: Draws three fast gamma EMAs, each blending the current source with its previous value by its gamma weight, plus six EMAs of the source at the Fibonacci lengths 34, 55, 89, 144, 233 and 377. Higher gamma tracks price more closely; the slow EMAs form a ladder of trend bands. Inputs: Source (close), Gamma 1 (0.2), Gamma 2 (0.5), Gamma 3 (0.8).

gamma-hedging-pressure.text: Measures the close's change over Gamma Calculation Length bars divided by its standard deviation, scales it to -100 to +100 over Normalization Lookback bars, and optionally smooths it with an EMA. The positive part is Bullish Gamma Pressure and the absolute negative part is Bearish Gamma Pressure. Readings above the Extreme Level of 70 tint the background. Defaults: 20, 100, EMA Length 5.

gann-box.text: Draws a Gann box between the highest high and lowest low of the visible bars, divided at 25, 38.2, 50, 61.8 and 75 percent of both time and price, with level labels. Optional fan, curves and angles are drawn from the start corner. Reverse is off, Extend (default on) projects the box into the future, and Show Fan, Show Curves and Show Angles are off.

gann-high-low.text: Draws a line from the simple average of highs or of lows. It shows the high average once the close has last fallen below the prior low average, otherwise the low average. The line is maroon in the first case and blue in the other. Alerts fire when the close crosses it, above or below. High Length is 13, Low Length 21.

gann-level.text: Takes the rounded square root of each bar's open as a base, then squares the base and steps of 0.25 around it. GANN Base is the squared base; Support 1 to Support 6 lie below it and Resistance 1 to Resistance 6 above it, all drawn as crosses. It has no inputs.

gaps.text: Finds gaps where a bar's low is above the previous high (up) or its high is below the previous low (down), at least Minimal Deviation (%) of the 14-bar average high-low range (default 30). Each gap is a green or red box extended right until price fills it; Close Gaps Partially shrinks the box as price enters. Max Number of Gaps defaults to 15.

gaps-imbalances-wicks-by-leviathan.text: Draws boxes with top, middle and bottom lines for one Zone Type: Imbalance (low above the high two bars back, or the mirror), Gap (low above the previous high, or the mirror) or Wick (a long wick on the previous bar). Zones are filtered by ATR by default (Filter Type, ATR Length + Mult. 30) and extend until price touches them, per Fill Condition (Touch). Lookback (D) defaults to 150 days.

gaussian-acceleration-array.text: Computes velocity from the signed logarithm of an EMA of WMAs of the high, low and hl2, then acceleration from an ALMA of that velocity, for five periods spread by Array Variance. Prime Acceleration is green when velocity is positive, red otherwise; fills turn green when it rises. Sample Period 26, Smoothing Function 9, Array Variance 3.

gaussian-channel.text: Draws a center line as a linear regression value of the Source over Length bars, with Upper and Lower bands set Multiplier standard deviations above and below it. The lines and fill turn green when the center rises, red when it falls, and gray when flat. Defaults: Length 20, Multiplier 2, Source close.

gaussian-filter-trend.text: Passes the price through a Gaussian filter of cascaded smoothing stages, then moves a trend line only when the filter plus or minus an ATR-based band pushes past it. The line turns bullish after a step up and bearish after a step down; the stars orbit the line. Main inputs: Length 14, Poles 4, ATR Length 14, Adaptive Width on.

gaussian-ribbon.text: Two ALMA averages of the Source over the same Length (default 49): one fixed, one using Offset (0.55) and Sigma (7). Both lines are shifted forward by lag bars (21). The ribbon and its fill are green when the fixed average is above the other, otherwise red, so colour flips mark a crossing of the two.

gaussian-rsi-nal.text: RSI smoothed by a Gaussian window, plus a longer Gaussian smoothing of it as a confluence line. The regime turns bullish above Upper Threshold (and above the confluence line when required) and bearish below Lower Threshold; the line, candles and triangle markers follow it. Defaults: RSI Length 14, Gaussian Length 10, Upper Threshold 55, Lower Threshold 52.5.

gbr-micro-kernel-trend.text: Smooths the Source (close) with exponentially decaying weights over the last Calculation Window (50) bars, with decay set by Smoothing Bandwidth (h) (14). GBR Kernel Line is green while it rises and red while it falls. Up and down labels mark the bars where the direction flips.

gho-t-ema-cloud.text: Draws exponential moving averages of the close with lengths 9 and 14, plus 12 EMA and 5 EMA, which are hidden by default. The cloud between 9 EMA and 14 EMA is green when the 9 is above the 14 and red otherwise, so crossings show as colour flips. No inputs.

ghost-tangent-crossings.text: Draws alternating zigzag legs as quarter ellipses between pivots confirmed by Pivot Lookforward (25 bars), each with a tangent line at the point that halves its vertical travel. A B label marks the first bar after a leg that falls beyond the tangent, and a pale ghost leg shows the pending swing. Max Zig-Zags (10) limits legs kept.

gideons-gold-adx-watchman.text: ADX Histogram plots the Average Directional Index as columns, from smoothed directional movement divided by smoothed true range, then smoothed again. Columns are red at or below 20, yellow between 20 and 22, and green from 22 up, so colour shows trend strength. ADX Smoothing is 14 and DI Length is 14.

global-liquidity-index.text: Adds central bank balance sheets (Fed less reverse repo and Treasury account) and M2 money supplies, in US dollars, into a total in trillions. The GLI Line plots its SMA, or the SMA of its rate of change. Inputs: SMA Length (0), ROC Length (0), Offset Bars (0), Trend Type (EMA), Fast Length (30), Slow Length (60). A table on the last bar shows trend, change and correlations.

global-monetary-supply-m2.text: Adds up the M2 money supply of 21 economies, each converted to US dollars with its exchange rate, and plots the total as one line in its own pane. A rising line means the combined money stock is growing in dollar terms; with Label on (default) the last bar shows the sum in trillions. Offset (default 0) shifts the line by that many bars.
names: Offset (move the chart horizontally in time -time shift-)

gmma.text: Draws two ribbons of six exponential averages of the Source: Trader EMA 1 to 6 (lengths 3 to 15) and Investor EMA 1 to 6 (lengths 30 to 60). Short-term ribbon spacing against the long-term one shows trend strength; arrows mark swings and trend breaks, using Alert Lookback Length (default 6) and optional filters like Filter Alerts with 200ema (off).

gmma-daisuke-gewinn.text: Plots twelve exponential moving averages of the close: six short ones in green and six long ones in red. A trader reads the short group against the long group, where their spacing, crossings and the order of the lines show how trend is building or fading. Periods are set by EMA1 Period to EMA12 Period, defaulting to 3, 5, 8, 10, 12, 15 and 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 60.

gmma-oscillator.text: Measures the gap between the average of several fast EMAs and the average of several slow EMAs, as a percentage of the slow average. GMMA Oscillator is compared with Signal, an EMA of it, and Histogram shows their difference around Zero. Inputs: GMMA Type Guppy, Smooth Length 1, Signal Length 13.

godmode-4-0-2.text: Builds an oscillator from a Benchmark symbol (default CRYPTOCAP:BTC) by averaging trend, momentum, money-flow and range parts. After Count (default 5) bars in a row above 70, the bar's high and low are kept as resistance levels; below 30 they become support levels; beyond either, supply and demand levels. Lengths are Channel Length 9, Average Length 26 and Short length 13, with optional Smoothing.

gold-trend-signal-indicator.text: Plots a Fast EMA (20) and Slow EMA (50) of the close, set by Fast EMA Period (20) and Slow EMA Period (50). A LONG label appears below the bar when the fast crosses over the slow, a SHORT label above when it crosses under. The background is green while the fast is above the slow, red otherwise.

golden-death-cross-highlighter.text: Plots a Fast MA and a Slow MA, simple averages of the close with Fast MA Length 50 and Slow MA Length 200. Fast crossing above slow starts a golden state and crossing below starts a death state. The background turns yellow while in the golden state with the close above both lines, and red in the death state with the close below both. Golden Cross and Death Cross alerts fire on the crossing bars.

golden-death-cross-with-re-activation.text: Plots two moving averages, MA 1 (length 21) and MA 2 (length 200), both HMA by default. A cross of MA 1 over MA 2 opens a long state, a cross under a short state; a state ends when their gap shrinks for 2 bars and can re-activate. The state shades a ribbon inside the BB Upper and BB Lower bands, stronger with a wider gap and RSI. Dots mark crosses; BB Length is 20.

golden-ratio-trend-persistence.text: Tracks a trend that begins at the first confirmed pivot, then sets Trend Level a Fibonacci Ratio fraction back from the trend's extreme toward an anchor pivot. A close beyond the level flips the trend; the step line and background show direction. Defaults: Pivot Lookback Left 15, Pivot Lookback Right 10, Fibonacci Ratio 0.618, Source for Extremity High/Low.

gorgo-s-hybrid-oscillator-strategy.text: Averages an RSI and an Ultimate Oscillator into Oscillator, adds a zero-lag line ZLMA and a stochastic of the CCI (Stochastic CCI), plus ADX columns. Overbought and Oversold circles appear when Stochastic CCI passes the levels; BUY and SELL conditions tint the background. Defaults: overbought_level 69, oversold_level 35, adx_threshold 24.

gradient-trend-filter.text: Passes the source through three chained EMAs to get the Filter line, and does the same to the bar range to set three pairs of bands around it. The Filter is coloured by whether it is above its value two bars ago; band fills shade by that change, and orange diamonds mark where it crosses zero. Inputs: Source close, Length 25, Transparency 80.

granville-entry-guide.text: Draws short, middle and long SMAs of the close, with background shading for an uptrend or downtrend from the middle versus long SMA. Circles mark entries: a confirmed pivot low on a bullish candle in an uptrend, or a pivot high on a bearish candle in a downtrend, with deviation inside the rate. Defaults: 短期 5, 中期 25, 長期 75, deviation rate(%)± 2.
