gravestone-doji.text: Flags a single candle with a doji-sized body whose lower shadow is no longer than its body, so the open and close sit near the low with the range mostly above. Labelled GD on the price pane, with no trend filter. The only input is a label colour, so there is nothing to tune.

gravity-well-trend-lyro-rs.text: Computes a volume-weighted mean of the source as the Gravity Center, with bands at set ATR multiples around it. The trend flips by Signal Mode: Trend needs the ATR-scaled distance beyond Escape Distance with the centre moving the same way. Long and short labels mark flips, and the centre and candles shade by distance. Inputs: Length 50, Escape Distance 2, Band Width 3, ATR Length 14.

grid-bot-simulator.text: Splits the range between Lower Limit (43000) and Upper Limit (50000) into equal steps set by Number of Grids(10). A buy marks a level crossed downward, a sell one crossed upward, skipped near the last signal, outside the limits or against Market Direction. Line Above and Line Below show the zone around the last signal level. High/Low for signals (on) uses highs and lows instead of closes.

gridbot-ping-pong.text: Draws a five-level grid around a base price, spaced by Spacing(%) of that price, with the base line tilting by Tilt Factor in the direction of the last grid shift. Price0 to Price4 are the levels and SWMA a smoothed close; buy, sell, take-profit and stop markers appear when the Trigger source (Auto) crosses a level. The grid shifts when a bar closes beyond the outer level plus a buffer set by Anchor Strength (1).

guppy-mma.text: Draws 22 moving averages of the close on the price pane, 11 short-term and 11 long-term, each green when the close is above it and red otherwise. In its own pane, each average scores +1 below the close and -1 above it; the group scores are averaged and smoothed into Enhanced Guppy Average, grey between the thresholds of 0.3 and -0.3, green above, red below. Moving Average Type defaults to EMA.

guppy-oscillator-revans993.text: Subtracts the average of five long EMAs (30 to 50) of the close from the average of five short EMAs (3 to 12), then smooths it with an EMA as Signal (Signal Length, default 5). The Histogram is green above zero and red below, in full colour when moving away from Signal and faded otherwise; a dashed zero line is drawn.

guppy-wave.text: Draws twelve moving averages of the source: six short (3 to 15) and six long (30 to 60). With Fill EMA on, lines are hidden and the bands between neighbours are filled in the bullish colour when Short MA 15 is above Long MA 30, else the bearish colour. Moving Average Type defaults to EMA, Moving Average Source to close.

gwap.text: A weighted average of the last closes in which the close i bars ago gets weight gamma to the power i, so recent closes count most when gamma is below 1. The single line on the price pane follows price more closely with a lower factor. Inputs are Length for GWAP Calculation (14) and Gamma Weight Factor (0.92).

h-infinity-volatility-filter.text: Runs the source through a recursive filter of several states, each updated with a gain from its error, the Worst-Case Noise and the Disturbance; the line is the first state. The line takes the bullish colour when it rises and the bearish colour when it falls, and keeps the last colour when flat. Defaults: Worst-Case Noise 0.02, Disturbance 3, Order 5.

half-trend.text: HalfTrend tracks the highest lows and lowest highs over the Amplitude, flipping direction when the average of highs or lows crosses them and the close confirms. The HalfTrend line is blue in an uptrend and red in a downtrend, with ATR High and ATR Low bands around it, and arrows or labels mark flips. Defaults: Amplitude 2, Channel Deviation 2.

halftrend-long-short-signal-engine.text: Draws a HalfTrend line from the highest lows or lowest highs, with ATR-based bands around it. LONG and SHORT labels mark trend turns, each opening a trade with a Bull SL or Bear SL stop and three targets at 1x, 2x and 3x the stop distance; hit targets get check marks. Main inputs: Amplitude (20), Channel Deviation (2) and Base Risk (3).

hammer.text: Flags a single small-bodied candle with a real body, located in the upper half of its range, with a lower shadow at least a set multiple of the body and no upper shadow. It counts only in a downtrend and is labelled H on the price pane. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets the trend test.

hanging-man.text: Flags a single small-bodied candle with a real body, in the upper half of its range, with a lower shadow at least a set multiple of the body and no upper shadow. It counts only in an uptrend and is labelled HM on the price pane. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets the trend test.

hap-macd.text: MACD is the fast minus the slow moving average of Source (EMA by default), Signal averages it, and Histogram, hidden by default, is the gap between them. Dots on the MACD line show bars where a DEMA-based MACD is above its own rising signal, and a red dot marks the first bar after that ends. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9.

harami-bearish.text: Flags a two-candle pattern: a long bullish candle in an uptrend, followed by a small bearish candle whose high and low both stay inside the first candle's body. A label marks the second candle as a possible bearish reversal. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the uptrend is judged; it can also be turned off.

harami-bullish.text: Flags a two-candle pattern: a long bearish candle in a downtrend, followed by a small bullish candle whose high and low both stay inside the first candle's body. A label marks the second candle as a possible bullish reversal. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the downtrend is judged; it can also be turned off.

harami-cross-bearish.text: Flags a two-candle pattern: a long bullish candle in an uptrend, followed by a doji-bodied candle whose high and low both stay inside the first candle's body. A label marks it as a possible bearish reversal. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the uptrend is judged; it can also be turned off.

harami-cross-bullish.text: Flags a two-candle pattern: a long bearish candle in a downtrend, followed by a doji-bodied candle whose high and low both stay inside the first candle's body. A label marks it as a possible bullish reversal. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the downtrend is judged; it can also be turned off.

harmonic-pattern-detection.text: Takes five anchor times X, A, B, C and D, reads closes at X to C, and tests four harmonic patterns from the AB/XA and BC/AB ratios. It draws the legs, ratio labels, projected point D and a table showing which pattern matched, plus a zone around D bounded by Upper PRZ and Lower PRZ. XA Precision (0.01) sets the tolerance of the Gartley and Butterfly ratio. Alerts: Price Enter PRZ, Price Cross D.

harmonic-pattern-detection-prediction-an.text: Finds Gartley, Bat, Butterfly, Crab, Shark and Cypher XABCD patterns by checking leg Fibonacci ratios against Allowed fib ratio error %, scores them, and draws potential (dotted) and complete ones with entry, stop and two targets. Each type has Target 1 and Target 2 choices. Entries use Enter after Point C or Enter after Point D when the score exceeds 90, with Stop at 75 and Pattern time limit of 3.

harmonic-periodicity-matrix.text: Averages three stochastic readings of the close at different lengths, smooths them with a weighted average and centres them on zero (range -50 to 50) as Harmonic Cycle, with Signal Line as its EMA. Circles mark Signal Line crossovers below -15 (buy) and crossunders above 15 (sell); zones beyond 25 and -25 are shaded. Inputs: Primary Cycle Length 20, Smoothing Factor 6.

harmonic-sniper-trigger-pyratime.text: Applies a Fisher transform to the candle midpoint within the high-low range of Length bars (9). Trigger is the Fisher value of the previous bar. The fill is green when Fisher is above Trigger and red otherwise; B and S labels mark crosses, which also drive the Fisher Buy Signal and Fisher Sell Signal alerts. Dotted lines sit at 1.5 and -1.5, with a dashed line at 0.

harsi-cbc.text: Draws Heikin-Ashi candles built from RSI (minus 50) of close, high and low, with Length 14 and Open Smoothing 1, plus a smoothed RSI line and histogram (Length 7) and an optional stochastic. Bands mark OB 20, OB Extreme 30, OS -20 and OS Extreme -30. Triangles and background mark flips when the close breaks the prior high or low.

hash-ribbons.text: Applies a short and a long simple average to the bitcoin hash rate to spot miner capitulation. Ribbons shows both lines, with the short one red below the long and lime above; Oscillator shows their percentage gap as columns. Circle markers flag capitulation, recovery and buy. Inputs: Hash Rate Short SMA (days). 30 and Hash Rate Long SMA (days). 60.

hawkeye-volume.text: Shows each bar's volume as a column coloured by price action. Green means close above the bar's midpoint with a range narrower than the previous bar's; red means close below the midpoint with a narrower range; grey is everything else. The Length input (20) is not used in the calculation.

heatmap-volume.text: Plots volume columns against a Moving Average of volume, scoring each bar by how many standard deviations it sits above that average. Bars are coloured in five tiers using the Extra High (4), High (2.5), Medium (1) and Normal (-0.5) multipliers, with optional threshold lines or background zones. MA Length and Standard Deviation Length both default to 610.

heiken-ashi-candles.text: Draws Heikin Ashi candles, where the close is the average of open, high, low and close and the open is the midpoint of the previous Heikin Ashi open and close. Candles are green when close is above open, otherwise red. Turning HA Candles off (default on) shows regular candles instead.

heiken-ashi-ribbon.text: Computes Heikin-Ashi open, close, high and low, then averages each with an EMA or SMA. The EMA High and EMA Low lines are drawn, and the band between the averaged open and close is filled green when the close is above the open and the 13 EMA is above the 21, 34 and 55 EMAs, red in the mirror case, grey otherwise. Inputs: Moving Average Type EMA, Moving Average Period 14.

heikin-ashi-colored-regular-ohlc-candles.text: Colours regular candles by Heikin Ashi direction, computed from the average of open, high, low and close against a smoothed Heikin Ashi open. Lime means the Heikin Ashi close is above its open, red below, gray equal; the candles keep their real open, high, low and close values. No inputs.

heikin-ashi-doji-with-high-volume.text: Builds Heikin Ashi candles and finds those whose body is small relative to their range. A grey circle below the bar marks a doji whose volume is at least Volume Multiplier (1.5) times its average over Volume MA Length (20) bars. Max Body % of Candle Range (10) sets the doji limit; the Doji + High Volume alert matches the circle.

heikin-ashi-reversals-with-region-dots.text: Builds smoothed Heikin-Ashi candles and flags a red candle whose upper wick is under half its body with a yellow dot below the bar. If the next candle closes at or above that close, a green dot marks the setup bar; a lower close gives a red dot. A faint background starts at the first setup, turning green or red after each reversal and green after 3 green candles in a row. No inputs.

heikin-ashi-rsi-oscillator.text: Shifts RSI to center on zero and draws it as Heikin Ashi candles built from the RSI of close, high and low, green when the candle closes above its open. A smoothed RSI Line and Histogram show the zero-centered value, with Upper Band 20, Lower Band -20 and extremes at 30 and -30. Optional Stoch K and Stoch D follow when Show Stoch RSI is on. HA RSI Length is 14.

heikin-line-tb365.text: EMA of the Source over Length bars (default 9), drawn on price and shifted by Offset (0). Type optionally adds a moving average of that EMA (SMA, EMA, SMMA (RMA), WMA, VWMA) using the second Length (14). SMA + Bollinger Bands also draws Upper Bollinger Band and Lower Bollinger Band at BB StdDev (2) deviations from the SMA, with a fill.

hema-trend-levels.text: Builds two Hull-style moving averages of the close, HEMA Fast and HEMA Slow, and fills between them. Lines take the bullish colour when the fast one is above the slow one, else the bearish colour. Triangles mark crossovers and wick tests of boxes drawn at each cross. Inputs: HEMA Length Fast (20) and HEMA Length Slow (40).

henderson-weighted-moving-average.text: A weighted moving average over Length bars of the Source, using Henderson filter weights that are heaviest at the centre of the window. The HWMA line is green when it rises and pink when it falls; bars, wicks and background can follow the same direction. Length is 7, Source is close, and Highlight Direction and Apply Bar Colors are on by default.

high-for-loop-misinkomaster.text: Scores each bar by comparing its high with the highs of the previous Start to End bars, adding 1 for each lower earlier high and subtracting 1 for each higher one. The High For Loop turns teal when it crosses above the Upper Treshhold and magenta when it crosses below the Lower Treshhold, holding that colour until the next signal. Defaults: Start 0, End 45, Upper Treshhold 25, Lower Treshhold -7.

high-low-of-x-bar.text: Plots the range (high minus low) of the bar Number of Bars Ago (1000) bars back, so each point shows how wide that earlier bar was. Until that many bars exist the value is empty and Not Enough Bars Line is drawn at 1. Difference Value can be hidden with Show Difference Line (on).

high-probability-order-blocks.text: Sums runs of same-direction candle bodies, turns them into a z-score, and when it crosses 4 marks the last opposite candle as a bullish (or bearish) block, extended until two closes through it. A close back across the block's edge draws a Bullish Rejection or Bearish Rejection marker. Key inputs: Z-Score Window (bars) 50, Max Box Age (bars) 2000, Prevent Overlap on.

high-volume-arrow-signals.text: Averages volume over Volume MA Length bars (default 20) and plots it as Volume MA. A bar counts as high volume when its volume exceeds that average times Volume Multiplier (default 1.5). High-volume bars that close above their open get a blue up arrow below them; those that close below their open get a fuchsia down arrow above them.

high-volume-buyers-sellers.text: Compares each bar's volume with its simple average. Volume above the average times High Volume Multiplier (2.5) is high; above the average times Extreme Volume Multiplier (4) is extreme. Green candles get a circle below the bar, red candles a circle above; extreme bars get triangles instead when Show Extreme Volume Signals (on) is set. Volume MA Period defaults to 20.

high-volume-points.text: Finds pivot highs and lows using Left Bars and Right Bars (both 15) where the volume over twice Left Bars, scaled against its 1000-bar 95th percentile, exceeds Filter Points by Volume (2). Each kept pivot gets a circle, a volume label and nested circles that grow with strength; Diameter Of Circles defaults to 1. With Show Levels on, a level line runs forward until the close crosses it, then turns dotted.

higher-high-lower-low-strategy.text: Finds pivot highs and lows, filters them into an alternating zigzag, and labels each kept pivot HH, LL, HL or LH against earlier pivots. Resistance is the last lower high and support the last higher low; lines extend until the level moves, and bars are coloured by trend. Left Bars and Right Bars both default to 5.

higher-order-orderblocks-breakerblocks-r.text: Finds three-bar pivots and higher order pivots. When a pivot breaks the prior swing level it draws a break line and a supply or demand zone. Zones change colour when retested and become breakerblocks when price leaves the far side. Nested higher order pivots also give a range with 0.5, 0.25 and 0.75 lines. Toggles include Plot Orderblocks, Plot Breakerblocks, Plot Range and Use Log Scale, all on.

higher-time-frame-support-resistance.text: Finds pivot highs and lows on a chosen higher timeframe for up to four levels, using the last completed pivot so it does not repaint. The latest pivot high and low of each level are drawn as lines extended both ways with a wider faint shadow, plus a right-side label with the timeframe and price. Defaults: Levels 1 is 4 on 240, Levels 2 is 5 on 720, Levels 3 is 5 on D, Levels 4 is 5 on W; Offset 15.

higher-timeframe-high-low.text: Plots the high and low of the previous bar of a higher timeframe, with their midpoint, and fills between the high and low. Diamonds mark a high crossing under the higher-timeframe high (Resistance) or a low crossing over the higher-timeframe low (Support); a close above the high turns the bar green, below the low red. Main inputs: timeframe (D) and Extension to the right of High and Low (50).
names: Extension to the right of High and Low

hilega-milega-rsi-ema-wma-indicator-desi.text: Computes an RSI from smoothed up and down changes of the source, then a WMA and an EMA of that RSI. The RSI, WMA and EMA are lines in their own pane, with dashed middle lines at the adjustable level and at 50. Fills shade between the RSI and the Middle Line Reference. Defaults: RSI Length 9, WMA Length 21, EMA Length 3, Adjustable Middle Line 50.

hist-volatility.text: Takes the standard deviation of the log change in close over the last length bars and annualizes it using 365 periods a year, scaled by 100. Bars longer than daily are treated as weekly, which changes the scaling. A higher HV means larger recent price swings. length defaults to 10.

hma.text: Computes a Hull moving average: a weighted average of twice the half-length weighted average minus the full-length weighted average, smoothed over roughly the square root of the length. It gives a single line on the price pane that follows price with less lag; a turn in its direction shows a change in short-term slope. Inputs are Length (9) and Source (close).

hma-breakdown.text: Builds a Hull moving average from a full-length and a half-length weighted average of the close, with a lower band, the HMA and a smoothed Signal line. The weighted lines and band turn the uptrend colour when WMA Half is above WMA Full, and HMA and Signal follow HMA versus Signal. An optional Fast EMA and Slow EMA pair, shown when Show EMA Cross is on, uses lengths 10 and 12. HMA Length defaults to 50.

horns-pattern-identifier.text: Detects three-bar horn patterns: the first and third highs (or lows), relative to the three-bar range, fall under threshold while the middle bar sits inside them. It draws a line between the horn tips, a dotted confirmation level and a dashed target one range away. A close crossing the confirmation level prints B or S. threshold defaults to 0.05.

hott-lott.text: Smooths the highest high and lowest low over HL Length (10) with a chosen moving average, then applies a percent-based trailing stop to each. HOTT is the upper line and LOTT the lower, both delayed two bars; close above HOTT or below LOTT marks a breakout. Inputs: OTT Period (2), Percent (0.6), MA Type (VAR).

hourly-trading-system.text: Marks each clock hour's open as a zone or line and each 4-hour open as a line, with labels on the high and low of past and current hours. Hourly Average Price plots the hour's average close, green at or above the hour open and red below. Zone width (1) sets the zone size in 1/10,000 of price; Show Retests (off) adds retest signals, up to Nbr of Retest (2) per hour. Only works on charts of 60 minutes or less.

hpdr-bands-indicator.text: Takes the highest high over the lookback times 1.15 and the lowest low times 0.85, with the Midline as their average. The outer bands blend 70% of that range with 30% of the highest high or lowest low over the Probability Length. Seven levels per side run from the outer band (100) toward the Midline at 95, 88, 78, 61, 50 and 38% of that distance. Inputs: Lookback Length 100, Probability Length 10.

htc-peppermint-07-cci-w-signal-s-r-rsi.text: Draws an RSI and a CCI in one pane, with dotted lines at the CCI overbought and oversold levels. The background shades when the RSI is above RSI Overbought Level or below RSI Oversold Level. A label appears at the top when both RSI and CCI are overbought, and at the bottom when both are oversold. Defaults: RSI Length 9, CCI Length 20, levels 70/30 and 100/-100.

htf-candle-profile.text: Draws the current higher-timeframe candle to the right of the chart, with a volume profile of the closes over its span and a widest row marked PoC. The candle is green if its close is above its open, otherwise red, with dashed High and Low lines and dotted Open and Close lines. TimeFrame is W; Profile Offset is 5; Min Period Profile is 50 bars.

htf-candles-mini-charts-by-dgt.text: Builds candles of up to two higher timeframes from chart bars. They are drawn as boxes on the chart and as a mini chart right of the last bar, with optional Supertrend, Bollinger Bands or moving average, an RSI or Stochastic oscillator, and range levels. A panel shows returns, distance to moving averages and volume. Defaults: Mini Chart Bars 41, Mini Chart Overlay Supertrend, Mini Chart Oscillator RSI.

htf-liquidity-levels.text: Draws lines at the high and low of the previous period of up to five higher timeframes, starting at each new period. Levels float to the right of the last bar. When price trades above a high or below a low, that line turns the purged colour and style, and is cleared on each new Removal period. Month, Week and Day are on by default, and Removal is D. Alerts: Purging Up, Purging Down, Purging.

htf-reversal-divergences.text: Computes RSI of the close, with a Mid Line at 50 and dashed levels OB (level 70) and OS (level 30). Bull Div or Bear Div appear when RSI pivots and price pivots disagree, and engulfing, hammer or shooting star patterns of the High Timeframe bar are boxed on the price chart. Main inputs: High Timeframe (15), RSI Length (14), Pivot Left Lookback and Pivot Right Lookback (5 each).

hth-wd-gann-square-root-levels.text: Draws fixed horizontal levels from the square root of the Base Price (default 55168.9), adding and subtracting 0.25, 0.50, 1.00 and 1.50 and squaring the result. The four levels above are Resistance 1 to 4, the four below are Support 1 to 4, and the Base Price line sits between them.

hull-butterfly-oscillator.text: Computes the difference between a Hull moving average of the source and the same average run over the source in reverse order, shown as a gradient-coloured histogram and a line. Grey levels sit at plus and minus the running mean of its absolute value times Multiplier, and half of that. Bullish Dot and Bearish Dot mark turns. Inputs: Length 14, Multiplier 2.

hull-suite.text: Computes a Hull-style moving average of the Source, in one of three forms chosen by Hull Variation (Hma default, Ehma, Thma), over Length bars (55). MHULL is the current value and SHULL is the same line two bars back, with a fill between them. Both are green when MHULL is above SHULL and red otherwise, so a crossing marks a turn.

hunters-reversal-v2-3.text: Finds prominent pivots, then marks reversals from liquidity sweeps, RSI divergence and pivot extension from the EMA. A BIG triangle appears when at least Big Triangle: Min Criteria (2) criteria fire within Cluster Window (bars) (8); an X marks invalidation. Key inputs: Pivot Left Bars 15, Pivot Right Bars (confirmation delay) 5, Cooldown Bars (per direction) 20, EMA Length 50.

hurst-based-trend-persistence-w-poisson-.text: Computes a rolling Hurst exponent from the rescaled range of the last Hurst Lookback Period (20) closes, drawn as H minus 0.5 around the Baseline (H = 0.5). Rolling Hurst Oscillator is green when the close is at or above the close that many bars back, else red. Poisson Projection shows the odds of a colour change, using Poisson Lookback Period (180) and Poisson Decay Factor (0-1) (0.618).

hyper-trend.text: Builds an Average line that jumps to the midpoint with price when the close strays beyond an ATR-based distance, and otherwise drifts in the current direction. Upper and lower bands sit around it at a share of the stored ATR distance. The Average is teal when rising and red when falling, and breaks at direction changes. Inputs: Multiplicative Factor 5, Slope 14, Width % 80.

ichimoku.text: Plots midpoints of the highest high and lowest low over three windows: Conversion Line (9 bars) and Base Line (26 bars), plus Leading Span B (52 bars). Leading Span A is the average of the first two. Both spans are drawn ahead by Lagging Span minus 1 bars, and the Lagging Span is the close shifted back. The cloud is green when Leading Span A is above Leading Span B, red otherwise.

ichimoku-ace-club.text: Ichimoku variant using midpoints of the highest high and lowest low over Tenkan (9), Kijun (17), Knife1 (65) and Knife2 (129). Span A and Span B form a cloud shifted ahead by Chikou (26), green when Span A is above Span B, pink otherwise; the close is drawn back as Chikou. Circles project each line's midpoint ahead over shortened lengths.

ichimoku-ema-bands.text: Combines an EMA with upper and lower bands set at ATR times ATR Multiplier (2.272), and Ichimoku lines: Conversion Line and Base Line from midpoints of highs and lows, with Senkou Span A and B shifted forward by Displacement (26). Base Line is blue when Conversion Line is above it, red when below. Also EMA Length 26, ATR Length 200.

ichimoku-hpotter.text: Tenkan and Kijun are the midpoints of the highest high and lowest low over conversionPeriods (9) and basePeriods (26). Chikou is the close shifted back by displacement (26) bars. SenkouA is the laggingSpan2Periods (52) midpoint, shifted forward by displacement; SenkouB averages Tenkan and Kijun from basePeriods bars earlier, and the cloud is filled between the two.

ichimoku-kink-hy.text: Adaptive Ichimoku: Tenkan-Sen and Kijun-Sen are highest-high/lowest-low midpoints over lengths that shrink when volume, ATR and Chikou filters confirm. Senkou Span A averages them, Senkou Span B is a longer midpoint, both drawn ahead as a cloud. Triangles mark Signal: Bullish Reversal ▲ and Signal: Bearish Reversal ▼.

ichimoku-kinko-hyo.text: Draws up to eight configurable moving average plots, a mean of selected plots and a cloud between two of them. Defaults give the Ichimoku set: 9, 26 and 52-bar Donchian midpoints, close shifted back, and a mean of the first two shifted forward. The cloud is white when its first plot is at or above the second, else yellow. Main inputs: Moving average type, Length, Periods.

ichimoku-oscillator.text: Turns Ichimoku lines into an oscillator: the close's distance from the cloud, with extra layers from the lagging comparison, Conversion minus Base, and the cloud span gap. Layers are green in uptrends and red in downtrends; the EMA smooths the Cloud layer. Triangles mark new full trends, X marks trend exits. Inputs: Conversion Line Length 8, Base Line Length 13, Leading Span B Length 26, Lagging Span 13.

ichimoku-score-indicator.text: Adds up points for Ichimoku conditions: close against the cloud and its shadow, Tenkan against Kijun, Chikou, Senkou Span A against Span B, and close against both lines. The Ichimoku Score Line rises with bullish conditions and falls with bearish ones. Key inputs: Tenkan Sen Length 9, Kijun Sen Length 26, Senkou B Length 52, Displacement 26.

ichimoku-theories.text: Plots TenkanSen, KinjuSen, ChikouSpan, SenkouSpanA and SenkouSpanB, each a midpoint of the highest high and lowest low over its length. It adds swing-based waves, price targets and time-cycle forecast lines. Swing Length is 10; Tenkan Sen Length, Kinjun Sen Length and Senkou Span B Length are 9, 26 and 52.

ichimoku-w-heikin-ashi.text: Draws Heikin-Ashi candles with Ichimoku lines built from midpoints of the highest high and lowest low. Conversion Line (9) and Base Line (26) are the short and medium midpoints; Leading Span A averages them and Leading Span B uses 52 bars. The close and both spans are shifted forward, with a cloud between the spans that is green when Span A is above Span B and dark otherwise. Displacement defaults to 26.

ict-algorithmic-macro-tracker-by-toodegr.text: Marks New York time windows from 50 minutes past each hour to 10 past the next, plus 15:15 to 15:45, on intraday charts of 15 minutes or less. On Chart draws a bracket above price with a MACRO label that rises with the window's highs; New Pane draws boxes. Macro Label?, Show Time? and Macro Projections? (dotted lines to price, off) adjust it; each window has its own switch.

ict-anchored-market-structures-with-vali.text: Finds swing highs and lows at three nested levels (short, intermediate, long term), each built from the swings of the level below. A close beyond the latest swing draws a line and a BoS or CHoCH label; a later close more than ATR(17) away ends a sweep box, and a reversal labels it a sweep. Swings is Disabled for short and intermediate, and ◉ for long.

ict-auto-validated-smc.text: Maps smart-money structure: swing breaks drawn as BOS (with trend) or CHoCH (against it), order blocks, fair value gaps, inversion gaps, liquidity sweeps and OTE zones, with a confluence score for long and short signals. Key inputs: Swing Length (10), HTF Timeframe (240) and Min Displacement (ATR Multiple) (1).

ict-concept-order-block-fvg-liquidity-sw.text: Marks swing highs and lows from candle breaks, and draws demand or supply zones when a close breaks structure through the major high or low. It also draws fair value gaps and liquidity lines from pivot highs and lows. Zones extend right until price crosses their far edge. Order Block Refine (On) and Refine Type (Defensive) narrow the zones; Statics Period Pivot (8) and Dynamics Period Pivot (3) set the pivots.

ict-concepts.text: Draws several price action tools: market structure shifts and breaks from pivots, liquidity boxes, fair value gaps, volume imbalances, order blocks, and weekly opening gaps. Closes through pivots or boxes change the drawings. Inputs: Mode (Present), Length (5), Swing Lookback (10), Show Liquidity (on).

ict-everything.text: Draws intraday session tools on the price pane: vertical lines for the London, New York, London Close, Afternoon and Asia sessions, a midnight opening price line, and boxes over the CBDR and Asia ranges with standard deviation lines. Session hours follow Timezone Selection (default UTC -5), and everything is hidden on charts above Hide Indicator Above Specified Minutes (default 31).

ict-fvg-buy-sell-signals.text: Builds a dealing range from the last swing high and low, with its midpoint drawn as Dealing Range CE, and tracks the midpoint of the latest bullish and bearish three-bar gaps (Bullish FVG CE, Bearish FVG CE). BUY or SELL labels print when a strong-bodied bar trades into the gap and closes beyond its midpoint, in discount for buys and premium for sells. Inputs: Swing length (dealing range pivots) 5, Min body size as ATR multiple (displacement) 0.6, ATR length 14.
names: Min body size as ATR multiple (displacement)

ict-htf-candles.text: Draws the latest candles of up to six higher timeframes to the right of the last bar, built from the chart bars: first open, highest high, lowest low, latest close. Gaps between candles are marked as fair value gaps and volume imbalances, with timeframe names and time left. Inputs: HTF 1 to HTF 6 (5, 15, 60, 240, 1D, 1W; 10 candles each), Limit to next HTFs only (6), Trace lines (off).

ict-immediate-rebalance-toolkit.text: Draws five ICT-style tools: immediate rebalances (a line at the high or low of the bar two back, plus 75%, 50% and 25% wick lines, and an icon that turns to a cross if price returns through the line), liquidity levels, order blocks, voids and macro windows. Rebalance checking uses Confirmation (Bars) of 2; liquidity uses Detection Length 7 and Margin 6.9, keeping Visible Liquidity Levels of 3.

ict-implied-fair-value-gap.text: Finds three-candle patterns where the middle candle has the largest body and the outer candles' shadows are each larger than a share of the current range, with the zones not overlapping. Each match draws a box and a midpoint line reaching IFVG Extension bars ahead, bullish or bearish; Bullish IFVG Average and Bearish IFVG Average track the latest midpoint. Inputs: Shadow Threshold % 30, IFVG Extension 8, Extend Averages off.

ict-institutional-order-flow.text: Maps market structure on the price chart: short, intermediate and long term highs and lows with labels, liquidity lines from pivots that end when price trades through them, and relative equal highs and lows. It also marks fair value gaps, inverted gaps, volume imbalances and opening gaps. Short is off by default; Intermediate and Long are on.

ict-killzones.text: Shades the background of four fixed intraday sessions (New York, London Open, London Close, Asian, in UTC-5) and labels each at its highest high. During any session it draws seven retracement levels between the run's low and high, extended to the next run when Extend is on. Show Retracements defaults on, Extend on, Reverse off (counts levels from the high).

ict-killzones-pivots-tfo.text: Marks up to six time-of-day killzones (ASIA, LNDN, NYAM, NYPM on by default) as boxes from each zone's high to low. With Show Pivots on, the high and low of each zone are extended as lines until price trades through them, and labelled, with hit rates tallied in a data table. Session Limit (3) caps how many drawings are kept, and Alert Broken Pivots is on.

ict-killzones-toolkit.text: Marks four intraday trading sessions (Asian 2000-0000, London 0200-0500, New York AM 0830-1100, New York PM 1330-1600, UTC-5) with a box from the session high to low, a label, and top/bottom lines that extend until price crosses them. It also draws order blocks and fair value gaps inside the sessions. Main inputs: Display Killzones within Timeframes Up To (15), Swing Detection Length (5), Open Price of (None).
names: Display Killzones within Timeframes Up To

ict-liquidity-sweep-swing-fail-pattern-v.text: Marks unbroken pivot lows and highs (Pivot Period bars each side) with horizontal liquidity lines, keeping up to Max Active Lines per side. Each line ends when price reacts: SFP when the close crosses back over the level, MSS when closes continue beyond it, X when the wick touches it and the close stays on the original side. Line colour follows the session. Defaults: Pivot Period 10, Max Active Lines 5.

ict-macros.text: Marks short New York and London time windows on a 1-minute chart, drawing top, bottom and mid lines that follow the highs and lows of the window, with dotted extensions. After the window ends it is labelled Expansion, Manipulation or Accumulation from recent swings and its open and close. Enabled by default: 09:50 AM 10:10, 10:50 AM 11:10, 13:10 PM 13:40 and 15:15 PM 15:45; Length is 13.

ict-power-of-three-flux-charts.text: Looks for a tight accumulation range, then a break beyond it (manipulation), and enters at that bar's close against the break: long after a downside break, short after an upside one. Buy and Sell labels mark entries, with take-profit and stop-loss lines and TP or SL markers on exit. Algorithm Mode (Small Manipulation), Breakout Method (Wick), TP / SL Method (Dynamic) and Risk (Normal) shape the setups.

ict-rtm-price-action-indicator.text: Plots a supply zone (50-bar highest high) and demand zone (50-bar lowest low). Reversal bars close beyond an SMA and the relevant zone; the next bar confirms with a same-direction candle and volume above the factor times the 20-bar average. Confirmations give BUY and SELL labels, or a TRADE triangle. Inputs: طول میانگین متحرک 14, ضریب حداقل حجم 1.5.

ict-seek-destroy-profile.text: Draws boxes for the Asia (2000-0300), London (0300-0830) and New York (0830-1600) sessions in New York time. A Potential S&D Day label appears when London takes both sides of the Asian range; Valid S&D Day appears after New York meets a selected criterion. A table counts sessions, warnings and successes, and shows the Warning Message during a warning.

ict-sessions.text: Draws the whole day's high and low as circles (Daily High, Daily Low), and shades boxes around them during four sessions: London Open, New York Open, Asian Range and London Close. Each box extends beyond the range by a margin set by Box Height (default 2, percent of the range). Session times are inputs, such as KillZone London Open 0100-0500.

ict-setup-04-sfp-sweep-liquidity-fake-ch.text: Finds swing highs and lows over Swing Period (21) bars each side and looks for sweeps: a bar pokes past a swing under 50 bars old but closes back inside it. If that bar is also small-bodied and closes beyond the swing bar's body edge, it draws two dotted lines, a "Sweep" label and a triangle, red above for highs, green below for lows. Max Swing Back Method (All) sets how many swings are checked.

ict-silver-bullet.text: Marks three New York hourly sessions: 3-4 AM, 10-11 AM and 2-3 PM. Inside them it tracks fair value gaps filtered by trend, and after each session draws lines from earlier pivot highs and lows that extend until price reaches them, with a dot marking a reached target. The first, untitled input sets swing bars (5); Keep lines (true) retains target lines.

ict-turtle-soup-flux-charts.text: Looks for false breaks of the range (highest high and lowest low) of the Higher Timeframe, default 60. A break below the low arms a long and a break above the high arms a short; the trade enters when price breaks the swing of the last MSS Swing Length bars (10) the other way. With TP / SL on, the exit is Dynamic (ATR-based stop, target 0.9 times its distance) or Fixed; Breakout Method defaults to Wick.

ict-unicorn-flux-charts.text: Finds fair value gaps and breaker blocks (from swings of Swing Length, default 10) and marks a setup when a gap overlaps an opposite-side breaker, then enters on the next bar's close. Buy and Sell labels mark entries, with TP and SL targets and markers on exit bars. TP / SL Method defaults to Unicorn; Require Retracement is off.

ict-unicorn-model.text: Finds patterns where a breaker block overlaps a fair value gap, using zigzag swings of Swings (10) bars. It draws the block, the gap and the stop level; a dot marks an entry candle, followed by risk and reward boxes sized by Risk/Reward (1 : 1) until stop or target is hit. Bull and Bear switch each side, Combine allows both at once, and Trailing Stop (off) plots a pivot-following stop.

ict-venom-trading-model-smc-ny-session.text: Marks the New York Opening Range (0800-0930) high and low, then in the Trading Permit session (0930-1700) watches the first break of either side. It sets a CISD level from the last opposite candle; when a close crosses it, a triangle appears with a supply or demand order block and a fair value gap zone. Zones extend until the mitigation level (Proximal by default) is reached.

ideal-bb-ma.text: Overlays a stepped NMA line (two chained moving averages of the Source), VWAP, Bollinger Bands, and two Hull lines smoothed by a Kalman-style filter. The Hull fill is green when Hull Short is above Hull Long and red otherwise; Buy and Sell labels mark their crossings. Inputs: 1st Length (NMA) 120, 2nd Length (NMA) 12, MA Type EMA, Source hl2, Hull Lookback 24.

ift-stoch-rsi-cci.text: Scales CCI, RSI, Stochastic and MFI around zero, smooths each with a weighted average, and applies the inverse Fisher transform to bound them between -1 and 1. Lines show only when enabled, by default CCIv2; AVERAGE is the mean of all four. Levels sit at 0.5 and -0.5. CCI Length, RSI Length, STOCH Length and MFI Length are 5; Smoothing Length is 9.

ifvg-sniper-entry-engine.text: Tracks three-bar fair value gaps in memory and flips one into an inverted gap when a close passes its far side plus an ATR buffer. If the candle passes the IFVG Filter Mode (default Balanced), it draws a labelled IFVG+ or IFVG- line and opens a visual trade with entry, ATR-based stop and target. Key inputs: SL ATR Multiplier 1.5, Take Profit RR 3R, ATR Length 14.

iir-one-pole-price-filter.text: A one-pole low-pass filter of the source: each bar the line moves a fraction alpha of the way toward price. Alpha comes from Alpha Mode (EMA-Length by default, using Length (EMA-Style) 20), Half-Life or Cutoff-Period, times Alpha Scale (1). The One-Pole line and candles are green while it rises and red otherwise; alerts fire when it turns up or down.

imbalance-detector.text: Detects three imbalances and draws them as boxes: fair value gaps (FVG), opening gaps (OG) between candle bodies, and volume imbalances (VI) where bodies miss but wicks overlap. Blue marks bullish, red bearish. Each kind has Min Width and an extend setting (Extend VI defaults to 5). Show Dashboard adds counts and fill rates.

impulse-macd.text: Impulse MACD compares a zero-lag EMA of the typical price with a smoothed channel of highs and lows. The ImpulseMACD histogram shows the distance above the high channel or below the low channel, and is zero inside it. Signal is a simple average of that value, and Histogram is their difference. Inputs: Length MA (34) and Length Signal (9).

indicador-millo-sma20-sma200-ao-rsi-m1.text: Plots a 20-bar and a 200-bar simple average of the close. A BUY label appears when the close is above SMA 200, the close crossed above SMA 20 within the last 4 bars, the Awesome Oscillator crosses above zero and RSI is above 50; SELL mirrors this. A cooldown of 10 bars applies per signal type.
names: Máx. velas para confirmar con AO
Velas de cooldown por tipo de señal

indicator-elder-impulse-system.text: Colours each bar's background by comparing a 13-period EMA and a MACD histogram with the previous bar: green when both rise, red when both fall, blue otherwise. The histogram is the 12/26 EMA difference minus its 9-period average. Inputs: lengthEMA 13, fastLength 12, slowLength 26, signalLength 9; showColorBars (off) also paints price bars, useCustomResolution (off) uses another timeframe's close.

indicator-hawkeye-volume-indicator.text: Draws volume as a histogram, coloured by comparing each bar with the previous bar's midpoint and range band, its range against the average range, and its volume against average volume. Gray bars mark neutral conditions, green bullish ones, red bearish ones, and blue the rest. Inputs: length 200 for the averages, divisor 3.6 for the band width.

indicators-traders-dynamic-index-hlctren.text: Computes an RSI of the close, then a band of its moving average plus and minus 1.6185 standard deviations, with a Middle Band halfway between. RSI Price Line and Trade Signal Line are short averages of the RSI; read them against the bands and the Level lines at 32 and 68. Inputs: lengthrsi 13, lengthband 34, lengthrsipl 2, lengthtradesl 7.

indicators-volume-weighted-macd-histogra.text: A MACD histogram using volume-weighted averages of the close, each being the smoothed volume times close divided by the smoothed volume. The difference of the Short period and Long period averages is smoothed by the Smoothing period, and the histogram is the gap between them. Bars are green at or above zero and rising, red below zero and falling, orange otherwise. Defaults are 12, 26 and 9.

infinite-ema-with-alpha-control.text: Plots a slow and a fast exponential average that start at the source and update only every Update Interval bars. Each line is colored by whether the close is above, below or equal to it, and a cloud fills between them. Triangles mark fast-over-slow crossings. Defaults: slow length 200, fast 50, interval 1.

initial-balance-breakout-signals.text: Records the high, low and open of each day's initial balance, the first hour of the session when Auto is on, and draws a box, top and bottom lines, percentage extensions, Fibonacci lines and two forecast lines. A triangle marks a close breaking out of the range after the initial balance. Display Last X IBs is 10, and Forecast Memory is 10 with a Forecast Multiplier of 1.

inside-bar-coloring-w-alerts.text: Detects inside bars, where the high is no higher and the low no lower than the previous bar's, and colours them by whether the close is at or above the open. The live bar uses full colours, earlier ones the faded historical colours. Show Historical Inside Bars (on), Highlight Current Bar Only (off), Show Markers Above/Below Inside Bars (off) and Enable Inside Bar Alerts (off) control display and alerts.

inside-bar-ind-alert.text: Marks inside bars judged by candle bodies: the body sits strictly within the previous bar's body. Green inside bars get a green bar and an upward triangle above; red ones get a red bar and a downward triangle below. An orange circle above marks two consecutive bars inside the body two bars back. Alerts: Inside Bar (Body) and Next Candle Also Inside Bar (Body). No inputs.

inside-bars.text: Tracks a zone that starts at the high and low of the bar before the first inside bar and lasts while later bars stay within it. Range High and Range Low draw the zone edges; a triangle marks a breakout and ends the zone. With Expand Inside Bar Range on Wick-Through (on by default), wicks stretch the edge and only a close outside breaks out.
names: Expand Inside Bar Range on Wick-Through

inside-outside-bars.text: Compares each bar's high and low with the previous bar's. An inside bar has a lower high and a higher low; an outside bar has a higher high and a lower low. Each type is coloured, and Enable Inside Bars and Enable Outside Bars (both on) switch them individually.

instantaneous-trendline-with-cloud.text: A smoothed trendline built from the source's last three values, blended with its own previous value by Alpha (Smoothing Coeff 0.1-0.3), default 0.2. The line is lime when rising, red when falling, yellow when flat; the cloud to Price / Source is lime above the line, red below. Triangles mark crosses of the source over or under the line, with matching alerts.

institutional-composite-moving-average.text: Draws up to four composite averages, each the mean of an SMA, EMA, WMA and Hull average of its own source over its own length. Longer lengths give slower lines, so their spacing and the price position relative to them show trend. Defaults are close with MA #1 Length 20, MA #2 Length 50, MA #3 Length 100 and MA #4 Length 200; each line can be hidden.

institutional-macd.text: Standard MACD whose histogram, MACD line and signal line are each converted to a z-score over a lookback. Z-Score Histogram columns change shade by sign and rising or falling; the Z-MACD Line and Z-Signal Line cross, and +Z Threshold and -Z Threshold mark unusually large readings. Defaults: 12, 26, 9, Z-Score Lookback Length 50, Z-Score Threshold Level 1.

institutional-order-flow-strength-classi.text: Detects order blocks at breaks of pivot structure and scores each from 0 to 100, 60% on how far the breaking close moved past the block and 40% on its relative volume. Unmitigated blocks are boxed with a strength label; Strongest OB Top, Strongest OB Bottom and Strongest OB Median trace the strongest recent block. Pivot Lookback is 5, Max Unmitigated OBs 5, Strongest OB Buffer Size 5.

institutional-orderblock-pressure.text: Marks a bar as an order block when it sets a new Pivot Length-bar high with a higher close (bullish) or a new low with a lower close (bearish), alternating sides. Bullish blocks get a circle below the bar, bearish above, with horizontal lines and price labels at their levels. Key inputs: Pivot Length (5), Line Display Style (Wick), Max Lines Displayed (20).

institutional-volume-rsi.text: Computes an RSI of the volume-weighted moving average of the close, or of the plain close, and wraps it in Bollinger-style bands: the average of the RSI plus and minus a multiple of its standard deviation. Institutional RSI is green above the Baseline and red below; white circles mark crosses beyond the Upper Band or Lower Band. Inputs: RSI Length 14, Bands Length 20, Bands Multiplier 2.

internal-candle-strength.text: Splits each chart bar into price rows and measures, from lower-timeframe bars crossing each row, net close-minus-open movement as a share of total movement, scaled 0 to 100%. Each row shows that percentage in a box, coloured from red (low) to teal (high). Inputs: Timeframe (1), Row Size (20) used when Auto (on) is off; Auto sets the size from ATR.

interpolated-median-volatility-lsma-otto.text: A rolling median of the linear regression of the source forms the middle line, and bands sit a rolling median of standard deviation times multiplier away. The trend turns up when the close is above the upper band and down below the lower band, drawn green or purple. Inputs: lsma length 30, sd length 20, percentile length 30, multiplier 1.4.

intraday-buy-sell.text: Plots an SMA of close and marks buy and sell bars when price crosses it with a strong candle, plus RSI reversal marks when RSI crosses back under the higher level or over the lower level. The SMA is lime when the low is above it, red when the high is below it, yellow otherwise or when RSI is at or beyond a level. Inputs: RSI Length 14, RSI Higher Level 80, RSI Lower Level 20, SMA Length 70.

intraday-ts-bb.text: Draws narrow Bollinger bands on close and, when a bar sits fully above the upper band or below the lower band, projects Buy Entry or Short Entry, a stop, and 1:1 and 1:2 targets. Arrows mark the first bar outside a band; Squeeze Momentum and Squeeze State dots sit on the band midline, with triangle markers from ADX and DI. Key inputs: Bollinger Bars Length 46, Bollinger Bars Standard Deviation 0.35, ADX Threshold 29.

intraday-volume-swings.text: Detects three consecutive bars with rising volume and a higher high (swing high) or lower low (swing low), and keeps the price range of each swing. Previous-day swing regions are drawn as filled red (low) and green (high) bands; triangles mark confirmed swings and labels flag new-day higher swing highs or lower swing lows. Display levels as they form? (off by default) also shows today's regions.

intraday-vs-overnight-change-tracker.text: Builds two synthetic price lines from the second bar's close: Intraday compounds each bar's close divided by its open, Overnight compounds each bar's open divided by the previous close. Comparing the lines shows whether gains came during the session or in the gaps between bars. Synthetic Price Type (default Both Intraday and Overnight) shows one or both.

intraday-vs-overnight-obv.text: Splits each bar's volume into an overnight share and an intraday share, then builds running OBV sums: intraday follows close versus open, overnight follows open versus the prior close, and Aggregate OBV adds both. Lines tint greener when rising and redder when falling. The Moving Average is green below the OBV and red above it. Key inputs: Estimated Overnight Volume % 20, MA Type SMA, MA Length 20.

inverse-distance-weighted-moving-average.text: A moving average over the last Length values of the Source, where each value is weighted by its summed absolute distance to the other values, so outlying values count more. IDWMA is green when it rises and pink when it falls if Highlight Direction is on; bars can follow it too. Length defaults to 14. Alerts: Bullish Color Change, Bearish Color Change and Any Color Change.

inverse-fvg-with-rejections.text: Finds three-bar fair value gaps larger than Displacement tenths of the recent average range and draws them as boxes with a dashed centre line. A close beyond a gap's far side turns it into an inverse gap, and a close through the other side removes it. Triangles mark swing pivots inside gaps; Rejection Strength is 1 and Display Limit is 10.

inversion-fair-value-gaps.text: Finds three-bar fair value gaps wider than an ATR-based minimum. When a candle body closes through a gap, the zone flips direction and is drawn as a box with a dashed midline, extended forward. A triangle appears when the close leaves the flipped zone after the prior close (or wick, with Wick) was inside it. Inputs: Show Last (5), Signal Preference (Close), ATR Multiplier (0.25).

inverted-hammer.text: Flags a single candle with a small, non-zero body that sits below the candle's midpoint, has an upper shadow at least a set multiple of the body, and has no lower shadow, while a downtrend is in place. A label marks it as a possible bullish reversal. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets the trend test.

ipo-date-screener.text: Counts the bars available on the chart and flags the symbol as a recent IPO while that count is below IPO Days (default 498). On those bars the background turns green, a red label sits at the top and the blue Days Since IPO-style column of height 1 appears in IPO Date within IPO Days; the orange Days Since IPO column shows the bar count. An alert fires while the flag is on.

is-it-time-for-a-pullback-check-bars-sin.text: Counts the bars since price last tested a moving average of the close. A bar tests it when the average lies within the bar's low-to-high range, or when the close crosses the average. The histogram, Bars Since MA Touch/Cross, reads 0 on a test bar and rises by one each bar after. MA Length defaults to 50 and MA Type to SMA (SMA, EMA, WMA or HMA).

isolated-peak-bottom.text: Compares each bar's highs and lows with the previous two to four bars to find isolated peaks and bottoms. A peak is a high above its neighbours confirmed when the low breaks below earlier lows; a bottom is the mirror with a high breakout. Labels PEAK1, PEAK2, BOT1 and BOT2 are drawn on the pivot bar, and the SELL Alarm and BUY Alarm alerts fire on the confirming bar. It has no inputs.

itg-scalper.text: Plots TEMA, a triple exponential average of the close, coloured lime when it rises or stays level and red when it falls. A buy appears when TEMA turns up after a sell, and a sell when it turns down after a buy; the noise filter also requires MACD above or below its signal. Inputs: TEMA period 14, Filter fast length 12, Filter slow length 26, Filter signal length 9.

iu-mean-reversion-system.text: Mean is a 9-period RMA of a 9-period EMA of the close, with Upper and Lower bands at the mean plus or minus ATR times Multiplier. A long entry label appears when the close crosses back over Lower and exits when the high crosses over Mean; shorts mirror this at Upper. ATR Length defaults to 100 and Multiplier to 3.

iu-smart-flow-system.text: Draws a band of the SMA of the close plus and minus a 14-bar ATR (Bull Trend and Bear Trned), and scores the gap between the highest and lowest close over Imbalance length versus the close that many bars ago. A Long label appears on a positive score, a close above the upper band and RSI above 50; Short is the mirror. Defaults: Imbalance length 10, Trend length 50, RSI Lenght = 14.

iv-rank-vixfix-hv-proxy.text: Builds a volatility proxy, either a VIXFix (drop from the recent high versus a multiple of the standard deviation of lows) or annualised historical volatility, then ranks it between its lowest and highest value over the lookback, in percent. IV Rank % near 0 means low versus the past range, near 100 high; lines mark 0, 50 and 100. Inputs: IV Source (proxy) VIXFix, IVR Lookback (trading days ~1y) 252.

john-wick-doji-indicator.text: Measures each candle's wicks as a percentage of its body. A green candle with a lower wick longer than its upper wick, or a red one with a longer upper wick, turns black when that wick exceeds John Wick Max Upper Wick Size (60)% of the body. Show Reverse John Wick Candles? (off) also accepts the opposite wicks. John Wick Candle alert fires on these.
names: John Wick Max Upper Wick Size

jopa-channel-v1.text: Draws a rolling VWAP of the Source over Rolling VWAP Length, with a channel whose width blends residual standard deviation, ATR and MAD, scaled by relative volume and an efficiency-ratio regime factor. Upper Containment and Lower Containment mark smoothed residual extremes; Channel 20% and Channel 80% split the range. Key inputs: Rolling VWAP Length 120, Residual Extremes Lookback 220.

jurik-moving-average.text: A three-stage adaptive smoothing of Source: a fast stage, a detrended stage and a phase-weighted stage summed into the JMA line. The line, and optionally bars and background, change colour with the slope, and the alerts Bullish Color Change, Bearish Color Change and Any Color Change fire when it flips. Defaults: Length 7, Phase 100, Power 2.

kalman-ema-crosses.text: Smooths the source with a Kalman filter, takes two EMAs of that filtered price, and filters each EMA again, giving EMA 1 Kalman and EMA 2 Kalman. Both lines and the fill between them take one colour after EMA 1 Kalman crosses above EMA 2 Kalman and another after it crosses below. Inputs: EMA 1 Length (15), EMA 2 Length (25), Process Noise (50), Measurement Noise (10).

kalman-exponentialy-weighted-moving-aver.text: Smooths the source with a one-state Kalman filter, then builds a Hull-like Weighted Moving Average and an Exponentialy Weighted Moving Average that blends it with its previous value. Both lines and the fill between them turn cyan when the first crosses above the second and magenta when it crosses below. Inputs: Length (45), Process Noise (Q) (0.0005), Measurement Noise (R) (0.097).

kalman-filter-trend-breakers.text: Runs a Kalman-style filter on the source with Kalman Sharpness (4) and Kalman K (6), plotting Kalman filter signal and a velocity-boosted smoothed line, Kalman filter velocity ribbon, both green when velocity is positive and red otherwise. A red label above a bar marks a turn down after Reverse lookback, bars (8) of rising; a green label below marks the reverse, gated by Sigmoid threshold (0.6).

kalman-flow-lyro-rs.text: Tracks the source with a Kalman filter holding a level and a velocity, and sets bands around the level from the average tracking error over 𝗡𝗼𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝗟𝗲𝗻𝗴𝘁𝗵. The trend turns up when the close is above the Upper Band with positive velocity, and down when below the Lower Band with negative velocity; Long and Short labels mark flips. 𝗦𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗶𝘁𝘆 is 4, + 𝗠𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗿 1.65, - 𝗠𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗿 1, 𝗡𝗼𝗶𝘀𝗲 𝗟𝗲𝗻𝗴𝘁𝗵 50.

kalman-hull-bands-for-loop-rakoquant.text: Smooths the source with a Kalman filter, takes a Hull MA of it as Baseline, and adds bands at a multiple of a looped standard deviation. A close crossing above the upper band turns the regime bull; crossing below the lower band turns it bear. The lower rail is active in bull, the upper in bear, the others faint. Defaults: Hull Length 37, Deviation Multiplier 2.

kalman-hull-kijun.text: Runs a Kalman filter on the price in a Hull-like combination, then takes the midpoint of its lowest and highest values over the Kijun Base Period (26) as the Kalman Hull Kijun line. It is green with the source above the line and red below; fills and candle colours follow. Inputs: Kalman Price Source (close), Measurement Noise (3), Process Noise (0.01). Alerts: Kalman Hull Kijun Long, Kalman Hull Kijun Short.

kalman-trend-levels.text: Runs two Kalman filters on the close, Short Kalman and Long Kalman; the trend is up while the short one is above the long one. Each trend turn places a label with the close and starts a box sized by half the 200-bar ATR, which is extended while the trend lasts. Retest Signals (off) adds x and + marks; Candle Color (on) tints candles. Defaults: short_len 50, long_len 150.

kalman-vwap-filter.text: Runs a Kalman filter on a blend of price and a VWAP baseline, either session-anchored or rolling. The Kalman VWAP line and the candles are green while the filter rises and red otherwise. Alerts cover slope turns, price crossing the line, and the line crossing the VWAP base. Inputs: Process Noise 0.01, Measurement Noise 3, VWAP Mode Session, VWAP Weight (0..1) 0.35.
names: Kalman VWAP Crosses Above VWAP Base
Kalman VWAP Crosses Below VWAP Base

kama.text: An exponential moving average whose smoothing speed adapts to an efficiency ratio: net change over ER length bars divided by the sum of absolute bar-to-bar changes. In steady trends it reacts faster, in choppy moves it slows toward the Slow length. Defaults: Source close, ER length 10, Fast length 2, Slow length 30.

kaufman-adaptive-ma.text: A moving average whose smoothing speed adapts to an efficiency ratio: net change over Length bars divided by the sum of single-bar changes. Trending prices make KAMA follow closely between the Fast EMA Length and Slow EMA Length rates; choppy prices make it flatten. Defaults: Length 14, Fast 2, Slow 30. The Color Change alert fires when rising or falling status flips.

kaufman-trend-strength-signal.text: Runs a Kalman filter on the close and draws the filtered level as Kalman Filter MA. Filter slope, normalised to its recent peak and smoothed, gives a trend strength: the line is lime when positive, red otherwise, and blue when weak. Triangles appear when strength crosses above the positive or below the negative Entry Threshold (60).

kd-newautotrade-for-future-trading-heiki.text: Plots a fast and a slow EMA of the close. A BUY triangle appears when the fast crosses over the slow, RSI is above RSI Buy Level (55) and, with Enable ADX Filter on, ADX exceeds ADX Min (25). A SELL triangle appears on a cross under with RSI below RSI Sell Level (45). Fast EMA Length is 10, Slow EMA Length 20.

kdj.text: Takes the close's position within the highest high and lowest low of the Period, then smooths it twice to get K and D, and J as three times K minus twice D. J moving beyond D is shaded green, below it red. J runs past K and D at extremes. Period is 9, Signal is 3.

kdj-indicator-iamaltcoin.text: Computes a raw stochastic value from the close within the highest high and lowest low over period bars. K smooths it with a running average, D smooths K the same way over signal, and J is 3 times K minus 2 times D. The background is green while J is above D and red otherwise. Defaults: period 9, signal 3.

keltner.text: Draws a channel around a moving average of the source: Basis, with Upper and Lower lines set a Multiplier (2) times a range measure above and below it. The Basis is exponential over length (20) by default, and the range is the average true range over ATR Length (10) by default. Price near or beyond the outer lines shows how far it has stretched relative to recent volatility.

keltner-aroon-efi-flow.text: Averages up to three votes of -1, 0 or 1: Keltner breakout (Keltner Length 54, Keltner Multiplier 1), Aroon strength (Aroon Length 32) and Force Index sign (Force Index Length 70, off by default), then smooths with an ALMA (Length 50). Flow above 0.1 is bullish, below -0.1 bearish; candles and Signal Line take that colour. KAE Long and KAE Short alert on crossings of those levels. Band-Up and Band-Down draw a Supertrend.

kernel-channel.text: A kernel-weighted mean of the Source (hlc3) over Window Length (100) forms the Kernel Midline, with Upper Band and Lower Band at Band Multiplier (2) times a kernel standard deviation or ATR width. Lines and fill are green when the midline rises, red when it falls, gray when flat. Squeeze periods, when the relative width is in the lowest percentile of its lookback, get a background highlight.

kerpd-noise-filter-kaufman-efficiency-ra.text: Averages two noise measures over Length bars, the Kaufman efficiency ratio and the inverted price density, both scaled by 100. The line is aqua when at or above the Noise Threshold % (quiet) and blue when at or below it (loud), with a matching tape under zero. Defaults: Length 20, Noise Threshold % 35.

key-levels-spacemanbtc-idwm.text: Draws horizontal lines with text labels for higher-timeframe levels: period opens, previous highs and lows with their middles, and the Monday range. Lines run from the period start to the right of the last bar. Merge Levels? (on) joins labels at the same price. Display Style (Standard) can anchor lines at Anchor Distance (250); Distance (30) sets the right end.

key-tdi.text: Computes the RSI of the close, then smooths it with an SMA for a centre line and adds bands at 1.6185 standard deviations of the RSI around it, plus a fast SMA of the RSI. Plot 3 (orange) is the centre line, Plot 1 and Plot 2 are the bands, Plot 4 is the fast line; dashed levels sit at 32 and 68. Inputs: Lengthrsi 13, Lengthband 34, Lengthrsipl 2.

keyzone.text: Draws step lines at the lowest low and highest high of the previous 3, 8, 21 and 89 bars, not counting the current bar. Ultra fast zones are lime, fast green, slow orange and ultra slow red; price near or beyond a line is outside that recent range. It has no inputs.

kicking-bearish.text: Flags a two-candle pattern: a long bullish candle with shadows of at most 5% of its body, then a long bearish candle with the same tight shadows, whose high is below the first candle's low (a downward gap). A label marks the second candle as a possible bearish reversal. No trend test is used and the only input is a label colour.

kicking-bullish.text: Flags a two-candle pattern: a long bearish candle with shadows of at most 5% of its body, then a long bullish candle with the same tight shadows, whose low is above the first candle's high (an upward gap). A label marks the second candle as a possible bullish reversal. No trend test is used and the only input is a label colour.

kijun-sen-with-buy-sell-labels-alerts-ic.text: Plots Kijun-Sen, the midpoint of the highest high and lowest low over Base Periods (26). It is green when the close is above, red when below, gray when equal. A B label appears below the bar on an upward cross or new uptrend, an S label above on a downward cross or new downtrend. Alerts: Color Change Alert, Price Crosses Kijun Up, Price Crosses Kijun Down.

kinetic-slippage-index.text: Measures price movement per unit of volume: squared true range divided by volume times its average volume, scaled by a million, with an EMA as the signal. The KSI Histogram is green when above the Signal Line and red otherwise; a cross over the Spike Line fires KSI Anomalous Spike. Inputs: Volume EMA Period (20), Signal Line Period (9), Spike Signal Level (0).

kiss-of-death.text: Plots a 21-bar exponential moving average of the close. A red downward triangle labelled kiss_of_death appears above a bar when it closes below the average, the previous close was at or above the average, and its low is under the lowest low of the two prior bars. It marks a downward break of the average and has no inputs.

klinger.text: Signs each bar's volume positive if the typical price did not fall from the prior bar, negative otherwise, then subtracts a 55-bar exponential average of it from a 34-bar one. Signal is a 13-bar exponential average of the Klinger Oscillator; crossings show shifts in volume flow. It has no inputs.

knn-market-architecture.text: Finds pivots on short, medium and long terms and keeps those a k-nearest-neighbours vote scores at or above Confidence Threshold (0.4). Kept pivots start level lines that run until a close breaks them, marked with a BOS label; candles are shaded by the close within the latest high and low of the Bias Source term. Main inputs: Structure Sensitivity 5, k-Nearest Neighbors 5.

kst.text: Sums four rate-of-change series, each smoothed by a simple average, weighted 1, 2, 3 and 4. The Signal line is a simple average of KST; crossings between them and the Zero level show momentum shifts. ROC Length #1-#4 default 10, 15, 20, 30; SMA Length #1-#4 default 10, 10, 10, 15; Signal Line Length 9.

l1-moving-average-fingerprint-for-long-e.text: Combines smoothed highest highs and lowest lows over three lengths with a low-movement ratio into a score that is non-zero only on bars making a 13-bar low. The background is green while the score is above zero; triangles below the bar mark it crossing above 1.2, 4.5 and 7.0. Inputs: MAGene1 485, MAGene2 222, MAGene3 96, MALookback 17, FPLookback 30.

l2-risk-assessment-for-trend-strength.text: Locates the close within its recent low-to-high range, smooths it with EMAs and inverts it into a safety level, drawn as Current Safety Level area. Trend Strength Indicator is 100 minus that level, coloured fuchsia from 80, red from 50, yellow from 20, green below. Dotted Level lines mark 100, 80, 50, 20 and 0. No inputs.

ladder-stdev.text: Computes two standard deviations of the source, or of its log returns in RETURN mode: Positive StDev uses only bars closing above the open, Negative StDev only the other bars, and each holds its value between its own bars. In RETURN mode values are converted to a price distance. Inputs: StDev Mode PRICE, StDev Len 20.

laguerre-filter.text: A Laguerre filter of the chosen price: several damped elements are combined with triangular weights into one line on the price chart. The Laguerre line turns long-coloured when it rises and short-coloured when it falls, candles take that colour, and fills join the line and the close. Main inputs: Gamma (Damping) 0.8, where higher is smoother, and Filter Order 4.

laguerre-kalman-adaptive-filter-alphanat.text: Blends a Kalman-smoothed Laguerre filter of the close with a second Laguerre filter whose gamma widens with recent volatility, then smooths the average with a short EMA. The line is cyan when it rises by more than Trend Threshold (0.001) and the close stays above it, otherwise magenta. Inputs: Laguerre Gamma (0.5), Adaptive Period (20), Kalman Noise Reduction (0.5). Alerts: Filter Cross Up, Filter Cross Down.

laguerre-rsi.text: Runs close through a four-stage Laguerre filter and takes the share of upward steps among all steps between stages, giving a 0 to 1 line. It is teal when rising and red when falling, with lines at 0.8 and 0.2. Defaults: Gamma 0.75, Smoothing (1 = off) 1; higher Gamma gives a smoother line.

laguerre-ultimate-explorations-multicato.text: Smooths the Source Series with a two-pole smoother, then a four-stage Laguerre filter. The pane shows Laguerre Oscillator: the smoother minus a one-pole filter of it, divided by its RMS over RMS Period (100). Dotted levels sit at 1 and -1, with a dashed zero. Overlaid are a ribbon of Laguerre 2 to 59, Ultimate Smoother and Laguerre Filter. Laguerre Period is 20, Laguerre Lag 0.5, Laguerre Mode 3.

lance-algo.text: Builds a channel from the highest high and lowest low of Sensitive times 10 bars; its middle is the trend line, green or red by the prior trend. A green triangle below the bar marks a long start, a red one above a short start, each opening a simulated trade with a stop and targets TP 1 to TP 4. Inputs: Sensitive (18), Risk % (1), BE target (1).

leledc-levels.text: Counts bars closing above or below the close four bars earlier. When a count passes Exhaustion Bar Count (10) on a bar that reverses and reaches the extreme of Swing Length (40) bars, it marks Top or Bot exhaustion. The high of a Top bar becomes the Resistance Level and the low of a Bot bar the Support Level; Up and Down alerts fire on these bars.

level2-signalfilter-liquidity-protection.text: Turns the sign of the chosen signal times Input multiplier / reverse (-value) into long, short or none. With Liquidity Safer active on, a repeated same-side signal is blocked until the close leaves a band set by Grow for next long (101) and Shrink for next long (99), or the short equivalents. Signaloutput shows the filtered result; Lock state shows +1 or -1.

leveraged-liquidation-zones.text: Estimates liquidation bands around the previous close for 25x, 50x, 75x and 100x leverage, placing them at the close plus and minus close divided by the leverage. The Sup line of each pair is the upper edge and the Inf line the lower edge, with the space between filled. Show 25x, Show 50x, Show 75x and Show 100x each switch a band on or off (all on by default).

lgmm-multivariate-poly-latent-states.text: Fits a rolling least-squares polynomial of the source over the Training window (252 bars), adding latent state weights, to give the Fair value. Upper band and Lower band sit Band width (×σ) (2) residual deviations away, widened by state entropy. Buy marks the lower band crossing over price, Sell the upper band crossing under it. Polynomial degree defaults to 2.

linear-predictive-filters.text: Filters the source with a high-pass and a smoother, scales it by its decaying peak, then adapts a linear-prediction filter on it each bar. It shows the signal with a 2-bar-ahead Predict line, a heat map of power by period (Spectrum 18 to Spectrum 39, black to red to yellow), and the Dominant Cycle, the period with most power. Inputs: Lower Bound 18, Upper Bound 40, Length 40.

linear-regression.text: Draws the Regression Line, a linear regression of the source over length bars, smoothed by an SMA; it is green while rising and red otherwise. A channel of Deviation standard deviations around the fitted line gives upper and lower lines; BUY marks a close crossing below the lower line, SELL a close crossing above the upper. Defaults: length 100, Deviation 2, offset 0, smoothing 1.

linear-regression-blend-candles.text: Draws candles whose open, high, low and close mix the price with its linear regression end point over LR Lookback (10): price times (1 minus blend) plus regression times blend, with LR Blend % at 50. Enable Adaptive Blend (off) instead scales the blend between Min Blend % (20) and Max Blend % (80) using volatility or R² per Adaptive Mode. Smoothing and Show Ghost Candles are optional.

linear-regression-candles.text: Replaces open, high, low and close with their linear regression values over Linear Regression Length (11), optionally averaged by Smooth Length (1), and draws them as candles: teal when open is below close, red otherwise. Signal is a moving average of the regression close, simple when Simple MA (Signal Line) is on (default) and exponential otherwise, with Signal Smoothing 11.

linear-regression-channel.text: Fits separate linear regressions to highs and lows over Length bars (default 300), shown as LinReg High and LinReg Low. Lower Band sits one mean deviation of lows below the low regression; Upper Band one mean deviation of highs above the high one. Each band is teal when rising and red when falling versus the prior bar.

linear-regression-channel-curve-slope-by.text: Fits a least-squares line to the last Count values of a source (200 for the first channel, 50 for the second) and draws parallel lines at 1, 2 and 3 standard deviations of the values around it. Price near the outer lines is far from the fitted trend. The LRC plot is a regression curve over 50 bars, with optional bands. Bars are coloured by volume against its 89-bar average.

linear-regression-oscillator.text: Fits a least squares line to the last Length closes, then normalizes its value with a 100-bar mean and standard deviation. The Oscillator is read around the Zero Line: crossings of zero mark trend changes and set an Invalidation Level on price, while turns beyond Upper Threshold (1.5) or Lower Threshold (-1.5) mark mean reversion. Length defaults to 20.

linear-regression-volume-lyro-rs.text: Computes a volume-weighted average price over Regression Length (35), using SMA, RMA, HMA or ALMA per Type, then smooths it with a linear regression to give Fair Value. Three band pairs sit at 1, 2 and 3 times Deviation Multiplier (1) times the close standard deviation. Fair Value is green when rising, pink when falling, gray when flat.

linear-volume-macd-lyro-rs.text: Builds a MACD from volume-weighted EMAs (Fast Length 12, Slow Length 21), subtracts a Signal Smoothing 5 average, and shows a linear regression of that gap over LR Length 35. Histogram columns take the up or down colour by the Signal Type (default Linear Regression: sign of the regression), with bands at 1 and 2 Stdev Multiplier-based deviations over Stdev Length 200. Background shades beyond the outer bands.

linereg-candles-with-hma-filter.text: Draws candles from linear regressions of open, high, low and close, plus a Signal Line that is a running average of the regression close. A regression close crossing above the Signal Line gives a buy marker, crossing below gives a sell. Key inputs: Linear Regression Length (11) and Signal Smoothing (11).

linreg-channel.text: Fits a least-squares line to the Source over the last Length bars (default 100) and draws it with an upper and lower line at Upper Deviation and Lower Deviation standard deviations (both 2). The two zones are filled in different colours, and Show Pearson's R labels how closely price follows the line. It is redrawn on each new bar.

liqudation-heatmap.text: Marks liquidity zones as boxes at swing highs and lows (two bars each side) over the last 500 bars. Each box is one ATR-based step above a pivot high or below a pivot low, shaded by that bar's volume against recent volume, and ends once a bar crosses its middle. Colours run from transparent through Min up to Max; the defaults are Max yellow and Min green.

liquid-reversal-bands.text: Computes a Fair Value line from blended EMA and ALMA of the Source over Fair Value Length (50), with bands set by a smoothed volatility width times 2.4. A Buy label appears when the close returns above the Lower Band, a Sell label when it returns below the Upper Band; Signal Cooldown (0) spaces signals. Fair Value shifts colour with its slope.

liquidation-levels.text: Estimates liquidation prices from a Reference Price (default open): long level is price times (1 + 1/leverage), short level times (1 - 1/leverage), for leverages 25, 50 and 100. Bars with volume above Volume Threshold (default 1.7) times its 13-bar average, or a large Volatility Threshold (default 10) move, draw bubbles sized by volume. Levels beyond the bar extend as lines until price trades through them.

liquidation-reversal-signals.text: Splits each bar's volume into up or down volume (estimated from the chart bar), turns each into a z-score over Z Score Length (200) bars, and flags a spike above Z-Score Threshold (3) as a liquidation dot. When the Supertrend then flips against the last spike within Liquidation Timeout Bars (0 = none) (50), it draws the Bullish Trend or Bearish Trend line with a start label.

liquidations-zones.text: Marks each pivot high or low found with Length bars on each side by stacking four boxes from the pivot price, spanning 1%, 2%, 4% and 10% (100X, 50X, 25X, 10X), red-brown above highs and green below lows. Active boxes run Extend bars ahead; a box turns gray and dotted once price trades through it, and labels show volume. Length is 10, Extend is 40, and Display HeatMap (off) swaps text for lighter boxes.

liquidity-delta-profiler.text: Marks swing highs and lows as buy-side and sell-side liquidity zones, split into four quadrants that each accumulate an estimated volume delta, shown with a signed number. Zones fade when swept, show remaining health, and get ABS, EXH, DIV or REJ labels on reversals. Key inputs: Pivot Length (15), Max Zones per Type (10), Zone Volume Capacity (5).

liquidity-entry-zones.text: Stores recent swing highs and lows as liquidity levels, then flags a bar that pokes beyond one by an ATR-based distance and closes back inside with a long wick. A following candle in the trade direction confirms it, marked by Buy Signal Marker or Sell Signal Marker triangles. Key inputs: Swing Pivot Length 5, EMA Length 50, Max Bars After Sweep For Confirmation 2.
names: Max Bars After Sweep For Confirmation

liquidity-flow-zones.text: Tracks the last confirmed swing high as Buy Side Liquidity and the last swing low as Sell Side Liquidity. A bar that pokes beyond a level by more than the Sweep Filter (ATR) of 0.2 times ATR but closes back inside gives a SELL or BUY triangle. Swing Length defaults to 5, ATR Length to 14.
