liquidity-grab-zones-flux-charts.text: Finds pivot highs and lows of Pivot Length bars and marks a grab when a bar's wick reaches an open level and the wick beyond the body is at least Wick-Body Ratio (0.5) times the body. Each grab draws a box with a dashed middle line, red for buyside and green for sellside; R marks a retest and B a break. Zone Invalidation (Close) sets how a zone breaks; Retests is on, Breaks off. The bubble plots are always empty.

liquidity-grabs.text: Tracks recent pivot highs and lows as liquidity levels and flags bars whose wick pierces a level while the body closes back on the other side. Circle size (small, medium, large) grows with wick-to-body ratio relative to Wick-Body Ratio (0.5). Buyside is drawn at the high, sellside at the low. Pivot Length 25, Cooldown Bars 3, Liquidity Zone Count 5.

liquidity-heatmap.text: Finds swing highs and swing lows on up to six higher timeframes and marks each pivot price with a shaded text block: red for highs, green for lows. Higher timeframes give less transparent, longer blocks. Each timeframe has Left and Right bar counts, such as 7 and 7 on the first. Hide lines lower than enabled timeframes? is on by default.
names: Hide lines lower than enabled timeframes?

liquidity-heatmap-ltf.text: Shows lower-timeframe activity inside each chart bar. A vertical line spans the bar's high to low, in the bullish colour if it closed above its open, else the bearish one. Each lower bar draws an open-to-close box shaded by its volume, and the highest-volume one is highlighted with lines at its open and close. LTF Timeframe defaults to 1.

liquidity-indicator.text: Marks local extremes: Local High Line shows the bar's high when it equals the highest high of the lookback window, and Local Low Line shows the low when it equals the lowest low. Other bars show nothing, so the step lines sit at recent swing highs and lows. Both lookbacks default to 10 bars, and alerts fire on each detection.

liquidity-levels.text: Finds pivot highs in volume and records the close of the pivot bar as a liquidity level, keeping the newest levels as horizontal lines extended left. An optional histogram counts recent bullish and bearish closes between neighbouring levels as boxes projected to the right. Inputs: length 20, Number Of Levels 5, Histogram Window 200, Show Histogram on.

liquidity-levels-mtf-sonarlab.text: Marks pivot highs and lows as liquidity levels, drawn as lines or boxes that extend forward until price mitigates them, by close or by wick. Left Bars (15) and Right Bars (5) set the pivot window, and Display Limit (5) keeps about half that many open levels per side. Mitigated levels stay as paler copies or vanish. Higher Timeframe adds levels from another timeframe.

liquidity-location-detector.text: Draws boxes where liquidity sits: above a 15-bar high that the current bar fails to exceed, and below a 15-bar low that the current bar fails to undercut. Box shade deepens with the prior bar's volume strength (0 to 10), shown as text from 1; boxes extend until price trades through them. Amount (100) caps the boxes; Fast (20) and Slow (35) add optional EMAs, plotted as Ema Fast and Ema Slow.

liquidity-pools.text: Tracks the highest and lowest candle of the current move and counts wick contacts with their body edges. After enough contacts spaced apart and a quiet confirmation period, it draws a bearish zone above or a bullish zone below, with a line and a volume label for the newest zone of each side. Key inputs: Zone Contact Amount (2), Bars Required Between Each Contact (5), Confirmation Bars (10).

liquidity-pools-pro.text: Finds pivot highs and lows and merges pivots within a tolerance of ATR into liquidity pools, scoring each 0 to 100 from touches, recency, volume and optional higher-timeframe confluence. A Long or Short signal appears when a bar's wick sweeps a strong enough pool and closes back over its level. Key inputs: Equality Tolerance (×ATR) 0.25, Min Pool Strength for Signal 25, Risk Preset Balanced.

liquidity-price-depth-chart.text: Takes the bars visible on the chart, sorts bullish and bearish closes by price and accumulates their volume into two depth outlines, drawn as dotted points joined by a filled polyline. Dotted lines mark the highest-volume close on each side, and boxes below the low show each side's volume share as a percentage. Volume % Box Padding (5) sets the box depth.

liquidity-proximity-heatmap.text: Stores recent pivot highs and lows with the volume of their pivot bar, then on each bar picks the stored highs above the bar high and lows below the bar low, nearest first. Up to Number of Points (P) dots per side (H1 to H10, L1 to L10) are coloured by volume; VWAP Highs and VWAP Lows are volume-weighted averages of each side's dots. Key inputs: Pivot Left Length 20, Pivot Right Length 20, Historical Buffer Size 200.

liquidity-sentiment-profile-lupen.text: Weights candle pressure by volume: bullish body plus lower wick against bearish body plus upper wick, summed over LENGHT bars (14) into a value from -100 to 100, with an EMA Signal Line using SMOOTHING (5). LSP Intensity Area is shaded by sign and direction, with dotted Upper Zone (level 50) and Lower Zone (level -50). LSP Line crossing the signal triggers LSP Buy or LSP Sell, marked when Show the corsings? is on.

liquidity-sniper-pro.text: Compares a fast and slow EMA for trend, and signals when the close crosses the fast EMA in that direction, optionally confirmed by higher-timeframe trend and strong volume. A signal opens a trade box with a stop at ATR times a multiplier and targets at 1, 2 and 3 times risk, graded A, B or C. Inputs: Fast EMA 50, Slow EMA 200, ATR Length 14, ATR Multiplier 1.5, HTF Timeframe 15.

liquidity-spectrum-visualizer.text: Draws volume bubbles on the last LookBack bars (default 200), sized by volume in standard deviations, green on up candles and orange on down ones. It also builds a 100-bin volume profile of that range with liquidity lines at bins above half the largest. Bubbles, profile and lines toggle with Display Volume Bubles, Volume Profile and Liquidity Levels, all on by default.

liquidity-structure-order-flow.text: Builds a 150-bin volume profile of the last Lookback Period (300) bars, from which it marks the point of control, the value area (Value Area % 70) with VAH and VAL lines, the widest low-volume void, a heatmap, and a delta panel. Bubbles flag bars whose volume z-score reaches Sensitivity (Z-Score) (2), and the alert Unusual Volume Detected fires on such volume.

liquidity-sweep-confirmation.text: Tracks the last swing high and low and notes when price trades beyond them. After a high sweep, a close below the prior bar's 3-bar lowest low gives a SELL label; after a low sweep, a close above the 3-bar highest high gives BUY. A TP label follows when RSI leaves 70 (long) or 30 (short). Inputs: Swing Length (3), RSI Length (14).

liquidity-sweep-filter.text: Builds trend bands from a moving average of an EMA of the Source, widened by an averaged deviation times Multiplier. Trend flips when the close leaves the bands; Uptrend Line or Downtrend Line shows the active band, and swing levels swept by price give sweep labels and triangles (filled when above Major Sweep Threshold). Length defaults to 12, Multiplier to 2, threshold to 50.

liquidity-sweep-hunter-algo.text: Stores the highest highs and lowest lows over Fast, Mid and Slow lookbacks as liquidity levels, scores them by volume, and shades them as a heatmap from weak to strong. A reversal label appears when one bar's wick sweeps at least two distinct levels and a close within 2 bars returns beyond them; Show TP/SL (default on) then draws stop and target boxes at RR 3. Fast, Mid, Slow default to 14, 42, 120; Strength is 33.

liquidity-sweeps.text: Tracks swing highs and lows found by nested three-bar pivots and keeps them as open levels. When a bar wicks past a level but closes back inside, a line from the swing to that bar and a shaded box are drawn, red for highs and green for lows. A level is dropped once a close breaks through it. Detection sets the swing depth: Short Term, Intermediate Term or Long Term (default).

liquidity-swings.text: Finds pivot highs and lows and builds an area at each: the wick to the body edge, or the full range. Later bars overlapping the area add to a count and a volume total, shown as a box and a label, with a level line that stops and turns dashed once a close crosses it. Pivot Lookback is 14, Swing Area is Wick Extremity, and Filter Areas By is Count with a value of 0.

liquidity-thermal-map.text: Builds a volume heat map over the last 100, 300 or 600 bars, split into 31 price levels, each summing the volume of bars closing near its middle. Bands are shaded by their share of the largest sum, with Upper Liquidity Color at or above the close and Lower Liquidity Color below it; labels show buy and sell liquidity and their imbalance. Profile Depth defaults to Balanced Profile, Thermal Sensitivity to Balanced.

liquidity-trap-reversal-bot.text: Takes the latest pivot high and pivot low and plots 11%, 13% and 27.2% extensions of their range above the high and below the low, with fills between the 111% and 113% levels. A reversal arrow appears when the high or low reaches the 111% level and the close then crosses back through the pivot; breakout and breakdown arrows mark closes crossing the pivot high or low. Pivot Lookback is 15.

liquidity-trendline-with-signals.text: Finds pivot highs and lows with Period bars on each side and draws a two-line band with a fill: a falling resistance band from two lower pivot highs, a rising support band from two higher pivot lows. The second line sits Padding times a small ATR-based step away. A low above resistance or a high below support ends the band and draws a triangle if Show Breakouts is on. Period defaults to 5, Padding to 2.

liquidity-voids.text: Finds three-bar gaps wider than the 144-bar average true range times Liquidity Voids Threshold (default 0.5), and draws each as a stack of thin boxes, green for bullish and red for bearish. A box turns grey once price re-enters it, or disappears if Filled Liquidity Voids is off. Mode picks Historical (all bars) or Present (last # Bars, default 360).

liquidity-zones.text: Finds swing highs and lows backed by strong relative volume, then places a liquidity level one ATR beyond each pivot, shown as a line and a box with the volume. When a bar trades through the level, the line turns dashed, the box reads Liquidity Grabbed and a red circle appears. Length (10), Zones Amount (10) and Volume Strength Filter (Mid) control detection; Dynamic Distance scales the gap by strength.

loacally-weighted-ma-direction-histogram.text: Computes a linearly weighted moving average of the Source, giving recent bars more weight, and plots its change over the last LWMA Direction Lookback bars as columns. Blue columns mean the average is flat or rising, yellow mean it is falling; the price candles take the same colour. LWMA Length defaults to 60 and the lookback to 1.

logarithmic-regression-channel-trend.text: Fits a straight line to the log of the close over Lookback Period (100) bars and plots its current value as Log Regression, green when above its value 3 bars back and red when below. A channel spans Channel Length (100) bars with a dashed mid line and outer bands at standard-deviation multiples of Channel Width (1.5), coloured by channel direction. Cross marks show when the 3-bar change crosses zero.

logistic-rsi-stoch-roc-ao-by-dgt.text: Applies a logistic map to a chosen base oscillator and plots 26 iterations as crosses, teal when at or above zero and red below. A thick Standard Deviation of Array's Elements line is cyan when the average is positive and orange when negative; its zero crossings trigger the early warning and trading opportunity alerts. Select Indicator defaults to Logistic Dominance, Logistic Map Length to 13.

logit-rsi.text: Takes the RSI of the close, clamps it and applies a logit, then by default divides by a length-based scale so values read as z-scores. RSI Plot switches between standardized logit, logit RSI and regular RSI; reference lines at Zero, Body +/-, Tail +/- (and optional Breakout and Overextension) show only for the standardized logit. Length defaults to 2, Body 0.66, Tail 2.14.

long-lower-shadow.text: Flags any candle whose lower shadow is more than 75% of its full high-to-low range. A label marks it as a bullish signal on that bar. No trend test is applied, and the percentage is fixed in the code rather than set by an input.

long-short-dom.text: Vortex indicator: VI + and VI - are sums over Length bars of the distance from the high to the prior low, and from the low to the prior high, divided by the summed true range. VI + above VI - means upward movement dominates, shown by a green background and lime columns in VI+ - VI-; otherwise red and maroon. Highest Line and Lowest Line follow the larger and smaller of the two. Length defaults to 14.

long-upper-shadow.text: Flags a single candle whose upper shadow is more than 75% of its full high-low range. A label marks the bar where this happens, read as a bearish sign that price was pushed up and then rejected. The only input is Label Color Bearish, a display setting; an alert named New pattern detected is available.

lorentzian-classification.text: Classifies each bar with a nearest-neighbours vote over 2 to 5 features (RSI, WT, CCI, ADX), using Lorentzian distance and labels from the price direction 4 bars ahead. Buy/Sell labels appear when a new signal agrees with the Kernel Regression Estimate and the enabled filters. Key inputs: Neighbors Count 8, Max Bars Back 2000, Feature Count 5.

lorentzian-length-adaptive-moving-averag.text: Builds two adaptive moving averages of close whose length moves between Min Length (9) and Max Length (600). A nearest-neighbour search on a blend of ADX, kernel MACD and volume features picks the length, then a kernel smooths the result. Long Adaptive Average and Short Adaptive Average are the two lines; feature and smoothing toggles are on by default.

lowess.text: Smooths a volatility-adjusted Gaussian average of closes (Length 30) with a tricube-weighted LOWESS over its last 10 values. The Gaussian Moving Average line is blue when above its value 2 bars back and purple otherwise, with a diamond where that changes. Pivots (Length 5 on the left) start levels that run until the close crosses them; Count Breaks numbers consecutive breaks.

lsma.text: Fits a straight regression line through the last Length (25) values of the Source (close) and plots the line's value at the latest bar, moved back by Offset (0). It acts as a moving average that follows the fitted trend, so it reacts to slope more than a simple average does. A price crossing the LSMA line marks price moving to the other side of that fitted trend.

lucid-sar.text: Parabolic SAR that steps toward the extreme price of the current trend, with the step growing each time a new extreme is made, and flips sides when price crosses it. Circles under price in SAR Up mark an uptrend; circles above price in SAR Down mark a downtrend. Start (0.02), Increment (0.02) and Max (0.2) set the initial step, its growth and its cap.

lumina-trend-channels.text: Plots an EMA of the close as Baseline, with ATR-based bands at inner and outer multiples, all coloured by trend: up if the baseline rose over two bars, down if it fell. Triangles mark closes crossing the baseline with the trend, circles mark trend changes. Defaults: Channel Length 21, Outer Band Multiplier 2, Inner Band Multiplier 1.

luminous-mean-reversion-channels.text: Builds a Mean Reversion Level that starts at the source and shifts by one ATR-based step only when the source moves more than a step away. The Overbought Band and Oversold Band sit at that level plus or minus twice half the last step. BUY marks the source crossing up over the lower band, SELL crossing down under the upper band. Inputs: Volatility Length 200, Channel Width Factor 6.

lunar-phase.text: Computes the Moon's phase from each bar's open time using orbital formulas: (1 minus the cosine of the Moon-Sun longitude gap) divided by 2, so 0 is new moon and 1 is full moon. Moon characters mark a trough below 0.1, a rising cross of 0.5, a peak above 0.88 and a falling cross of 0.5. It has no inputs.

luxy-big-beautiful-dynamic-orb.text: Builds opening ranges from the first 5, 15, 30 and 60 minutes of the session, drawing the active stage's high, low and mid lines with a fill between high and low. A close beyond a range edge plus Breakout Buffer (%), default 0.2, gives a breakout label; retests, failed breaks, stops and targets are tracked afterwards. Session Mode defaults to Auto-Detect and Signal Mode to Track Cycles.

luxy-super-duper-supertrend-predictor-en.text: An adaptive SuperTrend with bands at hl2 plus or minus ATR times a multiplier scaled by trend strength and volume, then smoothed. The SuperTrend Line shows trend direction in green or red, and BUY or SELL labels appear on flips that pass a volume-based quality score. Main inputs: ATR Length 10, ATR Multiplier (Base) 3, Smoothing Factor 0.15, Minimum Quality Score 30.

ma-adx.text: Plots a weighted moving average of Source (close) over MA Length (34), coloured by trend strength from an ADX calculation. It is lime when ADX is above ADX MA Active (18) and +DI exceeds -DI, red when ADX is above it and -DI is larger, and black otherwise. ADX Length defaults to 14.

ma-colored.text: Draws an exponential and a simple moving average of the Source on the price chart. Each line is coloured by direction: teal when it rose from the prior bar, red when it fell, blue when unchanged. Defaults: EMA Length 8 and SMA Length 8.

ma-converging.text: Draws an adaptive moving average that starts with a smoothing weight based on Length and raises it by 1/Increment while price keeps making new window highs or lows, then resets it when price crosses the line. Fast MA tracks recent extremes and eases toward price. Converging MA is teal when Fast MA is above it and red when below. Defaults: Length 100, Increment 10, Fast 10.

ma-cross.text: Draws a short and a long simple moving average of the close on the price pane. A Cross marker is placed on the Short MA value at each bar where the short average moves from at or below to above the long one, or from at or above to below it. Inputs are Short MA Length (9) and Long MA Length (21).

ma-cross-alert-mtf.text: Draws a short and a long moving average (SMA, EMA, WMA or linear regression) of a price source, optionally taken from a higher timeframe. Each line is lime when rising, red when falling and blue when flat; bars are green when the short is above the long, red when below. MA Cross marks crossings. Defaults: Short Period Moving Average 50, Long Period Moving Average 100, EMA.

ma-cross-with-displacement.text: Plots two simple moving averages of the close, MA 1 and MA 2. Bars whose close differs from the previous close by more than the threshold percent are recolored: one colour for up moves, another for down moves. Inputs: MA 1 Period (9), MA 2 Period (21), Displacement Threshold (%) (1.1).

ma-deviation-rate.text: Computes how far the Source sits from its moving average as a percentage, then builds a Center line and bands from that rate's average and standard deviation. Deviation Rate above HiBound or below LoBound is shaded red or green, marking unusually large gaps. Inputs: Moving average period 21, Number of Std Deviations 2, MA Type sma.

ma-ribbon.text: Draws up to four moving averages of a chosen source on the price chart, each with its own type (SMA, EMA, SMMA (RMA), WMA or VWMA) and length. Reading them side by side shows how fast and slow averages sit relative to price and to each other. Defaults are SMA of close at lengths 20, 50, 100 and 200, with MA #1 to MA #4 switchable.

ma-ribbon-5ema-20ema-50sma-200ema.text: Plots four moving averages of the Source (close) on the price chart: 5 EMA, 20 EMA, 50 SMA and 200 EMA, each of which can be hidden. Alerts fire when price crosses above or below the 200 EMA (Price Crossed Above 200 EMA, Price Crossed Below 200 EMA) and when the 5 EMA crosses the 20 EMA (5 EMA Crossed Above 20 EMA, 5 EMA Crossed Below 20 EMA).

ma-sabres.text: Plots a moving average of the close, TEMA by default. When the average turns up after falling for Previous Trend Duration bars (or turns down after rising), it marks three circles at the prior bar's low or high and draws a curved sabre pointing Length bars ahead. Blue marks bullish reversals, red bearish. Inputs: MA Type TEMA, Length 50, Previous Trend Duration 20.

ma-shaded-fill.text: Plots two exponential moving averages of the chosen Source, Fast EMA and Slow EMA, and shades the area between them. Green means the fast line is above the slow line, red means it is below, so crossings show where the order flips. Inputs: Fast Length 9, Slow Length 21, Source close.

ma-shift.text: Draws a moving average (MA Type sma, ema or wma) of the Source, which can be shifted in time by Offset. Candles are teal when the source is at or above the MA and orange below. A separate Oscillator, the smoothed change in the source-to-MA distance, shows columns with diamond marks. Defaults: Length 20, MA Type sma, Offset 0, Source close.

ma-strategy-emperor.text: Draws up to five moving averages of the close, all of one chosen MA Type (default EMA, with eight other types available). MA 1 to MA 3 are on by default with lengths 8, 13 and 21. A green up triangle marks MA 2 crossing above MA 3, and a red down triangle marks it crossing below, even when MA 2 or MA 3 is hidden.

ma-zones.text: Plots an EMA and an SMA of the close for each of three zones, and fills the space between the two averages of each zone. A wide zone means the two averages are far apart; price relative to the filled areas shows where it sits against these averages. Zone 1 Period is 50, Zone 2 Period 100, Zone 3 Period 200, and each zone can be switched off.

macd.text: Subtracts a slow moving average from a fast one to form MACD, smooths it into the Signal line, and plots their difference as the Histogram. The Histogram is teal above zero and red below, bright when it rises versus the prior bar and pale when it does not. Defaults: Fast length 12, Slow length 26, Signal length 9.

macd-4c.text: Plots the difference between a fast and a slow exponential average of the source as a histogram around a zero line. Four colours show the sign and direction: lime for positive and rising, green for positive and falling, red for negative and rising, maroon for negative and falling. Fast MA is 12, Slow MA is 26, Source is close.

macd-adx-pro-by-eternyworld.text: MACD from EMAs of the close, drawn as a histogram with MACD and signal lines, coloured using the ADX and directional movement. In Sensitive mode colours follow the histogram sign and slope; in Filtered mode they follow +DI versus -DI once the ADX reaches the threshold (22), with grey when the trend is weak. Strong Buy and Strong Sell fire when the histogram turns positive or negative. Defaults are 12, 26 and 9.

macd-based-price-forecasting.text: Tracks MACD trends, using the first close of each trend as the Reference Price, and stores how far later closes moved from it. On a MACD cross, it projects an average path and a filled percentile band forward. Key inputs: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9, Maximum Memory 50, Forecasting Length 100.

macd-bb.text: Computes a MACD line (fast EMA minus slow EMA of the Source) and wraps it in Bollinger-style bands: a simple average of the MACD over BB Periods, plus and minus Deviations times its standard deviation. The MACD dots show green when at or above BB Upper and red otherwise, and bars are tinted when MACD breaks outside the bands. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, BB Periods 10, Deviations 1.

macd-crossover.text: Plots the MACD line (fast EMA minus slow EMA), a Signal line that is a simple average of MACD, and a Histogram of their difference. Histogram is teal at or above zero and red below; bars are coloured by which line is higher, so crossings show where the trend side flips. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9.

macd-dema.text: A MACD built from double exponential moving averages instead of plain EMAs, with the Signal line also a double EMA of the MACD. Histogram is the MACD minus Signal, in brighter shades when it is moving further from zero, and the area between MACD and Signal is shaded. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9.

macd-divergence.text: MACD with a Signal line and Histogram, plus divergence checks on MACD pivots against price pivots. Regular Bullish and Regular Bearish show when price makes a lower low or higher high while MACD does not; Hidden ones are off by default. Labels mark confirmed pivots, with Bull, Bear, H Bull and H Bear alerts. Key inputs: Pivot Lookback Right 5, Pivot Lookback Left 5, Max of Lookback Range 60.

macd-dynamic-squeeze-pro.text: MACD of close with an SMA signal line and a histogram, plus a squeeze test: histogram size below Squeeze Compression Ratio times its average. Diamonds mark MACD crossing the signal in trend direction (both above or below zero) within Squeeze Valid Lookback (Bars) of a squeeze. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9.

macd-irtov.text: Standard MACD: the difference between a fast and slow moving average of Source, a signal average of it, and the Histogram as their gap. Histogram shades differ by sign and by rising or falling. A B label appears when MACD crosses above Signal and an S label when it crosses below, on the last 200 bars. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9, EMA types.

macd-leader.text: A MACD with an added Leader line. MACD is fast EMA minus slow EMA; Signal is an EMA of it; Leader adds EMAs of each EMA's distance from the source, so it reacts earlier. Histogram is MACD minus Signal, with shades showing growth or shrinking. Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9.

macd-liquidity-tracker-system.text: Draws the MACD line from FMA 12 and SMA 26 as a histogram, coloured blue above zero and magenta at or below it, brighter when it is rising or falling. System Type (Normal) turns this into long and short states, marked by triangles on the price pane, along with a Trend MA set by MA Type EMA and MA Length 50. Show Signals picks which triangles appear.

macd-overlay-v1.text: Draws a MACD on the price chart: Primary Fast and Primary Slow lines (EMA/SMA of the source, or rolling VWAPs in VW mode), with a ribbon between them tinted by the MACD sign and stronger while the histogram rises. Triangles mark MACD and signal crosses, filtered by Weakness and Expansion gates; blocked crosses are gray dots. Key inputs: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9.

macd-pro.text: MACD line is the fast EMA minus the slow EMA, with a Signal Line EMA and a histogram of the difference. MACD Leader is an optional faster variant. The MACD line turns lime on positive 10-bar momentum with strong trend, red on negative, blue otherwise. Histogram shades are stronger when it is rising above zero or falling below. Inputs: Fast EMA Period 12, Slow EMA Period 26, Signal Period 9.

macd-pseudo-super-smoother.text: A MACD whose averages are weighted filters imitating a super smoother: MACD is a fast filter minus a slow filter, Signal is a filter of the MACD, and Histogram is their difference. Histogram colours depend on its sign and whether it is rising. Alerts fire when it turns negative (Rising to falling) or positive (Falling to rising). Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9.

macd-reloaded.text: A MACD whose fast, slow and trigger averages use a chosen Moving Average Type (default VAR). MACDRe is the short average (12) minus the long one (26) of close; TRIGGER averages it over 9 bars. Histogram is MACDRe minus TRIGGER: lime and pale teal above zero, pale and strong red below, with the lighter shade when it rises.

macd-rsi-overlay.text: Builds price-scaled lines from an adaptive average that blends a 2-bar SMA and a trend SMA, projected away from the close. MACD Line and RSI Line are smoothed versions of it, and Signal Line is its SMA; crossings between them and the close drive the alerts. A table reports Bullish or Bearish for the last bar. Inputs: Smooth 1, Signal Length 14, Trend Factor 30, Scaling Factor 2.5.

macd-sniper.text: MACD with a selectable moving average type, giving a Histogram, MACD and Signal. Buy and sell triangles come from histogram runs (Min ⬇Falling Bars 3, Min ⬆Growing Bars 3) and MACD/Signal crosses, spaced by Reentry pause (5). RSI Filter ⮕ is on by default, limiting buys to RSI between 1 and 35 and sells to 70 to 100.

macd-support-resistance.text: Computes a MACD line as the difference of fast and slow moving averages of close, smoothed into Signal, with a fill between them and a dashed zero line. A diamond marks each cross; a downward cross turns the highest high of the last 6 bars into a resistance line, an upward cross the lowest low into support, removed once price breaks it. Inputs: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9.

macd-v.text: A MACD line (fast EMA minus slow EMA of the Source) divided by ATR and multiplied by 100, so momentum is scaled by volatility, plus an EMA Signal line and a Histogram of their difference. Horizontal lines sit at 150, 50, 0, -50 and -150; histogram colour shows its side of zero and whether it is rising. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9, ATR Length 26.

macd-v-with-volatility-normalisation.text: Computes the gap between a fast and slow EMA of the Source, divided by ATR and times 100, with an EMA signal line and a histogram of twice their difference. Circles mark MACD Line crosses of the Signal Line; levels run every 50 from -250 to 250. Defaults: MACD Fast Length 12, MACD Slow Length 26, Signal Line Smoothing Length 9, ATR Length 26.

macd-vxi.text: A MACD (fast EMA minus slow EMA) with a Signal line that is a simple average of MACD, and a Histogram of the difference. Cross circles appear on the Signal line where it crosses MACD. The background is teal when MACD is above Signal and faint black otherwise. Defaults: Fast Length 13, Slow Length 21, Signal Length 8.

macd-with-crossings-and-above-below-zero.text: MACD with a signal line and a histogram, plus the one-bar MACD change, an RSI scaled 0 to 1 with Upper Band and Lower Band levels at 0.7 and 0.3, and ADX. Triangles mark MACD and Signal crossings, larger on the zero side opposite the small ones. Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9.

macd-x-bb-x-stdev-x-rvi.text: Plots the MACD line with bands made from the EMA of the MACD plus and minus its standard deviation times a multiplier, plus a long-EMA Trend. The BB + MACD line is green above the Upper Band, red below the Lower Band, and inside follows rising or falling. Triangles mark the first bar of a new colour; RVI thresholds give flags. Inputs: Fast Moving Average Period 12, Slow Moving Average Period 26, Average Period 9.

macd-x-more-than-macd-by-dgt.text: A MACD variant whose MACD Calculation Mode (default MACD-SOURCE) picks the formula, on a chosen Source with EMA or SMA smoothing. It plots MACD-X, Signal-X and Histogram-X, green above zero and red below. Crosses of MACD-X and Signal-X read as momentum shifts. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9.

macd-xd.text: A MACD of the Source from fast and slow moving averages, a signal average of it, and a Histogram of the difference. Histogram columns are dark green above zero and rising, light green above zero and falling, light red below zero and rising, red below zero and falling. Inputs: Fast Length (12), Slow Length (26), Signal Smoothing (9), with EMA or SMA types.

macdas.text: Takes the MACD line (fast minus slow EMA of Source), subtracts its signal EMA, and plots that difference as MACD-AS. Signal-AS is an EMA of MACD-AS, and a zero line is drawn. Crossings of the two lines and of zero show shifts in the histogram's momentum. Defaults: Fast Period 12, Slow Period 26, Signal Period 9.

machine-learning-gaussian-process-regres.text: Fits a Gaussian process with a smooth kernel to the last Training Window closes minus their moving average, then extends it forward. A blue polyline shows the fit over the window and a red one the forecast after it. Defaults: Training Window 100, Forecasting Length 20, Smooth 20, sigma 0.01, Update Mechanism Lock Forecast.

machine-learning-knn-trend-predictor.text: Stores recent price-change distances and picks a neighbour value for each bar, then averages the stored neighbours into the kNN Curve. The curve is green when it sits below the source and red when above, with a fill toward the candle body. Optional arrows mark direction changes when Show Trading Signals is on. Nearest Neighbors (N) defaults to 50 and Distance Ranking (K) to 100.

machine-learning-logistic-regression.text: Trains a small logistic regression on each bar over the last Lookback Window Size bars, then rescales the resulting loss and prediction to the recent price range set by Normalization Lookback (default 2). With Use Price Data for Signal Generation on, price above the scaled loss gives a Buy label and below gives a Sell label. StopBuy and StopSell crosses mark trade ends after Holding Period bars (default 5).
names: Use Price Data for Signal Generation?

machine-learning-price-target-prediction.text: Takes a trend signal (SuperTrend, HMA direction or fast/slow EMA cross) and, at each flip, uses kernel regression over past trends to predict the size of the new move. It draws take-profit and stop-loss boxes, entry markers, a stats table and gray bars outside a trade. Main inputs: Trend Indicator for Signals (EMA Cross (Fast Slow)), Fast EMA Length 50, Slow EMA Length 200, Kernel Regression Bandwidth 5.

machine-learning-rsi-ai-classification-r.text: An RSI shifted by a nearest-neighbour model that compares eight RSI features with stored past bars and votes on their outcomes, plus a volatility-based trailing stop. ML RSI is read against OB (level 70), Mid (level 50) and OS (level 30); ML Supertrend Up and Down show trend, and signals need Min Rank to Signal (60) and Min Confidence to Signal (50). Base RSI Length is 14, Analog Count (k) is 8.

machine-learning-rsi-bullvision.text: Computes an RSI, smoothed by the chosen Moving Average Type (ALMA, MA Length 3), then blends it with a nearest-neighbour estimate from similar past bars. ML Weight vs Standard RSI (0.4), K - Number of Neighbors (5) and Historical Period for KNN (100) control the blend, followed by Kalman smoothing. RSI KNN is read against the 50 Level and the Overbought Level (70) and Oversold Level (30).

machine-learning-supertrend.text: A supertrend on a smoothed price basis whose band width and ATR period are nudged bar by bar by results of small simulated long and short trades. The trend line turns up or down on flips, with a cloud toward the close; Buy and Sell labels mark filtered signals, and rails show recent pivot highs and lows. Key inputs: Mode (Reversal), ATR Period (24), Band Width (xATR) (1.4), Pivot Window (30), Enable Auto-Tune (true).

mad-trend-detector-c-h-i-p-a.text: Builds bands around a moving average of the Source, offset by the mean absolute deviation from the median times MAD Multiplier (0.9). A close above the Upper Band turns candles blue, a close below the Lower Band turns them red, kept until the opposite break. MA Length is 8, MAD Length 20, MA Type EMA.

madrid-ma-ribbon.text: Twenty moving averages of lengths 5 to 100 in steps of 5, drawn as a ribbon from MA 5 to MA 100. Each line is coloured by whether it is rising or falling and whether it sits above or below MA 100: lime, maroon, red, green or gray for flat cases. MA Type chooses sma or ema (default ema); Source defaults to close.

madrid-ma-ribbon-bar-v2.text: Computes 20 moving averages of the close, lengths 5 to 100 in steps of 5, and stacks them as 20 column bands (MMA05 to MMA100). Each band's colour combines its average's slope with whether the 5-bar average is above or below the 100-bar one: lime or maroon above, red or green below, gray otherwise. Exponential MA, on by default, switches between EMA and SMA.

madrid-trend-squeeze.text: Measures three gaps from a long exponential average of close: CMA is close minus it, RMA uses a shorter average, and SMA uses the shortest, all drawn as histograms around zero. Positive values mean price or the faster average is above the long one. RMA turns yellow when CMA lies on the zero side of it. Length is 34, Reference Length 13, Squeeze Length 5.

madz-moving-average-deviation-z-score.text: Takes the percentage gap between close and a moving average, converts it to a z-score, and smooths it with a volume-weighted average to give MADZ. The line is green below Oversold Level (-%), red above Overbought Level (+%), gray between. Defaults: Length 150, MA Type VWMA, Z-Score Lookback Period 85, levels 1.5 and -1.5.

magnet-force-rsi-filter-v6.text: Plots Magnet Core, a volume-weighted moving average of the close, with Upper Bound and Lower Bound set a number of standard deviations away. Red background means close above the upper band with RSI at or over the overbought level; green means below the lower band with RSI at or under oversold. Defaults: Magnet Core Period 20, Attraction Strength (Sigma) 2, RSI Period 14.

maket-strat-absorption-bubbles.text: Divides volume by its standard deviation over the Lookback Period (100) and draws a circle at mid-range when the result reaches Absorption Threshold (0.1); higher values give larger circles. A dark red circle means the midpoint is in the upper wick (selling absorption), dark green in the lower wick (buying absorption). Show Bubbles? toggles the circles.

mama-fama.text: Adaptive moving average that estimates the market cycle with a Hilbert-transform phase and speeds up or slows down its smoothing accordingly, plus a slower follower line. MAMA and FAMA are both blue when MAMA is above FAMA and orange when below; triangles mark each crossing. Fast Limit (0.5) and Slow Limit (0.05) bound the smoothing rate; Source defaults to hl2.

manipulation-candle.text: Colours a bar that sweeps the previous bar's extreme and then closes beyond the previous body. A buy bar has a low under the previous low and a close above the previous body top; a sell bar has a high above the previous high and a close under the previous body bottom. Buy wins when both apply. It has no inputs.

mark-minervini-buy-signal.text: Plots simple moving averages of the close over 10, 20, 50, 150 and 200 bars. A large green triangle under a bar and a faint green background appear when the close is above the 50, 150 and 200 averages, which are stacked in rising order with the 200 rising, the close sits 25% above its 252-bar low and within 75% to 95% of its high, 100-bar momentum ranks 70 or higher, and volume tops its 50-bar average. No inputs.

market-cipher-a.text: Draws a ribbon of eight EMAs on the price chart, blue shades when EMA 8 is below EMA 2 and gray otherwise. Markers above bars flag EMA crosses and WaveTrend crosses, with RSI and RSI+MFI conditions for the yellow cross, and alerts such as Red Diamond and Blood Diamond. Lengths run from EMA 1 5 to EMA 8 34.

market-cipher-a-free-version-1-1.text: Draws a ribbon of eight EMAs of the close on the price chart, EMA 1 to EMA 8. A green circle above the bar marks EMA 2 crossing over EMA 8, a red cross above the bar marks EMA 1 crossing under EMA 2, and a blue triangle below the bar marks EMA 2 crossing over EMA 3. Lengths are ema1 to ema8: 5, 11, 15, 18, 21, 24, 28, 34.

market-cipher-b.text: Builds a WaveTrend oscillator from the hlc3 price: WT Wave 1 is a smoothed channel index and WT Wave 2 is its average, with VWAP (WT1-WT2) as the gap between them. MFI Area shows smoothed candle body relative to range, green above zero and red below, and Cross Dot marks each Wave 1/Wave 2 cross. Key inputs: WT Channel Length 9, WT Average Length 12, MFI Period 60.

market-cipher-b-free-version-with-buy-an.text: A WaveTrend oscillator of hlc3: wt1 is a smoothed channel index and wt2 is a 4-bar average of wt1, with wt1 - wt2 as the momentum gap. A black line point and a circle on wt2 mark each wt1/wt2 cross, red when wt2 is above wt1 and lime otherwise. Over Bought Level 1 (60), Over Bought Level 2 (53) and the two Over Sold levels (-60, -53) frame extremes; Channel Length is 10 and Average Length 21.

market-participation-ratio-mpr.text: Multiplies the close's ratio to its simple average by the volume's ratio to its average, scales by 100 and smooths with an EMA. The Smoothed MPR line is magenta above 100, dark grey below it and grey at exactly 100, with reference lines at 0, 50 and 100. Length sets the averages (14) and Smoothing Length the EMA (7).

market-pressure-oscillator.text: Scores each candle as up, down or flat, weighted by its body against the average body, sums the last Lookback Length (14) bars as a percent, then smooths it with an EMA and averages it with an SMA. The oscillator is green at or above zero and red below; Overbought Threshold (30) and Oversold Threshold (-30) bands, divergence labels and crossing triangles mark signals, chosen by Signal Type.

market-profile.text: At the start of each higher-timeframe period, splits the ended period's range into 20 channels and counts the bars touching each. The busiest channel is the point of control; the value area grows from it until it holds Percent for Value Area % (70) of the counts. Drawn as a stepped outline to the right, with a POC line when Show POC Line (true) is on. Higher Time Frame defaults to Auto.

market-profile-with-tpo.text: Builds a market profile per session, counting how many bars traded at each price row (TPOs). The row with the most TPOs is the point of control; a value area grows around it until Value Area Percent (68.26) of TPOs is covered. Boxes show row widths, three lines mark POC and value area edges, and letters mark each bar. Auto Tick Size? (on) sizes rows from Bars Back 48 and target height 5.
names: Average Target Session Height for Tick Size

market-pulse-pro.text: Averages three 0 to 1 measures: a smoothed stochastic momentum index, the stochastic of the RSI, and where a smoothed close sits in its recent range. The mean times 100 is buy dominance, smoothed into Bull Herd, and Bear Winter is its 100 complement, with a 50 level. Bull Herd above Bear Winter reads bullish. Main inputs: SMI Period 21, RSI Period 14, Signal Period 20.

market-sentiment-technicals.text: Scores eleven indicators from 0 to 100 and averages them into one sentiment, plotted as the Oscillator with Overbought Level, Equilibrium Level and Oversold Level lines. A panel of boxes and a half-circle meter with a needle appear after the last bar. Timeframe defaults to Chart; Show Divergence defaults to None; RSI Length, Stochastic and CCI Length use 14, 14 and 20.

market-sessions-by-leviathan.text: Marks the Tokyo, London, New York and optional Sydney trading sessions on intraday charts, using hours set in the Input Timezone (UTC). By default each session is a box spanning its high to low, with an Open/Close Line; Display Type can switch to zones, timeline or candles. Lookback (Days) is 150, and Hide Weekends is on.

market-sessions-volume-profile.text: Splits the chart into sessions (Session Type, default Daily) and builds a volume profile per session, spreading each bar's volume over Resolution price rows (default 30). Lines mark the POC, the row with the most volume, and the VAH and VAL, the rows around it holding Value Area Volume % (default 70) of the volume. A dashed box outlines each session, and Show Live Zone draws the session in progress.

market-shift-levels.text: Tracks a hull moving average of close and compares it with its value 5 bars earlier. An upward cross sets the Market Shift Level at that bar's low, a downward cross at its high; candles are green at or above the level and red below it, and labels mark wicks that pierce it and are rejected. Inputs: Length 55 and Label Data (Volume by default, or Price).

market-structure-break-ob-probability-to.text: Marks a market structure break when the close crosses the latest pivot high or low with a momentum z-score beyond MSB Momentum Z-Score (0.5), labelled MSB. It draws an order block box with a quality score; above 80 is brighter. Blocks turn grey once price breaks them. Pivot Lookback is 7 and Max Active OBs is 10.

market-structure-break-order-block.text: Tracks a zigzag of swing highs and lows, turning when price hits the highest or lowest of ZigZag Length bars (9). A new swing beyond the previous one by more than Fib Factor for breakout confirmation (0.33) of the last swing draws an MSB label, a level line, and order block and breaker boxes. Delete Old/Broken Boxes (on) removes boxes the close has left.

market-structure-by-leviathan.text: Finds swing highs and lows with Swing Length bars on each side (20) and labels them HH, LH, HL or LL against the previous swing. A close beyond the latest swing draws a BOS line and label; BOS Confirmation can switch this to wicks. Show CHoCH names a break against the prior break's direction. Show 0.5 Retracement Level is off.

market-structure-choch-bos.text: Finds fractal highs and lows over a window of length bars and marks the first close that breaks the latest one. A line runs from the fractal to the break, labelled ChoCH when it reverses the prior structure, else BOS. Support and Resistance (both off) draw dashed levels until a close breaks them. Default length is 5.

market-structure-confluence.text: Finds swing highs and lows over Time-Horizon bars (default 10) and labels them HH, LH, HL or LL. A close beyond the last swing marks a BOS, or a CHoCH when it goes against the previous break, and that break sets the trend. The Lower Band shows in an uptrend and the Upper Band in a downtrend, built from a WMA plus or minus Volatility Multiplier (2) times smoothed ATR; BOS Confirmation defaults to Candle Close.

market-structure-dashboard-flux-charts.text: Builds a table reading market structure on up to seven timeframes: swing highs and lows, structure (HH/LH/HL/LL), nearest order block and fair value gap, and distance to the EMA. It also shows volume, volatility, session, killzone and a weighted Trend Bias. Key inputs: Swing Length (5), EMA Length (9), Trend Weight per timeframe.

market-structure-inducements-ict-choch-b.text: Tracks market structure from pivot highs and lows at three periods. A close through the latest pivot level flips the trend and draws a solid ChoCh line; in a trend, dashed BoS lines turn dotted LQDT when swept, and dotted IDMT lines mark inducement pivots. Inputs: ChoCh Detector Period 30, BoS & Liquidity Detector Period 1, Inducement Detector Period 3.

market-structure-oscillator.text: Detects short, intermediate and long term swing breaks, then scales the close within its range since the last direction change, from 0 to 100, and smooths it. The Market Structure Oscillator is their weighted average, with 50 as the Equilibrium Level. Inputs: Short Term Weight 1, Intermediate Term Weight 3, Long Term Weight 2, Oscillator Smoothing 4.

market-structure-trailing-stop.text: Tracks pivot highs and lows found with Pivot Lookback (14); a close beyond the last uncrossed pivot marks a bullish or bearish structure. On a new structure the Trailing Stop jumps to the extreme since the pivot, then follows the running close extreme scaled by Increment Factor % (100). Reset Stop On (CHoCH) can also be set to All breaks.

market-structure-trend.text: Finds confirmed swing highs and lows, then tracks a trend that flips when the source breaks the last swing low (uptrend) or swing high (downtrend), plus a buffer. The line sits at the last swing low in an uptrend and the last swing high in a downtrend; circles mark flips. Key inputs: Left Structure Bars 5, Right Structure Bars 5, Confirmation Buffer % 0, Break On Wick off.

market-structure-trend-targets.text: Tracks swing highs and lows (Length bars each side) and marks the last of each with a line. A high crossing the last swing high turns the trend up, a low crossing the last swing low turns it down; labels show the first break's price, then the count of further breaks or, with Display %, their percent change. A trailing stop follows the trend, shown when Display Trailing Stop is on. Defaults: Length 10, Display % off.

market-structure-with-inducements-sweeps.text: Finds swings over two lookbacks and tracks structure: a close beyond the latest long swing draws a dashed CHoCH line, and a later close past the trailing extreme after an inducement draws a solid BOS line. Dotted lines mark IDM and sweeps (x). Inputs: CHoCH Detection Period (50), IDM Detection Period (3).

market-structure-zigzag-break-of-structu.text: Tracks market structure from an internal trigger chosen in Select Indicator Version (Internal Trigger), then finds swing highs and lows and draws order blocks, supply and demand zones, inflection zones, zig-zag lines, HH/HL/LH/LL/LS labels, and break of structure and change of character lines. Calculate Zig-Zag By (MTF) picks the level shown; breaks use close SMAs of 2, 5 and 15 bars. Touched zones are dimmed.
names: SMA Close Breakout Length for LTF
SMA Close Breakout Length for MTF
SMA Close Breakout Length for HTF

market-structures-zigzag-choch-bos-mss-m.text: Builds a zigzag from pivot highs and lows found Pivot Period of Order Blocks Detector (5) bars on each side, and tracks major and minor structure highs and lows. A close through the major high or low draws a line and a label: Major BoS when it continues the external trend, Major ChoCh when it goes against it. Minor lines are off by default, and Show Label adds point names (HH, LH, HL, LL).
names: Pivot Period of Order Blocks Detector

market-trend-levels-detector.text: Computes a fast and a slow EMA of the close, shading the gap between them. When the fast crosses above the slow, levels are drawn at recent lows; when it crosses below, at recent highs, each with a dot. Extended levels stop and turn dotted once price breaks them. Inputs: Fast 12, Slow 25, Extend Lines off, Display Last 50.

martell-mnq-quantum-scalper-pro.text: Plots a slow ALMA of the close (ALMA Macro Trend) and manages one trade at a time. Entries need price on the trend's side, a choppiness index under 50 and a TSI crossing its signal on the opposite side of zero; stop and target sit 2.5 ATR from entry. The Long SL, Long TP, Short SL and Short TP lines show only while that trade is open. No inputs.

marubozu-black.text: Flags a single long down candle (close below open) whose upper and lower shadows are each no more than 5% of the body size. A label marks the bar, read as a bearish candle with almost no wick on either side. An alert named New pattern detected is available.

marubozu-detector.text: Finds candles with a long body and short shadows: body at least Min Body % of Range (80) of the high-low range, each shadow at most Max Shadow % of Range (10). Bullish ones get a green BULL MARU label below and bearish ones a red BEAR MARU label above, plus a faint bar tint. Require Min Candle Size (ATR-based) is off by default; when on, the range must reach Min Range Multiple of ATR(14) (1).

marubozu-white.text: Flags a single long up candle (close above open) whose upper and lower shadows are each no more than 5% of the body size. A label marks the bar, read as a bullish candle with almost no wick on either side. An alert named New pattern detected is available.

mass-index.text: Takes the high-low range, smooths it with a 9-bar exponential average and again with a second 9-bar one, then sums the ratio of the first to the second over length (10) bars. The Mass Index line in its own pane rises when ranges widen and falls when they narrow. It gives no value until a full window of ratios exists.

master-pattern.text: Finds contractions where a swing high is lower than the one before while the latest swing low is higher. A later high above the contraction's top gives a bullish box, a low below its bottom a bearish one, with a midpoint line. Price crossing the opposite side makes it major and adds a border. Dotted lines mark pivots. Inputs: Contraction Detection Lookback (3), Liquidity Levels (20).

matrix-series.text: Smooths a weighted price into a standardised oscillator and shows it as candles, green when the faster smoothed line is above the slower one, red otherwise. Resistance Line and Support Line come from the CCI's highest and lowest over the Sup/Res Period. OB Cross and OS Cross appear past Overbought 200 and Oversold -200. Smoother defaults to 5.

mavilimw.text: Passes the close through a chain of six weighted moving averages whose lengths grow from First MA Length (3) and Second MA Length (5). MavilimW is blue when rising, red when falling and yellow when flat. MavWOld uses fixed lengths 3, 5, 8, 13, 21 and 34. Alerts MAVW BUY and MAVW SELL fire when MavilimW turns up or down.

mc-ginley-dynamic.text: Draws an adaptive moving average that starts from an exponential average of the close, then each bar moves toward price by a step that depends on length (14) and on the price-to-line ratio raised to the fourth power. The line speeds up or slows down as price moves away from or close to it. Price above or below the McGinley Dynamic line shows which side of it price trades.

mean-angles.text: Measures the slope angle, in radians, of five moving averages of close: atan of the average's change over Range bars divided by Range. Leading Trend uses a short average (5) and Strength 1 to Strength 4 use 20, 50, 100 and 200. Mean Type chooses EMA or SMA. Angle Levels adds dotted lines at plus and minus pi/2 and zero.

mean-reversion-channel.text: Draws a smoothed mean of the Price Source (hlc3) with inner bands (R1, S1) and outer bands (R2, S2) set at multiples of a smoothed true range times pi. A shaded zone surrounds each outer band, and a last-bar label states overbought, oversold or near-mean status, with distance from the mean, for the chart and two higher timeframes. Filter Type is SuperSmoother, Lookback Period 200, multipliers 1 and 2.415.

measured-pattern-move.text: Takes the bars from the chosen time window (up to 500 bars back), measures their height from highest high to lowest low, and projects a target. Bullish patterns add height times a fixed ratio to the high; bearish ones subtract it from the low. The Target line is purple with glow layers, and the window is shaded. Inputs: Select Adam Eve type (Double Bottom), Start time Period A and End time Period A.

mechart-moving-average-and-above-v1-1.text: Draws a moving average of the close plus Target Price, a line set a chosen percentage above it. The background turns red when the selected price is above Target Price and green when the selected price is below the Moving Average; both have alerts. Inputs: Moving Average Type SMA, SMA Period 200, Percentage Above MA 100, both price types high.
names: Price Type for Red Trigger (Above Target)
Price Type for Green Trigger (Below MA)

median.text: Takes the middle value of the source over the last Median Length bars, then draws Upper Band and Lower Band at that median plus and minus ATR Multiplier times the ATR. Median EMA smooths the median, and the area between the two is green when the median is above it, fuchsia otherwise. Defaults: Median Source hl2, Median Length 3, ATR Length 14, ATR Multiplier 2.

median-atr-sd-oscillator.text: Builds a median of the source, then an ATR level and a standard-deviation level above it. The trend turns up when close is above the SD level and down when it is below the ATR level. The Oscillator is close minus the relevant level, with an EMA, and is blue when the trend agrees with the EMA, red otherwise. Defaults: Median Length 63, ATR Length 4, SD Length 29, EMA Length 35.

median-gaussian-trend-nal.text: Smooths a rolling median of the Source with a Gaussian filter, then adds bands from a Gaussian-weighted deviation of that line. The trend turns up when the close is above the Upper Band and down below the Lower Band, holding in between, and bands and candles take the trend colour. Inputs: Gaussian Length 16, Sigma 5, Upper Band 2.5, Lower Band 2.

median-macd-mattes.text: A MACD built on the rolling median of the close instead of the close itself, with a signal EMA; the Delta columns show MACD minus signal. Light blue is above zero and rising, teal above zero and falling, purple below zero and falling, dark purple below zero and rising. Inputs: Fast Length (6), Slow Length (36), MACD Length (21), Median Period (11).

median-volume-weighted-deviation.text: A rolling VWAP of the close over Lookback bars, with bands set at VWAP plus or minus StDev Multiplier times the median of the volume-weighted deviation over Median StDev bars. A close crossing above the Upper Band turns the VWAP line yellow-green (long); crossing below the Lower Band turns it purple (short). Defaults: Lookback 14, Median StDev 2, StDev Multiplier 1.7; Bands is off.

mesa-adaptive-ehlers-flow.text: An adaptive moving average on the bar midpoint whose speed follows the measured cycle phase, with a slower companion line, both smoothed by an EMA. The MESA Adaptive line is cyan when the fast line is above the slower one and the close is above it, magenta in the opposite case, grey otherwise. FAMA is hidden by default. Inputs: Fast Limit (0.5), Slow Limit (0.05), Signal Smoothing (3).

mesa-phase-adaptive-band-trend.text: An EMA centre line (Trend) with bands set by recent return volatility. The band multiplier shifts between Slow Multiplier (3) and Active Multiplier (1.5) according to a phase measure of the source. A close above the Upper Phase Band starts a bullish regime, below the Lower Phase Band a bearish one, with LONG and SHORT markers at changes. Trend Length and Volatility Length default to 20.

mfi.text: Computes a volume-weighted momentum oscillator from typical price (high, low, close average): money flow on up bars is compared with money flow on down bars over Length bars and scaled from 0 to 100. MF above Overbought (level 80) or below Oversold (level 20) marks stretched readings, and Middle Band (level 50) is the midpoint. Length defaults to 14.

mfi-nexus-pro.text: Computes the Money Flow Index from price-times-volume flows, with a moving average and Bollinger Bands of the MFI, plus divergence checks against price pivots. Buy or sell signals appear when MFI crosses its average or the lower or upper band, or on divergence. Main inputs: MFI Length 14, Length 14, StdDev 2, Minimum Bars Between Signals 5.

mfi-rsi-ema-dynamic-signals.text: Plots Fast EMA and Slow EMA on price, with MFI and RSI in the pane against Overbought, Oversold, RSI Buy Threshold (45) and RSI Sell Threshold (55). A Buy Signal triangle appears a bar after MFI crosses up through oversold or the EMAs cross up, if RSI is high enough or the EMAs are close; Sell Signal mirrors it.

mfi-seiglerj.text: Money flow index: over length bars it sums volume times typical price on bars where typical price rose and on bars where it fell, then gives 100 minus 100 divided by one plus their ratio. The background turns red above upper (80) and green below lower (20), with levels at 0 and 100 too. length defaults to 14.

mid-term-ribbon.text: Averages a weighted price of 3 parts close, 2 parts open, 1 high and 1 low into a 14-bar Fast EMA and a 26-bar Slow SMA. The ribbon between the two lines is red when the Fast EMA is below the Slow SMA and green otherwise. It has no inputs.

minervini-trend-template-screener.text: Shows a BUY label and green background when all enabled filters pass: Use Trend Template (close above stacked SMA 50, 150 and 200, SMA 200 rising, near the 52-week high), returns of at least Min mid return pct 20 and Min short return pct 5, and Use VCP ATR contraction. Use volume spike is off by default. The BUY alert matches.

minimalist-doji-highlighter.text: Flags doji bars: those whose body, the distance between open and close, is no more than a set fraction of the bar's high-to-low range. Doji bars are painted white. Doji Maximum Body Size (default 0.15) sets that fraction; Show Cross Above Bar? (default off) adds a white cross above each doji.

mirage-liquidity-sweep-pro.text: Finds swing highs and lows, and detects sweeps where a bar pierces a swing but closes back inside it. Each sweep gets a 0 to 100 score from wick, close position, volume and higher timeframe bias. It marks qualifying sweeps, then gives entries with stop and three targets. Main inputs: Swing Length (21), Min Sweep Score (50), Require CHoCH Confirmation (true).

mix1-ema-cross-trend-channel.text: Combines EMA Fast and EMA Medium of the source with a trend average (MA Trend, SMA or EMA, set by MA Type) and a channel of ATR times Channel Range Length around it. The trend reads up or down when price and the EMA cross agree, and flat inside the channel. Long and Short labels mark entries, Close and SL crosses mark exits. Defaults: EMA Fast 26, EMA Medium 50, MA Trend 200, Channel Range Length 0.618.

ml-adaptive-supertrend.text: Splits the ATR into high, medium and low volatility clusters by k-means over the Training Data Length, then builds a SuperTrend from hl2 using the centroid nearest the current ATR. The line sits below price in the bullish colour and above it in the bearish colour, with triangle markers on trend changes and a 1 to 3 volatility label. Main inputs: ATR Length 10, SuperTrend Factor 3, Training Data Length 100.

ml-deep-regression-pro.text: Fits a least-squares line to the last Lookback Period (20) closes and plots its value at the window's oldest bar as Polynomial Regression Line, with the Linear Regression Line and an EMA of the close (EMA Length 14). Upper Band and Lower Band add and subtract Standard Deviation Multiplier (2) times its deviation when Display Upper and Lower Bands is on (off by default). Polynomial Degree is unused.

ml-knn-strategy.text: Compares two features per bar (RSI, ROC, CCI, scaled volume, or their average, chosen by Indicator) against stored bars from the training window, and sums the labels of the farthest-reaching neighbours into a prediction. Positive means long, negative short, otherwise clear. Buy and Sell labels mark turns, and ClearPos marks a yellow cross at the close when the signal clears. Defaults: Short Period [1..n] 14, Long Period [2..n] 28, Base No. of Neighbours (K) [5..n] 252.

ml-momentum-index.text: Takes slow and quick RSI, each smoothed by a weighted average, and stores them at every cross of two close averages with an up or down result. Each bar's MLMI Prediction is the summed result of the nearest stored points, drawn with WMA of MLMI Prediction around a zero line. Gradient bands mark the channel and overbought and oversold zones. Inputs: Prediction Data (k) 200, Trend Length 20.

ml-moving-average.text: Estimates a moving average with Gaussian process regression over the last Window bars of the Source, relative to their simple average. Bands sit above and below it by the average absolute error times Multiplicative Factor. The line changes colour when price closes beyond a band while the line moves the same way, with a Circle marking each change. Defaults: Window 100, Forecast 0, Sigma 0.01, Multiplicative Factor 2.

ml-rsi.text: Computes RSI, then finds the K Neighbors bars within the Lookback with the closest RSI values. Neighbours followed by a fall set the Adaptive OB line, and those followed by a rise set Adaptive OS, with at least 5 points between them. RSI is read against these lines and the 50 Level. Defaults: RSI Length 14, K Neighbors 10, Lookback 200, Source close.

modified-heikin-ashi.text: Computes standard Heikin-Ashi candles, then smooths each open, high, low and close with an EMA to draw smoother candles. EMA Trend is the average of the smoothed open and close; it and the bars are green when hlc3 sits at or above it and red otherwise. Inputs: EMA Length 6 and Show EMA Trend Line? on.

momentum.text: Computes the difference between the Source (close) and its value Length (10) bars earlier. The Mom line in its own pane is above zero when price is higher than that many bars ago and below zero when lower; larger distances from zero mean a bigger change over the window.

momentum-acceleration-by-dgt.text: Measures the acceleration of momentum in the close or On Balance Volume: a smoothed per-bar change, minus its own change over the period. Arrows point up when the value is positive and down when negative; triangles mark the turn through zero. Main inputs: Data Source (Price), Acceleration Period 13 and Display Length 233 bars. An optional backtest plots Entry / Exit Price.

momentum-ghost-machine.text: Momentum is the distance of the source from a low-pass filtered copy of itself, scaled and smoothed; MA is a moving average of it. Convergance Divergence (momentum minus MA) is a histogram: green tones above 0, red tones below, with shade showing rising or falling. Ghost Mode projects Momentum and MA two bars ahead. Defaults: Momentum Length 50, Post Smoothing 4, MA Length 24.

momentum-shift.text: Momentum is the Hull average of the close minus the close Length bars back, drawn in its own pane around Zero with a gradient fill. A turn up or down, versus the value 2 bars back, marks the price pane with triangles and draws six numbered levels above or below the bar, which end once price reaches them. Inputs: Length 50, Smooth 50, Shift Zone Size 1, a multiplier of the average bar range.

momentum-zigzag.text: Draws a ZigZag whose direction flips on a momentum signal, from QQE, MACD crossings or a moving average turning, rather than on price reversal size. LONG and SHORT labels show the pivot at each flip; with line colouring on, the line turns green or red after a flip following an RSI(5) extreme. Inputs: Select Momentum Indicator (QQE), QQE Factor (4.238), MA Length (20).

money-flow-extended.text: Money Flow Index of hlc3 over Length (14), with a moving average of it (Type SMA, Length 14). Readings above 80 are overbought, below 20 oversold, with a Middle Band at 50. With Calculate Divergence on, Bull and Bear labels mark regular divergences between MF pivots and price, confirmed Pivot Lookback (5) bars later.

money-flow-index-alerts.text: Money flow index: typical price times volume is split into rising and falling flow, each averaged over Length (14), and turned into a 0 to 100 index. A circle marks the index crossing below Oversold (20), green, or above Overbought (80), red. Dashed lines sit at 80, 60, 40 and 20, with shaded zones between them.

money-flow-profile.text: Builds a profile of the last bars by splitting their price range into rows and giving each bar's volume, or volume times row price, to the rows it touches. Row boxes are shaded as high, average or low traded nodes against the largest row, and a sentiment profile shows bullish versus bearish dominance per row. Main inputs: Lookback Length / Fixed Range (200), Profile Source (Volume), Number of Rows (25).

money-flow-pulse.text: Computes the Money Flow Index of the Source (hlc3) over MFI Length (13), and MFI ROC, its one-bar change drawn as an area around zero. MFI ROC is green when rising, red when falling, pale yellow when flat. The MFI line is orchid above 80 or below 20, lime above 60, peach below 40, and pale yellow between 40 and 60.

moneyball-ema-macd-indicator.text: Plots MACD as a fast minus slow moving average of the Source, with Signal as a moving average of it, around a zero line. Price bars are coloured by MACD side of zero and of Signal: green above both, orange below zero but above Signal, red below both, white below Signal, fuchsia in a short-term downtrend. Inputs: Fast Length 9, Slow Length 50, Signal Smoothing 16.

monotonic-trend-consensus.text: Computes a rank correlation between the source and time over up to four windows (8, 13, 21, 34 by default), then averages the scores into Consensus between -1 and +1. A bullish trend needs Consensus above Trend Threshold (0.35) and at least Min Conviction % (60) of windows agreeing in sign; bearish is the mirror below. The line takes the trend colour, with Bull Threshold and Bear Threshold lines.

moon-phases.text: Calculates the times of new and full moons with an astronomical lunar-phase formula and finds the bar where the phase changes. A translucent circle marks New Moon above that bar and Full Moon below it, and the chart background gets a faint tint that depends on the current phase. The two inputs set the waxing and waning colours.

morning-doji-star.text: Looks for a three-candle bullish reversal: a long down candle, then a doji whose body sits fully below the first body, then a long up candle that closes at or above the first body's midpoint but below its top. It requires a downtrend, set by Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50), and labels the final bar.

morning-star.text: Looks for a three-candle bullish reversal: a long down candle, then a small-bodied candle whose body sits fully below the first body, then a long up candle that closes at or above the first body's midpoint but below its top. It requires a downtrend, set by Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50), and labels the final bar.

most-moving-average-screener.text: Computes a moving average of the Source and a trailing stop line, MOST, set a STOP LOSS Percent (default 2) below it in an uptrend and above it in a downtrend. Buy and sell signals come when the average crosses MOST, or from the screening modes; a label lists the direction and bars since the last change for up to 20 symbols. Moving Average Length is 3 and Moving Average Type is VAR by default.

most-rsi.text: RSI smoothed by a chosen moving average, with a percentage trailing stop (MOST) trailing that average. A cross of RSI-based MA over or under MOST gives BUY or SELL when Show Signals? is on. Regular Bullish and Regular Bearish mark RSI pivot divergences against price. Defaults: RSI Length 14, MA Type VAR, MA Length 5, STOP LOSS Percent 9.

moving-average-candles.text: Builds candles by smoothing open, high, low and close separately with the same moving average. A candle is green when the averaged close is at or above the averaged open, otherwise red. MA Type picks the average from SMA, EMA, HMA, T3, KAMA and others (default SMA), and MA Length sets its period (default 14).

moving-average-crossover-with-shading-si.text: Plots a fast, slow and trend moving average (EMA or SMA), and shades between the fast and slow lines: lime when fast is at or above slow and slow is above trend, maroon when fast is below slow and slow below trend, yellow otherwise. Buy and Sell labels appear when the lines are stacked and a crossover occurs; crosses mark the end of a stack. Defaults: Fast MA Length 5, Slow MA Length 20, Trend MA Length 50.

moving-average-exponential-x-4.text: Plots four exponential moving averages on the price pane, each with its own length and source. Read them as layered trend lines of increasing smoothness: EMA - 1 is the fastest and EMA - 4 the slowest. Defaults: First 50, Second 100, Third 200, Fourth 400, each on the close Source.

moving-average-percentage-difference.text: Shows the bar-to-bar percentage change of a moving average of the close. The Moving Average Difference line is green when the change is higher than the previous bar's, red otherwise, with a fill toward zero. Dashed Twilight Upper Limit and Twilight Lower Limit mark a band around zero. Main inputs: Moving Average Length 20, Moving Average Type EMA, Twilight size 0.5.

moving-average-shaded-fill-area-crossove.text: Two exponential moving averages of the source, drawn as EMA-1 (default 21) and EMA 2 (EMA-2 input, default 55), with the space between them filled. The fill is green while EMA-1 is above EMA 2 and red otherwise, so the colour shows which average is on top and a change marks a crossover. The src input defaults to close.

moving-average-trend-meter.text: Compares a baseline moving average with fast, medium and slow ones, drawing three stacked candle rows and a top circle for all three combined. Green: baseline above that average; orange: baseline above but close below; red and purple mirror these. Optimized mode shows gray unless the averages are stacked. Baseline MA 13, Fast MA 21, Med MA 34, Slow MA 55.

moving-averages-as-support-resistance-mt.text: Computes four moving averages (SMA or EMA of the close) on the chart timeframe and on two higher timeframes, using the prior bar's value. The nearest average above the candle body is drawn as resistance and the nearest below as support, with labels; a grey line marks a level the close has broken. Key inputs: Moving Average Type (SMA), lengths 50, 100, 150, 200, Higher Time Frame 1 (240), Higher Time Frame 2 (D).

moving-averages-with-continuous-periods.text: A moving average of the close that accepts a fractional Length, as an SMA, WMA or HMA chosen by MA Style (default HMA, Length 9). Float MA is coloured by the angle of its latest change relative to a weighted average of recent changes: Gradient Style blends down, neutral and up colours from steep fall to steep rise, or uses solid or two-colour polar. Default is Three Tone.

moving-volume-weighted-avg-price-channel.text: Draws a rolling volume-weighted average price of the chosen Source over the last VWAP Window Length (bars) bars. Percentage bands sit above and below it by Percentage Points of the VWAP; optional StdDev bands add or subtract the source's standard deviation times a multiplier. Defaults: Source ohlc4, window 23, Percentage Points 2, StdDev Multiplier 2.25, StdDev Length 17; StdDev bands off.

moving-vwap-kama-cloud.text: Smooths VWAP with two EMAs to get Moving VWAP, then applies an adaptive moving average (KAMA) to it. A cloud fills between the lines: bullish colour when Moving VWAP is at or above KAMA, bearish otherwise. Lines are hidden unless Display Lines is on; alerts fire on price, Moving VWAP and KAMA crossings. Defaults: Moving VWAP Period 30, MVWAP Smoothing 10, KAMA Length 10.

mpo4-lines-modal-engine.text: Sums each candle's direction times its body relative to the average body over a lookback, scales it to a percentage, and smooths it with EMAs to give Slow Line, Fast Line A, Fast Line B and Line 4. Lines are green or red by position against zero, and Slow Line can colour by direction. Circles mark Fast Line A returning from Overbought Threshold 30 or Oversold Threshold -30; Pivot Length (Left/Right) 2 sets divergence labels.

mr-crypto731.text: Computes a MACD from the close: the difference of two EMAs, an EMA signal line of it, and a histogram equal to MACD minus signal. A triangle with a tinted background marks a MACD Line cross above Signal Line while MACD is above zero (bottom), or a cross below while it is below zero (top). Inputs: MACD Fast Length 12, MACD Slow Length 26, MACD Signal Smoothing 9.

msl-squeeze-pulse.text: Compares the standard deviation of the source with the average bar range, ranks that ratio against its history, and calls the state coiled, expanded or neutral. Dots on the Zero line show the state, and Coil Release marks where a coil ends. Candles show a regression pulse in ATR units. Key inputs: Compression Lookback 252 and State Percentile 25.

mtf-break-of-structure-market-structure-.text: Finds swing highs and lows on up to three timeframes and marks when the close (or high/low if Use High/Low for Bos & Mss is on) breaks the latest swing. A line and a label show BOS for a break with the prior direction, MSS for a break against it; the first break only sets direction. Swing Length is 7; Timeframe 1 is 2 Hour. Hide all Market Structure (on) hides the HH, LH, HL, LL swing labels.

mtf-order-block-finder.text: Finds order blocks: a down candle followed by a run of up candles (or the reverse for bearish). The run needs Order Block Required Length (5) candles and Order Block Required Move % (0.3). Zones are drawn rightward as boxes, lines or both, newest Bullish Zones to Show and Bearish Zones to Show (4 each). Order Block Timeframe selects a higher timeframe.

multi-band-trend-line.text: Builds bands of the chosen Band Type (Bollinger, Keltner, Donchian, envelope or ATR) and a Trend Line that ratchets: a close above the Upper Band lifts it to the bar's low (less ATR if Use ATR Filter is on), a close below the Lower Band drops it to the high. The line is green when rising, red otherwise, with BUY and SELL labels on trend changes. Defaults: Band Type Bollinger Bands, Period 20, ATR Period 14.

multi-kernel-regression.text: Smooths the source with a kernel-weighted regression, using the chosen Kernel Select (Laplace) and a Bandwidth of 14. The line is coloured by direction, and Up and Down labels mark where that direction turns. With Repaint on, the estimate is redrawn over the last 500 bars; off, a one-sided mean is plotted with Non Repaint STDEV bands at Deviation 2.

multi-layer-volume-profile.text: Builds up to four volume profiles on the last bar: the full Period and its half, quarter and eighth. Each cuts the high-low range into Resolution rows and sums volume per row by close. The thick line marks the busiest row (PoC), with labels for total volume and delta (up-bar volume minus the rest). Defaults: Period 300, Resolution 100; VP1 to VP4 toggle each profile.

multi-oscillator-adaptive-kernel-alphaal.text: Averages the enabled oscillators (RSI, Stochastic, MFI, CCI), each rescaled to about -100 to 100, then smooths the result twice with a kernel weighting of the chosen Kernel Type. The smoothed value is drawn as layered fills around the Zero Line: cyan above, magenta below. Defaults: Kernel Type Exponential, Kernel Length 25; CCI is off.

multi-time-frame-candles-with-volume-inf.text: Rebuilds higher-timeframe candles from chart bars and draws the last Number of Candles (8) in the pane, each with a volume bar, a K/M/B volume label and a countdown label to the close of the current candle. When the chart bar sets the highest high or lowest low of those candles, a blue line marks the older candles' extreme and New High or New Low fires. Time Frame defaults to D.

multi-time-period-charts.text: Draws higher-timeframe bars as boxes over the chart, built from chart bars, with the current period growing on the last bar. Up periods (close at or above open) and down periods use different colours. Calculation sets the range: High/Low Range by default, Open/Close Range, OHLC or True Range. Auto-timeframe is on by default; otherwise Timeframe applies (1M).

multi-timeframe-support-and-resistance.text: Plots the latest pivot high as resistance and pivot low as support, using Pivot bars on each side of wicks or bodies (Type), held until the next pivot. Pairs exist for the current timeframe and M5 to Weekly, shown when switched on, with only Current Timeframe on by default. An optional Adaptive Moving Average uses Line Length. Defaults: Pivot 15, Type Body, Line Length 15.

multi-zigzag-harmonic-patterns.text: Builds four zig-zags from pivot highs and lows over lengths 5, 10, 15 and 20, then tests the last pivots against harmonic ratios (Gartley, Bat, Crab and others) within errorPercent, default 10. Matches draw pattern lines in the zig-zag colour plus a label at D, green below for bullish, red above for bearish. waitForConfirmation, default true, skips the latest pivot.

multiple-divergences.text: Counts how many of ten oscillators (MACD, MACD Histogram, RSI, Stochastic, CCI, Momentum, OBV, Diosc, VWmacd, Chaikin Money Flow) show a regular or hidden divergence at the same price pivot.
