Labels with the count appear under pivot lows or over pivot highs, starting at Minimum Div Count to Display (default 2). Pivot Lookback Right is 1 and Left is 3.

multiple-exponential-fibnonacci-moving-a.text: Draws six moving averages of the chosen src (default close) with Fibonacci lengths: EMA1 21, EMA2 55, EMA3 144, EMA4 233, EMA5 377 and EMA6 610. All are exponential except EMA5, which is a simple average. Stacked order and spacing of the lines show short- to long-term trend direction relative to price.

multiple-ma.text: Plots six moving averages of the chosen Source with fixed lengths of 10, 20, 50, 100, 150 and 200 bars, on the price pane. Shorter lines follow price closely and longer ones show the slower trend, so their order and crossings show how the trends relate. MA Type picks ema (default), sma or wma.

multiple-rsi.text: Plots three RSI lines of the close with different lengths, with dotted lines at the overbought, 50 and oversold levels. Line colours show alignment: Fast RSI is green when at or above Medium RSI, and Slow RSI is aqua only when fast, medium and slow are in descending order. Triangles at the bottom mark medium and slow crossings. Defaults: 8, 12, 16, levels 70 and 30.

multitimeframe-fair-value-gap-fvg.text: Detects bullish and bearish fair value gaps on the chosen timeframe, keeping those whose candle body is large enough, and draws each as a box with a dashed mid line and buy and sell volume share boxes. A gap disappears once price reaches its midpoint. FVG Trend Filter is a smoothed average of gap prices, shown in green when rising and red when falling. Inputs: Sensativity 1, Mitigated on mid on, Extend Boxes 10.

multpile-strategies.text: Stacks several oscillators in one pane, scaled to the running maximum of the squeeze momentum. On by default are the Squeeze Momentum area, a Squeeze Zero Line coloured by squeeze state, ADX measured from a key level, RSI with bands, Cipher dots and divergences. Stochastic, AO, MACD, Koncorde and CCI are off. General scale is 75 and Key level for ADX is 23.

murreys-math-osc.text: Places the close within the highest high and lowest low of the last Length bars (default 100), scaled from 0 to 100. The Oscillator line is coloured by eighth-zone, greens above 50 and reds below. Dashed levels mark each eighth; the 0 to 12.5 and 87.5 to 100 bands are filled to show extremes.

muses-afl-script.text: An L1 filter that pulls a prediction toward the source by μ, ignoring steps smaller than an ATR(200) threshold times ATR Mult. The Filter and Src lines are green while the filter rises and red while it falls, with a fill between. BUY and SELL arrows mark trend flips when Signals is on, matching the Buy Alert and Sell Alert. Defaults: ATR Mult 1.5, μ 0.6.

mushir-s-inside-candle-indicator.text: Flags inside candles, where the high is below the previous bar's high and the low is above the previous bar's low. A small black circle above the bar marks each one. It has no inputs.

my-auto-dual-avwap-with-auto-swing-low-p.text: Draws two pairs of anchored VWAPs, one pair per time range, from the high and low sources. Within a range, a new swing low in the source restarts the sums from that bar; after the end time they keep accumulating. Optional handoff lines anchor to the last bar the low crossed under the VWAP. Inputs: Start Time (First VWAP), End Time (First VWAP), and the same for the second.

n-bar-reversal-detector.text: Looks back over a sequence of candles for a reversal: a bullish one needs the latest high to exceed the oldest candle's high with enough bearish candles between, and bearish is the mirror. A triangle marks the bar, lines show the pattern range, and a dot marks confirmation. Key inputs: Reversal Pattern Sequence Length 7, Min Percentage of Required Candles 50, Pattern Type All.

n-order-ema.text: An exponential moving average built as a recursive filter of chosen Order (1), with smoothing from Period (9) of the Source. Discretization (Impulse Matched) picks how the filter coefficients are derived, and EMA Style (ema) can switch to dema, tema or hema variants. It is drawn as one line on the price pane.

nadaraya-watson-envelope.text: Fits a Gaussian kernel regression to the source and builds an envelope at the mean absolute error times mult above and below it. Upper and Lower are the envelope edges, and arrows mark where price crosses out of them. By default Repainting Smoothing is on, so the drawing is recomputed on the last bar. Bandwidth is 8 and mult is 3.

nadaraya-watson-regression-liquidity-swe.text: Smooths the close with a Gaussian-kernel regression, divides its slope by the slope's standard deviation, and smooths that into the Oscillator, with an EMA as the Signal Line. Fills turn green above the Zero Line and red below; crossings of the signal beyond zero draw liquidity levels that end when the close crosses them. Inputs: Nadaraya-Watson Bandwidth 30, Nadaraya-Watson Lookback 140, Signal Length 14.

nadaraya-watson-smoothers.text: Smooths the Source with a Gaussian-weighted average over 500 bars, with width set by Bandwidth (default 8). With Repainting Smoothing on, the whole curve is redrawn on each bar, with colour showing direction and triangles at turning points; it changes past values. Turned off, NWE Endpoint Estimator plots a non-repainting value using only current and past bars.

nadaraya-watson-trend.text: Kernel regression of the Source over the Lookback Window (50) bars, weighting recent bars by the chosen Kernel Type with bandwidth Kernel Bandwidth (8) times Bandwidth Multiplier (2). NW Trend takes the bullish colour when rising and bearish when falling; markers show slope reversals. Optional residual bands sit Band Multiplier (1.5) times the weighted deviation away.

navier-cauchy-market-elasticity.text: Treats price like an elastic material: the price change over Displacement Length is scaled by a stiffness taken from volatility, then smoothed into a stress value. Stress Line above zero means tension, below zero compression. Upper Band and Lower Band mark extremes, with alerts when crossed. Defaults: Displacement Length 14, Elasticity Length 30, Poisson Ratio 0.3.

neighboring-price-bands.text: Keeps a sorted list of recent closes and finds where the current close sits in it. The Bearish Band is a low percentile of the K closes below that spot; the Bullish Band is a high percentile of the K closes above, both smoothed with an SMA. A tinted background marks a close outside the stored range. Inputs: Historical Buffer (Bars) 200, Neighboring Range (K) 50, Percentile 90, Smoothing 5.

net-volume.text: Plots each bar's net volume, up volume minus down volume, as a line around a dashed zero level. Above zero indicates buying volume dominated the bar, below zero selling. Without lower timeframe data the whole bar volume counts as up if close is above open, down if below, zero if equal. Inputs: Use custom timeframe (off) and Timeframe (1).

next-pivot-projection.text: Builds a zigzag of Length (8) bars and records each pivot's price, an oscillator value, direction and retracement ratio. It counts how past pivots with the same recent states ended, then projects the next higher or lower high and low with arrows, labels and filled ranges: green when a higher high is more likely, red when less. Oscillator (rsi) and History (5) shape the statistics.

nexus-sentiment-risk-matrix.text: Nexus Sentiment averages RSI, a smoothed Stochastic and a CCI rescaled to 0-100, and is shaded against the 50 Equilibrium Level. A Chandelier-style ATR trend flips with price. A BUY marker shows when risk turns up with sentiment above 50, a SELL when it turns down below 50. Oscillator Length is 14, ATR Length 22, ATR Multiplier 3.

nlms-volatility-trail.text: Predicts each bar from the previous Filter Taps (M) source values with an adaptive filter whose weights learn from the error, then keeps a trail inside a band of the prediction plus or minus ATR times Factor. Candles and the NLMS ATR line turn long colour when the trail rises and short colour when it falls; the bullish and bearish alerts fire on those turns. Step Size (μ) is 0.195, Period 14, Factor 1.7.

no-wick-candles.text: Finds bars whose open equals the low or the high, meaning no lower or no upper wick. These bars are coloured orange. A green label sits under an up-closing bar with no lower wick, and a red label above a down-closing bar with no upper wick. It has no inputs.

normalized-candles-rsi.text: Fractionally differences the close (Diff Order (d) 0.3), z-scores it over Z-Score Lookback (100) and squeezes it into 0-100 with a sigmoid to draw normalized candles, beside an RSI line (RSI Length 14) with levels at 70, 50 and 30. Optional smoothing and Bollinger Bands are set by Type (SMA) and Length (14). Alerts fire when the normalized close crosses 50, 70 or 30, and on divergences if Calculate Divergence is on.

normalized-qqe.text: Smooths an RSI with an EMA, then builds a trailing line from that smoothed RSI plus or minus a smoothed RSI range times QQE Factor. FAST and SLOW are both shifted down by 50, with levels at 10 and -10; FAST changes colour beyond them. Crossings of the two lines can show Buy and Sell markers. Inputs: RSI Length 14, Smooth Factor 5, QQE Factor 4.236.

normalized-quantitative-qualitative.text: Smooths the RSI with an EMA, subtracts 50, and builds a trailing slow line from volatility bands of that fast line. FAST is the line, Plot shows it as columns: green above 10, red below -10, yellow between; SLOW is the trailing level, and crossings of the two can give Buy/Sell labels. RSI Length defaults to 14, SF RSI SMoothing Factor 5, Show Crossing Signals? off.

normalized-spma-nal.text: Builds an EMA of the close that only updates when the percent rank of the one-bar change exceeds % Gate, then divides it by the close and negates it. Normalized SPMA is read against Normalized Midline at -1; Normalized SPMA Lower SD subtracts a standard deviation, and it turns long above -1. Defaults: Percentrank Lookback 50, % Gate 50, Normalized SPMA Length 20.

normalized-volume-true-range.text: Scales each bar's range (set by True Range Style, default Body) and its volume to 0-100% against an outlier maximum, the running average plus Outlier Range (default 5) one-sided deviations. Normalized Volume columns are green on up bars and red on down bars; Normalized True Range is a histogram; Baseline marks the scaled average volume, with a dashed 100% line. ATR and Average Volume (both 14) are optional.

nova-flow-lite.text: Draws a Flow Line, a 34-bar EMA of the close, with a wider Flow Glow behind it. It is teal when above the 55-bar EMA and red otherwise, showing trend direction. Upper Band and Lower Band sit one standard deviation (34 bars) around the 34-bar average, forming a light grey equilibrium zone. It has no inputs.

nova-statistical-filtering-oscillator.text: Takes the z-score of the close over the Statistical Window (20), smooths it with a triple EMA over the Smoothing Length (10), and plots it as Nova Oscillator and Histogram around the Baseline at zero. Upper Band and Lower Band sit at the Bands Multiplier (2) times the oscillator's deviation. Circles mark crossing up through Lower Band (buy) and down through Upper Band (sell).

nr4-nr7-with-breakouts.text: Finds NR4 and NR7 bars on the chosen Timeframe (D default): the bar whose range is the smallest of the last 4 or 7 bars. It draws a shaded box with high, low and dashed middle lines for the next period. A close above the high or below the low gives an up or down breakout arrow; Pattern Type picks NR4/NR7, NR4 or NR7.

nrtr.text: ATR-based trailing reversal line. In an uptrend the trail rises with close minus ATR times Multiplier and never drops; in a downtrend it falls from close plus that amount. A close beyond the trail flips the trend. NRTR Up is the uptrend line, NRTR Down the downtrend line, with Buy and Sell markers on flips. ATR Period defaults to 14, Multiplier to 2.

nvi.text: A cumulative index starting at 1000 that changes only on bars where volume falls from the prior bar, by that bar's percentage close change. Volume-rising bars leave it unchanged. NVI-based EMA smooths it, with EMA length defaulting to 255.

ny-orb-fakeout-detector.text: Tracks the high and low of the bars opening between 13:30 and 13:45 UTC on 2025-06-03, drawn as ORB High and ORB Low, and clears them on the first bar after that window. A cross marker above a bar flags a close above the range high after an open below it, with an upper wick over half the bar's range. Outside that date the lines are empty; there are no inputs.

oa-smes.text: Places the close within the high-low range of the last Price Analysis Period bars on a 0 to 100 scale, smooths it with an average, and applies a zero-lag adjustment to get Smart Money Flow. Circles mark crosses above 0 (entry), entries followed by a higher close (green), and crosses below 100 (exit). Shaded zones sit at 60 to 100 and 0 to 40; inputs: Smart Money Flow Period 5, Price Analysis Period 21.

obv.text: Builds a running total that adds volume on bars where the close rose and subtracts it where the close fell, plotted as OnBalanceVolume in its own pane. Type (None) can add a smoothing average of it, shown as OBV-based MA, over Length (14); the SMA + Bollinger Bands option adds Upper Bollinger Band and Lower Bollinger Band at BB StdDev (2) deviations.

obv-ad-oscillators-with-dual-smoothing-o.text: Builds cumulative OBV, AD, CDV and VPT volume series. Long lines show each minus its SMA or Ehlers DSMA (Long MA Type, default Ehlers DSMA; Long MA Length 377); RSI lines apply an RSI (RSI Length 14) with dashed levels 80, 70, 50, 30 and 20. Optional backgrounds mark jerk spikes, using Jerk look‑back 20 and Threshold fraction 0.8.

obv-custom-ma-strategy.text: Computes On Balance Volume, adding volume on closes above the prior close and subtracting it on lower closes, and plots two moving averages of it. Crossings of Short-term MA over Long-term MA, or OBV over Short-term MA, trigger the alerts. MA Type is EMA, with Short-term MA Length 20 and Long-term MA Length 100.

obv-gizmo.text: Cumulative volume line in its own pane: delta volume (buy minus sell volume from the close position in the bar range) or regular OBV, optionally smoothed. The signal line is a moving average of it, yellow when OBV is above it and red otherwise. Lines mark bullish and bearish divergences between OBV pivots and price. Ma type defaults to VWMA, Delta volume is on, Ma conversion is 30.

obv-macd.text: OBV MACD applies a MACD to on-balance volume: the fast EMA minus the slow EMA of OBV, less its signal EMA. Trend plots that gap, blue when at or above zero and red below. Up Signal and Down Signal mark crosses of zero, and pivot labels mark local peaks. Inputs: Fast Length (12), Slow Length (26), Signal Length (9), Show Cross Signals (on).

obv-oscillator.text: Builds on-balance volume, adding volume on up-closes and subtracting it on down-closes, then subtracts its exponential average. The OBV Oscillator histogram above zero means volume flow is running ahead of its average (teal), below zero behind it (red); OBV Osc Area shades the same values. Length (default 20) sets the average.

obv-oscillator-lazybear.text: On-balance volume, a running total that adds volume on a higher close and subtracts it on a lower close, minus its EMA of length (20). The OBV-Points line is green above zero and red at or below it, and the same value is shown as a silver area in OBV. Crossings of the zero level show OBV moving above or below its average.

obvx-conviction-bias.text: On Balance Volume, the running total of volume signed by the close-to-close direction, with a short and a long moving average of it; the long one is Length times 2.718. The Long MA is green when Short MA is above it, red otherwise, and shading shows whether On Balance Volume is above Short MA. Smoothing Method defaults to VWMA and Length to 34.

on-neck.text: Detects a two-candle bearish continuation pattern in a downtrend: a long red candle, then a small green candle that opens below the prior close and closes within a small distance of the first candle's low. A label marks the bar when it appears. Detect Trend Based On sets how the downtrend is judged, defaulting to SMA50.

one-shot-one-kill-ict-liquidity-mmxm-cis.text: Draws the previous day high and low, marks swing highs and lows that price sweeps and closes back through as Liquidity, and sets a CISD level from a recent opposite bar. A close through the level confirms it and draws Fibonacci levels. Inputs: Swing Period (50), Bar Back Check (5), CISD Level Validity (25).

opal.text: Draws the opening price of the bar starting at fixed New York times, such as 3:00, 9:30 and 18:00, plus the crypto daily open, as horizontal cross levels. The earlier levels run until 16:59 and reset at 17:00; the 6:00 PM and crypto levels carry through to midnight. Is Daylight Saving Time (DST) Active? (default on) puts the crypto open at 8 PM instead of 7 PM; each level has a Show toggle.

open-close-cross.text: Applies the same moving average to the open and the close, then plots their gap as a percentage-style value around Zero in PCD Area and PCD Line. Teal means the close average is above the open average, red below; a cross puts a Long or Short circle and fires the OCC alerts. Defaults: MA Type ZEMA, MA Period 8, multiplied by Resolution Multiplier 6 when Use Res Multiplier is on.

open-close-cross-alerts-norepaint-versio.text: Computes moving averages of the closes and the opens, then plots the gap between the longer-period pair as a factor of the shorter pair's average. Green means the close average is above the open average, red below; a circle at the bottom marks each cross, and a dashed Level (level 0) sits at zero. Key inputs: MA Type (ZEMA), MA Period (8), Multiplier for Alernate Resolution (6).

open-interest-stochastic-money-flow-inde.text: A money flow index that weights price by futures open interest (or chart volume with Market Type OTHERS), then applies a stochastic and two EMA smoothings to give the K-line and D-line. K crossing above D puts a Crossover cross on the zero line, crossing below gives a Crossunder; the Oversold Level (level 20) and Overbought Level (level 80) frame the range. Inputs: MFI Period (14), Oversold (20), Overbought (80).

open-interest-suite-by-leviathan.text: Adds open interest of the base currency's perpetual futures across up to six markets, in USD or coins. Display picks candles, Open Interest Delta columns, delta times relative volume, or Open Interest RSI. Upper Threshold and Lower Threshold are scaled averages of the deltas; Threshold Multiplier is 5 and OI RSI is 20.

open-liquidity-heatmap.text: Splits the highest-high to lowest-low range of the last Lookback bars (200), widened by Leverage (4.5%), into Levels (250). It builds a volume profile and a liquidation heatmap, with level lines shaded green above the close and red below it. A POC line and label mark the level with the most liquidation volume; VP and VP LIQ toggle the profile boxes.

opening-range-breakout-with-2-profit-tar.text: Takes the high and low of the session's first bar, measured on the Length Of Opening Range? timeframe (60), and adds two targets above and below at multiples of the range height. Opening Range High and Opening Range Low turn lime or red on breaks; the targets turn lime, and a 1 or 2 marks a bar reaching target 1 or 2.

opening-range-breakouts-targets.text: Tracks the high and low of each session's opening range, then draws ORH, ORL and a dashed middle line once the range ends. Targets are added at steps above and below the range, and a triangle marks a close crossing over ORH or under ORL. Main inputs: Time Period (30), Target % of Range (50), Signal Bias (No Bias) and Target Cross Source (Close).

optimized-trend-tracker.text: Builds a variable-speed moving average of the Source, the Support Line, and a percentage trailing stop around it that gives the OTT line, plotted two bars late. Buy and Sell labels mark the Support Line crossing the OTT; price crossings and OTT colour changes are optional. Fills are green when the Support Line is above OTT, red below. Inputs: OTT Period 2, OTT Percent 1.4.

orb-algo-flux-charts.text: Builds an opening range from the high and low of the first ORB Timeframe (default 30) minutes of each day, then looks for a close outside it. A Buy or Sell entry comes once the breakout has the retests Sensitivity requires (Medium needs 1). The stop sits at the range centre under Balanced, and TP Method Dynamic uses a 9-length EMA for take profits.

orb-opening-range-breakout.text: Tracks the high and low of the bars inside the Session Time window (default 0915-0920), growing the range with each new extreme and holding it until the next session. ORB High and ORB Low are drawn only on intraday charts whose timeframe in minutes is no more than ORB total time (minutes), default 5.

order-block-detector.text: Marks a block on each volume pivot high bar: bullish when the market state is up, bearish when down. Newest blocks extend right as boxes with an average line, and a block is removed once price breaks through it. Inputs: Volume Pivot Length (5), Mitigation Methods (Wick), Bullish OB (3), Bearish OB (3).

order-block-finder.text: Finds a bullish block, the last down candle before a run of up candles, and a bearish block, the last up candle before a run of down candles, when the move meets the minimum percent. Triangles, limits and a cross at the average mark each block. Inputs: Relevant Periods to identify OB (5), Min. Percent move to identify OB (0).
names: Min. Percent move to identify OB

order-block-finder-gold-projectsyndicate.text: Finds order blocks: after a confirmed swing low or high, it looks back for the first opposite-colour candle whose range is small against the move to the swing, and draws that candle as a zone. Green boxes are bullish and red are bearish; a zone disappears when a close breaks through it. Key inputs: Swing Detection Length 7, Order Block Lookback 20, Displacement Multiplier 1.3, Max Order Blocks 5, Minimum Strength Filter 3.

order-blocks-breaker-blocks.text: Finds swing highs and lows over Swing Lookback bars (10). A close above the last swing high creates a bullish order block box from the lowest bar since the swing; a close below the last swing low creates a bearish one. A block turns into a breaker when a candle body goes through it. Show Last Bullish OB and Show Last Bearish OB (3 each) set how many are drawn; Use Candle Body (off) uses bodies instead of wicks.

order-blocks-finder-major-ob-supply-and-.text: Tracks major highs and lows from candle breaks, and when a close crosses the major high or low it draws a demand or supply zone on the candle before. With Order Block Refine On, the zone is narrowed using ATR, and Refine Type (Defensive) keeps the far part of wide zones. Major High Levels and Major Low Levels show only if Show High Level or Show Low Level is Yes.

order-blocks-flux-charts.text: Finds order blocks where a close breaks the last swing high or low: the lowest-low bar of the move becomes a bullish block, the highest-high bar a bearish one, and blocks over 3.5 ATR are dropped. Zones end when price pierces them by Wick or Close (Zone Invalidation); overlapping same-side zones merge. Swing Length is 10 and Zone Count is Low; Volumetric Info shows volume and its split.

order-blocks-signals.text: Measures a 4-bar rate of change of open and, when it crosses below or above plus or minus Sensitivity divided by 100, draws a box on a recent candle's range as a bearish or bullish order block. Boxes extend right until price closes (or wicks) beyond them, per OB Mitigation Type. Buy Signal and Sell Signal enable alerts while price is inside. Sensitivity defaults to 28.

order-blocks-volume-delta-3d-flux-charts.text: Finds swing pivots, then a break of structure, and marks the order block as the bar touching the most-visited price of the move, shown as a zone with its bullish/bearish volume split and total volume. A zone ends when price breaks its far side, set by Invalidation (Wick); retests get triangles. Main inputs: Swing Length (5), Show Nearest (3), Extend Zones (10).

order-blocks-w-realtime-fibs.text: Finds order blocks: the bar Consecutive Bars Required (6) back, if followed by enough opposite-closing bars, becomes a box over its range. Each new block redraws fib levels (0, .236, .382, .50, .618, .786, 1) with price labels; a mark shows when price reaches the Rectracement Level (Order Block). Mitigation Type (Wicks) decides when a block ends.

order-flow-imbalance-oscillator.text: Builds up to five supply and five demand zones from runs of three same-direction candles with above-average volume, each with a signed volume delta, and drops zones that price closes through. The oscillator is demand minus supply over their total, from -100 to +100: positive is shaded in the Demand colour, negative in the Supply colour. Dashed lines mark 0, +50 and -50.

order-flow-vwap-deviation.text: Plots a VWAP of hlc3 restarted each period, with an Upper Band and Lower Band at a number of standard deviations from it, and shaded areas between VWAP and each band. Dashed pivot levels stay active until price trades through them, and circles mark a break on high volume. Key inputs: VWAP Anchor (Session), Std. Dev Multiplier (2), Pivot Lookback (Stop Zones) (50).

orderblocks-open-source.text: Finds fractal highs and lows and, when price breaks one, picks the candle with the extreme high or low since that fractal as an order block. It draws two short lines per block, red for bearish and blue for bullish, and removes them once price fills them if Delete lines after fill ? is on. Filter only OB that follow with FVG ? (on) requires a gap within Max bars between the OB and FVG (3).
names: Filter only OB that follow with FVG ?
Max bars between the OB and FVG

oscillator-matrix.text: Shows Money Flow, a smoothed volume balance of rising versus falling hlc3 bars, and Hyper Wave, a normalised MACD of close, both clamped to -1..1. Bands mark 0.7 to 1 and -0.7 to -1, with a zero band; the background and candles reflect the agreement of both lines. Strong Buy Signal and Strong Sell Signal fire on Money Flow crossings. Inputs: Money Flow Length 14, Hyper Wave Fast 12, Hyper Wave Slow 26.

ott-bands.text: A moving average of the Source feeds a percentage trailing stop, and OTT plots that stop, delayed two bars, with upper and lower bands offset by percentages of it. Price or the Support Line crossing OTT triggers the alerts. Defaults: OTT Moving Average Length 2, OTT Optimization Coeff 15, OTT Upper Band Coeff 0.1, OTT Lower Band Coeff 0.077, Moving Average Type VAR.

otto.text: Builds a ratio of three VIDYA-style averages of the Source, smooths it with the chosen Moving Average Type, and runs a trailing-stop band on it. LOTT is the ratio; HOTT is the stop lagged two bars. LOTT crossing above HOTT marks a buy, below a sell, and the fill turns green or red. Key inputs: OTT Period 2, OTT Optimization Coeff 0.6, Fast VIDYA Length 10, Slow VIDYA Length 25.

paft.text: Scores follow-through after the close crosses its EMA: a cross up resets the score to +1, a cross down to -1, and later bars add +1 for an up candle or -1 for a down candle. Columns are green with the close above the EMA, red below. With the hide option on, columns stay hidden after a cross until the score reaches +2 or -2. Main input: EMA length 20.
names: Hide until ±2 confirm (up: <2 to >=2 / down: >-2 to <=-2)

parabolic-rsi.text: Computes RSI, then runs a Parabolic SAR trailing process on the RSI values instead of price. PSAR is drawn as crosses; when RSI crosses it the side flips and a diamond marks it, labelled strong if it flips beyond Threshold Lower 30 or Threshold Upper 70. Inputs: RSI Length 14, SAR Start 0.02, SAR Increment 0.02, SAR Max 0.2.

parabolic-sar.text: Trails price with a stop-and-reverse point drawn as crosses on the price pane. It sits below price in an uptrend and above it in a downtrend, moving toward the extreme price by an acceleration factor that grows as new extremes are made. When price crosses it, the trend flips and the factor resets. Inputs: start 0.02, increment 0.02, Max value 0.2.

parabolic-stoch-sar-visualizer.text: Smooths a stochastic %K twice with a 3-bar average, then runs a parabolic SAR on that oscillator. The line shifts from red to green between the Lower Threshold (30) and Upper Threshold (70); SAR dots sit above in uptrends, below in downtrends. Inputs: Stochastic Length 14, Accel Start 0.02, Accel Max 0.2.

parallel-pivot-lines.text: Finds pivot highs and lows over Pivot Length bars each side, then fits a regression slope of close over a window reaching back to the pivot set by Lookback. Lines with that same slope, scaled by Slope Multiplier, run from the last Lookback pivot highs (PH) and lows (PL), giving parallel channel lines. Defaults are 30, 3 and 1.

pay-attention-candle.text: Flags candles whose body, the distance between open and close, is larger than the ATR times a multiplier. Flagged candles are recoloured; a bullish one gets a triangle below the bar and a bearish one a triangle above it. Inputs: ATR Length (9) and ATR Multiplier (1.5).

pcr-market-regime-indicator.text: Measures the close's change over PCR Length (80) bars as a percentage of the high-low range over that window, then smooths it with an EMA of Smoothing (3). PCR is lime above 0 and red otherwise, with a PCR EMA line. The background is green, red or gray by regime, set by the Neutral Zone (+/- around 0) of 1; dashed lines sit at 100, 70, 0, -70 and -100.

peak-reversal-v2.text: Builds Keltner channels from an EMA of the close plus and minus an EMA of the true range times a tight, normal or extreme multiplier. Bars are shaded by how many bars have passed since one stayed inside the upper or lower band, and triangles mark the first touch of a band. Keltner Channel EMA Length defaults to 21; Bands to Use For Crosses and Free Bars: defaults to Normal.
names: Bands to Use For Crosses and Free Bars:

peak-reversal-v3.text: Keltner channel: a moving average of the close (MA Type EMA, MA Length 20) with bands at ATR (ATR Length 14) times Inner 2 and Outer 3. Triangles mark the first bar whose wick reaches a band; bars are tinted by bars since last inside the band, and the channel is shaded when its width is in a low percentile (Lookback 200, Percentile 5).

percent-off-all-time-high.text: Tracks the highest bar high seen so far and plots the close's distance from it in percent, (close / high - 1) * 100. The % Off High line sits at 0 when price closes at a new high and falls negative the further the close is below that peak. It has no inputs.

percentile-based-bb-trend-mattes.text: A %B reading on bands built from the average of the 25th and 75th percentiles of the source, widened by MAD Multiplier times the median absolute deviation, then EMA-smoothed and drawn as columns around 0. Light blue and blue columns are above 0 (rising, falling); purple shades are below 0. Defaults: Lookback Length 36, MAD Multiplier 0.15, EMA Smoothing Length for Trend Line 9.
names: EMA Smoothing Length for Trend Line

percentile-rank-oscillator.text: Ranks the high-low midpoint within its last Lookback (bars for percentile) 100 bars as a percentile, and ranks the midpoint's deviation from its VWMA likewise, giving Price Percentile and VWMA Percentile. Output scale defaults to -1..+1; the background is shaded when a line reaches the Upper percentile threshold (%) 95 or Lower percentile threshold (%) 5, with alerts for price, VWMA and both together.

perfect-hammer-pattern-indicators-and-al.text: Finds candles that open at their low and close higher below the high (bullish), or open at their high and close lower above the low (bearish). A green H below the bar signals a run of such bullish candles after a red or doji candle; a red H above the bar signals the bearish mirror after a green or doji candle. Consecutive Perfect Patterns (2) sets the run length. Alerts: Bullish Pattern Alert, Bearish Pattern Alert.

perfect-rsi.text: Averages a dozen or so RSI variants (plain, dynamic, Wilder, momentum, TSI-based and a DI-based one) computed on the close and on hlcc4 into one line, Improved RSI. The background turns red when it exceeds a level pulled slightly inward from OB Level 70, and green when below one pulled from OS Level 30. Most lengths default to 5.

perforance-integral.text: Sums return-to-volatility ratios over the last length of calculation (50) bars, weighted by weight oldest, weight on middle and weight newest, then smooths with an EMA of ema length (2). The indicator line is green after crossing above upper threshold (1.5), red after crossing under lower threshold (-1.5); vol shows summed volatility.

performance.text: A table of percentage price changes over several periods for a list of symbols, using daily closes against the close at each period's reference bar. Cells are green for zero or more and red below, with stronger shading up to Color intensity cutoff (%) (10); uncomputable cells show No data. Inputs are Symbol list, Timeframe list (1W to 5Y, YTD) and Include chart symbol.

periodic-linear-regressions.text: Fits a least-squares line of Source against bar index over all bars since the current Anchor Period (W) began, with bands at Multiple (1) times the residual deviation. Rolling refits on every bar; Static draws one line per period. Line colour follows correlation, from red (negative) to green (positive). Show Extremities toggles the bands.

philakone-ema-swing.text: Draws four averages of lengths 8, 13, 21 and 55, as EMAs or, with Exponential MA off, SMAs. A Buy marker appears when 21 crosses 55 while 8 is above 13 and 21 is above 55. Sell is the mirror case. Buy Condition and Sell Condition alerts follow the same rules. Source defaults to close.

piercing.text: Looks for a two-candle bullish reversal after a downtrend: a long down candle, then an up candle that opens at or below the prior low and closes above the prior body's midpoint but under the prior open. A label marks the second bar. Detect Trend Based On defaults to SMA50.

pipstocrat-market-participant-analysis.text: Two smoothed RSI measures, each scaled by a sensitivity around a base, averaged with a 3-bar EMA and clamped to 0-20. Hot Money uses Sensitivity 0.7, Period 40, Base 30; Smart Money uses 1.5, 50, 50. They are columns drawn against a constant Retail Activity column at 20, with dashed lines at 5, 10 and 15; higher columns mean stronger RSI momentum.

pivot-breakout-high-low-signals.text: Tracks the last pivot high and pivot low as levels (Last Pivot High, Last Pivot Low). A close crossing a level starts a wait for a retest, where the bar's low or high comes within the tolerance of the level while the close stays beyond it; that prints a BUY or SELL triangle. Inputs: Pivot Length 5, Retest Tolerance (%) 0.3, Use EMA Trend Filter true (close must be beyond the EMA), EMA Length 200.

pivot-breakout-with-trend-zones.text: Tracks the latest pivot high and pivot low, drawn as crosses shifted by Line Offset (-9). The first close above the last pivot high gives a white candle and an uptrend; the first close below the last pivot low gives a black candle and a downtrend. Other candles are teal in an uptrend, red in a downtrend. Pivots use 9 left and 9 right bars.

pivot-hh-hl-lh-ll.text: Finds pivot highs and lows and compares each with the previous one to label it higher high, lower high, higher low or lower low, with markers, price labels and level dots extending from the latest pivots. A break marker appears when price closes through the last pivot, opening on its near side. Inputs: Pivot High Left Length 4, Pivot High Right Length 2, with matching low lengths.

pivot-high-low-analysis-forecast.text: Finds pivot highs and lows with length bars on each side and compares each with the previous pivot of the same kind, labelling percent change and bars between; arrows are blue when higher, red when lower. Average gaps forecast the next pivot with a dashed vertical line. Inputs: length (50), Show Forecasted Pivots (on); outputs Pivot High, Pivot Low.

pivot-hilo-support-n-resistance-levels-r.text: Finds pivot highs and lows that are the extreme of Pivot Length Left Hand Side and Pivot Length Right Hand Side bars (5 each), and draws the latest pivot high and low prices as Top Levels and Bottom Levels, or as a stepped chaos channel. Pivots print one bar late by default. Optional HH, LH, HL and LL marks, fractal break arrows and a fast and slow moving average filter are available.
names: Show Levels as a Fractal Chaos Channel
Show HH,LL,LH,HL markers on Pivots Points

pivot-levels.text: Draws the latest pivot high and pivot low of up to four pivot lengths (Pivot 1 to Pivot 4, defaults 5, 25, 50 and 100 bars each side) as lines running to the last bar. A line is green when the last low is well above it, orange when the last high is well below it (a margin of 1.5 times ATR 200), otherwise blue. Labels show price, volume and volume share.

pivot-market-structure.text: Marks the last confirmed pivot high and low as circle lines, and trails a high/low channel: the upper tail is the highest high of Length bars as of the last close below the prior lowest low, the lower tail the lowest low as of the last close above the prior highest high. Upper Tail shows while the close is below it, lower while above. Key inputs: Pivot Length (5), Length (10), Step Size (1), Line Break (off).

pivot-oscillator.text: Places the close relative to a pivot line set between the average of recent pivot highs and pivot lows, scaled by ATR into a 1 to 100 oscillator centred on 50. Its SMA, smoothed again, is the Signal SMA, coloured by slope. Triangles mark the oscillator crossing back above Oversold Level (30) or below Overbought Level (70). Inputs: Pivot Length (5), Pivot Lookback (5), ATR Length (14), ATR Multiplier Up and Down (15).

pivot-point-hpotter.text: Computes floor-trader pivots from the previous day's high, low and close, then plots three supports and three resistances. Every bar of a day shows that day's levels, and the first day has none. Read S1 to S3 as levels below the pivot and R1 to R3 as levels above it, each farther out than the one before. Input: width, default 2.

pivot-point-supertrend.text: A SuperTrend whose centre line moves a third of the way toward each new pivot high or low. Bands sit at the centre minus or plus ATR Factor times the ATR and trail with the trend. The PP SuperTrend line is green in an uptrend and red in a downtrend, with Buy and Sell labels on flips. Defaults: Pivot Point Period 2, ATR Factor 3, ATR Period 10.

pivot-points-high-low.text: Finds pivot highs and pivot lows: a bar whose high (or low) is the extreme of the bars on its left and right. It prints a label with the price above each pivot high and below each pivot low, and a pivot appears only after the right-side bars have closed. Pivot High and Pivot Low each take a left and right bar count, 10 and 10 by default.

pivot-points-high-low-missed-reversal.text: Finds pivot highs and lows that are the highest or lowest over Pivot Length bars on each side, marks them with arrows and joins them with a zigzag. When two pivots of the same kind occur in a row, the extreme between them is marked with a ghost label as a missed reversal, with a level running to the next one. Regular Pivots and Missed Pivots toggle each set; Pivot Length defaults to 50.

pivot-points-high-low-multi-time-frame.text: Finds pivot highs and lows on a higher timeframe (timeframe, default 240): a bar whose extreme beats Left Bars bars before and Right Bars bars after it (both 2). Each pivot is drawn as a horizontal line over its higher-timeframe bar, with small end brackets and a price label. A timeframe below the chart's gives an error.

pivot-points-standard.text: Draws horizontal support and resistance levels for each higher-timeframe period, computed from the previous period's high, low and close (and open for some types). Lines start at the period's first bar and are labelled P, R and S levels with optional prices. Main inputs: Type (Traditional), Pivots Timeframe (Auto), Number of Pivots Back (15) and Use Daily-based Values (on).

pivot-trailing-maxmin.text: Detects pivot highs and lows over length bars each side, then restarts a trailing maximum and minimum from the high and low of the pivot bar. Between pivots the maximum only rises and the minimum only falls, with Average midway between them. The area between them is shaded by the last pivot type. Inputs: length 24, backpaint false (shifts drawing back by length).

pivot-trend.text: Builds an upper band from the last pivot high of high plus 200-bar ATR times Offset, and a lower band from the last pivot low of low minus the same. The line follows the lower band in an up trend and the upper band in a down trend; the trend flips when close breaks the relevant band, with buy and sell marks at flips. Inputs: Left Bars 10, Right Bars 10, Offset 2.

pivot-trendlines-with-breaks.text: Joins a pivot low to the previous one when it is higher (a pivot high when lower) with a line, continued by a dotted trendline to the current bar. A close beyond the line ends it and marks a break: red label above for lows, green below for highs. Pivot Length (20) sets the pivot bars; Target Levels (off) adds flat lines at the latest pivots.

pmax-on-rsi-with-tillson-t3.text: Applies a trailing stop (PMax) to an RSI instead of price: the stop sits ATR Multiplier (3) times an RSI-based ATR (ATR Length 10) from a Tillson T3 average of the RSI (T3 Length 8, Volume Factor 0.7). The area between RSI and PMax is green when T3 is above PMax and red when below, and Buy and Sell labels mark T3 crossing PMax. RSI Length is 14, with bands at 70 and 30.

pmax-rsi-t3.text: Smooths RSI with a Tillson T3 filter and adds a PMax trailing line offset by a multiple of the average change in T3 RSI. T3 RSI crossing above PMax gives a Buy marker, below gives a Sell; the fill is green above, red below. Dashed lines sit at 70 and 30. Inputs: RSI Length 14, T3 Length 5, T3 Factor 0.7, ATR Multiplier 3.

pmo.text: Computes a twice-smoothed one-bar percentage rate of change of the source, scaled by 10, and a Signal line that is an exponential average of it. PMO is read against the Zero level and against Signal, which it can cross. Inputs: Source (close), Length 1 (35), Length 2 (20) and Signal length (10).

poc-volume-bar.text: Plots volume as columns and highlights the bar whose volume equals the highest volume of the last Lookback bars for POC bars. Aqua columns are bars closing at or above the open, blue are bars closing lower, and a yellow column marks the highest-volume bar in the window. Lookback bars for POC defaults to 60.

pocket-pivot-breakout.text: Flags a green bar whose body exceeds % change (3) of the close and whose volume is not below that of any down bar in the last Pocket Pivot Lookback Days (10). A blue triangle appears below the bar. With Gap-up Bar on (default off), a bar gapping above the prior high by more than Gap-up Value in % (0.5) is colored blue.

pocs-and-vahs-vals-all-and-non-broken.text: Builds a volume profile per period by spreading each bar's volume over price steps, then finds the busiest price (POC) and the value area around it (VAH top, VAL bottom). At each new period the last period's levels extend right as lines; unbroken ones vanish once price trades through. Drawn on 5-minute charts only; Value Area 0.7, Time Frame D.

polyfilter.text: Filters the price source with one of three methods: a Fractional MA, an Ehlers 2-Pole smoother or a Multi-Kernel blend, set by Filter Type (default Ehlers 2-Pole). Filter is green when it rises, or when the source is above it if trend colouring is off, and red otherwise; triangles mark the turns or crossings. Inputs: Filter Length 83, Adaptation Speed 0.618, which only affects the Fractional MA.

polynomial-regression-moving-average.text: Fits a polynomial to the last Period source values and uses its end-point prediction as a moving average, then smooths it with the chosen method. The line is green while rising and fuchsia otherwise; an L label marks a turn up with the close above the line, an S label a turn down with the close below it. Defaults: Period 100, Degree 4, Smoothing Method EMA, Smoothing Length 5.

polynomial-trend-exhaustion-divergence.text: Fits a cubic polynomial (or a Kalman filter) to a smoothed price source to get the trend slope. Crosses mark exhaustion, where a positive slope is falling or a negative slope is rising; DIV labels mark where a forecast cubic disagrees with recent price direction. Key inputs: Smoothing Method (LinReg Blend), Length (20), Consecutive Bars for Exhaustion (2), Forecast Period (25).

polyphase-macd.text: A MACD that can run several phases, each phase fed every Nth bar, with outputs smoothed over that many bars. It plots MACD, Signal and a Histogram of their difference around a Zero Line. Histogram shade shows whether it is above or below zero and rising or falling. Inputs: Phases 1, Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9, with SMA or EMA types, both EMA by default.

poor-man-s-volume-clusters.text: Splits bars into blocks and divides each block's high-low range into 15 price rows. Each bar's volume is spread over the rows its range touches, and the row with the most volume is the volume point of control, marked by an orange diamond when Show volume point of control is on. Row lengths scale with Visual row width (10) against an average set by Profile maximum high pass filter size in bars (200). Bars in profile block defaults to 15.
names: Profile maximum high pass filter size in bars

position-size-calculator.text: Computes stop and target distances as a percent of Entry, the reward to risk ratio, and a position size of Account Balance (1000) times Risk Percentage (2) divided by the stop percent. Entry, TP and SL levels appear on the right with green and red fills, plus labels. Entry, Stop Loss and Target Price default to 0, so results show NaN until set.

power-of-3-ict-01-amd-ict-smc-accumulati.text: Marks three New York time sessions of the day: Accumulation (1900-0100), Manipulation (0100-0700) and Distribution (0700-1300). Each session gets a dotted box spanning its highest high to lowest low, with a name label above its middle. Boxes are drawn only on charts of 60 minutes or less, and each session can be switched off with its checkbox.

ppo-alerts.text: Computes the percentage gap between a fast and slow EMA of the Source, smoothed by an SMA of Smoother bars, as the PPO line. Circles mark oscillator Bottoms and Tops, plus Bearish Divergence and Bullish Divergence where price and oscillator extremes disagree. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Smoother 2, Lookback Period 55, Source open.

ppo-divergence.text: Computes the gap between a fast and slow EMA as a percent of the slow one, smoothed by an SMA, and plots it as Plot. Circles mark divergences between oscillator and price pivots: Bearish Divergence2 and Bullish Divergence2, with long-term ones toggled by Use Long Term Divergences?. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Smoother 2.

precision-sniper.text: Tracks three EMAs of the Price source and simulates trades on fast/slow EMA crossovers. Entries must pass an evidence score, trend and volatility checks, then get an ATR and structure stop plus targets at TP1 R 1, TP2 R 2 and TP3 R 3. It plots EMA Fast, EMA Slow, EMA Trend and the nearest known resistance and support. Preset defaults to Auto.

predictive-channels.text: Tracks an adaptive Average that jumps to the close when price strays more than a Factor-scaled ATR(200) from it, and otherwise drifts with the last trend direction. Two resistance and two support lines sit above and below it. Inputs: Factor 5 sets the reset distance, Slope 50 sets how slowly the Average drifts.

predictive-ranges.text: Builds a stepped average that moves by ATR times a factor whenever the source strays further than that from it. Half that step becomes a unit, giving PR Upper 1 and 2 and PR Lower 1 and 2 around PR Average. Levels are hidden on bars where the average moves. Inputs: Length (200), Factor (6), Timeframe, Source (close).

premier-rsi.text: Takes RSI of the Source, applies a stochastic to it, rescales and smooths it twice with an EMA, then squashes the result into a range between -1 and +1. Premier RSI is the line, PRO Histo the columns: green above zero, red below. Dotted zero, solid levels at 0.9 and -0.9, dashed at 0.2 and -0.2. Defaults: RSI Length 14, Stoch Length 8, Smooth Length 25.

premier-stochastic.text: Computes a stochastic of the Source over Stoch Length bars, rescales it around zero, smooths it with two EMAs of Smooth Length, then squashes it with an exponential sigmoid so PSO stays between -1 and +1. PSO Histogram repeats the value in blue when at or above zero and red below. Horizontal levels sit at 0, 0.2, 0.9, -0.2 and -0.9. Defaults: Stoch Length 8, Smooth Length 25, Source close.

premium-discount-delta-volume.text: On the last bar, draws a premium box above the highest high and a discount box below the lowest low of a lookback, with an equilibrium line between them. Delta volume compares average volume of down bars to up bars, capped at plus or minus 100. A table shows the macro value. Premium & Discount Lookback Period is 50 and Macro Lookback Period is 200.

premium-trade-zones.text: Computes RSI of the Source over three lengths (RSI 14, RSI 21, RSI 50 by default 14, 21, 50) and averages them into a pipe drawn as Pipe Outer Glow, Pipe Inner Glow and Pipe Core. Lines take one colour family when the average is at or above 50 and another below. Fills run from 70 to No-trade top (57) and from No-trade bottom (43) to 30, with guide lines at 80, 70, 30 and 20.

previous-day-high-and-low-separators-dai.text: Marks each new day with a vertical separator, a box named after the weekday and a date-time label, and each new week with a thicker grey separator. It also draws HOD and LOD lines at the previous day's high and low, extended to the current bar. Day and week changes shift with UTC Offset (in hours), default 0.

previous-day-week-highs-lows.text: Draws the high and low of each day, week and month as dashed lines that start on the first bar of the period and end when the next begins, keeping the earlier periods (2 days, 1 week, 1 month). Read them as prior-period support and resistance. Daily, Weekly and Monthly switch each set; Show Projections extends lines forward, Show Gradient fades older ones.

previous-highs-lows.text: Draws the highs and lows of the last bars of a higher timeframe as lines running to the last bar, fading with age and numbered, with two shaded areas covering the top and bottom of those highs and lows. Inputs: Show Last (4), Frequency (Day), Areas Width (20), and Filter Based On Position (off), which hides highs below the close and lows above it.

price-acceleration-indicator.text: Takes the change of the Source twice to get price acceleration, then smooths it with an EMA of Smoothing Length (10) and draws it as Acceleration Bars around zero. Bright green means above zero and rising, dark green above zero and not rising, bright red at or below zero and falling, dark red otherwise. Upper Trigger and Lower Trigger are 0.3 times the highest and lowest smoothed value over Lookback for Peaks (100).

price-action-bands-trend-volatility.text: Draws a trend baseline, a moving average of the close, with an EMA Trend Signal that is cyan when the baseline is at or above it and orange below. Four bands sit around a smoothed baseline, widened by the standard deviation or ATR times the inner and outer multipliers. Defaults: Moving Average Type HMA, Moving Average Period 200, Inner Band Multiplier 2.5, Outer Band Multiplier 3.5.

price-action-breakout-trend.text: Trailing stop built from the highest high and lowest low of the prior bars. In an uptrend the Trailing Stop rises to the prior low and flips short when the test price drops below it; the short side mirrors this, with triangles at flips. Main inputs: Breakout Lookback 10 and Breakout Confirmation Close or Wick; Preset Configuration can override both.

price-action-engulfing-patterns.text: Compares each bar with the previous one to find engulfing candles. A bullish engulfing is a green bar after a red one whose close is at or above the prior open and open at or below the prior close; bearish is the mirror. Labels mark each pattern, and Plot draws the close. No inputs.

price-action-signals-filtered-ema.text: Finds pivot lows and highs, then requires a run of rising or falling closes. A bullish triangle shows when a pivot low follows rising closes with the close above EMA Trend Filter; bearish is the mirror below it. A new signal shows only if that side is not already active. Inputs: Pivot Left (2), Pivot Right (2), Number of Confirmation Candles (2), EMA Length (Trend Filter) (20).

price-action-smart-money-concepts.text: Tracks market structure with break and change-of-character levels. A close through a level draws a solid line; a wick through it with a close back is a sweep marked x. It also draws volumetric order blocks from the extreme bar of each break, with volume and share text. Algorithmic Logic defaults to Adjusted Points; Show Last shows 5 blocks; Mitigation Method is Close.

price-action-system.text: Draws a simple moving average of the close plus smoothed lines of the low, high and midpoint, and a slow EMA trend line. A Buy label appears when close is above the SMA and the bar is a bullish engulfing or hammer; a Sell label appears below it on a bearish engulfing or shooting star. Inputs: MA Length 50, ATR Length 14.

price-advance-decline-range-analysis.text: Takes the difference between Series B and Series A (close minus open by default) and splits it into an advance part (PD columns) and a decline part (PN columns). Circles track the largest advance and decline so far; grey lines average each part, and red and lime lines sit midway between each average and its extreme. Inputs: Average Type: (Cumulative Average) and Length: (24), used by the non-cumulative averages.

price-change-sentiment-index.text: Divides each bar's close-to-close change by its high-low range, maps it around 50, clamps it to 0-100 and smooths it with an SMA of Smoothing Period (3). Dashed lines mark Oversold Level (25) and Overbought Level (75), plus a midline at 50. With Show Background Colors on, the background turns red at or above overbought and green at or below oversold.

price-contraction-expansion.text: Compares each candle body with its average times a threshold: smaller is contraction, otherwise expansion. Bars are coloured yellow for contraction on high volume, blue for other contraction or expansion on low volume, green for bullish expansion and red for bearish. Key inputs are Body average period (20), Threshold multiplier (0.8), High volume multiplier (1.5) and Low volume multiplier (0.7).

price-divergence-detector.text: Computes a chosen oscillator on both highs and lows, finds 5-bar fractal tops and bottoms in it, and compares each with the previous one against price. A higher price high with a lower oscillator high (or the mirror at lows) is regular divergence; the reverse is hidden. Maroon marks bearish and green bullish on H F, L F, H D and L D. Key inputs: method (BB %B), Length for Method (except MACD): 20.

price-flow-buy-sell.text: Draws Fair Value, a Gaussian-weighted average of the Source Price (default hlc3) over the Lookback Window (50), with inner and outer bands set at multiples of the average error. Its colour shifts with the smoothed slope. BUY or SELL labels mark a first rejection of a band while the move is weakening. Inner Band Multiplier is 1.5 and Outer Band Multiplier 2.8; Base Bandwidth (h) is 8.

price-linear-sequence-counter.text: Counts consecutive bars where Series B is above Series A, adding one per bar, and consecutive bars where it is below, subtracting one per bar; any bar that breaks a run resets that count to 0. PLS and NLS are columns for the positive and negative counts, while PL and NL hold the highest and lowest counts reached. Defaults are Series A: open and Series B: close.

price-momentum-oscillator.text: Takes the one-bar percent change of close, smooths it with a custom exponential average, multiplies by 10 and smooths again to form PMO, then smooths PMO into Signal. Histogram shows PMO minus Signal; PMO above Signal is bullish, below is bearish. Dashed levels sit at 2.5 and -2.5, with a zero line. Inputs: 1st Smoothing 35, 2nd Smoothing 20, Signal Length 10.

price-oscillator.text: Computes the gap between a fast and a slow moving average as a percentage of the slow one (PPO), with a signal line averaging it and a histogram of PPO minus Signal line. The histogram is teal above zero and red below, brighter when it rises. Inputs: Fast length (12), Slow length (26), Signal length (9), Source (close).

price-volume-profile.text: Splits the high-low range of the last Lookback Bars (default 200) into Row Size rows (default 20) and builds a horizontal profile at the right edge. Each row's box length and text show how many closes fell in it (Counter, default) or their summed volume (Volume), shaded from red for the lowest to green for the highest. Point of Control, on by default, marks the row with the largest value as POC.

price-volume-value-histogram.text: Scores each bar by the close ratio to the prior close, boosted by a volume factor when volume rises, with falling closes scored negative. The Histogram is the average of the last Look back (7) scores, smoothed by an EMA of EMA Length (7) when EMA smoothing is on. Lime columns sit at or above Zero, red below; Color bars (on) tints candles the same way.

primitive-delta-divergence.text: Treats the last Lookback Period bars (20) as one candle and splits their volume into up-candle and down-candle volume, giving a bias of their difference over their sum. A red dot above the bar shows the combined candle rising while the bias is negative; a lime dot below shows it falling while the bias is positive.

pring-special-k-a2m.text: PSK is a weighted sum of twelve moving averages of rates of change of the source, covering short to long cycles, and is green at or above zero and red below. Smoothing MA averages it per Type (default SMA, Length 20); SMA + Bollinger Bands adds Upper Band and Lower Band, set by BB StdDev (2).

prings-special-k.text: Adds up twelve smoothed rate-of-change terms, each the moving average of a percent price change over a different span, with weights 1 to 4 rising within short, intermediate and long-term groups. Read it as a momentum curve around the Zero level: above it means net positive momentum, below it net negative, and turns show shifts. It has no inputs.

prism-moving-average-trend.text: Builds Prism Moving Average by applying a sine-and-cosine weighted average twice to the Source, with Prism Upper Band and Prism Lower Band set at ATR times Multiplier around it. Trend turns up when price closes above the upper band with a rising average, and down when it closes below the lower band with a falling one; candles and bands take that colour. Change shows the average's bar-to-bar move. Lookback is 31, Multiplier 0.85, Source close.

pro-scalper-2-minutestf-by-ayoob.text: Draws a volume-weighted moving average of hlc3 (VWMA 7) and an EMA of the close (200 Trend Baseline). A BUY label appears at the low when the close crosses above the VWMA while it rises; a SELL label at the high when it crosses below while falling. Signals alternate. VWMA Length is 7 and Institutional Trend MA is 200.

pro-scalper-ai.text: Blends trend (DI direction times ADX strength), volatility (ATR over close) and volume (OBV) into Composite Oscillator, scaled by 100. Dynamic Upper Threshold and Dynamic Lower Threshold widen Base Upper Threshold (25) and Base Lower Threshold (-25). Strong buy/sell markers need a band break with close past the HMA.

probabilities-module-the-quant-science.text: Simulates simple trades: one opens on a bearish bar, wins on a later bullish bar, or loses on a bar closing below the prior close. Win Rate % is the share of wins among stored outcomes, times 100; the stored list resets once it exceeds Lookback period (Trades), default 30, so the value jumps after resets.

profit-maximizer.text: Computes a moving average of the Source and wraps it in an ATR trailing stop; PMax is the lower stop while the trend is up and the upper stop while it is down. A Buy or Sell label appears when the Moving Avg Line crosses PMax, and the fill is green with the average above PMax, red below. Defaults: ATR Length 10, ATR Multiplier 3, Moving Average Type EMA, Moving Average Length 10.

projected-crossover-trend.text: Plots a fast EMA (Fast MA) and a slow SMA (Slow MA) and tracks a trend state. It turns long when a smoothed momentum of the fast-slow gap is above zero and the close is above the close Slow MA Length bars ago, short when both are below. LONG and SHORT triangles mark changes. Defaults: Fast MA Length 10, Slow MA Length 30, MDI Smooth Length 5.

prometheus-topological-persistent-entrop.text: Measures how evenly spread the sizes of recent log-return differences are. Each bar's Shannon entropy over pairs of return segments is averaged into Persistent Entropy, which is smoothed as Persistent Entropy SMA. The SMA line and fill turn red when entropy is above its SMA, teal otherwise; BULL or BEAR labels mark the SMA crossing over or under it. Window Size is 15, Bins 20, SMA Look Back 50.

protected-highs-lows.text: Tracks market structure from pivots with Pivot Strength bars each side, default 1. A close beyond the swing high or low marks a break: BOS if the trend continues, MSS if it flips. After a break, Plot trails the protected high or low, and a dashed line and label mark the break. Use Valid Pullback Criteria (on) requires a pullback first; Show Retracements adds 30, 50 and 70 percent levels.

pullback-candles-guaranteed-winners.text: Flags a pullback candle: two lower closes in a row, then a close above the previous close, on a swing low (the low or the prior low equals the lowest low of 6 bars). Such a bar gets a green x-cross below it labelled PB and a green bar colour, and raises the Pullback Candle alert. With Use EMA Filter? (off by default) the close must also be above the EMA set by EMA Length (50).

pullback-sar.text: Plots a Parabolic SAR with slow acceleration as crosses. Price closing above SAR is bullish, below is bearish. A pullback is a counter-move bar in the trend; the next bar resuming the trend with a higher (long) or lower (short) close draws a triangle and fires Alert Long or Alert Short. Inputs: Start 0.01, Increment 0.01, Max Value 0.1.

pullback-scalp-trade-v2.text: Plots a 50-bar and 200-bar average of the close (Medium Trend MA, Long Trend MA), with a fill green when the close is above the 200 average, red otherwise, plus a Supertrend split into upTrend2 and downTrend2 lines. A Buy marker appears when the Supertrend turns up with the close above the long average; Sell when it turns down below it. Inputs: ATR Length 10, Factor 1.

pullback-trading-tool-alt-r1-0-by-justun.text: Draws a fast and slow moving average ribbon (EMA 5 and 12), a Signal MA (EMA 50) and anchored averages (Fast Anchored MA 35, Medium Anchored MA 65, optional Slow Anchored MA 200). Ribbon lines turn aqua when rising, fuchsia otherwise; bars are coloured by open and close versus the Signal MA. Pivot dots mark swing highs and lows, with 2 bars each side.

pulse-range.text: Builds an adaptive range from double-smoothed absolute price changes times a multiplier, and a Center Track that moves only when the source is more than that range away. The center is green while rising, red while falling; Upper Track and Lower Track sit one range away. Triangles mark turns. Defaults: Sampling Period 40, Range Multiplier 3.4.

pulse-rsi-lyro-rs.text: Builds an RSI-style value from a smoothed, regressed volume-weighted price series, so rises and falls of that line drive the reading. The line is coloured by trend against its prior value or the 50 midline, with markers on crosses of 30 and 70. Main inputs: Length 55, Threshold Long 10, Threshold Short 15.

pulsewave-divergence.text: Computes the RSI of the source minus its SMA, drawn as a filled oscillator around a Zero Line, with Overbought Level (Oscillator) 12 and Oversold Level (Oscillator) -12. Bull and Bear labels mark pivot divergences between price and the oscillator, and triangles mark level or zero crossings per Signal Type. Inputs: RSI Length 20, RSI MA Length 20, Pivot Length (Left/Right) 5.

pump-dump-detector.text: Flags bars where volume, high-low range and NATR all exceed their short averages by set multipliers and volume passes a minimum. Such a bar is an early pump if it closes above the previous close, an early dump if below. A confirmed signal also needs a close-to-close change of at least Pump Threshold % (2.5) or at most Dump Threshold % (-2.5). Volume Multiplier is 1.8, Lookback Period 5.

pure-coca.text: Z-score of a moving average of the source: its distance from its own average over the Lookback Period, in standard deviations, drawn as a histogram that is red above 0 and white otherwise. Candles and background turn red when it crosses above Upper Boundery, and dim grey when it crosses back under Midline For Upper Boundery or above Midline For Lowe Boundery. Defaults: Lookback Period 26, MA Length 1, MA Type EMA.

pure-price-action-ict-tools.text: Finds short, intermediate and long term swing highs and lows, then builds from them structure break lines marked MSS or BOS, order and breaker blocks, buyside and sellside liquidity levels, and liquidity voids from large gaps. Each tool has its own on/off switch and Detection term. Key inputs: Margin 6.9, Visible Levels 3, Threshold Multiplier 0.75.

pure-price-action-order-breaker-blocks.text: Finds swing highs and lows from price action, then draws order blocks at the bar with the lowest (or highest) body between a swing and the close that crosses it. A close through a block turns it into a breaker block. Inputs: Detection (Intermediate Term), Show Last Bullish OB and Show Last Bearish OB (3 each), Use Candle Body (on).

pure-price-action-structures.text: Finds three-bar swing highs and lows, then applies the same pattern to those swings to get short, intermediate and long-term levels. When a close first passes the latest swing high or low of a level, a line is drawn from the swing to that bar. Labels read BOS for a break continuing the prior direction and MSS for a reversal. Long-term swings and labelled lines are on by default; the other two levels show lines only.

pvi.text: A cumulative index starting at 1000 that changes only on bars where volume rises from the prior bar, by that bar's percentage close change. Volume-falling bars leave it unchanged. PVI-based EMA smooths it, with EMA length defaulting to 255.

pvt.text: Builds a running total in which each bar adds the percentage change of the close from the prior close, multiplied by that bar's volume. PVT rises when up-moves come with volume and falls on down-moves, so its direction shows whether volume is backing price changes. It has no inputs, and the first bar is empty.

q-impulse-entry.text: Builds Impulse High and Impulse Low bands from SMAs of the high and low over Impulse Window, widened by the smoothed ATR times ATR Multiplier. A close crossing above the upper band turns the trend on, below the lower band off. Buy or sell labels need a green or red Elder bar (Elder EMA, MACD histogram), ADX above 20 and 30 bars since the last signal; Entry Price dots show that close. Defaults: 20 and 1.

q-kama-clarity-trend.text: Smooths the source with a Gaussian window, then applies an adaptive moving average (KAMA) to it. The trend turns up when the close rises above KAMA plus ATR times ATR Multiplier, and down when it falls below KAMA minus that amount; the line takes the trend colour and markers show changes. Defaults: KAMA Length 45, ATR Length 14, ATR Multiplier 1.5, Gaussian Length 4.

q-wave.text: Two adaptive averages of the typical price, Fast Wave and Slow Wave, that speed up on bars with a large body relative to ATR. Fast Wave is coloured by high/low structure, Slow Wave by a regime confirmed after Regime Inertia (6) steps; the zone between them tints when both agree. Fast Wave Sensitivity is 10, Slow Wave Sensitivity 35.

qg-particle-oscillator.text: Filters the close with a volatility-adaptive bank and plots its trend part as Raw Trend and its error part as Predict Trend, a histogram and a line, aqua above zero and purple below. Dots on zero show which component leads (Dot U, Dot L) or warn (Dot Warn). Period is 14 and Phase is 0.

qqe.text: Smooths the RSI with an EMA to get FAST, then builds a trailing line, SLOW, from volatility bands of the RSI's smoothed bar-to-bar change times the QQE factor. Crossings of FAST and SLOW mark turns, shown as Buy and Sell labels and a green or red fill between them; a circle line sits at 50. Inputs: RSI Length 14, Smooth Factor 5, QQE Factor 4.236.

qqe-cross.text: Smooths a short RSI and builds an adaptive trailing line from its average movement, scaled by QQE Factor. BUY or SELL marks appear when the RSI first moves beyond 50 plus or minus Threshold; other marks show crosses of the trailing line and of 50. Three moving averages are drawn: Fast MA, Medium MA, Slow MA. Defaults: RSI Length 6, RSI Smoothing 3, QQE Factor 2.618, Threshold 10, MA Type HullMA.

qqe-kivanc.text: FAST is an EMA of the RSI. SLOW is a trailing line built from bands placed 4.236 times a doubly smoothed average of FAST's bar-to-bar change above and below FAST. The area between them is green when FAST is above SLOW and red when below; Buy and Sell labels mark crosses, and Mid Line sits at 50. Inputs: RSI Length 14, SF RSI SMoothing Factor 5.

qqe-mod.text: Runs two QQE calculations on a smoothed RSI with trailing bands, and plots the secondary RSI minus 50 as the Secondary RSI Histogram next to the Secondary QQE Trend Line. QQE Up Signal or QQE Down Signal columns appear when the histogram is beyond the Secondary Threshold (3) and the primary line is outside its Bollinger band. Key inputs: Primary RSI Length 6, Secondary QQE Factor 1.61, BB Length 50.

qqe-signals.text: Smooths the RSI with an EMA and builds a trailing line from volatility bands around it, scaled by the factor. A green Long label appears under the bar when the smoothed RSI first moves above the trailing line, and a red Short label above the bar when it first moves below. Inputs: RSI Length 14, RSI Smoothing 5, Fast QQE Factor 4.238, Thresh-hold 10.

qtechlabs-machine-learning-logistic-regr.text: Feeds the log return and a synthetic price feature, each normalised over 20 bars, into a fixed logistic formula, then smooths the probability with an EMA as Signal Confidence. BUY labels mark a change to above Signal Threshold (0.6), SELL labels a change to below 1 minus it. Also uses Log Return Lookback 3 and Probability Smoothing 3.

quant-vwap-system-3-8.text: Plots Momentum, the z-score of the close against its moving average over Price Length (20). Bright colours mark rising moves, dark ones falling; shaded zones sit between 2 and 3 and between -2 and -3. Yellow Squeeze Active dots on zero show a volatility squeeze; a white diamond marks its end (Squeeze Fired).

quantile-regression-bands.text: Fits a linear regression over Lookback Length (75) bars, sorts the residuals and takes quantiles of them as offsets, giving inner (0.25, 0.75) and outer (0.01, 0.99) bands around a Center line, all EMA-smoothed by Band Smoothing Length (3). Wider spacing means larger past deviations. Bars are green when the close and prior close are above the center, otherwise red. Alerts fire on price crossing the outer bands.

quantum-regression-oscillator.text: RSI of the Source (Length 14), smoothed by a linear regression (Linear Regression Length 9) and an EMA (Smoothing Factor 3). Quantum Oscillator takes one colour when rising and another when falling. Bands sit two standard deviations around its 50-bar average. Circles mark price/oscillator divergences (Divergence Lookback 5); alerts fire on band re-entries and divergences.

quantum-trend-signal.text: Plots a fast and a slow EMA of the close. A BUY triangle appears when Fast EMA crosses over Slow EMA with RSI above 55 and ATR above its 20-bar average times ATR Filter; a SELL triangle appears on a cross under with RSI below 45. Background is green while fast is above slow, red below. Defaults: Fast EMA 21, Slow EMA 55, ATR Filter 0.8.

quantumtrend-swiftedge.text: Combines a Supertrend on hlc3, Keltner channels around an EMA of the close, and a trend EMA (100 EMA), with lengths set by Signal Sensitivity (default 3) unless Use Manual Settings? is on. The Supertrend shows only when the close is near it. Buy appears when the trend turns up, the close crosses above Keltner Upper and sits over the 100 EMA; Sell mirrors it below Keltner Lower.
names: Use Manual Settings? (If unchecked, uses Sensitivity)

quartile-for-loop.text: Computes a weighted quartile of the source (Q1, twice the median and Q3, divided by four), then Score counts how often the source is above that value from Loop Start to Loop End bars back. Score above Threshold Uptrend signals an up state, below Threshold Downtrend a down state; arrows mark transitions. Defaults: Quartile Length 14, Loop Start 5, Loop End 55, Threshold Uptrend 35, Threshold Downtrend -5.

quasimodo-pattern.text: Detects a three-candle pattern. Bullish: a bearish candle, then a bullish candle with a lower low, then a bar whose low is above the first candle's high. Bearish is the mirror image. The first candle of the pattern is coloured yellow for bullish or magenta for bearish. The Quasimodo Pattern alert fires on the third bar.

r-r-trading-system-framework.text: Backtests ten trade types: five longs above the 200-bar SMA (Stochastic, MA cross, MACD, Bollinger, Supertrend) and five shorts below it. A signal opens a trade at the next open with a stop at Stop % (default 2) and take profits TP 1 to TP 4 at 1 to 4 times the stop distance. The L0 TSL to S9 TSL lines show the trailing stop for the two types picked in A) and B).

r-trend-exhaustion.text: Computes a fast (Fast Length 21) and a slow (Slow Length 112) Williams %R, each smoothed with the Smoothing Type (default ema). When both sit above -Exhaustion Threshold (default 20) an overbought trend starts, and both below -80 mark an oversold one; a triangle marks the bar where the trend ends. The Average formula option uses one smoothed mean of both lines instead.

radiant-mean-reversion-channels.text: Radiant Oscillator shows where the source sits inside a channel built around a Hull moving average, with half-width of ATR times Band Multiplier, scaled 0 to 100 and smoothed. Circles mark a cross up through Oversold (20) and a cross down through Overbought (80); Extreme levels sit at 10 and 90. Channel Length is 21, Band Multiplier 2, Oscillator Smoothing 3.

radius-trend.text: A trailing band set from the 100-bar average bar range. It flips side when close crosses it, and every third bar it is nudged by a step that grows while the trend persists. Radius Trend Band is the smoothed band, light blue in uptrends and red in downtrends, with Outer Band beyond it. Radius Step is 0.15 and Start Points Distance is 2.

rally-base-drop-signals.text: Labels each bar as a rally (two green bars in a row), a drop (two red bars in a row) or a base, and tracks the last three different phases. A triangle with RBD, RBR, DBD or DBR appears when that sequence first forms; drop-ending ones point down above the bar, rally-ending ones point up below. Each sequence has its own toggle, and Bar Color Logic (Full Color) sets bar coloring.

range-analysis-by-leviathan.text: Takes a time range set by Start Time and End Time (both 0, so nothing draws until set) and draws its high, low, half and quarter levels, with optional eighths, Fibonacci and outer levels. It can also add a volume profile split into Resolution rows (30), POC and value-area levels, heatmaps, and an anchored VWAP. Direction (UP) affects labels and Fibonacci levels.

range-average-retest-model.text: Builds swing areas from pivot legs and takes each area's midpoint. When a close crosses an untouched midpoint, 10 to 200 bars after the area ends, it opens a trade with ATR-multiple take-profit and stop-loss boxes. Crossing up gives a short, down a long. Inputs: Pivot Length (20), Selection Mode (BOTH), Threshold (4), Take profit (8), Stop loss (4), Overlap trades (off).

range-breakout.text: Builds a channel around hl2 whose half-width is the 100-bar average of the 200-bar ATR times Channel Width (4), with a mid line in each half, reset after a breakout or 100 bars outside. A circle label marks a break; triangles mark lows or highs crossing the mid lines. Filter Signals by Trends limits triangles to the break direction; Show X signals adds fallback marks.

range-channel-by-atilla-yurtseven.text: Computes a moving average of the source (linear regression by default) and the percent distance of the source from it, shown as the Untrended histogram, green above zero and red below. Positive Mean and Negative Mean are running averages of the positive and negative distances, and they set Upper Edge and Lower Edge around the Moving Average on the price pane. Inputs: Lookback 200, Source close.

range-detector.text: Marks a range when no close in the last Minimum Range Length bars is further from their average than ATR times Range Width. Range Top and Range Bottom hold the band edges; they are blue while price stays inside, green after a close above and red after a close below. Inputs: Minimum Range Length (20), Range Width (1), ATR Length (500).

range-filter-buy-sell-5min.text: Builds a filter that follows the Source but only moves when price leaves a band whose width is a double-smoothed average of bar-to-bar change times Range Multiplier (3). Range Filter is coloured by direction, with High Target and Low Target bands around it. A Buy label shows when price is above a rising filter after a sell state, and Sell the reverse. Sampling Period is 100.

range-filter-dw.text: Builds a filter line that follows price only when it moves beyond a smoothed average of bar-to-bar changes times a multiplier. Upper Band and Lower Band sit one such range above and below the Filter. The Filter is green when rising, red when falling and grey when flat; bars are coloured by direction and close versus the Filter. Defaults: Period 50, Multiplier 3, Source close.

range-identifier.text: Tracks a price range that widens to include each new high and low while the close stays inside the prior range, and resets to the current bar's high and low when the close breaks out. Upper and Lower are coloured green when the close is above the EMA, red otherwise, with Midline halfway between. EMA Length defaults to 34.

range-oscillator.text: Measures how far the close sits from a change-weighted moving average, scaled by ATR times Range Width Multiplier (2), as 100 times that distance over the scaled ATR. Readings beyond the Upper Bound (100) or Lower Bound (-100) levels mean the close left the range, shown in strong colours; Zero separates sides. Minimum Range Length defaults to 50.

range-sentiment-profile.text: Splits the high-low range of the last length bars into rows bins and sums close minus open of the bars overlapping each bin.
