Boxes to the right show each sum as a percent of total body size: blue for positive, orange otherwise, longer for larger sums. Lines mark the range top, bottom and quarter levels. Defaults: length 80, rows 20, Width % 20, offset 8.

range-tightening-indicator.text: Scales each bar's high-low range from 0 to 100 between the lowest and highest range over the lookback, plotted as RTI. The line turns green when it at least doubles after a value at or below 20; an orange dot marks bars after two or more consecutive readings below 20. Zones 0-5 and 5-20 are shaded. Lookback Period defaults to 5, with Custom Lookback Period 50.

ranges-with-targets.text: On the first bar of each day with no open trade, it sets a range around the midpoint of the bar's high and low. A close crossing above the top opens a buy, and one crossing below the bottom opens a sell. Target is the entry plus Target (1.3) times the distance to the opposite side; stop is that side. Green or red labels mark outcomes, and a table counts wins, losses and profit for Risk Per Trade (USD) 100.

rapid-exponential-moving-average.text: Draws 59 filtered lines of the source, one for each period from 1 to 59, using the filter picked in Filters+ (default rema(), an EMA-like filter). Fanned lines show how smoothing changes with period: tighter lines mean agreement across periods, and the period 1 line is the unsmoothed source. Source Series defaults to close.

rbt-strategy.text: Flags reversal bars: a bull bar right after a bear bar, or the reverse, kept only if the switchable filters pass (body 0.3 to 3 times the previous body, previous bar not a doji, not engulfing, older bars in the same direction, range at least the recent mean). A green triangle below the bar is a bullish signal, a red one above is bearish. Prev Candles Same (0–4) defaults to 2 and Mean Candle Range (2-50) to 5.

rci.text: Computes a Spearman rank correlation between price and time over RCI Length bars (default 10), scaled from -100 to 100, with a smoothing line of RCI. Readings near 80 or -80 mark strong rising or falling consistency, and 0 is the middle. Source defaults to close; Type defaults to SMA with Length 14, and BB StdDev 2 applies only to SMA + Bollinger Bands.

rci-3lines.text: Three rank correlation lines, each comparing the ranking of recent source values with their time order, scaled from -100 to 100. Values near the top mean prices have mostly risen across the window, values near the bottom mean they have mostly fallen. Dashed lines sit at High line[%] 80 and Low line[%] -80. Intervals: short interval 9, middle interval 36, long interval 52.

rci-ribbon.text: Computes a rank correlation of the source against time over three window lengths, scaled from -100 to 100, and draws three lines. Values near the top or bottom mean prices have been rising or falling consistently across the window. Dashed levels sit at 0, 80 and -80. Inputs: Source (close), Short RCI Length 10, Middle RCI Length 30, Long RCI Length 50.

rcyc-bullish-bearish-indicator.text: Computes a KDJ oscillator from the stochastic position of the close, smoothed twice, and takes J = 3 times the first smoothed line minus 2 times the second. Candles are recoloured by state: J crossing above the midline gives a red candle then navy ones; crossing below gives yellow then aqua; gray is neutral. Inputs: KDJ Length (9), Signal Smoothing (3), Midline Level (50), Initial State (Auto).

readyfor401ks-just-tell-me-when.text: Draws a baseline moving average of the close (Trend Power based off of, Trend Power Period: 30) with a channel around it, plus a continuation line from the highs and lows. Baseline, channel and bars are aqua above the channel, red below, gray inside. Yellow arrows mark closes crossing the exit line (Calculate Exit off what Period? 8).

realtime-volume-bars.text: Splits each bar's volume into up, down or neutral by comparing the close with the previous close, and draws stacked columns in green, red and grey. In Up/Down mode a flat bar takes the last direction. Show MA adds an exponential average of volume over MA Period (20); Show Net Delta Above Bar writes up minus down volume above each bar.

redk-everex.text: Combines volume (effort) with a six-part price strength score into a bar flow, split into bulls and bears. Their averages form an RSI-like rate of flow, shown as RROF Smooth with a Signal Line. It turns aqua above zero and orange below, and zero crossings raise alerts. Inputs: length (10), Smooth (3), Signal Length (5).

redk-magic-ribbon.text: Plots a Fast Line (compound-weighted average of the source, Length 10, Smooth 3) and a Slow Line (Type RSS_WMA, Length 9). Each line is coloured by its slope, and the ribbon fill is green when both rise, red when neither rises, gray otherwise. MA Alignment Markers (on) put circles on the Slow Line when it and the optional Mood MA and Bias MA line up in one direction.

redk-momentum-bars.text: Draws candles whose open is a delayed slow-average momentum and whose close is fast-average momentum, both measured against a long filter average. Bright green means close above open and rising, red means below and falling, white is mixed; the Zero Line is the filter. Defaults: Fast MA Length 10, Slow MA Length 20, Delay 3, Filter MA Length 50.

redk-rss-wma.text: A weighted moving average applied in three passes, with the Combined Smoothness length split across the passes for a smooth line. SS_WMA Line is green while it rises and red otherwise; a plain WMA over the same length is hidden. Up/Dn Swing Signal? (off) adds triangles at swings, offset by Signal Locator % (1). Combined Smoothness is 15.

redk-tpx.text: Measures bull and bear pressure from one-bar changes in high and low relative to the two-bar range, each averaged with a weighted average. Net Pressure is their smoothed difference, white above zero and gray below. Bull Pressure and Bear Pressure at or above Control Level (30) trigger alerts; with Pressure Signal Line on, Hot and Cold mark them at Signal Level (70). Avg Length 7, Smoothing 3.

redk-vader.text: Measures volume-weighted buying and selling energy from the close change relative to a two-bar range, smoothed by moving averages. VADER Signal is demand minus supply; it is blue at or above zero and orange below. Demand Energy and Supply Energy are drawn separately, and the optional Sentiment histogram is a longer-term version. Defaults: Length 10, Average 5, Smooth 3, Volume Calculation Relative.

redk-vol-weighted-rsi.text: An RSI built from price changes weighted by volume (or by 1 if Volume Weighted ? is off), averaged with a WMA and rescaled to -100..100. K_RSI is the smoothed line, Raw RSI the unsmoothed one, and Sentiment an area using a longer RSI of Sentiment Factor times Length, rounded to Step. Triangles mark K_RSI crossing zero in the Sentiment direction. Defaults: Length 10, Sentiment Factor 3, Smoothing 3, Step 5.

reflex-trendflex.text: Smooths the source with a two-pole low-pass filter, then draws Reflex (cycle) and Trendflex (trend) oscillators, each normalized by a running RMS. Crossings of zero are the basic reads. Threshold + and Threshold - are dynamic levels on one oscillator, set by Threshold mode (MAD default), Apply to (Reflex), Period 50 and Multiplier (k) 1.5. Reflex Period and Trendflex Period default to 20.

regression-channel-oscillator.text: Fits a regression line to the previous Regression Length closes and scales the source's distance from it by RMSE Multiplier (channel) times the fit error, to a -150 to 150 range, then smooths it (Smooth Oscillator, SMA, Smooth Length 3). Green above zero, red below; triangles mark crosses of Oversold Level (-50) and Overbought Level (50). Signal SMA averages it over 30 bars.

relative-atr-volatility-indicator.text: Computes the ATR and ranks it against its own rolling window, using nearest-rank percentiles as thresholds. ATR at or above Top X% Threshold is filled red, and at or below Bottom X% Threshold green, more opaque the further it sits from the threshold; Median ATR is hidden. Defaults: ATR Length 14, Rolling Window Length 100, Top Percentile 80, Bottom Percentile 20.

relative-strength-heatmap.text: Twenty RSIs of the source with lengths growing by RSI Step, each drawn as a coloured tile by its value in the chosen palette. RSI > 70 Count and RSI < 30 Count show how many are overbought or oversold; ten or more tints the price background and triggers the alerts. Defaults: RS Period 1, RSI Step 2, RSI Multiplier 1.

relative-strength-index-divergences-libe.text: RSI of the close, with labels when price sets a new running extreme but RSI fails to follow: BEAR on highs, BULL on lows, plus PIVOT where the RSI extreme stops changing. The line turns red above Overbought (70) or below Oversold (30); the midline is 50. Extremes restart over Div lookback period (bars)? (90); RSI Length is 14.

relative-strength-of-a-stock.text: Compares the stock's change over Period bars with that of the Comparative Symbol: the ratio of the two changes minus 1. The RS line is green above the zero line and red below it, and optional MA smooths it. Confirmation Bubbles appear on RS when the price SMA is rising with price above it, or falling with price below it. Defaults: Comparative Symbol NSE:NIFTY, Period 123.

relative-valuation-oscillator.text: Z-score of the log close against its average and standard deviation over Lookback Period (34). Valuation Score above Overvalued Threshold (Deviation Threshold, 2) reads overvalued, below Undervalued Threshold undervalued, with Fair Value at 0. Circles mark extremes; Preset Configuration can override lookback and threshold.

relative-volume-at-time.text: Compares volume accumulated so far in the current anchor period with the average of the past periods at the same time offset. Columns show the ratio, with a dashed line at 1 and green columns above 1, red otherwise. Inputs: Anchor Timeframe (1D), Length (10 periods), Calculation Mode (Cumulative or Regular), and Adjust Unconfirmed (on) to extrapolate the last bar.

relative-volume-indicator.text: Divides each bar's volume by its simple average over the lookback and draws it as columns. Columns are red below Average Volume Threshold, yellow below Above Average Threshold, green below Extreme Volume Threshold and fuchsia above it, with dotted lines at those three levels. Defaults: Average Volume Lookback Period 20, thresholds 0.8, 1.25 and 4.

renko-boxes.text: Builds Renko-style bricks from the close, with brick size equal to ATR times a multiplier, and draws the current brick as a shaded box between Renko Upper and Renko Lower, with Renko Average at its middle. The box moves in whole bricks when the close passes a brick beyond its edge. Reversal Dots mark bars where direction changes; green means up, red down. Inputs: ATR Length 200, ATR Multiplier 1.

renko-candles-overlay.text: Builds Renko bricks from closes and draws the latest ones as boxes over the price chart. A new brick forms when the close moves one brick size from the last brick; a reversal needs two. Method (ATR/2) sets size, with Atr Period 14, Brick Size 10, Percentage % 0.1 and Number of Bricks 140. Trend is UP and Trend is DOWN alert on turns.

renko-chart.text: Builds Renko bricks over the chart bars, with brick size from the ATR or a fixed size, and a new column needing a 2-brick reversal. Renko Open and Renko Close draw the brick range, while Renko breakout and a trend line built from an EMA of brick closes show direction and trend turns. Key inputs: Method (ATR), [ATR] Atr Period (14), [Traditional] Brick Size (10), Trend EMA Length (34).

renko-compression-index.text: Gives each bar a direction (up, down or flat by the close change) and counts how often the direction switches between consecutive bars over the lookback, as a percentage of the possible pairs. High values mean choppy, compressed price; low values mean trending. Dashed lines at 80 and 20 and a dotted line at 50 frame it. RCI Lookback Length is 10.

renko-flip-alert.text: Compares each closed bar's direction with the previous bar's. A blue triangle appears below a bull bar (close above open) that follows a bear bar, and a red triangle above a bear bar that follows a bull bar, marking a change of candle direction. It has no inputs; the alerts Bullish Renko Flip and Bearish Renko Flip fire on those bars.

renko-mod.text: Draws a renko-style brick line that starts at 0 and steps by one brick per bar. It steps up when the close or high is more than one brick above the prior open, and down when the close or low is more than one brick below it. Renko Open is marked with green crosses after an up move and maroon after a down move; Renko Close trails one brick behind as gray circles. Brick Size: defaults to 0.0005.

renko-moving-average-rmi-alert-r3-by.text: Combines a moving average, a period open line and a Relative Momentum Index to mark trades. MA Plot is lime when rising and red when falling; Daily Open is the first source value of each period. Arrows mark long and short starts when the RMI reaches Overbought 70 or Oversold 30; crosses mark exits. Defaults: MA - Length 6, Momentum Length 5.

renko-sniper-pro.text: Plots a fast and a slow EMA of the close (Fast EMA 9, Slow EMA 21) and a Supertrend line, green when its direction is 1 and red otherwise. Supertrend ATR Length (10) and Supertrend Factor (3) set it. Triangles mark bars that break the Liquidity Lookback (bars) (10) extreme and close back inside, but as coded they never appear.

res-sup-with-concavity-increasing-decrea.text: Draws Resistance and Support as the highest high and lowest low of 20 bars, with x marks when a bar reaches the prior level. First Derivative and Second Derivative are thick smoothed lines; their colours and the fill between them show whether price rose against 50 bars ago and whether that gain grew. The background marks flat regression periods, judged by Range Accuracy 0.005 on src hlc3.

retail-vs-banker-net-positions-symmetry-.text: Splits volume into institutional and retail parts by bar size and trend direction, then plots each as a smoothed net up-versus-down percentage over Net Position Lookback (bars). A symmetry break marks an outlier jump in the Institutional (proxy) line while Retail (proxy) stays quiet or moves opposite, with a cooldown. Key inputs: Trend EMA 50, Smoothing (EMA) 5, Cooldown bars between signals 40.

retest-support-resistance-signals.text: Takes pivot highs and lows, by wick or body, and draws a level when price leaves one and later retests it with a bullish bar (support) or bearish bar (resistance), marked with an R. Lines extend forward, change colour by close above or below them, and stop after the set breakouts or bars. Defaults: Left Bars 20, Right Bars 20, Breakouts Until Level Deletes 1, Bars Until Level Deletes 300.

reversal.text: Finds a bar closing below the lows (or above the highs) of the previous Candle Lookback minus 1 bars and keeps it as an active bull (or bear) candle. A V Up triangle below a bar appears when a later close passes that candle's high within Confirm Within bars; V Dn above a bar is the mirror case below its low. Candle Lookback defaults to 20, Confirm Within to 3; Non-Repainting Mode (off) delays signals one bar.

reversal-candle-setup.text: Looks for a run of same-colour candles followed by a reversal. After Lookback red candles, a green candle closing above the previous high gets a BullRev arrow below the bar; after Lookback green candles, a red candle closing below the previous low gets a BearRev arrow above. Lookback defaults to 3.

reversal-candlestick-structure.text: Detects 16 candlestick patterns and labels only those that go against the short-term trend, read from a stochastic of the close and a smoothed copy. Bullish patterns are marked under the bar in a down trend, bearish ones above it in an up trend. Main inputs: Trend Length (14), Threshold (80), Warmup Length (20).

reversal-correlation-pressure.text: Measures how the correlation between highs and lows over Length bars compares with its own average and spread over five times that span, clamped to 0 to 2 and drawn as columns. Columns above 1 take a blue-to-magenta gradient, others are grey. Price-pane arrows and bar colours appear when a close z-score beyond plus or minus 2 passes a rolling win-rate check. Length defaults to 21.

reversal-probability-zone-levels.text: Detects reversals when the candle body makes a new high or low over Swing Length bars, then stores each leg's price move and bar count. At each new reversal it draws a box sized by the largest enabled percentile of past opposite moves, with lines and labels at 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th. Defaults: Swing Length 20, Maximum Reversals 1000. Show Marks dots each reversal.

reversal-scalper-2-0-adib-noorani.text: Plots Reversal Strength Meter, a moving average of a stochastic of the close, between Potential Supply Zone at 80 and Potential Demand Zone at 20. Readings near either line suggest an stretched move. Hidden ATR bands from a trend baseline shade ribbons on the price pane, and bars closing outside them turn black or white. Main inputs: Stochastic K Length 8, Stochastic Smoothing SMA 5, Amplitude (Highest/Lowest Bars) 3, ATR Deviation Factor 3.

reversal-signals.text: Counts consecutive closes against the close 4 bars earlier up to 9, marking completed momentum phases. A completed bullish phase sets a Resistance Levels line (9-bar high) and a bearish one sets a Support Levels line (9-bar low), each kept until a close breaks it. A trend exhaustion count to 13 gives an E label. Display Phases defaults to Completed; risk, target and trade setup options are off.

reversal-trap-probability-bands.text: Draws an envelope around a 55-bar EMA of the close, plus and minus 4 times the ATR. A trap signal appears when price closes back inside a band after poking beyond it. Each trap sets a dashed target at the baseline, a dashed stop and a win-rate label by RSI bucket. Inputs: Envelope Smoothness 55, Envelope Width 4, Trap Window (Candles) 10.

rhokeo-vw-rsi-histogram-for-cumulative-d.text: Volume-weighted RSI: price changes times volume are split into gains and losses, smoothed, turned into an RSI, rescaled to -1 to +1 and smoothed again by RSI MA Type. The VW-RSI Histogram changes colour above VW-RSI OB Level (0.4), above zero, above VW-RSI OS Level (-0.4) and below it. RSI Length defaults to 9.

ripster-ema-clouds.text: Plots five pairs of EMAs of the source, each pair shaded as a cloud. A cloud takes its bullish colour when the short EMA is at or above the long one and its bearish colour when below; lines change colour with rising or falling. Defaults: Source hl2, pairs 8/9, 5/12, 34/50, 72/89 and 180/200 set by Short EMA1 to Long EMA5.

rising-three-methods.text: Looks for a five-candle bullish continuation in an uptrend: a long up candle, three small down candles that open below its high and close above its low, then a long up candle closing above the first close. The label marks the last bar. Detect Trend Based On defaults to SMA50.

rising-window.text: Flags a two-candle bullish continuation pattern: the previous bar was in an uptrend, both bars have a non-zero range, and the current low sits above the prior high, leaving a gap. A label marks the bar where it forms. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the uptrend is judged.

risk-management-tool.text: Plans a trade from Entry Price (40000), or from the open after a close cross when Entry From Cross is on. Take Profit and Stop Loss (5 % each) can be ATR, percent, price or range. Boxes, labels and a table show risk/reward and position size from Account Size (1000) and Risk (2 %); Position Type sets Long or Short.

rma-atr-bands.text: Draws an RMA of the source with an upper band above it and a lower band below it, each offset by ATR times its own multiplier. A close above the upper band turns the trend up, a close below the lower band turns it down. Line, bands and bars take the trend colour, and Long Signal and Short Signal mark each turn. Defaults: Source high, Length 14, ATR Length 13, multipliers 0.4 and 1.6.

rmi-trend-sniper.text: Averages an RSI built from close changes with the MFI, then flips a trend state bullish when that value crosses above Positive above with a rising 5-period EMA, or bearish when it falls below Negative below with the EMA falling. While a state is active, a range-weighted moving average is drawn, shifted down in a bullish trend and up in a bearish one, with a band around it. Defaults: RMI Length 14, Positive above 66, Negative below 30. BUY and SELL alerts fire when the state turns.

rob-booker-ziv-ghost-pivots.text: Takes the typical price (high, low and close averaged) of the current day, week and month, plus a 4-hour period, and marks it on every bar of that period with a character: 8, d, w or m. The Close Price line is also drawn. Show Next Day (8 HR) Pivot, Show Next Week Pivot and Show Next Month Pivot are on by default; Show Next 4 HR Pivot has no effect.

robby-dss-bressert-colored-dots.text: Double smoothed stochastic: the close's stochastic over Stochastic Period (120) is smoothed with an EMA of Smoothing Period (EMA) 60, then the stochastic and EMA are applied again. DSS Dots are lime while rising and red while falling, read against dashed Overbought Level 80 and Oversold Level 20 lines.

roc.text: Computes the percentage change of the Source over the last length bars, plotted in its own pane as ROC around a flat Zero Line. Readings above zero mean price is higher than length bars ago, and below zero mean it is lower. Defaults are length 9 and Source close.

roc-weighted-ma-oscillator.text: Pulls a moving average of the source toward the source by a weight from the rate of change scaled 0 to 1, then takes the z-score of that over ROC Length bars. Oscillator bars turn bull colour above Neutral Threshold and bear colour below its negative; Signal is an EMA of it, with bounds at 3, 2.5, -2.5 and -3. Defaults: ROC Length 55, MA Length 7, Signal Length 9, Neutral Threshold 0.5.

rolling-liquidity-clusters-channel.text: Over a rolling window, finds the highest candle body top and lowest body bottom. Upper Level is the lowest bar high at or above that body top, Lower Level the highest bar low at or below that body bottom, and Mid Level their average. Price near either outer level is at the edge of the channel. Window Size defaults to 20.

rolling-sharpe-ratio-oscillator-astral-v.text: Rolling Sharpe ratio of daily log returns: mean over standard deviation across Lookback Period (days), scaled by the square root of 365, then smoothed by an EMA. Values beyond Overbought Threshold (2.8) or Oversold Threshold (-1.5) are filled, and Overbought Price and Oversold Price show matching price levels. Smoothing EMA Length is 30, Lookback 365.

rolling-trendline.text: A straight line advancing each bar by a slope taken from a linear regression over Slope Lookback bars (default 100), divided by Slope Divisor (1.5). When the Source strays from the line by more than Deviation Multiplier (2) standard deviations, the line resets to the source at a Reset Point. Upper Band and Lower Band sit ATR Multiplier (3) times the ATR (ATR Length 200) from the line.

rolling-vwap.text: Volume-weighted average price over a rolling time window rather than a session, plotted as Rolling VWAP. Optional bands sit above and below at a multiple of the volume-weighted deviation, shown only when Bands multiplier 1, 2 or 3 is above 0 (default 0). Window is automatic from timeframe, or set by Use a fixed time period (Days 1), with at least Bars (10) kept.

ross-cameron-inspired-day-trading-strate.text: Draws an EMA and an SMA with BUY and SELL labels from three rules: an open gap of Gap Percentage (4) from the prior close, RSI crossings of the Over Sold and Over Bought levels versus the EMA, and the same RSI crossings versus the SMA. Momentum and reversion signals need a Confirmation Period (3) check.

rrr-ema-ignition-buy-sell.text: Plots EMA 9, EMA 21 and EMA 55 of the Source. BUY labels appear below the bar when a bull trend is active, price is above EMA 55, EMA 9 is above EMA 21, the candle is green, EMA 55 slopes up, ADX is above Min ADX (20) and the close is far enough from EMA 55 by ATR Distance Multiplier (0.6) times ATR. SELL is the mirror.

rs-macd.text: Computes MACD as the fast EMA minus the slow EMA of the Source, a Signal line as the SMA of MACD, and a Histogram as their difference, with a zero line. MACD is green when above Signal and not falling, Signal is red when above MACD and not rising; Histogram Line is dark when it does not rise. Defaults: Source: ohlc4, Fast Length: 12, Slow Length: 24, Signal Length: 6.

rs-rating.text: Builds a raw strength score from weighted ratios of the close to its value 63, 126, 189 and 252 bars back, then rescales it to 1 to 99 between its lowest and highest values over the Distribution window (252). Higher readings mean stronger recent performance within that range. Nothing shows until Minimum bars before output (189) bars exist. Weight 3M is 2 and the other weights are 1.

rs-support-resistance.text: Finds the latest high (low) that matched the highest high (lowest low) of two lookback windows, giving short-term lines STR and STS and wider long-term lines LTR and LTS. Lines break when the level changes; circles .R and .S mark new long-term levels. Two L lines are trade limits inside the short-term range. Inputs: lookback window 1: 8, lookback window 2: 21, Percent of the diff to use for trade zone 25.
names: Percent of the diff to use for trade zone

rsi.text: Computes RSI of the Source over RSI Length (14) and plots it against levels at 30, 50 and 70, with a smoothing average of the RSI (Type SMA, Length 14) and optional Bollinger bands. With Calculate Divergence on, labels mark regular bullish or bearish divergences between RSI pivots and price pivots.

rsi-50-step-line.text: Step line on the price chart holding the close of the last bar where the RSI crossed 50 in either direction, flat until the next cross. Four colours show whether the close is above or below that level and whether the RSI is rising or falling; circles mark each cross. Main inputs: RSI Length 9 and RSI Source close.

rsi-5up.text: RSI built from smoothed up and down changes of the Source, shown with levels at 70, 50 and 30 and shading between 70 and 30. An optional RSI-based MA (default SMA, Length 14) can add Upper and Lower Bollinger Band lines using BB StdDev 2. With Calculate Divergence on, Regular Bullish and Regular Bearish divergences are labelled and can fire alerts. RSI Length is 14.

rsi-adx-atr-18-01-25.text: Shows RSI, a simple ADX (average of directional movement difference) and ATR in one pane. The background turns red when RSI is between its lower and upper bounds, ADX is under its threshold and ATR is under its threshold, which also fires the alert. Defaults: RSI Length 14, bounds 40 and 60, ADX Threshold 20, ATR Threshold 2.5.
names: RSI Lower Bound for BG Color
RSI Upper Bound for BG Color
RSI, ADX, and ATR Condition Met

rsi-adx-atr-combo.text: Plots the RSI, an ADX built from smoothed directional movement, and the ATR in one pane. The background turns fuchsia when the RSI is between RSI Lower Bound (40) and RSI Upper Bound (60), the ADX is below ADX Threshold (20) and the ATR is below ATR Threshold (2.5), marking a quiet, range-bound market. All lengths default to 14.

rsi-alternative-derivation.text: Builds an RSI from the distance of close to its Wilder average, divided by the Wilder average of absolute close changes, scaled by Length minus 1 and mapped to 0..100 around 50. Show Steps picks which stage is drawn, default RSI. Plot Regular RSI for Comparison adds the standard RSI. Length defaults to 14.

rsi-bands.text: Draws price levels at which RSI would reach the overbought and oversold thresholds, using smoothed average up and down moves over a window of twice RSI Length minus one. Resistance is the overbought price level, Support the oversold one, and RSI Midline their average. Inputs: RSI Overbought 70, RSI Oversold 30, RSI Length 14.

rsi-bars-onlyflow.text: Colours the price candles by the RSI. At or above Overbought the colour moves through the three overbought shades as the RSI nears 100; at or below Oversold the oversold shades do the same toward 0. Between them candles take a neutral colour. Optionally shows the RSI line with levels. Inputs: RSI Length 14, Overbought 70, Oversold 30, gradient mode on.

rsi-bb-dispersion.text: Computes RSI with bands on it: an EMA basis of BB Length 20 plus and minus BB Multiplier 2 times the RSI standard deviation. Dispersion Upper and Dispersion Lower lie around BB Basis by Dispersion (0.1) of the band width; RSI is green above the upper, red below the lower, else yellow. Levels: Overbought 70, Oversold 30.

rsi-bb-oversold-scalper-with-macd-confir.text: A setup needs the lowest Bollinger %b over BB%b Lookback (candles) of 20 below 0, the lowest RSI over RSI Lookback (candles) of 10 below 30, and DSS crossing over its signal below 20. A MACD line crossing above its signal within MACD Lookback(candles) of 15 bars of the setup draws a Buy Signal label below the bar.

rsi-bb-stddev-signal.text: Computes an RSI and a moving average of it, plus Bollinger Bands (average plus or minus a multiple of the standard deviation) on the RSI. Buy and sell signals come from RSI crossing its average or the bands, and from regular divergences, filtered by RSI zones, Reentry pause and Wait Opposite. Main inputs: Length 14 for the average, bands and RSI, StdDev 2, sell zone 60 to 80, buy zone 20 to 40.

rsi-candle-color.text: Colours each candle by an RSI of the close after a 1-2-2-1 weighted smoothing, reshaped by a power curve around 50 and mapped onto a gradient. The gradient runs blue, green, yellow, red, then purple, so the candle colour shows where the reshaped RSI sits from 0 to 100. Inputs: Length 8 sets the RSI period, Hue Shift 0 rotates the gradient hues, and Luminance Style defaults to Standard. Source is not used.

rsi-candles.text: Applies RSI separately to open, high, low and close, then draws the results as candles on a 0 to 100 scale, teal when the RSI close is at or above the RSI open and red otherwise. Dashed levels mark Overbought (level 70), Middle (level 50) and Oversold (level 30). Default RSI Length is 14.

rsi-colored-price-candles-with-backgroun.text: Computes an RSI from smoothed average gains and losses of the chosen source, and paints the price candles lime when it is at or above 50, otherwise red. With Show Overbought/Oversold Background on (default off), the background turns green above 70 and red below 30. Main inputs are RSI Length (14) and RSI Source (close).

rsi-confirm-trend-with-williams.text: Plots a 14-bar RSI of the close with a moving average of it, RSI MA. The background turns green when RSI is at or above RSI Upper Threshold and Williams %R is at least -20, and light cyan when only the RSI condition holds. Red and pink mark the same on the lower side, with %R at most -80. Thresholds default to 55 and 45; MA Type defaults to SMA, MA Length to 14.

rsi-core-levels-heatmap.text: RSI of the close with an SMA signal line, drawn in its own pane around a Middle Line (level 50). RSI (Gradiented) shifts from the bullish to the bearish colour between 30 and 70, with square markers for overbought, oversold and the 40-60 zone. Crossovers of RSI and Signal on a closed bar mark support or resistance levels on the price chart. Inputs: RSI Length 14, Signal Line Length 14, Max Active Levels & Labels 5.

rsi-cyclic-smoothed.text: Takes an RSI of the Source and passes it through a two-pole low-pass smoothing filter to give CRSI. LowBand and HighBand are adaptive levels from recent CRSI history, with 10 percent of values below the low and 10 percent above the high. Fixed dashed lines mark 70 and 30. Defaults: RSI Length 14, Smooth Length 5, Source close.

rsi-cyclic-smoothed-v2.text: An RSI of half the Dominant Cycle Length (20), smoothed with a phase lead, drawn as CRSI. LowBand and HighBand are adaptive bounds taken from the last two cycles of CRSI values, each placed where about 10% of values lie beyond it. CRSI near or past the bands marks relatively low or high readings; fixed lines sit at 30 and 70.

rsi-divergence.text: Subtracts a slow RSI from a fast RSI and plots the difference as one line named Divergence around a zero line. The line is green when the fast RSI is above the slow one and red when it is below. Inputs: Length Fast RSI 5, Length Slow RSI 14, and Source (close).

rsi-divergence-indicator.text: Plots RSI and compares its pivot lows and highs with price pivots to flag Regular Bullish, Hidden Bullish, Regular Bearish and Hidden Bearish divergences, with labels on the pivot. Levels sit at Oversold 30, Middle Line 50 and Overbought 70. Inputs: RSI Period (14), Pivot Lookback Right and Left (5 each), Max of Lookback Range (60), Min of Lookback Range (5).

rsi-ema-crossing-with-donchian-stop-loss.text: Draws a Donchian channel (Donchian Upper, Donchian Lower, Donchian Basis) and a moving average of the close, Preis MA. A yellow-shaded signal bar is where RSI crosses above its own average with the close above Preis MA; a green label marks the first later close above that bar's high. Stop-Loss follows the lower band. Inputs: Donchian Kanal Länge 48, RSI Länge 7, SMA RSI Länge 14, Preis MA Länge 50.

rsi-ema-mzones-with-divergences.text: RSI of the source with an EMA of it, RSI EMA, light blue when rising or flat and orange when falling. Zone lines sit at 80, 65, 50, 35 and 20, and pivot-based regular and hidden divergences against price are marked and alerted. Defaults: RSI Period 14, EMA Length 21, pivot lookbacks 5 left and right, range 5 to 60 bars.

rsi-entry-engine.text: Computes RSI, smooths it, and draws a signal line as a second average of that. The RSI line turns red at or above Extreme High and green at or below Extreme Low. An UP label shows when RSI crosses over Extreme Low, and a DOWN label when it crosses under Extreme High, with optional TP/SL boxes. Defaults: 📏 RSI Length 14, 🚨 Extreme High 80, ✅ Extreme Low 20, 💎 Risk / Reward 5.

rsi-fibonacci-hh-ll-support-resistance.text: Builds adaptive averages of the high and the low, whose speed depends on how often the highest high rises or the lowest low falls over length bars. The Midline is their average, with six upper and six lower levels at Fibonacci-based multiples of half their gap. The Midline is lime when above its value 5 bars earlier, red otherwise. The length input defaults to 55.

rsi-flux-charts.text: Records the RSI at each pivot high and pivot low, builds a density curve for each side, and places the current RSI on both. A faint arrow marks bars where the RSI sits in the zone of past lows (up) or highs (down); a full arrow follows when that run ends, with the RSI and probability. Main inputs: RSI Length 14, High Pivot Length 21, Low Pivot Length 21, Activation Threshold Medium, Kernel Gaussian.

rsi-games-1-2.text: RSI with an optional smoothing average, and Bollinger Bands when Type is SMA + Bollinger Bands. RSI is green above its average and red below; arrows mark RSI re-crossing inside the bands, and labels mark regular and hidden divergences with price. Main inputs: RSI Length (14), Type, Length (14), BB StdDev (2).

rsi-hash-capital.text: A doubly smoothed RSI of RSI Period 13 on hlc3, with Smoothing 3. The line is lime below the Oversold Level (30), red above the Overbought Level (70) and white between, with a midline at 50. Dots mark momentum turning up from below 20 or down from above 80; an optional Signal Line Type averages the RSI, and Calculate Divergence adds Bull and Bear labels.

rsi-histoalert.text: Computes RSI of the close minus 50, scaled by RSIHistoModify (1.5), drawn as the RSI HistoAlert line and a Histogram that is green at or above zero and red below. Level lines sit at 0 and at BuyAlertLevel (-10) and SellAlertLevel (10). Price bars turn green when the value is above the buy level, red when below the sell level, else keep the last state. RSIPeriod is 13.

rsi-ma-cross-divergence-signal.text: Crosses the RSI with a moving average of itself and requires a divergence against the last pivot lows or highs. Bullish Signal and Bearish Signal triangles appear on a cross up or down. Key inputs are RSI Length (14), RSI MA Length (9) and Divergence Lookback (L=R) (5).

rsi-macd-suite.text: Combines an RSI with bands at 70, 50 and 30 and a MACD in one pane. MACD is fast minus slow average of a source, with a signal average and a histogram (MACD - Histogram) that is teal at or above zero and red below. Length is 14, Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9; Oscillator MA Type and Signal MA Type default to EMA.

rsi-macd-v3-2.text: Shows the RSI minus 50 (RSI Period 14), drawn orange when RSI is at or beyond Overbought Level (70) or Oversold Level (30). MACD and Signal are rescaled to the RSI's range and drawn as columns. Bull and Bear labels mark price and RSI pivot divergences; hidden ones are off by default. Key inputs: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9.

rsi-modified.text: An RSI built from simple averages of gains and losses over Period (14), with RSI MA as its simple average over RSI MA Period (9). RSI is blue at or above Overbought (70), red at or below Oversold (30) and green between, with the area beyond those levels shaded. Dashed lines also mark a midpoint of 50 and range bounds set by Range (100).

rsi-momentum-divergence.text: Applies an RSI to the 10-bar change in close and plots it in its own pane with a midline at 50, shaded above 70 and below 30. It looks for divergences between RSI pivots and price pivots: price lower low with RSI higher low gives a Bull label, price higher high with RSI lower high gives a Bear label. Inputs: RSI Length (14), Enable Divergence Detection (on), Qty Divergence Zones (10).

rsi-multi-length.text: Computes an RSI for every length from Minimum Length to Maximum Length and averages them into Average Multi Length RSI. Upper Channel and Lower Channel pull toward that average by the share of RSIs above overbought or below oversold; the Overbought Area and Oversold Area show those shares in percent. Defaults: Maximum Length 20, Minimum Length 10, overbought 70, oversold 30.

rsi-multi-levels.text: Computes three RSIs of the close, with Short RSI Length 7, Mid RSI Length 14 and Long RSI Length 42, in a separate pane. Dashed horizontal levels run from 10 to 90, with 50 in red, and shaded bands mark zones on each side of 50 (Low, Mid and High Potential Zone). A trader compares where each RSI sits against these levels and bands.

rsi-multicolor-editable.text: Computes a standard RSI of the close from smoothed average gains and losses, and draws it against five editable levels. The area of the RSI above Overbought (70) is filled red and the area below Oversold (30) green; grey bands sit between the noise levels (60 and 40) and the outer levels, with Neutral at 50. Length is 14.

rsi-perfect-flip-dots.text: Takes the RSI of the source, then a fast 5-period and a slow 14-period EMA of that RSI. An up arrow shows while the fast EMA is above the slow one, a down arrow while below; a large green dot under the bar marks a cross up, a large red dot above marks a cross down, on closed bars. Inputs: RSI Length (14), Source (close).

rsi-potential.text: Works out the close that would push the next bar's RSI to the Overbought Level (75) or Oversold Level (25). Upside Potential is the percent distance up to the overbought price, Downside Potential the percent distance down to the oversold price. Net Potential is upside minus downside, in columns that are green above zero and red otherwise. RSI Length defaults to 14.

rsi-snabbel.text: Plots two RSI lines of the same source, a fast one and a slow one, in a separate pane. Horizontal reference lines are drawn at 80, 55, 50, 45 and 20, labelled Overbought, Upper Mid, Midline, Lower Mid and Oversold. Crossings of RSI Fast and RSI Slow can be read directly. Inputs: Fast RSI Length 7, Slow RSI Length 14, Source close.

rsi-stoch-band-oscillator.text: Works out the prices at which RSI and slow Stochastic would hit their overbought and oversold levels, then plots the close's position between the resulting bands: 0 at the lower band, 100 at the upper. Red fill above 100 and green below 0 flag stretches. Key inputs: RSI Length 14, RSI Overbought 70, RSI Oversold 30, ADX Threshold 25.

rsi-stoch-rsi-marx-capital.text: Shows the RSI and a Stochastic RSI in one pane: %K is a moving average of the stochastic of the RSI, and %D is a moving average of %K. RSI Overbought and RSI Oversold default to 70 and 30 with a purple zone, StochRSI levels sit at 80 and 20, and optional lines mark 0, 50 and 100. Defaults: RSI Length 14, Smooth K 3, Smooth D 3.

rsi-strategy.text: Computes RSI of the close and keeps a state: 1 when RSI is above Overbought, -1 when below Oversold, otherwise the previous state. Bars are coloured green in state 1, red in state -1, and blue otherwise, including before any level is crossed. Inputs: Length (12), Oversold (30), Overbought (70).

rsi-supply-demand.text: Builds four supply and demand zones from RSI of different lengths. Once RSI stays overbought or oversold for the Confirmation Bars, that bar's high and low become the zone edges and carry forward. Price entering a zone triggers its alert. Defaults: RSI Length 7, 14, 21, 28 (only the second zone shown), Overbought Level 70, Oversold Level 30, Confirmation Bars 3.

rsi-support-resistance-by-dgt.text: Computes an RSI of close or OBV and, each time it crosses the Overbought, Bull Zone, Bear Zone or Oversold thresholds, keeps a price from that bar as a level on the chart. Reverse RSI labels show the price needed now to bring the RSI to each threshold. Defaults are Length 14, Overbought 70, Bull Zone 60, Bear Zone 40 and Oversold 30.

rsi-swing-indicator-v2.text: Draws price swings from RSI extremes. A swing high begins when RSI reaches RSI Overbought (70) after being oversold; a swing low begins at RSI Oversold (30) after being overbought. The point follows new highs or lows during the phase, labelled HH, LH, HL or LL, with a line to the prior swing. RSI Length defaults to 7.

rsi-swing-signal.text: Plots RSI, coloured red above the overbought level, lime below the oversold level, otherwise blue, with a dashed midpoint at 50. The background turns lime or red on a reversal bar after a lookback-window low or high while RSI is, or just was, oversold or overbought. The RSI SIGNAL alert fires on any of these. Defaults: Lookback: 7, RSI Overbought Level: 80, RSI Oversold Level: 20, RSI Length: 7.

rsi-tops-bottoms.text: Plots RSI with Upper Band and Lower Band, then finds the RSI extreme during each overbought or oversold stay. When RSI leaves the zone and the new extreme diverges from price versus the previous one, an arrow line is drawn and the bar is coloured. Inputs: RSI Length 14, Upper Band 70, Lower Band 30.

rsi-trend-bias.text: Plots the RSI of the close and keeps a trend state, bearish at first. It turns bullish when the RSI crosses over Upper Threshold and bearish when it crosses under Lower Threshold; the RSI line takes the colour of the state. Inputs: Length (14), Upper (70), Lower (30), Change Background Color? (false) shades the price background.

rsi-trend-navigator.text: Builds an adaptive average of the price, shifted by the smoothed RSI scaled by ATR, then runs a trailing line through ATR bands around it. The RSI Trend Line is bullish after it rises and bearish after it falls, with a fill toward the bar midpoint. Key inputs: RSI Period 14, RSI Smoothing 5, Base Trend Period 21, RSI Sensitivity 0.5, ATR Period 14, ATR Multiplier 1.5.

rsi-trendlines-with-breakouts.text: Computes an RSI and finds its pivot lows and highs, then joins rising pivot lows (or falling pivot highs) with a solid line, continued by a dashed trendline. A "Br" label marks a break when RSI moves more than RSI Difference (3) beyond the line; levels sit at 70 and 30. Main inputs: Lookback Range (4), RSI Length (14), Repainting (On).

rsi-with-auto-zone-colors-overbought-ove.text: Computes the 14-bar RSI of the close, with no inputs. The RSI line is green at or above 70, red at or below 30 and blue between. The background is shaded green when RSI is above 70 and red when below 30, with dashed lines at 70, 30 and 50.

rsi-zone-step-lines.text: Draws two step lines on the price chart. Upper Level (RSI Cross Above) takes the close when RSI crosses above the upper threshold, Lower Level (RSI Cross Below) takes it when RSI crosses below the lower one; each holds until its next cross, with circles at the crosses. The fill between is green with RSI above, red below, gray between. RSI Length is 9; thresholds 55 and 45.

rvi.text: Compares the close-to-open move with the high-to-low range: both are smoothed with a short weighted average (weights 1, 2, 2, 1) and summed over Length bars, then divided to give RVGI. Signal is a weighted smoothing of RVGI, so crossings of the two lines show shifts in momentum. Length defaults to 10; Offset defaults to 0 and shifts the plots in bars.

rvol.text: Takes the standard deviation of the close over length (default 10), splits it into up-bar and down-bar parts, smooths each with a 14-period EMA, and plots up share of the total times 100 as RVI. Levels sit at 80, 50 and 20; RVI-based MA smooths it (Type SMA, Length 14). Offset (default 0) shifts the lines in bars.

rvol-effort-matrix.text: Divides volume by its simple average over Average Volume Lookback (default 22) and colours it by zone using Average Volume Threshold 0.702, Above Average Threshold 1.414 and Extreme Volume Threshold 4. Buy volume is estimated at 70% on up candles, 30% on down candles and 50% otherwise. With Show Buy/Sell Ratio Overlay on (default), Relativity Overlay, Buy RVOL and Sell RVOL are drawn; off shows Total RVOL columns.

rvol-relative-volume-intraday.text: Divides the session's cumulative volume so far by the average cumulative volume at the same time of day over the past Number of Days (5) sessions. RVOL columns are green on up bars and red on down bars, brighter as the ratio grows; values above 1 mean more volume than usual. Levels sit at 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5 and 2. Daylight saving on last weekend (0) shifts the hour in the last week.

s-r-breakout-atr-confirmation.text: Draws Resistance and Support as the highest high and lowest low of the prior Support/Resistance Length (20) bars. A BUY label and green background appear when the close breaks above Resistance with a candle body larger than ATR (ATR Length 14) times ATR Strength Multiplier (1); SELL and red mirror this below Support. With Use Volume Filter on, volume must also exceed its average over Volume MA Length (20).

sar-ema-macd.text: Plots a parabolic SAR as dots and a 200-bar EMA of close, and adds Buy and Sell labels when SAR, MACD histogram and trend agree. Buy: SAR below the low, histogram crossing above zero, ohlc4 not below the EMA. Sell: the mirror case. Inputs: SAR Start 0.02, SAR Increment 0.02, SAR Max 0.2, EMA Length 200.

saty-atr-levels.text: Draws price levels around the previous period's close, spaced in multiples of that period's ATR: Lower Trigger and Upper Trigger at a fraction of ATR, Fibonacci steps up to 100%, and out to 300% with Show Extensions. Price moving toward the 100% or -100% lines shows a full ATR move. Trading Type (Day) sets the period, ATR Length 14, Trigger Percentage 0.236.

saty-pivot-ribbon.text: Draws EMAs of the close (Fast EMA 8, Pivot EMA 21, Slow EMA 34) with two clouds: fast/pivot and pivot/slow, each in its bullish colour while the first is at or above the second. Fast Conviction EMA (13) and Slow Conviction EMA (48) give an up triangle when fast returns to at or above slow and a down triangle when it drops below. Time Warp (off by default) computes the EMAs on another timeframe.

savitzky-flow-bands.text: Smooths the last 16 closes with fixed weighted coefficients, averaged over Length minus 1 bars, as the Filter. Bands sit two times the 100-bar average high-low range around it and ratchet like a trailing stop. Trend Band follows the lower band in an up trend and the upper band in a down trend, with Trend Extinguishing fading as the trend ages. Length defaults to 15.

savitzky-golay-hampel-filter-alphanatt.text: Applies a weighted Savitzky-Golay kernel to recent closes, replacing closes flagged as outliers by a Hampel test (distance from the median beyond Hampel Threshold times scaled MAD) with the first filter value, then a WMA smooths it. The line is cyan when rising with close above it or a strong slope, magenta otherwise. Alerts SG-Hampel Bull Cross and SG-Hampel Bear Cross fire on close crossings. Defaults: Polynomial Order 2, Window Size 21, Hampel Threshold 3, Final Smoothing 3.

scalp-pro.text: A MACD built from smoothed filters rather than moving averages: MACD is the fast filter of the close minus the slow filter, scaled up, and Signal is a further smoothing of it. A Buy label appears when MACD crosses above Signal and a Sell label when it crosses below. Fast Line defaults to 8, Slow Line to 10 and Smoothness to 8.

scalping-line.text: Subtracts a smoothed reference average from a short average of close. The reference is a double-smoothed SMA, used only when it lies outside a percent band around close, otherwise close itself. Scalp Line above Zero fills green, below fills red; crossing zero triggers BUY ALARM! or SELL ALARM!. Inputs: Percent 1, Main Period 100, Signal Period 7.

scalping-pullback-tool.text: Builds a channel from EMAs of the high, low and close (High Low PAC channel Length 34) plus fast, medium and slow close EMAs (89, 200, 600), using Heikin Ashi candles by default. Bars are blue above the channel, red below, gray inside; background shows trend; arrows mark pullback recoveries, with Buy Condition and Sell Condition alerts. Pullback Lookback for PAC Cross Check is 3.
names: Pullback Lookback for PAC Cross Check

scalping-swing-trading-tool-r1-4-by-just.text: Draws EMAs of the high, low and close as a Price Action Channel (High Low PAC Length 10), plus an EMA 5-12 channel, three long EMAs and a 12-to-36 ribbon. Bars turn blue at or above the channel top, red at or below the bottom, gray inside. Show PAC Swing Alerts adds BUY/SELL arrows on the first close outside the channel, filtered by Filter PAC Alerts with 200ema (on).

scalping-tool-dynamic-tp-sl.text: Fast and slow EMAs give BUY and SELL labels when they cross. A signal opens a trade at the close, with a take profit set by percentage or ATR multiple and a stop loss offset by an ATR multiple; the take profit resets from the close when reached, and the trade ends on the opposite cross. Inputs: Fast Length 5, Slow Length 13, ATR Length 14, Buy Take Profit (%) 0.3.

scalpmap-ema-pivot-targets.text: Plots a 34-period EMA of the close plus the five nearest pivot levels above the close (Pivot H1 to H5) and below it (Pivot L1 to L5). Pivots come from closes and from highs and lows, a level is dropped after two close crossings, and gaps are filled with levels spaced by recent average true range. Key inputs: Tight Close Lookback 5, Wide Wick Lookback 20, Minimum Swing Distance 10.

sce-gann-predictions.text: Averages the bar-by-bar close minus open as a velocity and projects it from the close n bars back, scaled by a ratio. The ratio between Min ratio for the GANN Wave and Max ratio for the GANN Wave with the lowest error against recent closes is kept, and GANN plots its smoothed result: teal when the close is above, red when below. Lookback defaults to 15, step 0.01.
names: Min ratio for the GANN Wave
Max ratio for the GANN Wave
Step for the GANN Wave ratio
Select a lookback period for the GANN Wave

schaff-trend-cycle.text: Schaff Trend Cycle takes the difference between a fast and a slow EMA, then rescales it to 0-100 against its recent range and smooths it, and repeats this a second time. The single Schaff_TC line swings between low and high values as the cycle turns. Inputs: Length (10), Fast Length (23), Slow Length (50), Factor (0.5) and Source (close).

scottgo-advanced-macd.text: MACD is the fast moving average minus the slow one of the Source, with a signal line and a Histogram of the difference. The fill is green when MACD is above Signal line, red otherwise; markers show MACD and signal crosses and zero crosses. Defaults: Fast length 12, Slow length 26, Signal length 9, both MA types EMA (or SMA).

screener-mean-reversion-channel.text: Scans up to 40 assets and lists them in a label right of the last bar. Each is checked against a smoothed mean with an outer band of smoothed range times pi times Outer Channel Size Multiplier (2.415). Assets are listed as overbought or oversold, weak, normal or strong. Also set Lookback Period (200), Filter Type (SuperSmoother).

seasonality.text: Computes each month's percentage close-to-close change from monthly bars, starting at Starting year and skipping Ignored months, then averages them per calendar month. A heatmap table shows each year's changes plus averages, standard deviation and share positive; green is up, red is down. Expected price for current month is the previous close moved by the Historical average for current month.

self-aware-trend-system.text: An adaptive SuperTrend: bands sit a multiple of ATR from the source, widening when trend efficiency and a 0-to-1 trend quality score are low. The SuperTrend line flips when the close breaks the band, giving buy and sell signals with a stop and three targets. Key inputs: ATR Length 13, Base Band Width (xATR) 2, Preset Auto.

sell-buy-rates.text: Splits each bar's volume into buying and selling shares using the candle's body and wick sizes, then takes a linear regression of the difference over Period bars (34) and shows it as columns in Rate. Above zero means buying pressure, below means selling. Lime or maroon columns show the value moving with its sign over five bars; green or red show the opposite.

sequential-pattern-strength.text: Counts runs of consecutive higher or lower closes, scales the run by its quality and price extension, adds a 5-bar momentum term and smooths it with an EMA into SPS Signal. Above zero it is drawn in the bullish colour, below in the bearish one; zones lie between 50 and twice Max Sequence Length. Inputs: Max Sequence Length (9), Reset Threshold % (0.3), Pattern Smoothing (3).

session-liquidity.text: Draws horizontal lines at the running high and low of up to three daily sessions, with a label at the middle of the lines, so the pools of liquidity above and below each session show. Lines restart each day, follow the session's highest high and lowest low, and appear only on intraday charts under 60 minutes. Inputs: Display Only 🔢 Days Back 15, Line Start & End Times (1900-0259 and 0300-0929 on; third session off).

session-streaks.text: Splits the chart into sessions (each trading day on intraday charts, each bar on daily) and plots the session's running high as Top and low as Bottom. A session counts as bullish when its close is at or above its open; labels count consecutive bullish or bearish sessions. Dashboard (off by default) summarises streaks longer than one session; Gradient (Horizontal) sets the fill.

session-sweeps.text: Tracks the high and low of four sessions (Asia, London, NY AM, NY PM) and marks zones where price pokes through the last ended session's high or low, then opens back inside. Orange-tinted buyside and blue-tinted sellside zones turn grey when judged fake. Key inputs: Margin 1.3 for both zone types and Sweep Margin Length 5.

session-tpo-market-profile.text: Builds a TPO market profile for each session set by Session calculation (0930-1600): rows of Ticks number per tpo (25) ticks hold a letter for each bar touching them. The POC line marks the busiest row, value area lines enclose Value area percent (68) of the TPOs, and single prints, the open, the close and the initial balance are marked. With Extend yesterday's levels (on), the latest levels extend to the right.

sessions-luxalgo.text: Tracks four trading sessions (New York, London, Tokyo, Sydney) by their Hours, read at a fixed UTC offset. For each session it can show a Range box from high to low with its name, a regression Trendline, a running Mean, a volume-weighted VWAP plot, and Max/Min lines of the last finished session. Range is on by default; the others are off. UTC (+/-) defaults to 0.

sessions-on-chart.text: Tracks the low and high of four sessions (London, New York, Tokyo, Sydney) read in New York time, restarting each period of Resolution (D by default). Session bars get a tinted background, or with Activate High/Low View the area between session low and high is filled. London, New York and Tokyo are on by default, Sydney off.

setup-9-1-ema-50.text: Tracks a 9-bar moving average of the close, coloured green when rising, red when falling, yellow when flat. The first bar of a rise sets Buy Entry Level (its high) and Buy Stop Level (its low); the first bar of a fall sets Sell Entry Level (its low) and Sell Stop Level (its high), with arrows and 9.1 Buy Alert and 9.1 Sell Alert. MA 1 Length (9) and MA 2 Length (50) set the averages.

sexi-super-exhaustion-indicator.text: Plots an RSI along with counts of Aroon-based drives to a new high or low over the Aroon Reference window. When the RSI is beyond a trigger line and the matching count has reached the Exhaustion Value, the background is highlighted; the extreme lines add a stronger highlight. Defaults: RSI Length 14, Aroon Reference 14, Exhaustion Value 5, Top Trigger Line Value 72, Bottom Trigger Line Value 32.

sharp-modified-moving-average.text: SHMMA is 3 times the weighted moving average of the Source minus 2 times its simple moving average, both over Length (14). With Highlight Direction on, the line is green while it rises and pink otherwise; Apply Bar Colors (on) tints bars the same way and Apply Background Colors (off) tints the background. Alerts: Bullish Color Change, Bearish Color Change, Any Color Change.

sharpe-ratio-indicator.text: Computes a Sharpe ratio from bar-to-bar percentage returns over the Lookback Period (180 Days): mean return scaled by 365, minus the Risk-Free Rate (0.04), divided by return deviation. The line is red above OverValued (5), green between UnderValued (-1) and CriticallyUnderValued (-3), blue below that, otherwise yellow.

sharpe-ratio-v4.text: Divides the percentage rate of change of the close over the Lookback Length (20) by the standard deviation of that rate of change over the same span. The Sharpe Ratio line is read against the dashed zero level: above zero means positive return per unit of risk. Average Return and Risk are hidden by default; Standard Deviation Multipliert (2) is not used in the calculation.

sharpshooter-30-ema-distance.text: Plots EMA Fast (Fast MA Length 7) and EMA Slow (Slow MA Length 200) of the close. When the fast line crosses under the slow one, the signal arms; the first closed bar where the fast EMA is at least USD Distance below Slow MA (20) under the slow EMA draws a BUY label. Each downward cross yields at most one BUY, which also triggers the BUY alert.

shock-percentile-moving-average-nal.text: An EMA of the close that only updates on bars where the percent rank of the one-bar close change is above % Gate, otherwise it holds its last value. The line, candles and bars turn bullish when it rises and, if Use Slope Gate? is on, its change over Slope Lookback (bars) exceeds % Slope Gate; bearish when it falls. Defaults: Baseline Length 30, Percentrank Lookback 30, % Gate 50, slope 9 bars and 0.75.

shooting-star.text: Marks a single bearish candle in an uptrend: a small but non-zero body in the lower half of the bar, an upper shadow at least a fixed multiple of the body, and no lower shadow. A label appears on the bar when all hold. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) controls how the uptrend is determined.

sigmoid-rsi-nal.text: Converts RSI into a 0 to 100 logistic curve, then smooths it with an adaptive EMA driven by ATR change; Sigmoid RSI MA is a similar signal line driven by RSI change. The state turns long above Long Threshold (72) and short below Short Threshold (40), optionally also needing the line to be above or below Sigmoid RSI MA via Sigmoid EMA Confluence?. Buy and Sell triangles mark flips. Also RSI Length (9).

signal-forge.text: Combines up to eleven classic indicators into one long or short signal and backtests it. Only SMA Crossover is enabled by default. With Require All Enabled Indicators to Align on, every enabled one must agree; off, any one is enough. Glow circles mark entries, and Stop Loss, Take Profit and Trailing Stop lines appear when enabled, set at ATR multiples (ATR Length 14).
names: Require All Enabled Indicators to Align

signal-ma.text: Plots an SMA of the Source and a Signal line that is an EMA of that SMA. The SMA line is green and the area between the lines is shaded green while the SMA is above Signal, red when below. Inputs: Length 20, Signal Length 9, Source close.

signal-table-autofib-sma-ema-rsi-atr-vol.text: A dashboard of classic indicators on the last bar: a table with RSI, ATR, MACD, ADX, moving averages, a bullish-vote score and a range or trend regime, plus HUD panels of oscillators right of the last bar. Optional overlays include EMA/SMA lines, Supertrend, Ichimoku, VWAP and Fibonacci levels. Table is Desktop, Show HUD is on, RSI Period is 14, and Fibonacci Distance is 233.

simple-moving-averages.text: Draws ten simple moving averages of the Source, with lengths 20, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 400, 500 and 600. The first five are blue when close is at or above them and orange below; the last five are green above and red below. The only input is Source (close).

simplified-percentile-clustering.text: Builds up to six features (RSI, CCI, Fisher, DMI, Z-Score, MAR), then sets cluster centers from lower and upper percentile values and the average over the Lookback of 1000 bars. Each bar joins the nearest center; histograms, circles and step lines show the cluster, and Main Plot (default Clusters) can show a single feature instead. K Clusters is 2, Lower Percentile 5, Upper Percentile 95.

sine-weighted-moving-average.text: A weighted moving average where weights follow a half sine wave, so bars in the middle of the window count most. The SWMA line is green when it rises and pink when it falls, with optional bar and background colouring; alerts fire on colour changes. Main inputs: Length 14 and Source close.

sl-4-emas-2-smas-crossover-signals.text: Plots four EMAs (EMA 1 to EMA 4 Length 10, 21, 50, 100) and two SMAs (SMA 1 Length 20, SMA 2 Length 200) of the Price Source. A BUY label appears when EMA 1 crosses above EMA 2 with the EMAs in rising order, close above SMA 2, RSI above 50 (RSI Period 14), all EMAs rising and volume above its 20-bar average. SELL is the mirror case.

slow-heiken-ashi.text: Builds smoothed candles: close is the mean of the Period-bar averages of open, high, low and close, and open is an adaptive smoothing of the previous close. Candles are red when open is above close, green otherwise. With Signal on, a white down arrow marks open crossing above close and an up arrow marks the cross below. Inputs: Period 6, fastend 0.666, slowend 0.0645.

slow-stochastic.text: Computes a stochastic of the close over the high-low range of smoothK bars (14), smooths it with a 3-bar simple average to get %K, then averages %K over smoothD bars (3) to get %D. A crossing of %K and %D shows momentum shifting. Dashed levels at 80 and 20 bound a shaded band.

sma.text: Plots the simple average of Source over Length bars (default 9) as MA on the price pane. Type (default None) can add a second average of that line, SMA-based MA, over Length 14; choosing SMA + Bollinger Bands also draws an Upper Bollinger Band and Lower Bollinger Band at BB StdDev (default 2) deviations.

sma-adx-filter.text: Draws a main moving average of the close, green when the close is above it and red otherwise, plus a long period average as a trend filter. B marks a close crossing above the main line and S a cross below; the long filter requires the close on the matching side, and an optional ADX minimum of 22 drops weak signals. Panjang MA is 25 and Panjang Long Period is 100.

sma-angle-alerts.text: Computes a moving average of the close and turns its change over the last few bars into a slope angle in degrees. UP and DOWN labels with a tinted background appear on the first bar the angle rises above the threshold or drops below its negative, and the angle is plotted as Slope Angle (°). Main inputs: MA Type (SMA), MA Length (9), Angle Threshold (Degrees) (35), Bars to Check for Slope (5).

sma-dma-crossing-signal.text: Plots simple averages of the close over 30, 50, 100 and 200 bars, a fast DMA and a slow DMA lagged by Slow DMA lag (chart bars), 14. BUY and SELL labels appear when closes hold beyond the fast DMA by an ATR-based buffer, with a DMA crossover or recovery after a sell. Price confirmation candles defaults to 2, Price buffer (ATR multiple) to 0.25.

sma-squeeze-oscillator.text: Momentum is the SMA of the average gap of SMA 1 above SMA 2 and SMA 3. A squeeze is on when the spread of the three SMAs is below ATR times ATR Multiplier. Fills are green or red outside a squeeze and yellow inside; diamonds mark zero crosses, circles the first bar after a squeeze, Bull/Bear labels divergences. Defaults: SMA 1 (used for Squeeze & Momentum) 6, SMA 2 18, SMA 3 26, ATR Multiplier 0.8, Pivot Length 2.

smart-breakout-targets.text: Finds volatility squeezes where Bollinger Band width and ATR are both compressed, and boxes the range once a squeeze of enough bars ends. A close beyond a range with a strong candle body gives a Long or Short signal with entry, stop and three risk-multiple targets. Key inputs: Squeeze Detection Length 20, Squeeze Threshold 0.6, Min Squeeze Bars 5, TP1 Risk:Reward 1, TP2 Risk:Reward 2, TP3 Risk:Reward 3.

smart-mcdx-final-pro.text: Builds a volume flow from the close change times volume, then normalises and smooths it over three lengths into Retail, Hot and Banker columns, with Banker MA as an EMA of Banker. The band fills green when Banker is above 0 and red when below, once its size exceeds Min Strength Filter (5). Dots mark Banker crossing Banker MA. Key inputs: Banker Length (50), Hot Length (40), Retail Length (30), Smoothing (6).

smart-money-breakout-channels.text: Tracks the volatility of the normalised close and, once a calm phase lasts over 10 bars, draws a channel from its highest high to lowest low with a dashed mid line. It extends until price exits; a green up or red down marker shows the breakout. Normalization Length 100, Box Detection Length 14, Strong Closes Only on.

smart-money-breakout-signals.text: Finds swing highs and lows using Market Structure Time-Horizon bars (25) on each side, then marks a break when the close passes the last swing; BOS Confirmation Type can switch it to Wicks. Bullish Signal and Bearish Signal mark breaks, labelled BOS or CHoCH when Show CHoCH is on, with three dashed targets drawn.

smart-money-breakouts.text: Marks pivots with Length (20) bars each side; a high or close (Type, default Wicks) beyond the latest swing is a break, labelled BOS or CHoCH. A break opens a trade with a stop 1.5 ATR away and a target at RR Ratio (1.1) times that distance; SL Type sets the stop test. BUY and Sell alerts fire on these breaks.

smart-money-concepts-luxalgo.text: Maps market structure from swing pivots: a close beyond the last pivot is marked BOS when with the trend and CHoCH when against it, for internal and swing structure. It also draws order blocks, equal highs and lows, and optionally fair value gaps. Key inputs are Mode (Historical), Show Internal Structure (on) and Show Swing Structure (on).

smart-money-concepts-probability.text: Tracks the running highest high and lowest low, reset at each pivot, and labels each break as CHoCH, SMS or BMS on the bullish or bearish side, with a line at the broken level. Two labels at the current upper and lower levels show the share of past structures followed by reversal or continuation; a table counts wins and losses. Main inputs: Structure Period (20) and Structure Response (on, 7 bars).

smart-money-flow-signals.text: Blends a volume-weighted momentum wave (50%), Chaikin money flow (30%) and a rescaled Money Flow Index (20%) into one wave. Smart Money Flow is filled to Zero, green above and red below; Smoothed Trend is its SMA over Signal Smoothing (4). Overbought (60) and Oversold (-60) mark extremes; Trend Period defaults to 21.

smart-money-range.text: Takes the range from the last pivot high to the current bar and, on the last bar only, draws a green box at its low, a red box at its high, counts of price crossings as labels, a dashed zigzag and a volume-style profile of rows between low and high, all projected to the right. Row length shows how many bars touched that row. Main inputs: period 30 for the pivot bars each side, Volume Levels 24 for the number of rows.

smart-money-setup-01-double-order-blocks.text: Tracks a zigzag of pivot highs and lows, found with Pivot Period (default 2) bars on each side, and labels the points HH, LH, HL, LL. When the last points form a set bearish or bullish sequence of types and prices, and the candle ranges of two earlier points overlap, it marks the pivot bar and draws Supply OB or Demand OB boxes, plus an LTF box.

smart-money-volume-index.text: Builds a smart money and a dumb money volume index, turns each into an RSI over Volume Flow Period (14), and sums their ratios over Index Period (25), scaled by the highest sum across Normalization Period (500). Net mode (default) shows buy minus sell as green columns above and red below Zero Line; Compare shows Buy Interest and Sell Interest lines. High Interest Threshold (0.9) sets the high zones.

smart-trader-episode-03-by-ata-sabanci.text: Splits the latest Window Bars (100) into Group Count (20) equal blocks, boxes each one and compares block mid-points to build up, down or range trend channels, with a range when the angle is at or below Range Angle Threshold (10). It also marks the nearest buy/sell volume levels and volume-profile POC above and below price, plus a dashboard. Calculation Basis (Closed (bar[1])) sets the reference bar.

smart-trader-episode-06-isotropic-trend-.text: Rescales log price by Yang-Zhang volatility, splits history into blocks, and fits trend channels through block highs and lows. The angle of the block means gives up, down or range; at or below Range Threshold (°) it is a range. A dashboard shows consensus across six periods. Inputs: Trend Block Period (13), Trend Block Groups (5), Yang-Zhang Sigma Length (20).

smart-trend.text: An ATR trailing line: in an uptrend it ratchets up from high minus ATR times a multiplier, in a downtrend it ratchets down from low plus it. The trend flips when the close crosses the line, optionally needing volume rank above a target. BUY and SELL triangles mark flips that agree with a Hull average. Inputs: ATR Period (25), Volatility Multiplier (3.2), Main Trend Smoothness (HMA) (500).

smarter-snr.text: Finds swing highs and lows over Swing Period (default 20) and draws the last three supports and resistances as lines with price labels. It also draws trendlines through the last two pivots of the Source (default Close Body) over Trendline Period (default 20), and marks bars where a trendline breaks. Alerts cover trendline breaks and closes crossing the levels.

smc-indicator-with-webhook.text: Marks fractal highs and lows (Fractal Periods, 2) as triangles. A bar trading through the latest fractal draws a Swept line and label; a later close through the extreme bar between the fractal and the sweep draws an MSS line, and three-bar fair value gaps are drawn as boxes. Four session backgrounds are shaded; Only Draw In Session (off) limits drawings, and Alert Name (1m XAUUSD) labels the webhook messages.

smc-statistical-liquidity-walls.text: Computes an SMA of the source (EQ) with zones at 1, 2 and 3 standard deviations above (red, premium) and below (green, discount), using true range when the deviation is zero. Zone fills turn more solid toward the outer edges. Alerts Hit Premium Wall and Hit Discount Wall fire when the high reaches Upper 2 SD or the low reaches Lower 2 SD. Inputs: Range Period 20, Wall Steepness 2.5, Wall Start Point (SD) 1.5.

smc-structures-and-fvg.text: Tracks a structure high and low; a close beyond the structure low or high draws a line labelled BOS when the trend continues or CHoCH when it reverses, and keeps the last Number of break to show (10). It also boxes fair value gaps (up to Number of FVG to show, 5), changing colour once price enters one and removing it once filled. Break with candle's body (on) requires a close.

smi.text: Measures where the close sits relative to the midpoint of the highest-high/lowest-low range over %K Length bars (default 10). Both the offset and the range are smoothed twice with an EMA of %D Length (3), then scaled to about -100 to 100. SMI-based EMA smooths SMI with EMA Length (3). Dashed levels sit at 40 and -40, with 0 as the middle line.

smi-ergodic.text: Takes the bar-to-bar close change and its absolute value, smooths each twice with EMAs (Long Length, then Short Length), and divides the first by the second to get SMI, a ratio between -1 and 1. Signal is an EMA of SMI, and crossings between the lines or of zero show momentum shifts. Defaults: Long Length 20, Short Length 5, Signal Line Length 5.

smi-ergodic-osc.text: Plots SMI Ergodic Oscillator as a histogram of the SMI minus its signal line, where SMI is the double-smoothed close change divided by the double-smoothed absolute change. Bars above zero mean SMI is over its signal, below zero under it. Defaults: Long Length 20, Short Length 5, Signal Line Length 5.

smi-ucs.text: Measures where close sits relative to the midpoint of the highest-high/lowest-low range over Percent K Length bars, double-smoothed and scaled to about -100 to 100, with an EMA signal line. Fixed lines at 40 (Over Bought), -40 (Over Sold) and 0 (Zero Line) help read extremes and crossings. Inputs: Percent K Length 5, Percent D Length 3.

smiiol.text: A true strength index of the close, shown as Indicator, with Signal as its EMA and Oscillator as their difference in a histogram. A Buy triangle appears on the bar after Indicator crosses up through the negative band while the HMA of the close is rising. Defaults: Short Period 5, Long Period 24, Signal Line Period 5, HMA Period 18, Band Line (+/-) 0.35.

smma.text: Computes Wilder-style smoothing of the chosen source: each value is the previous value times Length minus one, plus the new source value, all divided by Length. SMMA is drawn on the price chart as a slow-reacting trend line. Defaults are Length 7 and Source close.

smooth-rsi.text: Computes the RSI of the open, high, low and close and draws them as candles in the own pane, with the price bars recoloured to match. Candles are green when the average RSI is above 50 and the average rate of change is positive, red when both are below, otherwise they keep the last colour. Levels sit at 30, 50 and 70. Inputs: RSI (28), RoC Length (28); Show RoC (off) adds the RoC Plot line.

smoothed-heiken-ashi.text: Draws candles built in three steps: EMAs of open, high, low and close, Heiken Ashi candles computed from those, then another EMA on each Heiken Ashi value. Candles are green when close is at or above open, red otherwise. EMA Length 1 and EMA Length 2 both default to 10.

smoothed-source-weighted-ema.text: An EMA of the close, with upper and lower sources set one standard deviation of the close above and below it. Long state when the lower source is above the EMA times EMA Upper Weight (1.004); short when the upper source is below the EMA times EMA Lower Weight (1.028). The EMA is coloured by state, with triangles at flips. Smoothing Length 32, EMA Length 36.

smt-divergence-ict-01-smart-money-techni.text: Compares swing highs and lows of the chart symbol with the same bars of a second symbol. When one makes a higher high or lower low and the other does not, it draws a dashed line and a -SMT label at tops or +SMT at bottoms, on the pane and chart. Inputs: Second Symbol XAUUSD, Divergence Fractal Periods 2.

smt-divergences.text: Finds swing highs and lows with Pivot Lookback bars on each side (default 3) on the chart and on up to two comparison symbols. When both make a swing on the same bar but moved in opposite directions since their previous swings, a line joins the chart's two swings (red for highs, blue for lows) and a label names the diverging symbols. Show Dashboard adds counts and shares per symbol.

source-aligned-oscillators.text: Computes one chosen Oscillator (RSI by default; also ROC, Momentum, MACD histogram, CMO or Stoch RSI) on the price chosen by Source Mode (Close). The split modes draw a Bullish Source Line on the low and a Bearish Source Line on the high, so divergences can be compared with matching price extremes. The Midline and, for RSI types, Upper 70 and Lower 30 are drawn.

sp-macd-with-divergence.text: MACD line (fast EMA minus slow EMA), its EMA signal line and a histogram that is teal at or above zero and red below. When Enable Divergence Detection is on, MACD pivots are compared with price: higher MACD low with lower price low gives a Bull label, lower MACD high with higher price high gives a Bear label. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Smoothing 9.

spinning-top-black.text: Marks a single candle with a falling (close below open) body that is not a doji, where both the upper and lower shadows are each at least 34% of the bar's full range. A neutral label on the bar points to indecision rather than a direction. It has no trend input.

spinning-top-white.text: Marks a single candle with a rising (close above open) body that is not a doji, where both the upper and lower shadows are each at least 34% of the bar's full range. A neutral label on the bar points to indecision between buyers and sellers rather than a direction. It has no trend input.

spira-alligator.text: Draws three moving averages of hl2 (Lips 5, Teeth 8, Jaw 13, SMMA by default, shifted forward by their offsets 3, 5 and 8) plus a 144-length EMA trend line of the close. BUY or SELL labels and a background tint appear when Lips cross Teeth after a pullback, with the close on the trend line's side. Lengths and MA Type are adjustable.

spx500-quick-drop-rise-alerts.text: Measures the percent change of the close versus the close Lookback Bars ago (default 1). A change at or below minus Drop Threshold (%) (default 0.05) draws a red circle at the top of the chart; a change at or above plus the threshold draws a green circle at the bottom. Alerts: Quick Price Drop and Quick Price Rise.

squeeze-channel.text: Flags a squeeze when Bollinger Bands sit inside the Keltner Channel, then opens a channel at the recent swing high and low and locks it after a few bars. A close above Channel High or below Channel Low marks a breakout; a close back past the opposite side within Reversal Watch Bars marks a reversal. Key inputs: Bollinger Length 12, Keltner Length 20, Swing Lookback Bars 5.

squeeze-momentum.text: Flags a squeeze when Bollinger Bands sit inside Keltner Channel bounds, and plots Momentum as a regression of price minus the average of the range midpoint and moving average. Squeeze dots are black when on, blue when off, gray otherwise. Momentum bars are brighter when rising. BB Length 20, BB MultFactor 2, KC Length 20, KC MultFactor 1.5.
