squeeze-momentum-indicator-version2-by-k.text: Plots a linear regression over KC Length (20) of close minus the average of the high-low midpoint and the close SMA, plus its SMA over Signal Length (5). Zero-line crosses are blue without squeeze, black when Bollinger bands lie inside the Keltner channels, gray when outside. Both use KC MultFactor 1.5.

squeeze-momentum-v2.text: Compares Bollinger Bands with Keltner Channels and plots a regression-based momentum as Momentum columns, plus a Signal average. Squeeze Dots are black when the bands sit inside the channel, gray when outside, blue otherwise; bright columns mean rising momentum. Pivot divergences are flagged as Bull Div, Bear Div, Hidden Bull and Hidden Bear.

sr-levels-breaks.text: Draws Resistance and Support lines from the latest confirmed pivot high and pivot low, using Left Bars and Right Bars (both 15). A close crossing over Resistance or under Support is labelled: a B label needs volume momentum above Volume Threshold (20), while wick-type crosses get Bull Wick or Bear Wick labels with no volume filter. Show Breaks (on) toggles the labels.

ssl-channel.text: Takes simple averages of the highs and of the lows over Period bars (10). A close above the high average sets an up state and a close below the low average sets a down state, and the state holds in between. In an up state SSL Up is the high average and SSL Down the low average; in a down state they swap, so the lines crossing shows the trend turn.

ssl-hybrid.text: Draws a Baseline moving average with an Upper Channel and Lower Channel built from its smoothed range, plus SSL1 from averages of highs and lows, a faster SSL2, and exit arrows when the close crosses a third line. Colours show the close above, below or inside the channel. Key inputs: Baseline Type HMA, Baseline Length 60, SSL2 Length 5, Exit Length 15.

ssl-hybrid-advanced.text: Builds a moving-average baseline (SSL1/Baseline Type HMA, SSL1 / Baseline Length 55) with a channel, plus SSL2, exit lines and extras such as QQE, ADX, Supertrend and Bollinger bands. Buy and Sell labels follow exit-line crosses, and a strength table sums ten bull or bear votes. Buy Sell Signals defaults to SSL-HYBRID, with Table Alert Strength 8.

ssl-hybrid-scalper.text: Draws fast, slow and trend EMAs of the close. A buy label appears when Fast EMA crosses above Slow EMA while the RSI is below the overbought level and the close is above Trend EMA. A sell label appears on a downward cross with RSI above the oversold level and the close below Trend EMA. Defaults are 8, 21 and 50 for the EMAs, with RSI levels 70 and 30.

st0p.text: Computes a percent trailing stop from the Source: a long stop trails below price and a short stop trails above it, each ratcheting in one direction until price closes beyond it. LONG=1 SHORT=2 (default 1) picks which side is drawn; the Plot line is green when rising, red when falling, blue when flat, and a ST0P label marks price crossing it. Percent defaults to 3, Unit to 0.

standardized-macd-ha.text: Divides the MACD by the EMA of the bar range, times 100, and turns it into Heikin-Ashi candles. Signal is an EMA of that candle; Histogram is its close minus Signal. Triangles flag reversals beyond Reversion Threshold (100). Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9.

statistical-price-deviation-index.text: Scores the bar midpoint against its rolling median in units of mean absolute deviation, clips it, and squashes it with tanh into -1 to +1. VWMA Disp Osc does the same for the midpoint's distance from its VWMA. Readings beyond the Top (0.8) or Bot (-0.8) levels are extremes, and background shading marks when both lines agree. Main inputs: Lookback (median & MAD) 100, Mapping scale (alpha) 0.6.

stc-indicator-a-better-macd.text: Takes the MACD of two EMAs, then applies two rounds of stochastic scaling over Length bars, each smoothed by the AAA factor, giving the STC line from 0 to 100. The line is green while rising and red otherwise, and is read against the Level 25 and Level 75 lines. Inputs: Length 12, FastLength 26, SlowLength 50, AAA 0.5.

std-filtered-n-pole-gaussian-filter.text: Smooths the chosen Source with an N-pole Gaussian filter set by Period (25) and Order (5), then with the default Filter Options of Gaussian Filter holds the output when it moves less than Filter Devaitions (1) standard deviations over Filter Period (10). N-Pole GF is green while rising and red while falling. Long and Short mark turns with L and S triangles.

stdev.text: Computes the standard deviation of the close over a rolling window and plots it as StDev in its own pane. A higher value means closes have been spread more widely around their recent average, a lower value means tighter prices. The length input sets the window, default 20.

sth-unrealized-profit-loss-ratio.text: Measures how far the close sits from its simple average over Realized Value Lookback Length (default 150), as a fraction of the close, then smooths it with an EMA over Smoothing Period (default 5). STH-NUPL MA is a moving average of that line (MA Lookback Length 90, MA Type EMA), yellow when rising versus 2 bars ago, else red. STH-NUPL Trend and Midline are yellow above zero and red below.

stoch.text: Locates the close within the high-low range of the last %K Length bars on a 0-100 scale, smooths it with a simple average for %K, then averages %K again for %D. High readings near the Upper Band (80) and low ones near the Lower Band (20) show where the close sits in the range; Middle Band is 50. Defaults: %K Length 14, %K Smoothing 1, %D Smoothing 3.

stoch-pop-1.text: Smooths a stochastic, using Stochastic Length 14 and Smooth K 5, and plots it between 0 Line and 100 Line. The Stochastic line is green at or above Buy Entry/Exit Line (60), red at or below Sell Entry/Exit Line (30), and blue in between; bars take the same colours. Upper Line and Lower Line mark those two levels.

stoch-pop-2.text: Smooths a stochastic, using Stochastic Length 14 and Smooth K 5, and plots it between 0 Line and 100 Line. The Stochastic line is green at or above Buy Entry/Exit Line (55), red at or below Sell Entry/Exit Line (45), and blue in the narrow band between; bars are coloured the same way. Upper Line and Lower Line mark those levels.

stoch-rsi.text: Computes RSI of the source, then applies the stochastic formula to it, placing the RSI within its range over the lookback window. K is a moving average of that value and D is a moving average of K. Levels at 80, 50 and 20 mark the bands; K crossing D is the usual reading. Inputs: K 3, D 3, RSI Length 14, Stochastic Length 14, RSI Source close.

stoch-vx3.text: Computes a stochastic of the close over length bars, smooths it with an average of smoothK to get K, then averages K over smoothD to get D. A gray line shows the percentile rank of a Laguerre-filtered percent oscillator of hl2. Black circles mark K/D crossings, the background is teal while K is at or above D and black otherwise, and levels sit at 80 and 20. Defaults: length 13, smoothK 5, smoothD 5.

stochastic-heat-map.text: Computes stochastics at periods from Increment (10) up to 28 times it, smooths each, and averages them. Avg Stochastic is a histogram coloured from blue at low to red at high; Fast rescales the average to Plot Number (28) and Slow smooths Fast. Smooth is 2, Slow Smooth is 21, MA Type is EMA.

stochastic-momentum-index.text: Compares the close with the midpoint of the Stochastic Length high-low range, double-smooths that distance and the range with exponential averages (1st Smoothing, 2nd Smoothing), and scales to roughly -100 to 100. SMI is read against Signal, an average over Signal Length, with Histogram as their gap. Dashed lines sit at 40 and -40, shaded when SMI goes beyond them. Defaults: 13, 25, 2, 13.

stochastic-ott.text: Computes a raw stochastic over %K Length (500), smooths it with an adaptive moving average over %K Smoothing (200), and adds 1000 to give the %K line. OTT is a trailing stop on a further smoothed copy, offset by OTT Percent (0.5) with OTT Period 2, and drawn two bars late. %K crossing over OTT is read as bullish, under as bearish. Show Support Line? (off) adds the smoothed line.

stochastic-z-score.text: Takes the z-score of the Source (hlc3) over Length (21) bars, runs a stochastic on it, scales it to -2 to 2 and smooths it into the Smoothed Oscillator. Dots mark its crosses of its prior value; triangles mark reversals when it turns back beyond -2 or 2 with ALMA momentum agreeing. Overbought and Oversold alerts fire beyond 2.5 and -2.5. Show Histogram (off) adds the raw Z-Score columns.

stockbee-combobull.text: Outputs ComboBull, a histogram showing 1 on bars meeting a breakout test and 0 otherwise. A bar needs volume above 100,000, a prior-day gain of at most 2%, and either a rise of 0.90 or more with a larger body, or a 4% jump on higher volume. It must also close above 3 in the top 30% of its range. It has no inputs.

stockbee-reversal-bullish-v2.text: Histogram showing 1 when the previous bar passed a bullish reversal screen, else 0. It requires close at least 20, 20-bar average volume at least 200,000, close above the 150-bar SMA, 5-bar ATR at least 1, a down bar, a close over 6 percent below the 6-bar highest close, and 2-bar RSI at or below 30. No inputs.

stop-take-bounds.text: Computes stop and take-profit prices around each close for a long and a short position. The stop distance is the close times Stop Distance (%) (default 1) divided by 100, and the take-profit distance is that times Take Profit Multiplier (default 2). Long Stop Loss sits below the close and Long Take Profit above; Short Stop Loss sits above and Short Take Profit below.

strat-assistant.text: Classifies each bar against the previous one as inside (1), 2 up, 2 down or outside (3), marking it with a number, arrows and a bar colour: yellow, green, red or fuchsia. On the last bar it adds Shooter, Hammer and Inside Bar flags using Action Wick Percentage (0.75), timeframe continuity arrows, Strat combo flags, and dashed previous day high and low lines (both on by default).

strength-of-divergence-across-multiple.text: Tests RSI, OBV, MACD, STOCH, CCI, MFI and AO for regular and hidden divergence against price pivots, then sums each divergent indicator's weighted strength. Lines join the two price pivots (red bearish, green bullish, dashed hidden); labels show the total and count. Lookback bars is 50, Lookback pivots 2, Alert for values above 5.

strong-burst-fader-projectsyndicate.text: Flags bursts where a high exceeds, or a low undercuts, a basis band of Band width (ATR beyond basis = burst starts), default 2 ATR. At a burst peak it stacks diamonds, more for larger bursts, capped by Max stack height (diamonds) at 6, in hotter colours; triangles flag stacks reaching Min stack height to flag a fade (3).
names: Band width (ATR beyond basis = burst starts)
Min stack height to flag a fade

strong-demands-supplies-liquidity-zonas-.text: Maps market structure on the price pane: swing breaks, fair value gaps, liquidity zones and previous day high and low lines, with triangles under bullish and over bearish engulfing candles. Optional demand and supply zones and internal structure are off by default. Key inputs: Show Previous day High and Low (on), Mark Engulfing candles with arrows (on), Amount (10).
names: Show Previous day High and Low

strong-engulfing-candlestick.text: Detects engulfing bars. A bullish one is a green bar after a red bar, with a high at or above and a low at or below the previous bar, and a larger body. A bearish one is the mirror case. A green label below the bar marks bullish, a red label above marks bearish. It has two alerts and no inputs.

super-guppy.text: Plots 11 fast EMAs (3 to 23) and 16 slow EMAs (25 to 70) on price, drawing the outer edges of each band, their averages and shaded fills. A band changes colour when its EMAs are fully stacked in order, grey otherwise. Arrows mark swing and break starts, spaced by Signal Lookback (6); Show Swing Signals and Show Break Signals default on.

super-orderblock-fvg-bos.text: Draws boxes for order blocks, fair value gaps, optional rejection blocks and breaks of structure; each box extends right until price crosses it. Pivot Top and Pivot Bottom show the last pivot high and low, found with Pivot Lookup (1). Shapes mark order blocks after a liquidity sweep or stacked with a gap, and bars are coloured on high volume. Plot OB and Plot FVG are on; Plot BoS is off.

super-sma-5-8-13-ema-20-200-regime-filte.text: Plots SMAs of 5, 8 and 13 bars and EMAs of 20 and 200 bars on price. A buy marker shows when SMA 5 and SMA 13 cross with SMA 5 above; a sell marker when they cross with SMA 5 below SMA 8 and SMA 13. Regime Filter (default Both) can limit signals to EMA 20 above or below EMA 200.

super-smoothed-macd.text: Computes the difference between a fast and a slow exponential average, then smooths that difference with another average to get Smoothed MACD. Signal averages it again, and Histogram is their gap. Histogram bars are greener when at or above zero and redder below, with brighter shades when the bar is growing in that direction. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9, Smooth Length 5.

super-supertrend.text: Draws three SuperTrend lines on price, each placed at hl2 plus or minus ATR times its own multiplier and trailing in the trend direction. Each line is teal in an uptrend and red in a downtrend. Arrows appear where a line flips trend, and bottom shapes mark where the close crosses a line. Defaults: ATR Length 10, Multiplier 1 of 1, Multiplier 2 of 2, Multiplier 3 of 3.

super-trend-v.text: Builds a volume-weighted price, smooths it with an EMA (Weighted EMA) and compares it with an EMA of the open (Open EMA); the cloud is lime while the first is above the second, orange otherwise. A SuperTrend on the weighted EMA, with SuperTrend Multiplier 1 and SuperTrend Period 10, gives Buy and Sell labels on close crosses. TP labels mark closes crossing bands of a regression, set by TP (2) and TP length (150).

superbands.text: Draws a bullish and a bearish ATR trailing line, each smoothed by an EMA and reset when the close crosses it, plus a Center line midway between them. Line colour shifts with the trail's slope, and the areas between each trail and the High or Low are shaded. Main inputs per side: Smoothing 18, ATR Period 12, Multiplier 1.

superbollingertrend.text: A trailing line built from Bollinger bands of highs and lows over Period (default 12) with Mult (default 2). It turns lime and jumps to the lower band when the close crosses above it, and red at the upper band when the close crosses below. ZigZag adds signal markers, and Take Profit adds a target line; alerts cover signals and targets.

supersmoother-ma-oscillator.text: Smooths price with a two-pole filter, then takes fast EMA minus slow EMA as the Oscillator, with a Signal Line and a Histogram of their gap. Crosses of the signal larger than ATR times Signal Sensitivity give buy or sell triangles. Inputs: Fast MA 20, Slow MA 50, Price Smoothing Length 5, ATR Length 20, Signal Sensitivity 0.03.

supertrend.text: Builds a trailing line from the Average True Range, set Factor times the ATR away from price, that flips side when price crosses it. Up Trend (green) shows while the direction is up and Down Trend (red) while it is down, each shaded toward the candle body middle. Defaults: ATR Length 10, Factor 3.

supertrend-ai-clustering.text: Runs many SuperTrend versions across factors from Min Factor to Max Factor in Step increments, scores each by recent performance, groups the scores into three clusters, and averages the factors of the cluster picked in From Cluster. Trailing Stop is the SuperTrend line using that factor; Trailing Stop AMA is a smoothed version of it. Defaults: ATR Length 10, Min Factor 1, Max Factor 5, Step 0.5, Performance Memory 10, From Cluster Best.

supertrend-cci.text: A Supertrend line built from the bar midpoint plus or minus [ST] Factor (3) times an ATR of [ST] PD (ATR Period) (3). Direction comes from CCI with CCI Period (28) relative to CCI Mid Line Pivot (0): above it the lower band is used, below it the upper band. SuperTrend CCI is green when close is at or above the line, red otherwise.

supertrend-channels.text: Computes a standard SuperTrend line from ATR and a factor, then takes its highest and lowest values over the channel length as an upper and lower channel, plus their midpoint. SuperTrend is teal in an uptrend and red in a downtrend, with fills between it and each channel edge. Defaults: ATR Length 10, Factor 3, Channel Length 20.

supertrend-ladder.text: Supertrend with two ATRs: true ranges of up bars and of other bars are averaged separately with the chosen Moving Average. The buy stop is the low minus ATR Multiplier times the down-bar ATR; the sell stop is the high plus it times the up-bar ATR. The stop of the current side is drawn, teal when up and fuchsia when down. Defaults: hma, length 7, ATR Multiplier 4; Wait For Close and Delayed/Sticky are off.

supertrend-mtf-heikin-ashi.text: Computes two Supertrend lines on Heikin Ashi bars: SuperTrend on the chart timeframe and Supertrend HTF on a higher timeframe, with bands at the midpoint of high and low plus or minus ATR Factor times ATR. A line flips when the close crosses the opposite band. Circles in Supertrend HTF Trend Up and Supertrend HTF Trend Down mark its flips. Inputs: HTF Method Auto, ATR Factor 2, ATR Period 7.

supertrend-oscillator.text: Measures where the close sits relative to a SuperTrend line, divided by the band width, clamped to -1..1 and scaled by 100. Columns show it; positive means above the line. The Signal line is an adaptive average of it, Histogram is a smoothed difference, and Plot marks sign changes. Labels at 80 and -80 flag crosses as check or cross. Inputs: length (10), mult (2), smooth (72).

supertrend-relative-volume-kernel.text: A SuperTrend, from ATR Length (10) and ATR Multiplier (3), whose breaks are rated by relative buy or sell volume against past breaks using a kernel density estimate. Arrows and Vol labels mark breaks, and the fill grows more opaque as the KDE percent rises. Enable Activation Threshold, off by default, requires KDE Threshold % (70).

supply-and-demand-anchored.text: Between the anchors timeLeft and timeRight it finds the highest high, lowest low and total volume, cuts the range into Resolution levels (50) and adds up volume from the top by highs and from the bottom by lows past Threshold % (10) of the total. This sets a supply and a demand zone, each with an average and a dashed volume-weighted line, plus mid-range and weighted equilibrium lines.

supply-and-demand-daily.text: On the first bar of each day, it splits the previous day's high-to-low range into equal steps and walks in from the top and bottom, adding volume until it passes a share of the day's volume. That marks a supply box and a demand box, each with a solid middle line and a dashed volume-weighted line, extended to the last bar. Threshold % (10) sets the share and Resolution (50) the step count.

supply-and-demand-visible-range.text: Splits the visible price range into Resolution intervals (default 50) and adds up volume from the top (by bar highs) and from the bottom (by bar lows). Once a side exceeds Threshold % (default 10) of total volume, it draws a supply or demand area with an Average line and a Weighted line. When both exist, Equilibrium lines mark the range midpoint and the mean of the two weighted lines.

supply-and-demand-zones.text: Draws boxes on the price pane after three same-coloured candles when the prior bar's volume is above its recent average. Each box spans from the latest opposite candle's extreme to 2 x ATR(200) away, and shows a volume delta and its share of all deltas. Supply and Demand set the box colours; a supply zone is dropped when price closes above it, a demand zone when price closes below it.

supply-demand-flux-charts.text: Finds demand zones after four rising momentum candles and supply zones after four falling ones, using the range of the bar before them, capped at 1.5 ATR. Boxes run until a candle invalidates them. R labels mark retests; B labels mark breaks. Inputs: Zone Invalidation Close, Retests on, Breaks off.

supply-demand-profiles.text: Builds a volume profile of the bars between Start Calculation and End Calculation, drawn on the end bar. Rows show bullish and bearish volume, a sentiment profile, the point of control, the value area high and low, and supply and demand zones for rows under Supply & Demand Threshold % (15). Value Area Volume % is 68; Number of Rows is 100.

supply-demand-zones-pro.text: Builds supply zones at confirmed pivot highs and demand zones at pivot lows, sized against a 20-bar ATR and limited to Asian, London and New York hours. Zones extend forward until a close (or wick) breaks them, then turn grey as historic; labels show size, strength and age, and R marks a retest. Main inputs: Swing Length (Sensitivity) 12, Max Zones to Display 10, Zone Invalidation Close.

support-and-resistance-flux-charts.text: Finds support at pivot lows and resistance at pivot highs, on up to three timeframes, and draws each as a line or zone until the close (or wick) breaks it. A touch that closes back on the level is a retest and adds strength; a B label marks the break and R labels the retests. Main inputs: Pivot Length 15, Strength 1, Invalidation Close, Expand Lines & Zones Only Valid.

support-and-resistance-logistic-regressi.text: Treats pivot highs as resistance and pivot lows as support, then trains a small logistic regression on RSI and body size to predict which levels get respected. Levels at or above Probability Threshold (0.7) are drawn as lines with a percent label; Pivot Length is 14 and Target Respects is 3. Optional R and B labels mark retests and breaks.

support-resistance-ai.text: Clusters the closes of the last Bars back from last bar to train on (252) into Number of clusters (3) groups using Cluster Method, K means or K median. Each cluster gets a horizontal level at its centre, plus a table of the share of closes per cluster. With Show SD bands on (default), two white lines mark the centre plus and minus the spread of that cluster's closes, with a tinted fill.
names: Bars back from last bar to train on

support-resistance-channel-breakout.text: Resistance is the highest high (or close) of the previous bars and support the lowest low (or close), each wrapped in a thin channel. A label marks a close leaving the resistance channel top or the support channel bottom after the prior close was inside, with a cooldown per side. Period Support & Resistance is 50, Minimum Bars Between Breakouts 10, Channel Multiplier 5.

support-resistance-channels.text: Groups recent pivot highs and lows into channels no wider than Maximum Channel Width % of the 300-bar range, scores them by pivots and price touches, and draws the strongest as boxes: resistance above price, support below, another colour when price is inside. Alerts: Resistance Broken, Support Broken. Pivot Period 10, width 5, Maximum Number of S/R 6; optional MA 1 and MA 2.

support-resistance-channels-mtf.text: Finds pivot highs and lows on a higher timeframe (Higher Time Frame, default D), groups nearby pivots into channels no wider than Maximum Channel Width % (default 6) and ranks them by strength. The top Maximum Number of S/R (default 6) are drawn as boxes, red above the close, green below, grey if price is inside. Alerts: Resistance Broken, Support Broken. Pivot Period defaults to 5.

support-resistance-classification.text: Nine level sets: SMA, Bollinger upper or lower band, higher-timeframe previous high or low, swing points, or Fibonacci pivots. On the last visible bar, levels inside the visible price range become lines, green below the close and red above, fading with each break by the close and vanishing after fade (5) breaks. Labels give each level's rank (1 = fewest breaks) and its timeframe.

support-resistance-dynamic.text: Collects recent pivot highs and lows and groups those lying within a channel of Channel Width % of the period's range; a group with enough pivots becomes a support/resistance line with a price label. Highest and lowest pivot lines are optional. RS_level holds the level the close just crossed, which triggers Resistance Broken or Support Broken. Defaults: Period for Pivot Points 10, Loopback Period 284, S/R strength 2, Channel Width % 10.

support-resistance-dynamic-v2.text: Collects recent pivot highs and lows, groups them into channels no wider than Maximum Channel Width % of the 300-bar range, and keeps the strongest non-overlapping ones. Each channel midpoint is a line with a label showing its distance to the close; red when at or above the close, green when below. Pivot Period is 10, Maximum Number of S/R 5, Minimum Strength 2.

support-resistance-high-volume-boxes.text: Signs each bar's volume by its direction, then marks a close pivot as a support box when its signed volume beats the recent filter high, or as a resistance box when it falls below the filter low. Boxes turn dashed on a break, and diamonds mark holds and retests. Inputs: Lookback Period (20), Delta Volume Filter Length (2), Adjust Box Width (1).

support-resistance-interactive.text: Draws up to five zones around price levels you enter. Each zone's half height is % Threshold percent (minimum 0.1) of the highest-to-lowest range of the last 300 bars. A zone is green when the close is above it, red when below, grey when inside, and a label gives its number and upper and lower prices. Number of Support/Resistance is 5 and % Threshold is 1; S/R level 1 to 5 default to 0.

support-resistance-mtf.text: Plots chart-timeframe resistance and support from the latest highest high and lowest low of the last Period for Highest/Lowest Bars (default 10), plus matching levels from a Higher Time Frame (default Auto). Each level shows only while unchanged, and zones are shaded between chart and higher-timeframe levels. Source defaults to High/Low; Extend Lines is off by default.

support-resistance-power-channel.text: Draws a channel on the last bar from the highest high and lowest low of the last length bars, with zones of half a 200-bar ATR around each extreme and a dotted midline. Zones show a count of falling bars (Sell Power) at resistance and rising bars (Buy Power) at support; crosses mark the extremes, diamonds mark bars leaving a zone. length is 130, extend is 30.

support-resistance-pro-toolkit.text: Finds swing highs and lows with Detection Method (default Donchian) and Swing Sensitivity (10), and draws resistance above and support below as zones sized by ATR Period (200) times Zone Depth (ATR Mult) (0.5). A level breaks when a bar closes beyond it; active levels show counts of entries, sweeps and volume, and Max Active (Unmitigated) keeps 5 of them. Triangles mark swings, dots sweeps, crosses breakouts.

support-resistance-signals-mtf.text: Finds pivot highs and lows and turns them into resistance and support zones with a line at the pivot price. It labels breakouts, tests, retests and rejections of the newest zones, and can show manipulation zones. Detection Length (15) sets the pivot width, Detection Timeframe scales it, and Support Resistance Margin (2) sets zone height.

support-resistance-v2-indicator.text: Marks support at the low of a bar where RSI(9) is below 25 and a Hull-average momentum ratio is above 50. Resistance is the high of a bar with RSI(9) above 75 and the ratio below -50. Each new level draws a horizontal line, green for support and orange for resistance, until the next level of that side; the alert New S/R line fires on a change. S/R Timeframe is empty, meaning the chart timeframe.

support-resistance-with-breaks-and-retes.text: Draws support and resistance boxes from pivot lows and highs found over Lookback Range bars on each side, and labels breakouts when price crosses a box edge and retests when it returns into the box. A retest starts as a potential one and is confirmed within Retest Detection Limiter bars (default 2), or dropped. Bars Since Breakout defaults to 2; Lookback Range to 20; Repainting to On.

suppot-and-resistance-buy-sell-signals.text: Plots a high/low channel (Upper Channel, Lower Channel) over Period 200 bars, and a close-based pair, YPSAR and DPSAR. BUY labels need a green candle dipping below DPSAR and closing above it, with RSI below the oversold level, a strong trend and a volume-and-wick trap. SELL mirrors this at YPSAR.

sweep-candle.text: Colours bars whose range exceeds Imbalance Multiplier (1.5) times an ATR of ATR Length (5), and marks engulfing bars with triangles and momentum bars with circles. Both close beyond the previous high or low after a bar of the opposite (engulfing) or same (momentum) direction. Sweep type also requires taking the previous low or high; Engulfing Type and Momentum Type choose.

sweep-engulf-2-candle.text: Spots engulfing bars that sweep the previous extreme: bullish when the low undercuts the prior low and the close clears the prior bearish open or bullish close; bearish mirrors this with the high. Bullish Engulfing gets a green label below, Bearish Engulfing a red one above. Aktifkan Notifikasi (on) enables alert calls.

sweep-engulf-choch.text: Detects a three-candle entry. Bullish: a bearish candle, then one that breaks its low and closes above its close, then a candle closing above the first one's open. Bearish is the mirror, breaking the high. A green triangle below the bar marks a bullish entry and a red one above marks a bearish entry. Show Bullish Entry and Show Bearish Entry toggle each side, and Enable Alerts controls alert messages.

sweep-institutional.text: Finds swing highs and lows (20 bars each side) and marks a sweep when a bar pokes past the last swing low (or high) but opens and closes back on the inside, and the next three closes hold. A line runs from the swing to the sweep bar, with a Sweep marker; Bullish Sweep and Bearish Sweep alerts fire. Cooldown Period (10) sets the minimum bars between same-side signals; Show Swings? (on) draws the latest swings.

sweep2trade-pro.text: Draws a smoothed T3 line of hlc3, green when below hlc3 and red otherwise. A sweep of the prior swing low or high, a turn in the T3, then a confirming bar produce BUY or SELL markers. Main inputs: T3 Length (4), Swing lookback for sweep (High/Low) (20), Max bars for sequence (timeout) (8).

swing-anchored-vwap.text: Two VWAPs restart after swings: one of the highs after a swing high, one of the lows after a swing low, with swings found over Length bars (50). The trend turns up when the high equals the highest high and down when the low equals the lowest low. The low VWAP is drawn in an up trend, the high VWAP in a down trend, with a value label; earlier ones remain thinner, sized by Vwap Line Width (1).

swing-breakout-sequence.text: Detects swing points from legs and looks for a swing high and low followed by four points that stay inside that range, plus an optional fifth point near the fourth. Each match gets a green (bullish) or red (bearish) box, dotted lines and numbered labels. Inputs: Swing Length (5), Internal Length (2), Point 4 Beyond Point 2 (off), Show Point 5 (on), Require Equal H/L at Point 5 (on).

swing-failure-pattern.text: Finds bars that poke past the latest swing high or low but open and close back inside it. Each pattern gets a swing line, a dotted confirmation line, a thick wick segment and an SFP label, with a triangle added when a close crosses the confirmation level. Unconfirmed patterns are removed if a close crosses the swing. Swings sets the bars used to define a swing (default 5); Validation must stay None.

swing-failure-signals.text: Finds swing highs and lows (Pivot Detection Length, 12), then flags a signal when price sweeps one and the trend flips the other way within Patience bars (7). A flip needs a close beyond a prior opposite candle's open and passing the Trend Noise Filter (0.7). Bullish and bearish signals draw a marker, a dashed swept-level line and a solid line.

swing-high-low.text: Marks a ZigZag of swings: the trend turns up when a bar makes the highest high of Swing Length (100) bars and down on the lowest low. Each turn draws a horizontal line at the ended swing, a dashed zigzag line between swings, price labels and a table showing direction. Broken Levels dashes a line once price crosses it, and History Levels (off) keeps older ones.

swing-highs-lows-patterns.text: Finds pivot highs and lows that are the extreme of Length bars on each side, then labels each as a higher or lower high, or a higher or lower low, versus the previous pivot of its kind. The label also names a candle pattern at the pivot bar: hammer, inverted hammer, hanging man, shooting star or engulfing. Length defaults to 21.

swing-levels-and-liquidity-by-leviathan.text: Finds swing highs and lows using Bars Right-Left (10) and a second length (15), then draws a dot, a dotted level line and a thin box at each swing. Levels extend to the right until a bar touches them (Extend Until Fill), and Hide Filled removes touched ones. Volume > keeps only swings above that bar volume (default 0).

swing-points.text: Finds pivot highs and lows with Swing Point Period (5) bars on each side, labelled H and L on the pivot bar. Each new pivot pulls the Center Line toward it, green when close is above and red otherwise. Circles show the last pivot low as Support Level and the last pivot high as Resistance Level. Alerts cover breaks, colour flips and new pivots.

swing-profile.text: Finds swings from the highest high and lowest low over Swing Length (50) bars. When the move flips, it builds a volume profile of the finished leg in price rows of half an ATR(200), marking the largest-volume row as PoC, with a ZigZag line and an arrow label showing volume details. The current leg is drawn on the last bar. Type picks an optional MA (default None) with Length 25.

swing-support-and-resistance.text: Tracks the latest pivot high as Resistance and the latest pivot low as Support, each confirmed using Pivot Length bars on each side (default 10) and drawn as circles shifted back by that length. A Buy triangle marks a close crossing above resistance, a Sell triangle a close crossing below support. Show Support and Show Resistance both default on; Buy Alert and Sell Alert fire on these signals.

swing-trade-signals.text: Plots a Long SMA of the source, coloured lime when the bar's low is above it, red when the high is below it, and yellow otherwise or when RSI is at or beyond 85 or 15. Markers show SMA/EMA crosses as B or S, and arrows where RSI leaves the overbought or oversold zone. Alerts: Reversal, Buy/Sale Swing Signal. Defaults: EMA Length 5, SMA Length 50, RSI Length 14, limits 80 and 20.

swing-volume-profiles.text: Builds a volume profile between each pair of consecutive swing points, found with Swing Detection Length (47), split into Number of Rows (27). Row length follows volume, and rows inside the Value Area Volume % (68) get one colour. It also marks the Point of Control, value area high and low, a developing PoC and unfilled liquidity rows. Mode Present limits profiles to the last # Bars (300).

swingarm-atr-trend-indicator.text: An ATR trailing stop, the Trailingstop, set ATR Factor times a Wilder-smoothed true range from the close and moved only with the trend; Extremum is the trend's best high or low. Fib 1, Fib 2 and Fib 3 sit between Extremum and the stop, and triangles mark closes crossing back through them against the trend when Show Fib Entries? is on. Defaults: Trailtype modified, ATR Period 28, ATR Factor 5.

t1-wyckoff-aggressive-a-d-setup.text: Finds Wyckoff climax, reaction and breakout candles from wide range, volume spikes, close position and a regression slope. Signal Options picks Reversal (default) or Trend Following; Long and Short labels appear. The background is green on a rising slope, red on a falling one.

t3-psar.text: Two Tillson T3 averages (T3 Fast, T3 Slow) built from six chained EMAs with a volume factor, plus a Parabolic SAR drawn as dots: Up SAR when close is at or above it, Down SAR when at or below. Alerts fire when close crosses the slow T3 or the two T3 lines cross. Defaults: T3 Fast Length 5, T3 Slow Length 8, T3 Volume Factor 0.7, SAR Start 0.02, SAR Increment 0.02, SAR Max 0.2.

ta-adaptive-trend.text: Plots a Fast EMA and a Slow EMA of the close and fills the zone between them: mint green when the fast is above the slow, orange when below. Triangles mark the fast crossing over (below the bar) or under (above the bar) the slow, and alerts fire on those crosses. Defaults: Fast EMA 21, Slow EMA 55, Show crossover markers on.

target-trend.text: Builds two bands from the average of highs plus, and the average of lows minus, an ATR-based distance. A close crossing above the upper band starts an up trend, below the lower band a down trend. Trailing Stop Up and Trailing Stop Down show the stop on the opposite side; each trend change draws a triangle plus stop, entry and three target levels. Inputs: Trend Length (10) and Set Targets (0).

targets-for-many-indicators.text: Sets a target when Source A crosses or equals Source B, placed at the close plus or minus a distance (Target Distance From Price, default 3 ATR). A dashed line extends until the high or low reaches it, and the label turns solid when reached. Target 1 is long on CrossOver, Target 2 short on CrossUnder; Evaluate Wicks is on.

targets-for-overlay-indicators.text: Sets a target when the close crosses over the source (Crossover) or under it (Crossunder), placed above or below the close by a distance in Currencies, %, ATR or Ticks. The target line extends until price reaches it, then its label changes colour; candles take the colour of the latest target. Defaults: Target Distance From Price 3 in ATR, Evaluate Wicks on, source close.

tasc-2025-02-autocorrelation.text: Smooths the Source with a low-pass filter of period Length (or uses a 30-bar sine wave when Use test signal is on), then correlates the last Length bars with the same window shifted back by each lag. Each of 32 lines sits at a lag level and is coloured from green (positive correlation) through yellow to red (negative). Lag range picks the lags shown: 0-32, 33-65 or 66-98. Length defaults to 20.

tasc-2025-06-cybernetic-oscillator.text: Passes the source through a second-order highpass filter, then a Super Smoother lowpass filter, and divides the result by its root mean square over a window. The Cybernetic Oscillator plots around the Zero Line, green above and red below in Trend style; Threshold style draws Upper threshold and Lower threshold and fills beyond them. Inputs: Highpass period: 30, Lowpass period: 20, RMS length: 100, Threshold: 1.

tasc-2025-09-the-continuation-index.text: Compares a short and a long smoothed version of the source with a multi-term Laguerre filter, scales the gap by its average size over Length, and squashes it into a range of -1 to 1. Readings above 0.5 shade toward the uptrend colour and below -0.5 toward the downtrend colour; in between the line is gray. Main inputs are Gamma (0.8), Order (8) and Length (40).

tasc-2026-01-the-reversion-index.text: Divides the sum of close-to-close changes by the sum of their absolute values over RI Length bars (default 20), giving a ratio between -1 and 1. Two smoothing filters of that ratio give Smooth (period 8) and Trigger (period 4), the faster line. Read them around the zero line: sign shows net direction, and Trigger crossing Smooth marks turns.

tasc-2026-04-a-synthetic-oscillator.text: Builds a cycle oscillator by smoothing the source, band-pass filtering it between the two bounds, and taking the sine of a running phase that is reset whenever a separate band-pass line crosses zero. Read it as a bounded wave around the Zero Line, where turns suggest the cycle's high and low. Lower Bound: (15) and Upper Bound: (25) set the cycle range, and the upper must exceed the lower.

tasc-2026-05-the-autotune-filter.text: Applies a high-pass filter, then autocorrelates it at lags up to the window. Twice the lag of the lowest correlation gives the dominant cycle, which tunes a band-pass filter. Output: shows the filter, correlation, cycle or tuned band-pass (default Tuned band-pass filter) around a zero line. Inputs: Source: (close), Window: (20).

tasc-2026-09-adaptive-supersmoother.text: Draws a second-order SuperSmoother as SuperSmoother (SS Base in the pane) and an Adaptive SuperSmoother whose period shortens when the base filter's bar change is large relative to its RMS. Adaptive SS Oscillator is the adaptive line minus the base line, so above zero means the adaptive line is higher. Inputs: Source (close), Base period (20), RMS length (81).

td-macd.text: Computes MACD as a fast exponential average of close minus a slow one, with Signal as a simple average of MACD. MACD Histogram draws the MACD value as bars, lime when it rose from the prior bar and red otherwise. MACD is a black line, and Signal is green when rising and red when flat or falling. Defaults: Fast Length 5, Slow Length 20, Signal Length 30.

tdi-rsi.text: Computes an RSI, then bands from its average over Band Length plus and minus 1.6185 standard deviations, with a Middle of Bands line, and Fast MA and Slow MA lines that are short averages of the RSI. Levels sit at 20, 30, 50, 70 and 80. Labels mark divergences between price pivots and the Slow MA, and alerts fire on them. Defaults: RSI Period 21, Band Length 34, Fast MA on RSI 7, Slow MA on RSI 2.

tdi-traders-dynamic-index-rsi-divergence.text: Applies volatility bands (average of the RSI plus and minus 1.6185 standard deviations over Band Length) and two smoothed RSI lines: RSI PL (Slow MA on RSI, 2) and TSL Signal (Fast MA on RSI, 7). Long and Short labels mark RSI PL crossing TSL Signal while TSL Signal sits beyond both MBL and 50. Bull and Bear labels flag RSI divergences found from pivots, set by the Pivot Lookback inputs (5 each).

technical-ratings.text: Combines votes from 15 moving-average checks and 11 oscillator checks into ratings from -1 to 1, plotted as columns. Levels sit at 0.5, 0.1, 0, -0.1 and -0.5, read as strong buy, buy, sell and strong sell zones; the last bar gets labels. Main inputs: Higher timeframe (chart), Repainting (On), Rating uses (MAs and Oscillators), Weight of MAs (%) (50).

technicals.text: Averages +1/0/-1 votes from 15 moving-average checks and 11 oscillator checks into ratings from -1 to 1, plotted as columns in Rating (indicator timeframe). Rating is based on picks MAs, Oscillators or All (default All). Levels at 1, 0.5, -0.5 and -1 mark strong zones; a table lists ratings per timeframe, with Indicator Timeframe defaulting to the chart's.

tema.text: Combines three chained exponential averages of the close as 3 times the first, minus 3 times the second, plus the third, which trims the lag of a plain exponential average. TEMA is drawn on the price pane and follows price more closely than a single average. The length input defaults to 9.

tenkan-cloud-signals.text: Builds Ichimoku-style midpoints of highest high and lowest low: Tenkan, Kijun (calc), Senkou Span A as their average, and Senkou Span B, with both spans pushed forward and a cloud filled between them. BUY or SELL flags appear when Kijun crosses Span B and holds. Inputs: Tenkan Length (7), Senkou Span B Length (44), Confirmation Bars (close) (1).

terminal-velocity-stop-lyro-rs.text: A trailing stop that chases a target of close minus (uptrend) or plus (downtrend) a multiple of ATR, moving at most Terminal Velocity times ATR per bar in the trend direction. When the close crosses the stop, the direction flips, a Flip Dot marks it and the stop restarts. Inputs: ATR Length 14, + Multiplier 3, - Multiplier 3, Terminal Velocity 0.3.

tfo-adx-with-histogram-signal.text: Adds a scaled MFI (-1 to +1) to Chaikin Money Flow and smooths the sum into TFO, then follows it with TFO Signal. TFO Histogram is TFO minus signal, green at or above 0 and red below; ADX (scaled) is (ADX - 25) / 25, clipped to ±1.5. Levels sit at 0, 0.7 and -0.7. Key inputs: MFI Length 14, CMF Length 20, Signal Type WMA, Signal Line Length 3.

the-echo-forecast.text: Compares the latest Forecast Window of the source with earlier windows within Evaluation Window, by correlation, and keeps the most similar one (or the least, in Dissimilarity mode). Its bar-to-bar changes are replayed after the last bar as a dotted forecast line. Forecast Construction (Cumulative by default) sets the base; both windows default to 50.

the-jewel.text: Combines a doubly smoothed stochastic (StochK, StochD, each rescaled to 0-100), DI+, DI- and ADX from simple averages, and an EMA scaled to 0-100. The background turns green when StochK crosses above StochD with RSI above RSI Buy Level (55), ADX above ADX Threshold (20) and close above the EMA; red is the mirror with RSI Sell Level (45). Yellow marks RSI and StochK both overbought or both oversold.

the-mean-goose-v1.text: Draws two Keltner channels, a wide one (KC1 Length 200, KC1 Multiplier 9.5, exponential average) and a tight one (KC2 Length 20, KC2 Multiplier 3.5), plus an EMA. A dot appears when a bar's high or low pierces both outer bands; a signal label follows when the close crosses back over the EMA. Require new HOD/LOD adds a session extreme test.

the-next-pivot.text: Searches the last Bars Back To Search bars for the past sequence most similar to the latest Correlation Length bars, then projects the bar-to-bar changes that followed it as a dotted price path of Forecast Length segments. A projected zig zag follows the path, and boxes mark the matched and latest sequences. Defaults: Correlation Length 20, Forecast Length 50, Cosine Similarity, Price.

the-strat.text: Compares each bar's high and low with the previous bar and prints a number below it. 1 marks an inside bar, a green 2 a bar with a higher high but no lower low, a red 2 a bar with a lower low but no higher high, and 3 an outside bar taking out both. It has no inputs.

theil-sen-line-filter.text: Takes the median of the slopes from the current price to each of the last Window Length bars (default 70), optionally capped, and moves a filtered line by Response (0.97) times that slope each bar. The Theil-Sen line and the candles take the long colour while the line rises and the short colour while it falls. Slope Cap Mode (None) can limit the slope by ATR, percent or points.

three-bar-reversal-continuation.text: Scores each bar 0 to 3 by whether its range, volume and range times volume exceed Coefficient (2) times their averages over Period (10) bars. Dots show strength 1 to 3. An arrow marks a strong bar (Detection Level, 3), then a zero-strength bar, then a larger bar closing in its direction; Show Continuation (on) drops the extreme-low or extreme-high filter.

three-bar-reversal-pattern.text: Finds three-bar reversals: two falling bars, then a rising bar whose high exceeds the first bar's high, with the bearish case mirrored. A close beyond the first bar's line confirms it and starts a support or resistance level; a close the other way, or an opposite pattern, fails it. Pattern Type defaults to All, Filtering to None.

three-black-crows.text: Detects three consecutive long falling candles, each closing lower than the last and opening inside the prior candle's body. Each lower shadow must be under 5% of its bar's range, so closes sit near the lows. A bearish label marks the third bar. It has no trend input.

three-drive-pattern-detector.text: Checks zigzags from Minimum Swing Length (3) to Maximum Swing Length (100) for three drives: moves extended by Extension (1.272 to 1.618) and pulled back by Retracement (0.618 to 0.786), with timing within Width Margin (100). A match is drawn as a polyline with ratio labels, bearish colour at a high end, bullish at a low end.

three-moving-averages.text: Plots three moving averages of the chosen source on the price pane, each with its own length. The average type can be exponential, simple or weighted for all three. Read them by how the shorter lines sit relative to the longer ones and to price. Defaults: Length 1 of 9, Length 2 of 21, Length 3 of 55, MA Type ema, Source close.

three-white-soldiers.text: Detects three consecutive long rising candles, each closing higher than the last and opening inside the prior candle's body. Each upper shadow must be under 5% of its bar's range, so closes sit near the highs. A bullish label marks the third bar. It has no trend input.

tight-range-display-with-background.text: Measures the high-to-low range over a lookback window as a percent of the lowest low. When it falls below Tight Range %, the background turns blue, stronger as the range is smaller relative to the threshold. The lookback is at least 10 bars and is set by ATR Period for Dynamic Lookback (5). Wide Range % defaults to 10.0 and Tight Range % to 10.0.

tillson-t3.text: Runs the typical price (high + low + 2 x close, over 4) through six chained EMAs and blends the last four with volume-factor weights to give T3. The line is green when rising, red when falling, yellow when flat; T3 BUY and T3 SELL alerts fire when it turns up or down. Inputs: T3 Length (8), Volume Factor (0.7), plus an optional T3fibo line via Show T3 Fibonacci Ratio Line? (off).

time-based-alerts-for-trading-windows.text: Checks each bar's opening time against twelve hour and minute pairs, read in New York time or Chicago time when Use Central Time (Exchange) is on. Odd-numbered matches draw a green triangle below the bar (Odd Alert), even ones a red triangle above (Even Alert). Each pair has an Enable Alert switch, all on by default; Alert Hour 1 and Alert Minute 1 default to 15:30.

tma-bands.text: Computes a triangular moving average of closes, a simple average smoothed by a second simple average, and offsets it by ATR times a multiplier to form Upper and Lower bands around TMA. Price near Upper or Lower shows stretch from the smoothed centre. Inputs are Length 20, ATR Multiplier 2 and ATR Length 14.

tma-overlay.text: Draws smoothed moving averages of the close with lengths 21, 50, 100 and 200, plus a fill between a hidden EMA(2) and the 200 SMMA: green when the EMA is above, red when below. Triangles mark three-candle strikes and engulfing candles; engulfing candles also trigger Bullish Engulfing and Bearish Engulfing alerts. Show Trade Session shades the chosen hours in the set Timezone (default America/Chicago).

tmo.text: Each bar's close is compared with the open of the current bar and the previous Length bars, scoring +1, -1 or 0, and the sum is smoothed by an EMA (Calculation Length), then Main and Signal by EMAs of Smooth Length. Green means Main is above Signal, red otherwise; Overbought and Oversold sit near 0.7 times Length, with Overbought Line and Oversold Line at plus and minus Length. Defaults: Length 14, Calculation Length 5, Smooth Length 3.

tonyux-ema-scalper.text: Plots an EMA of the close, plus High Channel and Low Channel lines, the highest and lowest close over the channel length. A Buy arrow appears below the bar when the close crosses the EMA and is above the prior close, and a Sell arrow above the bar when it crosses with a lower close. Defaults: EMA Length 20, Channel Length 8.

top-bottom-candle.text: Plots Momentum (close change over Percent D Length 3 bars, times 1000), a Stochastic Momentum Index of close against the range midpoint, and SMI Signal Line. Levels: Over Bought 40, Over Sold -40, Zero Line. Bars turn lime when SMI is below -35 and Momentum crosses above zero, red above 35 and crossing below. Percent K Length 5 sets the range.

tops-bottoms.text: Computes a volatility index: close minus the average of the bar midpoint, divided by the averaged ATR scaled by the square root of Length. The Bullish and Bearish lines are fixed thresholds. A green star appears below the bar when the index leaves the zone at or under Bullish, and a red star above it when it leaves the zone at or over Bearish. Defaults: Length 3, Bullish -0.51, Bearish 0.43.

tr-high-low-meter.text: Adds the true range to a list when the lookback highest source rises, and subtracts it when the lowest falls, keeping the last Look back entries (7). The TR High/Low Meter is their sum, optionally smoothed by EMA smoothing. Green area above zero is bullish, red below is bearish. Use no trade zone adds High Threshold 10 and Low Threshold -10, with Buy Signal, Sell Signal and Neutral Signal alerts.

trade-price-spread-compensator-overlay.text: Draws ask and bid candles offset from the chart price by a spread, equal to Spread (pips) (2) divided by Decimal Units (10000). Ask candles add the spread to high, low and close; bid candles subtract it; both open at the previous bar's own close. Anchor Mode (Both) shows Ask, Bid or both candle sets.

trade-prime-fluid-trend-indicator.text: Runs a HalfTrend line with an ATR-based channel around it, all smoothed with a Hull moving average. The centre line takes the bull colour in an uptrend and the bear colour in a downtrend; the ribbon shows only the active side, and a triangle marks each trend flip. Trading Mode (Trend Mode) multiplies the Intensity Level (1) by 5, and Smoothness Length is 16.

trader-xo.text: Plots fast and slow EMAs, or one Consolidated EMA when Show Both EMAs is off, coloured green when fast is above slow and red when below. Bull and Bear triangles mark the first bar after a fast/slow crossover, and bars are tinted by trend. A Stoch RSI K/D crossover, filtered by MA Type and MA Length, feeds the Stoch RSI Crossover alert. Defaults: Fast EMA 12, Slow EMA 25, Consolidated EMA 25.

traders-dynamic-index-indicator-alert-v0.text: Builds a Traders Dynamic Index from an RSI: a volatility band with a middle line (MBL), a fast RSI line (RSI PL) and a slower TSL Signal line. Bars are coloured by long or short strength when RSI PL crosses TSL Signal inside the RSI Oversold Level (22) and RSI Overbought Level (78), with the price action channel and bar direction confirming. Strength Level (2) sets which grades show.

traders-reality-main.text: Overlays PVSRA volume-based candle colouring, EMAs of 5, 13, 50, 200 and 800 with a cloud around the 50, previous day and week highs and lows, pivot and M levels, average range lines, sessions and psy levels. Green/red bars mark the strongest volume, blue/violet weaker ones, grey the rest; plots like YDay Hi and Daily Open give reference levels. Show EMAs? is on by default; ADR is shown, RD/W label offset is 24.

trading-abc.text: Builds a trend cloud from four SMAs and two EMAs, with a zigzag and Fibonacci retracement range, and labels A, B and C when a counter-trend pullback retraces between the Fibonacci Min and Fibonacci Max. A triangle appears below (ABC Long) or above (ABC Short) a bar when a trend-side candle bounces off an average soon after an ABC. Inputs: ZigZag Period 8, Fibonacci Max 0.618, Fibonacci Min 0.382, Error Rate 5.

trading-activity-index.text: Takes the log of the average dollar volume (close times volume) over the Formation Window. Trading Activity shifts from light blue to orange-red as it moves from the low to the high of the History Window. P20, P40, P60 and P80 mark the matching percentiles of that history. Defaults: Formation Window (bars) 20, History Window (bars) 252.

trading-gaul.text: A Chandelier Exit: the long stop is the highest close (or high) over the period minus a multiple of ATR, the short stop the lowest close (or low) plus it. Long Stop shows while the direction is long and Short Stop while short; the direction flips when the close passes the opposite stop, marked by a circle and Buy or Sell label. ATR Period defaults to 22, ATR Multiplier to 3.

trading-sessions.text: Draws a box for each session run on intraday charts, spanning the lowest low to highest high of the session's bars. A label gives the range in ticks, average close and name; dashed lines mark the session open and latest close, and a dotted line the average close. Defaults are Tokyo 0900-1500, London 0830-1630 and New York 0930-1600, set by Session time and Session timezone.

tradingmoja-sqzmom-adx.text: Squeeze momentum histogram (linear regression of close versus a channel midpoint and SMA, auto-scaled to Altura Objetivo Squeeze, 45) with dots on zero: blue no squeeze, black squeeze on, gray squeeze off. Bar colour shows sign and whether momentum is rising. The ADX line is drawn with a dashed ADX Threshold (20); DI+ and DI- show with Mostrar lineas DI+ / DI-. Uses KC Length 20, KC MultFactor 1.5 and ADX Length 14.

trailing-stop-loss-indicator-by-k-van-fr.text: Plots the previous bar's low taken at the second most recent bar whose low rose above the prior bar's low, computed on the bars of the chosen timeframe. It forms a stepped line under price that moves only when a new higher low appears, read as a trailing reference level. The Time Frame input defaults to D.

trama.text: An adaptive moving average that counts how many of the last Length bars moved more than the average absolute bar-to-bar change. That share, times the standard smoothing factor of 2/(Length+1), sets how fast the line follows the Source. It is steadier when moves are small and quicker when many bars move strongly. Defaults: Length 14, Source close.

transient-zones.text: Draws a channel from the lowest low and highest high of the previous H left bars. Triangles mark bars that reach a new extreme of that window (potential zones, green above, red below). Arrows mark a bar that was the extreme across H left plus H right bars. Hidden percentage plots count these over Sample bars for % TZ. Defaults: H left 10, H right 10, Sample bars 5000.

tremor-tracker.text: Measures each bar's high-to-low move in percent and draws it with a moving average, Vol MA. Vol is coloured by its ratio to the long-run average: lime below the Low Volatility Limit (1), yellow below the High Volatility Limit (2), fuchsia above. Volatility MA Length is 20 and Average Volatility Lookback is 200.

trend-channels-with-liquidity-breaks.text: Builds down and up trend channels from the last two pivot highs or lows (Length 8), with top, bottom and centre lines 6 ATR apart and shaded zones. A channel ends when price closes fully beyond its top or bottom line, leaving a label: LV, MV or HV for the volume state. Wait for Break (on) delays a new channel while the opposite kind is active.

trend-direction-helper.text: Combines trend labels, pivot levels and a percent zigzag. Buy (B) and sell (S) labels appear when a Williams %R based value moves from one zone to the other, set by Risk (14). Pivot circles from Left Pivot (50), Right Pivot (25) and Quick Right Pivot (5) show only on the last bar, green when the close is at or above them, else red. The zigzag reverses at 1.75 percent.
names: Percent of last pivot price for zigzag reversal:

trend-direction-zone.text: Draws a lag-reduced EMA trend line with a zone around it whose width is ATR-based and scales with where the ATR sits in its recent range. Direction turns bullish or bearish after Direction Confirmation bars (2) of a rising or falling line with price beyond the Switch Filter (ATR) distance. Triangles mark changes, and Minimum Bars Between Signals is 5. Trend Length is 20, Zone Width 2.

trend-double-pullback-v1-0.text: Plots EMAs of 15, 25, 50, 70 and a 199 baseline. A trend counts as stable when the short pair stays fully above (or below) the medium pair for Trend Stability Bars (20). A first pullback to a band marks a watch signal; a second one to the same band gives a Buy or Sell marker, after Signal Cooldown Bars (10).

trend-duration-forecast.text: Computes a Hull moving average of the close; the trend is up when it is above its last Trend Detection Sensitivity values (3) and down when below them. The HMA line takes the trend colour. Labels at each change show the trend's real length, and an arrow shows the probable length, the average of the last Trend Sample Size (10) trends. Smoothing Length is 50.

trend-filter.text: Smooths the close with a two-pole filter set by Length (20) and Damping (0.9). The line shifts from neutral toward the up or down colour as rising or falling bars build up; circles appear ATR-based Bands (1) away once Rising and Falling (5) bars run in a row. Signals (off) adds triangles.

trend-flow-oscillator-adx.text: Adds Chaikin money flow to a money flow index rescaled to -1 to +1, with light smoothing, as TFO. The line is blue at or above zero and red or maroon below, shaded by direction; grey background marks values beyond 1. ADX (scaled) is drawn too. MFI Length 14, CMF Length 20, TFO Smoothing 2.

trend-following-ma.text: Plots 20 moving averages with lengths from 5 to 100 in steps of 5, of the chosen MA Type, optionally smoothed by linear regression. Each line shows only when its recent range exceeds a channel set by Trend Channel Rate %, green when rising and red when falling, with stronger shades for stronger trends. Defaults: EMA, Period to Check Trend 20, rate 1, Use Linear Regression on, Linear Regression Period 10.

trend-heatmap.text: Combines two volume-weighted RSI-like lines, one on the 8-bar average price and one on the close over 20 bars, with a bar strength from where the close sits within the bar's range. The Trend line is coloured on a gradient from green toward red between 30 and 80. Dotted levels mark Max (100), Mid (50) and Min (0). It has no inputs.

trend-impulse-channels.text: An ATR-based Trend Line that steps along the trend and resets to the close when price moves beyond a Trigger Threshold multiple of ATR from it. Upper Band and Lower Band sit a Band Multiplier of ATR away, with a filled channel. Triangles mark band retests. Defaults: Trigger Threshold 2.86, Max Step Size -0.034, Band Multiplier 2.02, Trend Hold 0.

trend-indicator-a-v2.text: Smooths the open, close, high and low of Heikin Ashi candles with the chosen moving average, then fills a cloud between the smoothed open and close. The close line and cloud take the positive colour when the smoothed close is above the smoothed open, otherwise the negative colour; lighter clouds span the smoothed high and low beyond the body. Main inputs: MA Type (EMA) and MA Period (Length) (9).

trend-levels.text: Tracks the trend from the highest high or lowest low of the last length bars, then plots the running highest high (High Level), lowest low (Low Level) and their average (Mid Level) since the trend changed. Closes above versus below the Mid Level are counted, and the candles shade from the down colour to the up colour by that balance. The length input defaults to 30.

trend-line-auto.text: Finds fractal highs and lows, where a bar is the highest or lowest of the last Fractals Period bars, then joins each to an earlier fractal within Segment Range bars using the smallest angle. Top lines and bottom lines get separate colours, and lines far from price are removed or dotted. Defaults: Bars Limit 100, Segment Range 55, Fractals Period 15.

trend-lines.text: Finds pivot highs and lows using Left Bars and Right Bars (30 each) and joins each pivot to the previous one on its side. A lower pivot high gives a downtrend line, a higher pivot low an uptrend line, extended right unless a slope comparison stops it. Pivots are marked H or L. Show Old Line as Dashed (on) dashes the earlier line.

trend-lines-for-rsi-cci-momentum-obv.text: Computes RSI, CCI, a Momentum line (a CCI over its own length) or OBV, then finds pivot highs and lows of that line and joins rising lows or falling highs into trend lines, kept only if the line is never crossed. Levels sit at 70 and 30 for RSI, 100 and -100 for CCI. Inputs: Indicator (RSI), RSI Length (14), CCI Length (20), Momentum Length (10), Pivot Point Period (10), Number of Pivot Point to check (3).
names: Number of Pivot Point to check

trend-lines-v2.text: Detects pivot highs and lows over Pivot Period bars, keeping the latest Number of Pivot Points to check. It draws lines through rising pivot lows and falling pivot highs only if no later close breaks them, up to three each. Nothing is drawn before the start date set by Start Year 2020, Start Month 1 and Start day 1.
names: Number of Pivot Points to check

trend-magic.text: An ATR trailing stop steered by CCI. With CCI at or above zero the line follows the low minus ATR and only rises; at or below zero it follows the high plus ATR and only falls. The Trend Magic line is green when CCI is non-negative, red otherwise. Inputs: CCI Period 20, ATR Period 5, ATR Multiplier 1.

trend-meter.text: Shows three rows of dots, each a trend test chosen from MACD, Mom Dad, RSI or trend candles, green when bullish and red when not. The background turns green when all three agree bullish and red when all agree bearish, with a large dot where they first align. Two trend bars below turn green when a fast moving average is above a slow one (Fast MA 5 and Slow MA 11 for bar 1, 13 and 36 for bar 2).

trend-predictor-ribbon.text: Computes a trailing stop around a Hull moving average of the Source, offset by ATR times a multiplier. In an up trend the stop only rises, in a down trend it only falls, and it flips sides when the close crosses it. Trend Line is green in an up trend and red in a down trend, with a ribbon to price and triangles at crosses. Inputs: Trend Length 10, ATR Multiplier 2.

trend-pro.text: Colours candles by a phase-compensated Hull average of hlc3 and a least squares line of the Source. Green means the Hull line rises with the close above that line; red is the mirror; grey marks other moving bars. LONG and SHORT labels use an ATR trailing level scored by Long Threshold (4) and Short Threshold (-4).

trend-pulse-oscillator.text: Divides the gap between a fast and a slow EMA by the ATR, scales it with Speed (Sensitivity), and squashes it into a 0 to 100 line called Osc. Signal is an EMA of Osc, and Pulse (Osc - Signal) is their difference as a histogram, green when Osc is at or above Signal, red otherwise. Dashed levels sit at 50, Overbought (80) and Oversold (20). Defaults: Fast EMA 9, Slow EMA 21, ATR Length 14.

trend-range-detector.text: Computes a centre from a weighted average of recent closes and flags a range while every close in the window stays within ATR times a multiplier of it. It draws a box with top, bottom and dotted middle lines. With Highlight Box Breaks on, green marks a close above the box, red below. Inputs: Minimum Range Length (50), Range Width Multiplier (2).

trend-scalper.text: Draws three EMAs of the close with lengths EMA 1 Length (9), EMA 2 Length (21) and EMA 3 Length (89). With a bullish stack, a triangle below the bar marks a low between EMA 2 and EMA 1; a bearish stack gives a triangle above on a high in that band. First signals only? (off) limits triangles to the first after an opposite stack within Lookback Bars for Trend Validation (50).

trend-state-signals.text: A step filter that moves only when the source leaves a band of the previous filter plus or minus a range, the range being a smoothed average absolute price change times a multiplier. Trend is bullish when the filter rises and bearish when it falls; BULLISH and BEARISH labels mark changes. Sensitivity Length 20, Range Multiplier 3.5, Confirm Signals On Bar Close on.

trend-strength.text: Computes the Pearson correlation between closing prices and bar index over a rolling window, giving a value from -1 to 1. Above 0 suggests prices are rising across the window, below 0 falling; values near 1 or -1 mean a very straight trend. Dashed levels sit at 0, 1 and -1. Length is 14 by default.

trend-strength-direction.text: Builds six Hull moving averages of the close and plots each one's slope as an angle in degrees, the arctangent of its one-bar change. Lines above 0 slope up, below 0 slope down, and the grey band marks -45 to 45. HMA Length 1 to 5 default to 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100; Custom HMA Length is 5. Alerts fire on HMA1 beyond the levels.

trend-targets.text: Builds a Baseline from an EMA of a WMA of the midpoint of two trailed Supertrend bands. The trend turns up or down when the Baseline turns; arrows mark rejections when bars straddle it more than Confirmation count (3) times. With Show Take Profit Levels on, each turn draws an entry, a stop set by Stop Loss ATR Multiplier (5) and three targets scaled by TP1 Multiplier, TP2 Multiplier and TP3 Multiplier.

trend-trader.text: Builds a stepped trailing line from the prior bar's highest high minus, or lowest low plus, a Multiplier times the weighted average true range over Length. The line moves to the upper limit when the close is above both limits, and to the lower limit when below both; otherwise it holds. Bars are green above the line, red below, blue otherwise. Defaults: Length 21, Multiplier 3.

trend-trigger-factor.text: Compares the highest high and lowest low of the latest Length bars with those from the prior Length bars to get buying and selling ranges, then scales their difference into TTF. Values above Buy Trigger (100) or below Sell Trigger (-100) are the signal zones; Buy Clip and Sell Clip cap the line at those levels. A zero line is also drawn. Length is 15.

trend-type-indicator-by-bobrivera990.text: Classifies each bar as uptrend, sideways or downtrend: sideways when ATR is at or below its average or ADX is at or below ADX Limit (25), otherwise direction follows +DI versus -DI. The Trend Type Oscillator is that class smoothed over Smoothing Factor (3) bars and shifted back by Lag (8). It steps among Band_2 (up), 0 (sideways) and Band_0 side (down) zones.

trend-volatility-index.text: Computes the average of the six pairwise gaps between four SMAs of the Base Price (lengths 10, 20, 40, 70), drawn as candles opening at the prior value and closing at the current one, with highs and lows reaching the value rounded to Step Factor. Green candles mean a rise. ATR (28) and High-Low Range MA (28) show as reference areas. Inputs: Step Factor 1, ATR_len 14, Range_len 14.

trend-with-adx-ema-buy-sell-signals.text: Compares +DI and -DI, built from smoothed directional movement and true range: the background is green when +DI is above -DI, else red. A FastEMA and SlowEMA of the close are drawn; a Buy label marks the fast crossing above the slow after a downward cross, Sell the reverse. Inputs: ADX Length 14, FastEMA 5, SlowEMA 8.

trendcylinder.text: A Trend Line that jumps to the midpoint between close and itself when the close strays far from it, scaled by smoothed ATR times Factor and Step; otherwise it stays flat. Upper Band and Lower Band sit around it, with gradient fills. The line is drawn only while direction is unchanged from the prior bar. Defaults: Period 100, Factor 9, Step 0.7.

trending-market-toolkit.text: Detects swing points from legs and looks for reversal patterns (five swings) and trend continuation patterns (four swings), drawing trend lines plus reversal or retracement areas. When price returns to an area and closes through a recent internal swing, it plots a trade with risk and reward boxes, if the ratio reaches Risk to Reward Threshold (3). Swing Length defaults to 5.

trendline-breakout-navigator.text: Draws trendlines from swing highs and lows at three lengths: Long 60, Medium 30 and Short 10. A higher high starts a bullish line at the previous swing low, a lower low a bearish line at the previous swing high; later swings tilt the line, and a close through it stops it. Term picks which length gets HH/LL labels, background and bar colours.

trendline-breakouts-with-targets.text: Draws a falling trendline through the last two pivot highs and a rising one through the last two pivot lows, each with a shaded band, extended past the last pivot. A green up label marks a close above the falling line, a red down label a close below the rising one; Show Targets adds a dashed Target line. Period 10, Type Wicks, Extend 25.

trendlines-2x.text: Draws two sets of trendlines through pivot highs and lows, a primary set with 1 - Primary - Lookback Length (20) and a secondary with 2 - Secondary - Lookback Length (7), each continued along its slope. Green lines join falling highs, red lines join lows that do not fall. Trend Candles (off) colours bars from Heikin Ashi.

trendlines-jd.text: Finds pivot highs and lows and draws a solid line through the last two pivots of each side, then a dotted continuation on the same slope. Close crossings over a line mark breaks: a triangle below the bar and lime bar for lines of highs, a triangle above and fuchsia bar for lows. Main inputs: loockback length pivots (30) and Limit extensions of the lines? 0 = infinite, other values x 50 bars (2).
names: Limit extensions of the lines? 0 = infinite, other values x 50 bars

trendlines-with-breaks.text: Finds swing highs and lows and draws sloping trendlines from each, descending from highs (Upper) and rising from lows (Lower), with the slope set by Atr, Stdev or Linreg. A B label marks a close breaking a line; alerts are Upward Breakout and Downward Breakout. Inputs: Swing Detection Lookback 14, Slope 1, Slope Calculation Method Atr, backpaint on, which shifts lines back in time.

trendmasterpro-fekonomi.text: Weighted vote of MACD crossover, RSI versus 50, EMA crossover with a DI/ADX filter, and price versus a two-span cloud. BUY or SELL labels appear when the vote share reaches the Confidence Level (%) of 70. Short EMA (9), Long EMA (21), both spans with a green or red fill, and the close are plotted.

trendshift.text: Tracks the last confirmed swing high and low and detects structure shifts when the close breaks one, by default at least one ATR beyond it. A shift builds a band, and the background is tinted when the close is in its lower or upper quarter. Triangles labelled Shift↑ or Shift↓ mark the first shift in each direction. Inputs: Swing length 5, ATR length 14, Break ATR mult 1, Regime timeout bars 500.

trendshift-detector.text: Counts runs of same-colour candles, and when the colour flips after enough of them, searches the next few bars for a setup. A down triangle above marks a bearish candle with almost no upper wick; an up triangle below marks a bullish one with almost no lower wick. Séquence min (bougies) is 1, Taille min corps (%) 0.1, Tolérance mèche (%) 0.05, Bougies max à chercher 5, with a time filter on.

trendsync-buy-sell-by-simply-dante-fx.text: Uses the close against the SMA as the trend. Bars with a range above ATR times Range Filter Multiplier give a BUY or SELL label on the first bar of a condition, using the prior three bars' high or low and RSI against RSI Threshold for Buy/Sell. SMA Length 200, ATR Length 14, multiplier 1.2, RSI Length 14, threshold 50.

trendwave-bands.text: Draws an upper band from the highest of a short average plus volatility and a lower band from the lowest of a Length (50) average minus volatility, scaled by Factor (1). When hlc3 crosses a band the trend turns up or down, that band is hidden and the other fades as the trend lasts. Dotted waves sit five ATRs away.

tri-star-bearish.text: Looks for three doji candles in a row after an uptrend, where the second doji's body gaps above the first and the third's body gaps below the second. A bearish label marks the third bar. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the uptrend, checked at the first doji, is judged.

tri-star-bullish.text: Looks for three doji candles in a row after a downtrend, where the second doji's body gaps below the first and the third's body gaps above the second. A bullish label marks the third bar. Detect Trend Based On (default SMA50) sets how the downtrend, checked at the first doji, is judged.

triangular-hull-moving-average-volatilit.text: Computes a triangular Hull moving average of the Source over Length, and compares it with its own value 2 bars back. Candles run from the average to its 2-bar-old value, with wicks widened by a smoothed bar range when Volatility (15) is on. Up colour means the average is above the older value; triangles mark crossings. Length is 40.

triangular-momentum-osc.text: Smooths the Source with two moving averages of Length, then takes the change of that over Length bars, shown as a histogram around zero. Greens are above zero and reds below, with brighter shades when it is rising or falling. Buy and Sell labels mark divergences between oscillator peaks or troughs and price extremes. Defaults: Length 7, Source close, Show Lines on.

trimmed-mean-atr-bands.text: A trimmed mean of the source (sorted values, the extremes at each end dropped, the rest averaged) with bands one ATR above and below. The signal turns up when the high exceeds the upper band and down when the low breaks the lower band; candles are coloured by it, and only the band opposite the signal is drawn. Inputs: TM length (66), Trim amount (%) (25), ATR length (18).

triple-doji-sequence.text: Finds doji bars whose one wick is much larger than its 200-bar average, with a small body and a small opposite wick. A star above the bar marks an upper-wick doji, a star below marks a lower-wick doji; the Doji 1, 2 and 3 toggles (only Doji 1 on) pick 1, 2 or 3 consecutive same-side dojis. Dominant Wick Multiple is 3, Recessive Wick Multiple 1, Body Multiple 0.6.

triple-gaussian-smoothed-ribbon.text: Applies a Gaussian-weighted average to the source three times to form Core Gaussian, then smooths it again at Signal Length 18 and longer lengths for the ribbon. The line and candles shift in colour between bullish and bearish by the gap between the signal and core. Triangles mark crossings, skipped in flat ranges. Main Smoothing Length is 7, Sigma 3.

triple-ma-for-loop.text: Computes a triple moving average of the MA Source, then scores it by looping from Loop Start to Loop End, adding 1 for each lag where the source is above the earlier average and subtracting 1 otherwise. FL Histogram is that score; it turns bullish above Threshold Uptrend and bearish below Threshold Downtrend, and labels mark those changes. Defaults: MA Length 45, EMA, loop 5 to 55, thresholds 45 and 0.

triple-ma-forecast.text: Plots three simple moving averages (Short MA 7, Mid MA 30, Long MA 50) with circles on the last bar projecting each average 1, 2 and 3 bars ahead. MA Forecast Type sets the assumed future prices: flat repeats the current source, linreg extends a regression over the number of candles set (default 3). Source defaults to close.
names: # of candles to use in linear regression

triple-rsi-misinkomaster.text: Combines three RSIs of the Source, each centred on zero: a short one plus a medium one minus a long one, then smooths the result three times. TRSI is green with a green fill above the Zero Line and red below it. The background changes colour on bars where TRSI crosses zero, in the price pane too. Inputs: TRSI Length 30 sets the three RSI lengths, Source close.

trix.text: Takes the natural log of close, smooths it with three successive exponential averages, then takes the one-bar change times 10000. TRIX above the Zero level means the triple-smoothed trend is rising; below, falling. Input: length (18).

true-breakout-pattern-breakout-signal.text: Finds major swing highs and lows (pivots with Swing Period bars on each side) and flags a failed breakout: a close beyond the swing, then a close back across it within Back to Break-Even Period bars. A dashed line joins the swing to the signal bar, with an FBO label, a cross and Fibonacci levels from 1 to 0. Swing Period is 50 and Valid After Trigger Bars is 5.

true-high-low-rsi-for-divergence.text: Computes two RSIs over RSI Length (14): High RSI from the High RSI Source (high) and Low RSI from the Low RSI Source (low), each from smoothed average gains and losses.
