High RSI is visible only above 50 and fully opaque at 70 or more; Low RSI is visible only below 50 and fully opaque at 30 or less, for comparing with price swings.

true-range-expansion.text: Draws each bar as a low-to-high candle coloured by close versus open, plus moving averages of highs and lows pushed outward by a smoothed ATR scaled by ATR Multiplier. MA of High and MA of Low form an envelope, with Basis at their midpoint. Defaults: MA Length 100, MA Type WMA, ATR Length 3, ATR Smoothing 15, ATR Multiplier 10.

tsi.text: Smooths the bar-to-bar close change and its absolute value with two exponential averages each, then scales their ratio to 100 times. True Strength Index swings around the Zero level, positive when smoothed changes are mostly up. Signal is a moving average of it. Defaults: Long Length 25, Short Length 13, Signal Length 13.

ttm-squeeze-greeny.text: Plots a momentum histogram: the linear regression of close minus half of (midpoint of the highest high and lowest low plus the average close) over Length (20) bars. Bright bars mean it is rising, dark bars falling, cyan at or above zero and magenta below. Squeeze dots on zero are red when the Bollinger upper band sits inside the Keltner upper band, green otherwise.

ttm-squeeze-pro.text: Plots a momentum histogram, a linear regression of the source's distance from the average of the Donchian midline and the SMA, plus a row of SQZ dots at zero showing how Bollinger Bands sit inside three Keltner channels. Dots are orange for the tight KC Mult 1 (Tight), red for KC Mult 2 (Normal), black for KC Mult 3 (Wide), green for no squeeze. Key inputs are BB Length 20, BB MultFactor 2 and KC Length 20.

ttrades-daily-bias.text: Compares the day that just ended with the one before it (and the week, if Weekly Bias is on) to set a bias toward the previous high or low. A close beyond a level, a failed break that closed back inside, or an inside period decides it, and a label can give the reason. Previous high and low lines change colour when reached; Daily Bias is on and Weekly Bias off by default.

turtle-soup-ict-strategy-fvg-choch-csd.text: Finds swing highs and lows on the Higher TimeFrame Levels bars (60 default, Swing Period 50) and marks an HTF Liquidity Sweep when price trades through one but closes back inside. After a sweep it draws an MSS level and, once a close breaks it, the latest fair value gap as a supply or demand zone lasting FVG Length (120) bars. MSS Length defaults to 80.

turtle-trade-channels.text: Plots the highest high and lowest low over Entry Length (default 20) as Entry High and Entry Low, and over Exit Length (default 10) as Exit High and Exit Low. Long and Short labels appear when price reaches the prior entry channel edge, and Exit L or Exit S when it reaches the exit edge. Trend Line and Exit Line follow whichever side broke most recently.

twap.text: Plots the running average of the chosen Source over the current anchor period, restarting at the start of each new period. The TWAP line therefore shows the equal-weighted average price so far in that period. Anchor Period defaults to 1D, Source to ohlc4, and Offset (default 0) shifts the line by bars.

tweezer-bottom.text: Looks for a two-candle bullish reversal after a downtrend: a long red candle followed by a green one whose low nearly matches the first candle's low. The second candle must not be a doji body unless it has shadows on both sides. A label marks the match. Detect Trend Based On sets the trend test, defaulting to SMA50.

tweezer-top.text: Looks for a two-candle bearish reversal after an uptrend: a long green candle followed by a red one whose high nearly matches the first candle's high. The second candle must not be a doji body unless it has shadows on both sides. A label marks the match. Detect Trend Based On sets the trend test, defaulting to SMA50.

tweezers-kangaroo-tail.text: Scans candles for two patterns. A T label marks tweezers: two recent highs (or lows) within Max Distance between Tweezers whose wicks are similar in size and end near the same level. A K label marks a kangaroo tail: a long rejection wick, at least Wick/Body Rate 3 times the body, after a zigzag swing with enough room. Alerts exist for each bearish and bullish kind.

twin-range-filter.text: Averages a fast and a slow smoothed range of price changes, scaled by Fast range (1.6) and Slow range (2), and builds a filter that follows the Source only when price moves beyond that range. A Long label appears when price turns above a rising filter after a short state, and Short for the mirror. Periods are Fast period 27 and Slow period 55; Long and Short alerts fire on the labels.

twin-range-filter-visualized.text: Smooths the bar-to-bar change of the Source with two double EMAs (Fast period 27, Slow period 55), scales them by Fast range 1.6 and Slow range 2, and averages them into a range that drives a trailed band filter, drawn as Plot. BUY and SELL labels mark closes crossing it; the fill to OHLC4 is green above, red below.

two-pole-oscillator.text: Takes the close's distance from its 25-bar average, standardises it as a z-score, and smooths it twice with an exponential filter set by Filter Length (15). A buy circle appears when Two-Pole crosses above its value 4 bars back below zero; a sell when it crosses below above zero. Levels (on) draws dashed price levels from each signal, plus Level 1, Level 0.5, Zero, Level -0.5 and Level -1.

ulcer-index.text: Measures downside risk as the square root of the average squared percentage drop of the Source (default close) from its highest value in the last Length bars (default 14). Higher readings mean deeper or longer drawdowns; zero means no drop from the high. A dashed Zero level is drawn.

ultimate-buy-sell.text: Computes an RSI with Bollinger bands and price bands, and sets watch flags when RSI crosses its bands. A buy or sell triangle appears when RSI crosses its basis while a matching watch flag falls within the Watch Signal Lookback (35 bars). Candles are coloured by price versus the Fast MA Length (10) and Slow MA Length (20) averages. Also RSI Length 32.

ultimate-moving-average-mtf.text: Plots a moving average of the close, chosen from SMA, EMA, WMA, Hull, VWMA, RMA or TEMA, on the chart or a higher timeframe. The line is lime when it is at or above its value Color Smoothing bars ago and red when below. An optional second average is drawn as circles, and MA Cross marks where the two cross. Moving Average Length defaults to 20 and Color Smoothing to 2.

ultimate-opening-range-breakout.text: Builds the high and low of an opening range from the Opening Range Session (default 0930-1000, Timezone UTC-5) and projects three extension levels on each side, as multiples (1, 2, 3) or Fibonacci ratios. A close crossing above the range high or below the low after the session gives a bull or bear break label, tagged high or low volume. A hit-rate dashboard and an optional ATR trailing stop are included.

ultimate-osc.text: Computes buying pressure (close minus the lower of low and previous close) divided by true range, summed over three windows, then blends the three ratios with weights 4, 2 and 1 and scales to 0-100. The single Oscillator line shows where closes sit within the range: higher means closes nearer the top. Windows are set by Fast Length (7), Middle Length (14) and Slow Length (28).

ultimate-rsi.text: An RSI variant that uses the highest-to-lowest range as the move when a new high or low is made, otherwise the price change. The smoothed move over the smoothed absolute move is scaled to 0-100. Ultimate RSI turns green above Overbought (80) and red below Oversold (20), around a Midline at 50, with Signal Line smoothing it. Length is 14 and Method is RMA.

ultra-clean-support-resistance-levels.text: Finds pivot highs and lows of the high and low, and holds the latest pivot high as Resistance and the latest pivot low as Support until a new pivot appears. Each level is drawn as a flat segment, once shifted back to the pivot bar and once unshifted as Resistance 2 and Support 2. Pivot Length Left Hand Side is 25 and Pivot Length Right Hand Side is 5.

ultra-smart-trail.text: Builds a Trend Flow Line from a weighted blend of a Hull and a double weighted average of the close, with deviation bands around it from the close's standard deviation. In an uptrend the lower bands show, otherwise the upper bands, until price breaks past the outer band. Length is 24, Smooth 9, Multiplier (inner) 0.618, Multiplier 1.

um-ema-sma-wma-hma-with-directional-colo.text: A moving average of the chosen Source (EMA by default) and a Smoothing Line that applies the same Method to the MA. Both lines are green when the MA is above the Smoothing Line and red otherwise (reversed for HMA), with fills between them and the price. Arrows can mark colour flips, which also drive the alerts. Defaults: Length 65, Smoothing Length 2, Source OHLC4.

unicorn-setup-detector.text: Builds two zones from the 3-bar lowest low and highest high plus or minus half the 2-bar high-low range. A blue triangle below the bar marks a close crossing above the lower zone; a red triangle above marks a close crossing below the upper zone. Both triangles are drawn one bar earlier than the crossing. It has no inputs.

universal-large-orders-proxy-fabio-valen.text: Scores each bar's buy and sell pressure from volume, close position in the range and body size, then compares it with the previous bars' average. A signal needs a strong score, high volume, wide range and a bullish or bearish candle shape. Circles grow with the score. Lookback 30, Pressure Sigma 2.3.

universal-signal-backtester.text: Simulates one trade at a time from moving-average cross signals (Source Mode, default Predefined Crosses, 9/21 EMA Cross), entering at the signal close with up to three take profits and three stop losses at ATR multiples. It draws target lines marked hit or missed, win and loss crosses, and a results dashboard. Take Profit 1 to 3 default to 1, 2 and 3; Stop Loss 1 to 3 to 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5.

up-down-volume.text: Splits each bar's volume into up and down volume, using the bar's direction or an estimate based on close versus the previous close. Up Volume shows as green columns above zero, Down Volume as red columns below, and a dash marks the net difference, green when positive and red otherwise. Use custom timeframe (off) and Timeframe (1) choose the lower timeframe.

upside-tasuki-gap.text: Marks a three-candle pattern with a UTG label in an uptrend: a long green candle, a smaller green one whose body gaps above it, then a red candle that opens and closes inside the gap without filling it. Detect Trend Based On sets the trend test (default SMA50).

uptrick-dynamic-z-score-deviation.text: Plots Smoothed MA (ALMA + ZLMA), the average of an ALMA and a zero-lag EMA of the close, coloured by its slope, with ATR shadow bands around it. Buy and Sell labels appear when the price z-score and an RSI z-score both exceed their thresholds, the RSI EMA is below 40 or above 60, and the close turns. Inputs: Main MA Length 50, Z-Score Lookback 50, Price Z-Score Threshold 2, RSI Z-Score Threshold 1.5.

uptrick-multima-volume.text: Applies up to three chained smoothing steps to the close, each using a chosen moving average type from a list of 29, with each step fed by the previous one. Final MA (3x) is green while it rises and red otherwise, and the bars take the same colours. Only Enable Smoothing #1 is on by default, with Type #1 EMA and Length #1 9.

uptrick-rsi-ma-buying-selling-signals.text: Computes RSI of the source, then smooths it with an RMA of the same length to give RSI MA, drawn as a line and a Histogram around a dashed level at 50. Triangles mark RSI MA crossing above 50 (up, below the bar) or below 50 (down, above the bar). Defaults: Length 14, Source close.

uptrick-trend-analysis.text: Plots a MACD line (fast EMA minus slow EMA of the close) with an EMA Signal Line; the MACD Line is cyan above the signal and purple below. With Calculate Divergence on, it marks regular divergences between MACD pivots and price pivots, with Bull and Bear labels and alerts. Defaults: Fast EMA Period 12, Slow EMA Period 26, Signal Line Period 9.

uptrick-volatility-reversion-bands.text: Draws Bollinger-style bands on close, widened by ATR, as Reversal Upper and Reversal Lower. Bars shade from cyan to purple by close position between the bands. A close crossing under the lower band gives a ▲+ label, over the upper a ▼+ label; weak ▲ or ▼ labels appear near the bands. Lookback Length is 20, Standard Deviation Multiplier 2, ATR Multiplier 1.5.

user-defined-range-selector-and-color-ch.text: An EMA of the source (EMA Length 69, hlc3) coloured by its slope over Slope Length 3: blue rising, red falling, gray flat. When price strays beyond Overextension Threshold (%) (10.1) from the EMA it arms a setup, and a reversal signals once the close holds back across the EMA for Acceptance Bars After EMA Reclaim (2). A Reflection EMA of the low and mirrored lines are also drawn.

ut-bot.text: An ATR trailing stop that sits Key Value (Sensitivity) times the ATR below or above the close and only moves in the trend's favour until price closes through it, when it flips sides. The Trailing Stop line and bars are green with the close above the stop, red below. Buy and Sell labels mark crossings. Inputs: Key Value (Sensitivity) 1, ATR Period 10.

ut-bot-trend-volume.text: Computes an ATR-based trailing stop that rises while the close stays above it, falls while below, and resets on a flip. The stop is not drawn: a BUY label below the bar marks the close crossing above it, a SELL label above marks a cross below. Sensitivity (Lower = More Signals) multiplies the ATR (1) and ATR Period is 10. Alerts: UT Buy Signal, UT Sell Signal.

vacuum-candles.text: Redraws price candles with a black body whose transparency reflects volume per unit of range. Each bar's volume divided by its high-low range, times Multiplier, is compared with the average ratio over Length bars and capped at 0 to 1. Bars with a wide range for their volume look dark; bars with heavy volume for their range look transparent. Length defaults to 15 and Multiplier to 1.

variable-ma.text: An adaptive moving average whose smoothing speeds up when directional movement is strong and slows when price is ranging, using smoothed up and down moves of the source. VMA is green when rising, red when falling and purple when flat; bars are coloured likewise. Length defaults to 6, Source to close.

varis-zones.text: A volume-weighted average of the typical price (high, low, close mean) that restarts on the bar opening at 18:00 New York time, with two pairs of bands a fixed number of points above and below it. Price relative to the VWAP and the bands shows how far it has moved from the session average. The band distances are set by 1/2 Risk Interval (Points) (10) and 1 Full Risk Interval (Points) (25).

vco-fusion.text: Locates the close inside a channel around the SMA of the candle midpoint, giving an oscillator from -100 to 100, smoothed into MA 1 and MA 2 with the Histogram MA1-MA2 as their gap. Line colour turns bull or bear on MA 1 and MA 2 crosses; Overbought Level and Oversold Level mark the extremes. Volatility Window is 10, Band Scaling (%) 200.

vdub-binary-pro-3-v2.text: Draws a WMA of the close with bands at 2 and 3 times a WMA of the true range, a centre band from the SMA of highs and lows, and 3 and 13 bar SMAs with a circle at their cross. It also shows large and small channel highs and lows from other timeframes, and a zigzag. Key inputs: WMA Length 56, ATR Length 100, MA Period 21, LRG_Channel_TF_mins_D_W_M 30, SML_Channel_TF_mins_D_W_M 240.

vdub-sniper.text: Overlay combining a channel of the highest and lowest close, a self-referencing high/low resistance channel, recent swing high and low lines, two EMAs and a Hull MA. The EMAs are lime when rising and red when falling over two bars. Buy and sell markers appear when a TEMA/DEMA signal agrees with EMA 1 direction, and arrows mark trend flips. Inputs: EMA 1 13, EMA 2 21, Support / Resistance length: 6, Channel Period 13.

vdub-trend-master-v-v1-v2-v3.text: Combines several overlays: a 144-bar average (MA2), an Ichimoku cloud from Lead 1 and Lead 2 shifted ahead, higher-timeframe Extreme High and Extreme Low, previous Daily High and Daily Low, a ribbon of MMA averages from 5 to 90 bars, and a Channel Low and Channel High. Key inputs: MA2 Period: (144), ExtremeTimeFrame (240), Fast MA Length (5), Slow MA Length (90).

vdubus-binarypro.text: Overlay of a highest-high line and a lowest-low line drawn as dots, a simple moving average, and a band around the midpoint of those two lines. The band's half-width is BB Multiplier times the standard deviation of close over BB Length. Read price against the dots, the average and the shaded band. Defaults: Upper Channel 20, Lower Channel 20, MA1 Period 50, BB Length 20, BB Multiplier 1.5.

vdubus-divergence-wave-pattern-generator.text: Tracks zigzag pivots at a fast and a slow scale and tests the last five against peaks and troughs of the MACD histogram. Matching shapes are drawn as four-leg patterns with fills and a label at the last point, such as head and shoulders, harmonic names, climax, rounded and predator. Key inputs: Fast Pattern Scale (ZigZag) 9, Slow Pattern Scale (ZigZag) 24, Harmonic Tolerance 0.15.

vega.text: Builds an adaptive moving average of the close blended with its linear regression, then takes its bar-to-bar change as velocity, normalized by Z-Score (default) or ATR with a dead zone near zero. VEGA is a histogram: bright cyan is positive and rising, red is negative and falling. Squeeze Pro dots on zero show Bollinger Bands inside the Keltner Channel. Key inputs: ER Length 40, Normalization Z-Score.

vervoort-ha-oscillator.text: Smooths open, high, low and close with a triple EMA, builds Heiken Ashi candles from them, and plots the gap between the Heiken Ashi close and open as a percent of the close. Oscillator is a histogram around a dashed Zero level, teal when at or above zero and red below. Bars are also coloured green, red or blue by the sign. TEMA Length defaults to 55.

vim.text: Plots money volume (volume times close) as columns, with a simple average of it as MA of Money Volume. Columns are green, red or gray when the close is above, below or equal to the previous close, or to the open in the Candle Direction mode. Inputs: the moving average length (14) and the colouring method (Prev Close).

visible-average-price.text: Averages the chosen Source over the bars currently visible on the chart and draws one dashed horizontal line across the chart at that value. Read it as the mean price of the visible window; it moves when you scroll or zoom. The only input is Source (close); the Avg Price plot itself is shifted out of view.

visualisation-tendances.text: Shows an EMA of the price (Moyenne_décalee, drawn forward by décalage bars) against a 3-bar SMA of the close (lissage_prix), with a fill that is red while the EMA is above the SMA and green otherwise. It also draws Bollinger bands of the close. Both parts are off until Montrer visualisation tendance and Bandes_Bollinger are enabled; defaults are Moyenne expo Base 14, décalage 3, periode 20, Ecart type 2.

volatility-adaptive-filtered-trend.text: Follows the source with a smoothing speed that rises when ATR and net change are large against their averages, then smooths it with an EMA and a displacement-weighted filter. Bands sit around it by the stdev of returns times the multipliers; a close beyond a band flips the regime, shown by LONG and SHORT markers and colours. Key inputs: Volatility Length 15, Filter Length 9, Upper Multiplier 2, Lower Multiplier 2.

volatility-band-cloud-with-overextension.text: Plots a simple average of the Source over Basis Length (default 100) as the Center Line, with inner and outer bands at standard deviation multiples (Inner Band Deviation 1, Outer Band Deviation 2.5). The cloud shades red above the centre and green below. A down triangle labelled Upper marks the Source crossing above the Upper Outer Band; an up triangle labelled Lower marks a cross below the Lower Outer Band.

volatility-bands.text: Draws UMA, an adaptive moving average of the close that reacts more after large moves, with bands built on a log scale from an adaptive deviation of highs and lows. Hidden band lines feed shaded clouds: red above and green below, in two intensities for the inner and outer zones. UMA is lime when rising, red when falling, navy when flat. It has no inputs.

volatility-big-market-moves.text: Measures each bar's largest excursion from the previous close in percent: the climb to the high as a positive histogram and the drop to the low as a negative one. Bars whose climb (green) or drop (red) reaches the threshold get a background shade in both the price and indicator panes. The input Highlight Moves Exceeding % from Previous Candle Close defaults to 5.
names: Highlight Moves Exceeding % from Previous Candle Close

volatility-breakout-pulse.text: Draws Resistance and Support as the highest high and lowest low over Lookback Period (default 20). A close beyond the previous Resistance or Support tints the background green or red when Show Zones is on. It is labelled BUY or SELL only if the Resistance-to-Support range exceeds ATR(14) times Volatility Multiplier (default 1.5), and BUY ALERT and SELL ALERT fire on those labels.

volatility-channel-oscillator.text: Builds a channel around the average candle midpoint, widened by average range and body size, and shows where the close sits in it from -100 to 100 as Oscillator, plus a Signal SMA. Triangles mark crosses of the overbought and oversold levels, zero, or the Signal SMA through zero, per Signal Type. Key inputs: SMA Length / Volatility Window 30, Band Scaling (%) 200, SMA Length for Signal 20.

volatility-driven-vwap-structure.text: Follows a rolling VWAP of hlc3 with a stepped structure whose step scales with ATR and an adaptive volatility factor. When the VWAP moves a full step beyond it, the structure jumps and flips direction, shown by the VWAP Structure Mean colour. Each flip anchors a new VWAP with deviation bands. Inputs: Rolling VWAP Length 200, Structure Multiplier 1.5, Volatility Length 14.

volatility-gated-trend-oscillator.text: Measures the source's distance from a moving average, ignoring moves smaller than a noise floor (average absolute distance times Noise Threshold, 1.5). Bigger moves set an up or down trend; otherwise the held value decays. It is scaled by ATR and smoothed in Main, with shaded layers toward Zero, coloured by trend. Filter Strength is 20 and Baseline MA Type is SMA.

volatility-halo-nal.text: Draws Upper Band and Lower Band around the ZLEMA Baseline, at ATR times ATR Multiple times a GARCH-based volatility regime multiplier clamped between Min Multiplier and Max Multiplier. Bands take the bullish colour after a close above the upper band and the bearish colour after a close below the lower, holding it in between. Inputs: ZLEMA Baseline Length 50, ATR Length 24, ATR Multiple 1.8.

volatility-quality.text: True range signed by candle direction is smoothed by an EMA of VQI Length (14) then VQI Smoothing Length (5), and scaled to -100..100 over Normalization Lookback (200). AVQ is lime at or above Zero Line, red below, with stdev bands at Stdev Multiplier #1, #2 and #3 (1, 2, 3) as Upper and Lower lines. Small markers appear on the price pane when the 3 stdev band reaches +200 or -200.

volatility-stop.text: A trailing stop based on average true range scaled by a factor, plotted on the price pane as crosses. It trails below price in an uptrend (teal) and above it in a downtrend (red), and flips side when the source crosses the stop. Main inputs are Length (20), Source (close) and Multiplier (2).

vold-ratio-histogram.text: Natural log of the ratio of up-bar volume to down-bar volume summed over the last Période de calcul (somme) bars (30). Epsilon anti-division par zéro (1) is added to both sums. The histogram is green at or above zero, meaning up volume dominates, and red below zero, meaning down volume dominates.

volumatic-fair-value-gaps.text: Finds three-bar gaps where the low sits above the high two bars back (bullish) or the reverse (bearish), keeping only sizeable ones, and draws a box for each with its volume and two bars showing bullish and bearish volume shares. A gap is removed once price closes beyond its far side; at most 10 show. FVGs Mitigation Source defaults to close, or high/low; Volume Bars defaults on.

volumatic-sr-levels.text: Marks resistance when the highest high of Length bars (25) is no longer being made, and support the same way for lows. Each level has a band whose width scales with ATR and the bar's volume relative to recent peak volume. Dots appear when volume exceeds Resistance Max Volume % (80) or Support Max Volume % (80), and bars above Bars Max Volume % (50) are recoloured.

volumatic-variable-index-dynamic-average.text: A volume-aware adaptive average (VIDYA, weighted by absolute Chande momentum) smoothed over 15 bars, with bands at a multiple of the 200-bar ATR. The Trend Line is the lower band while the source is above the upper band's last cross, the upper band after a downward cross; markers flag each turn. Inputs: VIDYA Length (10), VIDYA Momentum (20), Distance factor for upper/lower bands (2).

volume-accumulation-pct.text: Scores each bar by where the close sits in the high-low range, scaled by volume, then divides the Length-bar average of that by the Length-bar average volume, times 100. VA% and VAPI Histogram show the result around a dashed Zero level: above zero means closes tend to land in the upper part of bars, below zero the lower part. DummyU and DummyL only feed the fills. Length defaults to 20.

volume-alert.text: Compares each bar's volume with the previous bar's, using either standard volume or an estimated aggression volume (body over range times volume, as an absolute value). A orange VOL label above a bar means volume reached the set multiple of, or grew by the set percent over, the prior bar. Inputs: Volume Type (Aggression), Comparison Mode (Multiplier), Factor (x times or %) (3).

volume-analysis-heatmap-and-volume-profi.text: Splits recent bars into grids of boxes, using lower-timeframe bars: Number of Columns (7) across time, Number of Rows (5) across price. Box colour shows signed volume against the largest of its sign; empty boxes are grey. On the last bar a volume profile with a value area of Value Area Volume (70) percent and a POC line are drawn.

volume-and-volatility-ratio-indicator-wo.text: Multiplies volume as a percent of its average by the bar range as a percent of the close, giving a step-line index. Short and long averages of the index are scaled by a sensitivity factor and drawn against a threshold line. Volume columns above average are cyan, purple on a bullish reversal pattern, red on a bearish one. Inputs include 交易量均线长度 (48), 指数阈值 (200) and K线形态检测长度 (3).

volume-bands.text: Takes a Hull average of the source at the highest-volume bar of the recent window, then the median of it, and adds and subtracts ATR times a multiplier. A close above Upper turns the trend long and below Lower turns it short; the Lower band shows in a long trend and Upper in a short one, with labels at changes. Inputs: Source Length 14, Median Length 14, ATR Length 14, Multiplier upper 1.35, Multiplier lower 1.35.

volume-bar-range.text: Tracks the high and low of the latest bar with the highest volume over the Lookback Period (55) and fills between them. Labels appear when a close crosses the range with volume above its average (Volume MA Period 21) and the prior bar, and the close in the matching half of the bar. Show Reversal Signals is on by default.

volume-bars-color.text: Plots volume as columns against its average and standard deviation over Mean period bars. Columns are red when volume reaches Mean Volume plus the deviation times the multiplier, yellow at or below the matching low level, and light grey otherwise. High Band and Low Band mark one deviation. Alerts: High Volume Alert, Low Volume Alert. Mean period is 30, multiplier 1.
names: Std deviation multiplier for volume bands

volume-based-moving-average.text: Averages the chosen Source over a window that grows back from the current bar until the summed volume reaches Target Volume (default 250000), so the length adapts to activity. With High & Low it draws Volume MA High and Volume MA Low; otherwise Volume MA. A line turns green after Slope Confirmation Bars (default 3) rises in a row, red after as many falls.

volume-based-rsi-color-indicator-with-ma.text: Plots the RSI of the close, with a long and a short moving average of the RSI. The RSI line turns red at or above the Overbought Level (70) and green at or below the Oversold Level (30) only when volume exceeds its average times the High Volume Multiplier (2); otherwise it is blue. Other inputs: RSI Length (14), Long MA Length (200), Short MA Length (20), MA Type (SMA).

volume-based-support-resistance-zones.text: Finds fractal highs and lows with above-average volume on up to four timeframes. Each fractal high opens a resistance zone from the high to the candle body edge; each fractal low opens a support zone from the low to the body edge. Zones run until the next one of the same kind, and the latest extends right. Volume MA - Threshold is 6, Number of Zones Back is 30.

volume-bubbles-liquidity-heatmap.text: Splits each bar's volume into buy and sell parts by candle shape, then draws one ellipse bubble per Bubble Timeframe period (1D), sized by volume, plus a heatmap of volume per price row. Bubble Mode (Buy & Sell Volume) shows buy and sell slices; others show total or delta. Heatmap Rows is 25, Cell Minimum Size 20.

volume-buy-sell-split.text: Splits each bar's volume by where the close sits in the high-low range: the part near the high counts as buying, the part near the low as selling. Columns show Total Volume, the larger share as Majority Volume and the smaller as Minority Volume, in the buying or selling colour. Above Avg Marker draws the volume average only on bars whose volume exceeds it; Volume MA Length is 20.

volume-candle-coloring-v5.text: Colours price bars by volume relative to its SMA over Période moyenne volume (20) bars, and by direction: close at or above open is green, otherwise red. Faint shades mean low volume, lime or orange extreme, aqua or fuchsia ultra. Thresholds: Volume faible 0.7, Volume fort 1.5, Volume extrême 2.5, Volume ULTRA 4.

volume-candle-highlighter.text: Compares each bar's volume with its simple average over Volume MA Length bars (default 20). A bar whose volume reaches Abnormal Volume Multiplier (default 2) times that average is repainted in the abnormal colours, other candles in bull or bear colours. With Show Marker on, abnormal bars get a triangle, up below rising bars and down above falling ones. Flash Background adds a background tint.

volume-candles.text: Colours bars by volume strength: green when the close is at or above the open, red otherwise, in three tiers of intensity. In Percentile Ranking mode, the share of the last Ranking Lookback (20) volumes below the current one sets the tier, under 50, under 80, or higher. In Volume Average mode, the tier depends on volume versus half and 1.5 times its average.

volume-colored-bars.text: Shows volume as columns coloured by candle direction: green when close is above open, red otherwise, in a brighter shade when volume is above its simple average and a dimmer one when below. It also recolours the price bars in six shades by direction and by volume relative to 0.5 and 1.5 times the average. Input: MA Length 20.

volume-comparison-with-buyer-seller-pres.text: Measures where the close sits against the open as a share of the bar's range, giving Buyer Pressure and Seller Pressure, next to volume columns and averages of 3, 5, 10 and 20 bars. The background is green when buyer pressure is at least 0.75, red for seller pressure, otherwise gray. Extra tints and top markers appear when volume exceeds an average. Show inputs toggle each volume series.

volume-delta.text: Splits each bar's volume into up and down volume and plots the net as a candle running from zero to the delta. Teal candles mean positive delta (buying), red mean zero or negative (selling), measured against the dashed zero line. Without a lower timeframe, all volume goes by close versus open. Inputs: Use custom timeframe (off) and Timeframe (1).

volume-divergence.text: Plots a volume oscillator that weights volume by candle direction through a chain of weighted averages, so it is positive on bullish pressure and negative on bearish. Labels Bull or Bear mark pivot divergences against price, and Hidden Bullish and Hidden Bearish are off by default. Inputs: First Moving Average length 5, Second Moving Average length 8, Pivot Lookback Right 5.

volume-flow-indicator.text: Gives each bar signed volume, capped by Max Vol Cutoff (2.5) times average volume: positive if the typical price rose by more than a volatility threshold set by Coefficient (0.2), negative if it fell by more, else zero. This is summed over VFI Length (130) and divided by average volume. VFI above zero suggests net buying flow. Signal averages it over Signal Length (5); Histogram is the gap; Smooth VFI is off.

volume-flow-v3.text: Splits volume into bull (close above open) and bear (open above close) parts and smooths each with a chosen average. Bull MA and Bear MA are drawn at twice the average; spike columns mark bars where bull or bear volume crosses above the average times Spike Factor. Difference Value is the gap between the averages, green when bulls lead, orange otherwise. Defaults: MA Type Simple, MA Length 14, Spike Factor 3.1.

volume-footprint.text: Splits each bar's range into price intervals and spreads the bar's volume across them, weighted toward the close because no tick data is used. Each interval is a box showing its volume or percent share; bars are coloured by close versus open. Interval Size Method is Atr or Manual, sized by Length / Manual Size (14); As Percentage is off and Display Type is Candle by default.

volume-footprint-measuring-by-math-geome.text: Splits each bar's volume into buy and sell: with the Geometric engine, buy is volume times (close minus low) over the range. It outputs Buy Volume, Sell Volume, Total Volume and shares, and draws a footprint table, a buy/sell bell profile and Point of Control, Value Area and imbalance marks. Engine defaults to Geometric, Window Bars to 5, Profile Period to 23, Value Area to 70.

volume-gaps-imbalances.text: Builds a volume profile over the last Lookback bars (default 200): the high-low range is cut into Rows price rows (50), and each bar's volume goes to its price row as bull or bear volume. Shaded zones mark rows with no volume. A side panel of Summary Sections (20) shows buy-minus-sell delta as a percentage.

volume-gated-trend-ribbon.text: Builds a fast and a slow moving average of a volume-gated close, which only updates on bars where volume reaches its average times the Volume Multiplier (Volume Period 50, default 1). Four ribbon lines run from Fast MA to Slow MA; the trend is bullish when Fast MA is above Slow MA. MA Type defaults to EMA, Fast Length 15, Slow Length 30.

volume-heatmap-divergence.text: Shows volume as a percentage of its highest value over 1000 bars, drawn as candles coloured from aqua through yellow to red. When Divergence is on, a volume pivot (Pivot Left 10, Right 5) with higher volume and a lower low than the last pivot is bullish; lower volume and a higher high is bearish. Range Min (5) and Max (60) bound the gap between pivots.

volume-linreg-trend.text: Plots the linear regression slope of the source times its length, as Short Term columns and a Long Term line. Shades show whether regressions of estimated buy and sell volume support the move: blue or green for rising prices, orange or red for falling, stronger when matching volume slope leads. Defaults: Source close, Short Term Length 20, Long Term Length 50.

volume-open-interest-footprint-by-leviat.text: Splits the visible price range into Resolution rows (default 20) and spreads each bar's volume, or with Source set to Open Interest its change, over the rows it covers, split into up and down parts. Rows are drawn as boxes with the amount as text, shaded by rank, as Up/Down columns, Total or Delta (Type, default Up/Down). Offset (30) and Width (40) place it, Positioning sets Right or Left.

volume-order-blocks.text: Two EMAs of the close define the trend. A cross up turns the lowest recent low into a bullish block, a cross down the highest high into a bearish one, each with its mid line and a label showing its share of volume and its volume. Blocks drop when a close breaks through them. Sensitivity Detection (5) sets the fast length, the slow one is 13 longer. Mid Line and Trend Shadow are on.

volume-orderbook.text: Divides price into levels whose height is the first bar's range times Width, and adds each bar's volume to the level holding its source price. On the last bar, boxes show the volume of the Rows levels above (red) and below (lime) the current level, gray for the current one; larger volume gives wider, more opaque boxes. Main inputs: Source close, Rows 10, Width 0.5.

volume-osc.text: Takes a fast and a slow average of volume and expresses their difference as a percentage of the slow one (PVO). Signal line averages PVO, and Histogram is PVO minus it, drawn as columns that are teal above zero and red below, brighter when rising. Defaults: Fast length 12, Slow length 26, Signal length 9.

volume-positive-negative.text: Sums volume over Period Length (30) on bars where typical price rose or fell by more than Fraction of ATR (0.1) of the ATR. The net share of average volume is scaled by 100 and smoothed with an EMA of 3 to give VPN. VPN is green above the Critical Value Line (10) and red below, with an optional Cloud and Moving Average (SMA, length 30).

volume-profile.text: Builds a volume histogram over the last Lookback (500) bars, split into Row Size (200) price rows; each bar adds its full volume to every row its range crosses. Longer rows mean more volume, and a dotted line marks the highest-volume row's middle. Show Rolling POC plots Rolling POC per bar; Flip Histogram moves the base to the latest bar.

volume-profile-auto.text: Builds a volume profile for each higher-timeframe period, splitting the first bar's range into parts slices (default 25). Each bar covering a whole slice adds its volume to the line width. The busiest slice is coloured differently and a POC line marks its middle. Automatic Settings is on, so the period follows the chart timeframe; max width is 15.

volume-profile-fixed-range.text: Builds a volume profile of the last Number of Bars (150) bars, split into Row Size (24) price rows, with each row's volume divided into up and down parts. The row with the most volume is the point of control, shown as an extended line and a POC label. The value area grows outward from it until it holds Value Area Volume % (70) of volume, and those rows are drawn in stronger colours.

volume-profile-free-pro-by-rrb.text: Splits a fixed price range into up to 25 levels and adds the volume of recent bars to the level of each bar's source price, as Buy Volume when close is at or above open, else Sell Volume. POC Level marks the busiest level; the value area grows from it until it holds Value Area % Of Total Volume (70). Num Levels is 25, VP Range Length (Bars) is 1000.

volume-profile-free-ultra-sli.text: Builds a volume profile over a fixed price range from Min Price Level to Max Price Level, split into Num Levels (100) rows, using bars inside the VP Range Length (1000). Longer rows mean more volume; the POC is the largest row, and the value area holds Value Area % Of Total Volume (70) around it. In vwap mode, VWAP and its standard deviation bands replace the developing POC and value area lines.

volume-profile-heatmap.text: Builds a volume profile of the last Lookback Period bars (default 100), split into up to Profile Rows rows (default 24), and shades each band from low to high volume. POC marks the busiest row; VAH and VAL bound the area holding Value Area % (default 68) of volume, and High and Low show the profile extremes. Volume Type picks Both, Bullish or Bearish bars.

volume-profile-kv4coins.text: Builds a volume profile over the lookback bars: each bar adds its full volume to every price level inside its low-high range. Horizontal lines at the right show volume per level; the Point of Control is the busiest level, and the value area grows from it until it holds Value Area Percentage(%) (default 68). Use Visible Range is off by default; Volume Type filters bullish or bearish bars.

volume-profile-per-day-with-support.text: Builds a volume profile for each recent day, splitting the range into price levels and finding the level with the most volume. Each day gets volume bars, plus lines at its low, high and highest-volume level. That level mirrored across the range gives a dashed support or resistance line, labelled with its age in days. Inputs: Number of days (10), calculation resolution (500), show support/resistance since (3).

volume-profile-pivot-anchored.text: On each confirmed pivot, builds a volume profile over the bars since the previous pivot, split into rows by price. It marks the Point of Control (PoC), the row with most volume, and the value area around it, with high and low lines. Pivot Points Left / Right Length is 20, Value Area Volume % is 68, Number of Rows is 25.

volume-profile-pivot-levels.text: Builds a volume profile of the last Period bars (200) in Volume Profile Resolution bins (50), drawn as a curved line. It is teal when rising bars dominate, otherwise maroon. PoC adds a line and label at the busiest bin. Display marks pivots, using Length (10) bars each side, lying on bins holding at least Filter % 0-100 (20) of peak volume, with dotted levels running forward until crossed.

volume-profile-plus.text: Builds a histogram of volume (or time spent, in Market Profile / TPO mode) across Number of Rows price buckets (default 300), drawn to the right of the last bar. The longest row is the point of control; VAH and VAL mark where the Value Area Percent (default 70) of volume is enclosed. Range Mode (default Visible Range) sets where counting starts.

volume-rsi-ma-differential.text: Draws a 20-bar average of volume as Volume MA Columns, light orange when RSI is under RSI Buy Signal (35) with volume above its average, pink when RSI is over RSI Sell Signal (75) with close above the fast average. MA Differential is a line at 1 from the Fast MA (50) minus Slow MA (100) difference scaled by volume: dark when rising, pink when above half the volume average, light orange otherwise.

volume-sentiment-breakout-channels.text: Normalizes the close over Normalization Length bars (100) and draws a channel when its volatility rises back above a weighted average over Box Detection Length (14), with a buy/sell volume profile. A break out of the channel, judged on the candle body midpoint with Strong Closes Only on, starts a Bullish Trend or Bearish Trend line.

volume-spike-and-contraction-indicator.text: Builds bands around the volume's simple moving average: upper adds Sensitivity of Spikes (3) times the standard deviation, lower subtracts Sensitivity of Contractions (1) times it, both over Volume MA length (20). Volume crossing above the upper band shows a yellow burst symbol; crossing below the lower band on a closed bar shows an aqua arrow. Alerts: Volume Spike, Volume Contraction.

volume-spike-indicator.text: Compares each bar's volume with its 20-bar simple average. A bar whose volume exceeds 4 times that average gets a red cross and a red x-cross above it, flagging unusually heavy trading. The length and multiplier are fixed, so there are no inputs.

volume-suite-by-leviathan.text: Shows one of six volume views chosen by Display: relative volume (volume over its average across Relative Length, default 20), its cumulative form, volume, buy/sell volume, volume delta or cumulative delta. Bars take the primary colours by direction and stronger green or red pairs when the value passes the thresholds 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5. Buy and sell volume are estimated from each bar's own close versus open.

volume-supertrend-ai.text: Builds a SuperTrend from a volume-weighted average of close, offset by a multiple of ATR, then colours it with a nearest-neighbour vote. Bullish colour means a vote of 1, bearish 0, neutral otherwise; circles mark colour starts, triangles vote-confirmed flips. Main inputs: Neighbors 3, Data 10, Length 10, Moving Average Source WMA.

volume-surge-detector.text: Shows volume as columns with a simple moving average of volume. When volume divided by that average exceeds Surge Level1 (5) the column takes the first ratio colour, and above Surge Level2 (10) the second; otherwise it is coloured by whether the close is above the open. MA Length defaults to 14.

volume-trend-order-block-engine.text: Draws a SuperTrend stop from the midpoint of each bar, offset by Multiplier times the average bar range over Volatility SMA Length. In its direction, pivot bars create order block zones split into Buy and Sell parts by volume share. A cross marks a retest of the zone when the share passes Min Buy % or Min Sell %. Defaults: 50, 3.5, Pivot Strength 7, Min Buy % 50, Min Sell % 50.

volume-variation-index-indicator.text: Takes the previous bar's volume minus the current bar's volume. Positive results are drawn as green Volume Increase columns, negative ones as red Volume Decrease columns, around Baseline Zero. When Show Average Variation is YES (default), Average Variation adds a simple average of that difference over Avarage Period (default 10).

volume-weighted-ma-crossover.text: Draws a volume-weighted moving average of the Source and compares it with a simple moving average. The VWMA line turns cyan after it crosses over the SMA and magenta after it crosses under, which also trigger the long and short alerts. VWMA Length defaults to 20 and SMA Length to 50.

volume-weighted-macd-v2-vwmacdv2-by-kiva.text: A MACD built on volume-weighted averages: each average is the EMA of volume times close divided by the EMA of volume, and VWMACD is fast minus slow. Signal is an EMA of VWMACD, and Histogram is their difference, around a Zero line. VWMACD crossing Signal or Zero shows momentum shifts. Inputs: fastperiod 12, slowperiod 26, signalperiod 9.

volume-weighted-median-price.text: Sorts the prices of the last Lookback Period bars (20) by value and takes the price where cumulative volume first reaches half of the window's total volume, ignoring bars without positive volume. VWMP is drawn on the price chart as a line. Price Source defaults to hlc3.

volume-weighted-money-flow.text: VWMF is a weighted average of normalized OBV, PVT, A/D, CMF and MFI on a 0 to 100 scale, where 50 is neutral. Above 50 is bullish, below is bearish; Bullish Strength % is the share of the five measures above 50, and the background shades by side. Each weight defaults to 20, MFI Length to 14 and Volume Flow MA Length to 20.

volume-weighted-order-block-zones.text: Turns swing pivots into boxes over the pivot candle once price moves ATR(100) times Displacement Multiplier (4) away; box text is volume strength versus the 20-bar average. A dashed line is a pending trigger, solid once confirmed; B or S marks a retest, and a break of the far side deletes the box. Swing Detection Length (10), Max Active Order Blocks (10), Min Volume Strength (%) (0).

volume-weighted-pivot-bands.text: Computes a rolling volume-weighted average of hlc3, optionally smoothed by an SMA, as the VWAP Pivot, with five R and five S bands spaced by the range over the length times a multiplier. Alerts fire when the close crosses above R1 to R5 or below S1 to S5. Inputs: Rolling Length 20, both multipliers 0.25, Pivot Smooth Length (SMA) 20.

volume-weighted-price-z-score.text: Measures the log gap between price and its volume-weighted moving average, divides it by the rolling standard deviation of that gap, then smooths it with an EMA into the Z-Score. The line shades from gray toward the positive or negative colour as it nears the Extreme Positive Level or Extreme Negative Level, with Zero Line and ±1σ guides. Inputs: Lookback Period 100, Smoothing Period 5, Extreme Threshold 2.5.

volume-weighted-rsi.text: An RSI built from volume: volume on up closes and on down closes are each smoothed over VW RSI Length (14), then turned into a 0 to 100 line. The line is green above 50, red below, gray at 50. Dashed lines mark 50 and the Overbought Level (70) and Oversold Level (30); the background tints red above the first and green below the second.

volume-weighted-trend.text: Plots a volume-weighted moving average of the close with bands at ATR times a multiplier above and below it. The trend turns bullish when the close is above the Upper Band and bearish when below the Lower Band, and the line, bands, ribbons and bars take that trend colour. Inputs: VWMA Length 34, ATR Multiplier 1.5, plus Fast Response and Smooth Trend presets.

volume-with-alert.text: Plots volume as columns with a Volume Moving Average. Columns turn yellow when volume is at or above the threshold, otherwise teal on up bars and red on down bars. A dashed Threshold Line marks the level, and the Volume exceeds threshold alert fires on yellow bars. Alert when volume is ≥ to defaults to 1000; Volume moving average length (visual only) is 20.

volume-with-ema-and-coloring-rules.text: Plots volume as a histogram with an exponential moving average of volume drawn as the Volume EMA line. A volume bar is blue when volume exceeds the average and white otherwise, so you can see above-average activity. EMA Length defaults to 500.

volumetric-compressed-ma.text: Compressed MA is a moving average of close weighted by log volume that is clamped between bands set by Upward threshold (2) and Downward threshold (-2) around its weighted average. VWMA is the same MA type of close over Compression Lookback (81). Teal fill means Compressed MA is above, maroon below; circles mark crossings. Comperative Lookback is 21 and MA Type is RMA.

volumetric-entropy-index.text: Averages up-bar volume and down-bar volume with two EMAs, EMA Up and EMA Down; the dominant one is solid and the other faded. Their drifts over Drift Lookback (bars) are smoothed, and the background turns green when both rise and red when neither does. Optional Smoothed Net Drift, Drift Strength and Drift Baseline with bands. Defaults: EMA Length 20, Drift Lookback (bars) 2, Drift Smooth Length 5.

volumetric-order-flow-structure.text: Marks structure breaks: a close over the last pivot high or under the last pivot low is BOS when it follows the trend and CHoCH when it reverses it. Each break draws a band and label, plus a 15-row order block and volume histogram on the pivot candle (widest row orange); a close through the block removes it. Inputs: Pivot Length (3), Max Recent Blocks (5).

volumetric-tensegrity.text: Two volume measures in a separate pane. The histogram shows the volume z-score, coloured by zone from blue (low) through teal, yellow and orange to red (above 2.5). The line shows an OBV spread, normalised and smoothed, green when at or above its value two bars earlier, else red. Defaults: ZVOL MA 55, ZVOL Std Deviation 55, OBVX Fast VWMA 13, OBVX Normalization 55.

volvol.text: Computes three z-score style lines on the price scale. Direction is the smoothed z-score of the close, shaded green above zero and red below; Intensity is the smoothed z-score of the low (or high); Momentum is an EMA of weighted up versus down volume balance. Squares, triangles and circles mark exits, adds and entries. Length is 5.

vortex.text: Sums two vortex movements over the window, current high versus previous low and current low versus previous high, and divides each by the summed true range. VI + above VI - points to upward pressure, the reverse to downward, and crossings between them mark shifts. Length is 14 by default.

vortex-pro-with-moving-average.text: Computes the Vortex difference, upward minus downward movement sums over true range sums, scaled by 10, as Vortex Pro, with a moving average of it and a Zero Line. The area between Vortex Pro and zero is green when positive and red otherwise. Inputs: Vortex Period 14, MA Period 9, MA Type EMA (EMA, SMA, HMA or WMA).

voss-predictive-filter.text: Runs a two-pole bandpass on the 2-bar change of the Source, then a Voss prediction stage that gives the Voss line a lead over the Filter line. Reading: Voss and Filter oscillate around the zero line; Threshold + and Threshold - bands mark unusually large Voss swings. Key inputs: Bandpass Period 20, Prediction Multiplier 3, Bandwidth 0.25, Threshold mode MAD, Period 50, Multiplier (k) 1.5.

vpci.text: Multiplies the gap between volume-weighted and simple averages (Long Length 20) by a short-to-long price ratio and volume ratio (Short Length 5). VPCI is drawn with Signal, an average of Signal MA Length 8, plus a Bollinger band on VPCI (BB Length 20, BB Mult 2.5). Breach crosses mark VPCI touching BB Upper or BB Lower.

vpsa-vtd.text: Normalises bar spread and volume to 0..1 over a lookback and colours them by z-score: blue below 1, green 1 to 2, red above 2, fuchsia above 3. Normalized Volume is drawn as columns, and Volume SMA appears in SMA mode. Top labels mark bars where a volume trend holds. VPSA period for analysis and Volume Trend Detector period for analysis both default to 14; Method of trend determination is SMA.
names: Volume Trend Detector period for analysis

vulkan-profit.text: Compares two WMAs of the close with two EMAs. Bullish when both WMAs sit above both EMAs, bearish when both sit below. Buy and sell triangles mark the first bar of each state, and Signal Line under the lows is green, red or grey before any state. Fast WMA Period 3, Medium WMA Period 8, Fast EMA Period 18, Slow EMA Period 28.

vumanchu-swing.text: Computes a ratcheting range filter whose width is a smoothed average of bar-to-bar close changes times a multiplier, with High Band and Low Band around the Filter. Green, red or grey Filter means rising, falling or flat; BUY and SELL labels print on the first signal after the opposite one. Swing Period 20, Swing Multiplier 3.5.

vw-macd-v2.text: A MACD built from volume-weighted moving averages: VWMACD is the fast average minus the slow one, Signal is an EMA of it, and Histogram is their difference. Histogram is bright green when positive and rising, teal when positive and not rising, bright red when negative and falling, otherwise lighter red. A dashed zero line is drawn. Defaults: Fast Length 12, Slow Length 26, Signal Length 9, Source close.

vwap.text: Volume-weighted average price of the Source (default hlc3), restarting each Anchor Period (default Session), with optional bands at multiples of the standard deviation or of 1% of VWAP, chosen by Bands Calculation Mode. Only Bands Multiplier #1 (1) is shown by default; #2 (2) and #3 (3) are off.

vwap-deviation-oscillator.text: Measures how far price (HLC3, or close with Use Close instead of HLC3) sits from a volume-weighted average price, as an absolute, percent or z-score deviation set by Deviation Mode. Bars of VWAP Deviation are zone-coloured above or below Zero, with Std +1 to Std +3 and Std -1 to Std -3 lines. VWAP Mode defaults to Rolling (Lookback: Bars) of 20 bars.

vwap-dual-ma-ribbon-tracker-pro.text: Draws a ribbon of constant height coloured by trend state: green when the fast average is above both the VWAP and the slow average plus an ATR cushion and Elder Force Index is positive, red for the mirror case, blue otherwise. MA Type defaults to EMA, MA 1 Length to 4, MA 2 Length to 9, ATR Multiplier Cushion to 0.2.

vwap-mtf.text: Volume-weighted average of hl2 that restarts at each period of TimeFrame (W by default). It is drawn as circles, green when the close is above it and red otherwise. Show previous VWAP close adds the prior period's final value as a second circle line, and Show barcolors paints bars in the VWAP colour; both are off by default.

vwap-mvwap-ema-crossover.text: Computes a daily-anchored VWAP from hlc3, smoothed by an EMA, plus a moving average of it (MVWAP), two close-price EMAs and a volume-weighted Ichimoku-style cloud. Bars turn green and a Long triangle appears when both EMAs and the VWAP are at or above MVWAP; otherwise bars are red with a Short triangle. Main inputs: VWAP Length 1, EMA 1 Length 7, EMA 2 Length 25, MVWAP Length 21.

vwap-periodic-close.text: Computes VWAPs that restart each day, week, month, quarter or year, and draws a horizontal line at the level where each period's VWAP closed, labelled with the start date, period and price. VWAP Close Level shows these levels, VWAP Origin draws each closed period's VWAP path, and Historical Closes sets how many are kept. VWAP Source is hlc3 and Line/Label Offset is 17.

vwap-predictive-breakout-rsi-ob-trend-ch.text: Plots VWAP with a background that is green in a trend (ADX, EMA gap and clean-candle tests) and red when choppy. Long and short entry conditions combine a VWAP cross, volume spike, strong body, RSI and engulfing-bar checks, but as coded the cross and confirmation conflict, so they never fire. ADX Length 7, ADX Trend Threshold 18, Fast EMA 9, Slow EMA 21.

vwap-stdev-bands-v2-mod.text: Volume-weighted average price of hl2 that restarts each day, with up to five pairs of bands at multiples of the volume-weighted standard deviation. The first pair uses 1.28 above and below; Show second group of bands? and Show third group of bands? are on, the fourth and fifth off. Bars are coloured by where ColorSrc (close) sits relative to the bands when Turn Barcolor ON/OFF? is on.

vwap-supply-demand-zones-pro.text: Computes a moving VWAP over VWAP Length bars (default 20) with thin bands around it. A close crossing under VWAP on high volume and a large body adds a supply zone above, and a cross over adds a demand zone below. A close through a zone breaks it and turns it grey. Zone Width % is 0.5, Max Zones Per Type 5, Zone Extension (bars) 30.

vwap-volume-profile.text: Builds a volume profile of the daily-restarting VWAP over the last period bars (default 250), split into bins rows (50). Row bars are drawn offset bars (10) to the right: up colour for rows where the VWAP rose, down colour where it fell. POC boxes mark the strongest rows, and the VWAP line changes colour with its slope.

vwma.text: Averages the Source over the last Length bars, weighting each bar by its volume so heavy-volume bars pull the line more. VWMA is drawn on the price pane; Offset shifts the line along the time axis. Defaults are Length 20, Source close and Offset 0.

vwma-sma-delta-volatility.text: Takes the difference between a volume-weighted and a simple moving average over MAs Length (14), then scales it to -100..100 over Statistical sample size (100). Delta bars are red when negative and below the lower filter, green when positive and above the upper filter, otherwise faint. The filters sit Z-score (2) deviations from the mean and show when Z-score channel is on.

vwmacd-mfi-obv-composite.text: Builds a MACD from volume-weighted averages (MACD Fast Length 12, MACD Slow Length 26, MACD Signal Smoothing 9), plus MFI (MFI Length 14) and OBV scaled 0-100 over 100 bars. Combined averages the scaled MACD, MFI and scaled OBV. The background is green when MACD is above its signal, red otherwise; lines mark MFI Overbought (80) and MFI Oversold (20).

vwrsi-crossovers-extremes.text: A volume-weighted RSI (VWRSI Length 14) where up and down moves of the close are averaged with volume weighting, plus an EMA of it as MA (MA Length 9). The fill is green when VWRSI is above MA and red otherwise. Triangles with an orange background mark VWRSI returning above Oversold Level (30) or below Overbought Level (70); Mid sits at 50.

waddah-attar-explosion.text: Takes the bar-to-bar change of a fast-minus-slow EMA MACD, scaled by Sensitivity, and plots it as Up Trend or Down Trend columns. Explosion Line is the Bollinger band width and Dead Zone is 3.7 times a 100-bar average true range; columns above both lines show stronger momentum. Inputs: Sensitivity (150), Fast EMA Length (20), Slow EMA Length (40), BB Channel Length (20).

wae-sniper-scalp-xauusd-m1-tuned.text: Measures the one-bar change of a MACD, multiplied by Sensitivity, as green Up Trend and red Down Trend columns. The Explosion Line (BB) is the Bollinger band width and the DeadZone (ATR) is a scaled average true range. A triangle marks a rising column above both lines on the right side of the Trend EMA Filter (200). Sensitivity is 150.

waindrops.text: Splits each period (PERIOD SIZE (max 2880 min), 60) into two halves and draws a high-low bar, a volume-weighted average line per half, and a per-half volume histogram with labels. Right average above left is bullish, below bearish, else neutral. Ticks per bar (max 50) is 2; Track price marks the last close.

wave-n-kdj-volumi-smc-ichimoku.text: Draws Ichimoku lines without offset: Tenkan-sen (9 bars), Kijun-sen (26), Senkou Span A (their average) and Senkou Span B (52). It also marks BUY or SELL when an N-shaped higher-high/higher-low wave (or its mirror) coincides with KDJ's J beyond 50, above-average volume and close beyond Kijun-sen. Small crosses mark J crossing 50. No inputs.

wavefunction-macd.text: Takes a fast minus slow moving average of the close, scales it by the cosine of a smoothed phase angle from the detrended close, and smooths that energy into a signal. The histogram is energy minus signal; dots mark line crossings. Defaults: Moving Average Type WMA, Fast MA Length 12, Slow MA Length 26, Signal Smoothing Length 9.

wavelet-filter-with-adaptive-upsampling.text: Splits the log returns of the Source into two wavelet levels, soft-thresholds the detail parts to remove noise, upsamples and rebuilds a return per bar. Cumulative Series compounds those returns from 1; the Reconstructed Log Return Histogram shows each return, green above zero, red otherwise. Inputs: Upsample Factor 2, Frequency 1, Phase Shift 0.

wavelet-transform-trend.text: Smooths the Source with a Haar wavelet over the Wavelet Period (16) and Wavelet Levels (3), then wraps it in a band of ATR Period (14) times ATR Mult (1.5). The trend flips when the close leaves the band; the trailing edge shows in Line mode, and Wave mode (default) fills between lagged copies of the path. Alerts fire on bullish, bearish or any flip.

wavelet-trend-ml-integration.text: Blends a high-pass trend filter, divided by ATR and normalised over Normalization Lookback, with a logistic classifier on six binary features, then smooths the mean as Signal. Signal is green at or above zero and red below, against reference levels from -1 to 1; labels mark zero crossings, matching the Bullish Signal and Bearish Signal alerts. Key inputs: Short Scale Length 12, Long Scale Length 23, Final Signal Smoothing 8.

wavetrend.text: Normalizes the typical price's deviation from its EMA into a channel index, smooths it into WT1, and averages that over 4 bars for WT2. Diff shows WT1 minus WT2, and circles mark each WT1/WT2 cross, red for bearish and green for bullish. Channel Length is 10, Average Length is 21, Over Bought Level 60, Over Sold Level -60.

wavetrend-oscillator.text: Takes the average of high, low and close, measures its distance from an EMA scaled by an EMA of that distance, and smooths the result into a fast line. A 4-bar average of it forms the slower cross line, and their difference is shaded as an area. Fixed lines mark zero and the overbought and oversold levels (60, 53, -60, -53 by default). Channel Length is 10 and Average Length 21.

wavetrend-oscillator-divergence-directio.text: WaveTrend of the typical price: Media WT is green while rising and red while falling, and Media Señal is its 4-bar average. Red circles mark downward crosses at or above Nivel Sobre Compra (53), green circles upward crosses at or below Nivel Sobre Venta (-53); Histograma shows their gap. Longitud Del Canal (10) and Periodo Movil (21) set the smoothing.

wavetrend-oscillator-wt.text: Measures how far the typical price (high, low, close average) sits from its smoothed average, scaled by the average deviation. That channel index is smoothed into WT1, and WT2 is a 4-bar average of WT1. A WT1 cross of WT2 marks momentum shifts, WT1 - WT2 is drawn as an area, and the Over Bought and Over Sold levels (60/53 and -60/-53) frame extremes. Channel Length is 10 and Average Length is 21.

wedge-and-flag-finder.text: Finds wedges and flags on up to four zigzags, where pivots alternate and the legs alternately grow and shrink between two trend lines. A pattern is labelled Flag when it retraces under 0.618 of an earlier pole, otherwise Wedge. Key inputs: Wedge Length (5), L1 to L4 lengths (5, 8, 13, 21), Suppress Overlap (on).

weierstrass-function.text: Sums cosine terms of the bar index, each weighted by the Amplitude Factor to a power and with frequency raised by the Frequency Factor, for Number of Terms terms. It depends only on bar position, not price. The Fractal Oscillator line is blue when it rises from the prior bar and yellow otherwise. Defaults: Invert on, Amplitude Factor 0.5, Frequency Factor 3, Scale Factor 0.0001, Number of Terms 20.

weighted-ma-function.text: A moving average of the Source over the last Length bars (50), weighted by a Beta-distribution curve. +Lag (Alpha, 3) pushes weight toward older bars for more smoothness and lag, while -Lag (Beta, 3) shifts weight toward recent bars for a quicker response. The BWMA line is coloured on a red-to-green scale from its own RSI.

weighted-percentile-nearest-rank.text: Sorts the last Length source values and returns the one where cumulative weight reaches the chosen percentage of total weight. Weights favour newer bars (Time) and bars with larger bodies (Inferred volume). At 50 it acts as a weighted median line on price. Defaults: Source close, Length 256, % 50.

weighted-regression-bands.text: Builds a smoothed weighted high/low midline over Length (50) bars, turns it into a fair value by Linear Regression or ALMA (Method), and draws Weighted Regression Line with three bands each side at multiples of the close's standard deviation times Deviation Multiplier (1). The line and fills are green while the fair value rises and red while it falls. Weighted HL Method defaults to Simple; Smoothing defaults to 0.08.

weis-wave-candle.text: Builds Weis waves from candle size (body, plus half the high-low range if Include candle shadows is on), summing it while the wave direction holds. Direction comes from Trend detection method (LazyBear Style) over Trend analysis period (4). Upward wave and Downward wave columns deepen in colour as the total rises within the Lookback period for dynamic thresholds (70).

weis-wave-volume.text: Builds a Renko-like close that steps to the bar's high or low when price leaves a box around the previous Renko close, giving an up or down wave direction. Volume (or true range) is summed while the direction holds and restarts when it flips. Columns are green in up waves and red otherwise; Oscillating makes down waves negative and Normalize divides by bar count. Renko Assignment Method defaults to ATR with Value 14.

weis-wave-volume-lazybear.text: Sums volume across price waves, restarting the total when the wave direction turns. Up waves show as a green histogram in Up; other waves show as a red histogram in Down, drawn below zero for down waves when showDistributionBelowZero is on. A wave turns after the close rises or falls for trendDetectionLength bars (default 2); showDistributionBelowZero defaults to false.

whale-activity-impact-oscillator.text: Flags a bar when volume exceeds Volume Spike Multiplier (X, 3) times its average and the absolute percent price change exceeds Price Spike Multiplier (Y, 2) times its average, both over Lookback Period (N, 50). The column is positive and green on an up bar, negative and red on a down bar, and 0 otherwise.

whale-liquidity-and-absorption-profile.text: Uses lower-timeframe bars (chart timeframe divided by Bar Granularity, 10) over Profile Lookback (200) bars to draw volume, delta and absorption profiles. A row is strong at or above the Strength Filter (97) percentile of volumes. Absorption peaks become zones with Show Levels; Profile Resolution (35) sets the bins.

whale-volume-absorption-aggression-maxma.text: Volume columns are coloured by direction (close below open is seller, otherwise buyer) and by size against the average volume. Tiers are retail, mid-tier, whale and climax; whale and climax bars also tint the background. Volume Average is the line. Inputs: Volume MA Length (20), Mid-Tier Multiplier (0.8), Whale Multiplier (2), Climax / HFT Multiplier (3).

wick-volume-alert.text: Flags bars whose upper or lower wick is at least Wick to body ratio (1.8) times the body. A red label above the bar marks a long upper wick, a green label below marks a long lower wick. With Use volume filter on (true), volume must also be at least Volume multiplier (1.3) times the previous bar's volume. Optional price limits can restrict the signals.

wicked-fractals.text: Finds fractals on the highs and lows: a bar whose high is strictly above its neighbours gets a downward triangle above it, and a bar whose low is strictly below its neighbours gets an upward triangle below it. Markers are placed two bars before the bar where they are detected. 3 or 5 Bar Fractal defaults to 3 and sets how many neighbours are compared; Periods defaults to 2.

williams-alligator.text: Draws three smoothed moving averages of the bar midpoint (high plus low over two) on the price chart, each shifted forward by its own offset. Jaw is the slowest, then Teeth, then Lips; their spacing and order show how tightly or loosely price is moving. Defaults: lengths 13, 8, 5 and offsets 8, 5, 3.

williams-bbdiv-signal.text: Plots Williams %R over Length 14, with a moving average of it and Bollinger Bands around that average, plus regular divergences between %R pivots and price. Buy and sell signals come from %R crossing its average or the bands, or from divergences, filtered by %R zones, a Reentry pause of 7 bars and optional RSI Filter. Levels sit at -35, -50 and -75.

williams-combo.text: Combines three smoothed averages of the bar midpoint (🐲 Jaw, 🐲 Teeth, 🐲 Lips), each drawn forward by its offset, with high/low fractal markers and ⤒ Resistance and ⤓ Support lines. Resistance and support hold the latest high or low that matched the highest or lowest over 🐲 Jaw... see lengths. Defaults: Lips 5/3, Teeth 8/5, Jaw 13/8, 📌 Period 2, ⤒⤓ Res-Sup Length 13.

williams-fractals.text: Finds local turning points: a bar whose high is above the highs of Periods bars on each side gets an upward triangle above it, and a bar whose low is below the lows of Periods bars on each side gets a downward triangle below it. A fractal is confirmed only Periods bars later, and the left side tolerates up to four equal values. Periods defaults to 2.

williams-percent-range-with-threshold.text: Computes Williams %R of the Source (close) over Length (50) bars: 100 times the source's distance below the highest high, divided by the highest-to-lowest range. The state turns up when %R rises above Uptrend Threshold (-16) and down when it falls below Downtrend Threshold (-67), staying put between; the %R line and price candles are green, red or gray by state.

williams-r.text: Places the source within the highest high to lowest low range of the window, scaled from -100 to 0. Near 0 means it sits close to the window high, near -100 close to the low. Levels at -20, -50 and -80 are drawn as upper, middle and lower marks. Inputs: Length 14, Source close.

williams-vix-fix.text: Measures how far the low sits below the highest close of the last LookBack Period (22) bars, as a percent, giving a synthetic volatility reading. WVF bars turn green when above the Bollinger-style upper band (BB Length 20, BB StdDev 2) or the Highest Percentile (0.85) share of its recent peak. Show High Range and Show StdDev Line add reference lines.

wlsma-fast-approximation.text: A fast approximation of a weighted least squares moving average, combining two linearly weighted averages of the Source as 4 times the squared-weight one minus 3 times the linear-weight one. The line is blue when rising, red when falling and purple when flat. The length input sets the window (256); below 1 it uses all history.

wma.text: Averages the Source over the last Length bars with linearly rising weights, so the newest bar counts most. WMA is drawn on the price pane and reacts faster than an equal-weight average of the same length. Defaults are Length 9, Source close and Offset 0, which shifts the line along the time axis.

wolfe-scanner.text: Scans a zigzag for Wolfe waves: the last five pivots must form two converging lines (pivots 1-5 and 2-4) with same-sign slopes that meet soon after pivot 5. A found wave keeps its wedge lines, dotted legs and a dashed projection to the meeting point. Inputs: Length (3), Depth (250), Min Level (2), Suppress Overlap (false).

woodies-cci.text: Two commodity channel index lines of the close: CCI Turbo with a short window and CCI 14 with a longer one, plus a histogram of CCI 14. The histogram is teal when the last five CCI 14 values are all above zero, red when all are below, otherwise it follows the sign of the current value. Inputs: CCI Turbo Length (6) and CCI 14 Length (14); lines at 0, 100 and -100.

wyckoff-effort-vs-result.text: Flags bars whose volume exceeds the average volume times a multiplier. A high-volume down bar is an accumulation effort, shown in red with the Accumulation Line at its open; a high-volume up bar is a distribution effort, shown in green with the Distribution Line at its open. Average Volume Lookback is 50 and High Volume Multiplier 1.5.

x5-smooth-ema.text: Takes an EMA of the Source and smooths it again with five averages of the same length: SMA, EMA, RMA, WMA and VWMA, drawn as fl1 to fl5, with the base EMA as fl0. Each line takes the bull colour when it rises from the prior bar and the bear colour otherwise. Base Length defaults to 9.

xauusd-buy-sell-alerts-with-sl-tp.text: Plots a Fast EMA (9) and a Slow EMA (21) of the close. A BUY label appears when the fast crosses over the slow while RSI (RSI Length 14) is below 60; a SELL label when it crosses under while RSI is above 40. Buy Alert and Sell Alert fire on these bars, with text giving entry, Stop Loss (pips) 300 and Take Profit (pips) 1000; the pips only affect that text.

xauusd-family-scalping.text: VCO shows where the close sits in a channel around the SMA of the candle midpoint, from -50 at the lower band to +50 at the upper band, with an SMA Signal line. Length (30) and Scale (%) (200) size the channel; Signal Length is 20. The background is green when VCO is above Signal, red below. BUY triggers when VCO crosses over Oversold (-58), SELL when it crosses under Overbought (58).

z-score.text: Z-score of the Source versus its average and standard deviation over Length (default 20). Over the same window it also plots the highest z-score as High, the lowest as Low, their mean as Average, and the root mean square as Pos RMS and Neg RMS, mirrored below zero. Readings far from zero show stretched prices.

z-score-oscillator.text: Measures how far the source sits from its rolling mean or median, in standard deviations, then smooths it and compares it with percentile-based thresholds. In Oscillator mode the thresholds become +100 and -100, and the line is clipped at Extreme Clip; Z-Score and Percentile Rank are other modes. Fills and glow mark overbought and oversold areas. Defaults: Rolling Window 80, Smoothing Length 5.

z-score-stdema-bands.text: Computes the Z-Score of the Source: its distance from the average over Z-Score Length (default 50), in standard deviations. STDEMA Upper Band and STDEMA Lower Band are the Z-Score's EMA plus and minus its standard deviation, both over STDEMA Length (28). Bars turn blue when the Z-Score is above zero and above the upper band, and yellow when below zero and below the lower band.

z-score-trend-monitor.text: Takes the difference between a weighted short SMA and a weighted long SMA of the close, then converts it to a Z-Score against its mean and standard deviation over the lookback. Dashed lines mark plus and minus the threshold and zero, so readings beyond them show an unusually wide or narrow spread. Defaults: Short SMA 14, Long SMA 60, both weights 1, Z-Score Threshold 2, Z-Score Lookback Window 100.

zero-lag-ema.text: Computes an EMA of the close, then an EMA of that EMA, and plots the first plus the difference between the two. This double-EMA construction removes much of the lag of a plain EMA, so the line hugs price more closely. The length input sets both EMAs and defaults to 10.

zero-lag-garch-bands-nal.text: Builds bands around a zero-lag EMA baseline, with half width set by a GARCH volatility estimate whose weights are refitted each bar over GARCH Lookback (30). A close above the Upper Band gives the bullish colour, below the Lower Band the bearish one, kept in between; Midline is hidden. Other inputs: GARCH ZLEMA Smoothing 60, Baseline Length 52, Band Pressure 30 (higher gives tighter bands).

zero-lag-hma-trend-suite.text: Computes a Hull moving average that is drawn as a glowing line, teal when above its value Slope Index Coloring bars ago and purple otherwise. Optional Buy/Sell signals fire when the source crosses ATR-based offsets from it, and the VWAP ribbon shows a daily VWAP. Inputs: HMA Length 21, ATR Length 14, Signal Multiplier 1.5.

zero-lag-liquidity.text: Finds bars with high volume RSI and an unusually large wick, then uses lower-timeframe volume to locate the busiest price bin in that wick and draws it as a liquidity level. A level ends when two closes pass it, giving Bullish Break or Bearish Break; Bullish Rejection and Bearish Rejection mark bounces. Inputs: Lower Timeframe 3, Profile Bin Count 7, Wick Multiplier 2.

zero-lag-macd.text: A MACD built from zero-lag EMAs (twice the EMA minus the EMA of the EMA), with a zero-lag Signal line and a histogram of their difference. Positive Histogram and Negative Histogram show which side MACD is on, EMA on MACD adds a smoother line, and Cross Dots mark MACD and Signal crossings. Inputs: Fast Period (12), Slow Period (26), Signal Period (9), MACD EMA Length (9).

zero-lag-signals-for-loop.text: Builds a zero-lag moving average of the close, then scores it against its own values from Loop Start (1) to Loop End (70) bars back. The trend flips up when the score exceeds Threshold Uptrend (5) and price clears the basis plus a volatility margin, down on the mirror case with Threshold Downtrend (-5). Zero Lag Length is 50 and Volatility Multiplier 1.5; labels mark flips.

zero-lag-trend-signals.text: Computes a zero-lag EMA of the close and bands around it set by the highest ATR times a multiplier. The trend turns bullish when the close crosses over the Upper Deviation Band and bearish when it crosses under the Lower Deviation Band. Small arrows mark Bullish Entry and Bearish Entry. Inputs: Length 70, Band Multiplier 1.2.

zig-zag-channels.text: Zig zag on closing prices: a close above the highest close of the next length bars is a top, below the lowest is a bottom, so swings are confirmed length bars later.
