Each leg gets a line, with dotted lines showing the farthest candle-body distance above and below it, plus price labels and Circles at swings. length defaults to 100.

zigzag.text: Connects alternating swing highs and lows into a line, adding a swing only when price reverses by at least the set percentage. Labels show each reversal's price, its change from the prior pivot, and cumulative volume; green labels mark highs, red lows. Inputs: Price deviation for reversals (%) (5), Pivot legs (10), Extend to last bar (on).

zigzag-fibonacci.text: Builds a zigzag from bars whose high or low is the extreme of the ZigZag Period, keeping the last five turning points. On the last bar it projects Fibonacci lines from the last complete leg: enabled retracements below 1, then extensions 1, 1.272, 1.414, 1.618, 2 and beyond until a level passes the latest point. Labels show ratio and price. ZigZag Period is 15; levels 0.236 to 0.786 can be toggled.

zigzag-multi-time-frame-with-fibonacci.text: Builds a zigzag from swing highs and lows over a window spanning ZigZag Period (2) periods of the ZigZag Resolution timeframe (D). On the last bar it draws Fibonacci lines, labelled with ratio and price, from the leg before the latest one: 0, the enabled 0.236 to 0.786 ratios, 1, then extensions up to 5.618. Show Zig Zag (off) draws every leg; Show Fibonacci Ratios is on.

zigzag-multiple-methods-forecast-pattern.text: Draws a zigzag that turns when price moves past the latest extreme by a set rate, or on pivots or price action, depending on Method to use for the zigzag (default percent move over X * Y). It adds price labels, harmonic pattern names, rate lines and a forecast of the next turn from averaged swing size and duration. Key inputs: parameter X (1), parameter Y (1), Pattern Error Margin (5), Averaging Weight (10).
names: Method to use for the zigzag:

zigzag-percent-reversal-forecast-pattern.text: Builds a zigzag that turns when the close falls back from the running extreme by a reversal range, either a percent of the last pivot or an ATR multiple. It labels pivots, finds harmonic and other patterns from leg ratios, and projects the next pivot. Inputs: Percent of last pivot price for zigzag reversal: (0.25) and method MANUAL.
names: Method to use for the zigzag reversal range:
Percent of last pivot price for zigzag reversal:

zigzag-trend-divergence-detector.text: Builds a zigzag from closes and compares each point's direction with that of an oscillator (RSI by default). Labels mark Continuation (C), Divergence (D), Hidden Divergence (H) or Indeterminate (I). Supertrend, built from recent zigzag points and ATR, colours the bars. Main inputs: Source (RSI), Length (22), ATR Length (22), ATR Multiplier (1).

zlma-trend-levels.text: A zero-lag moving average: an EMA of close plus its own gap from a first EMA, drawn as ZLMA against the plain EMA. ZLMA is green when above its value three bars ago and blue when below. A diamond marks each ZLMA crossing of EMA; with Trend Levels on, a box is drawn at each cross, sized by ATR. Length defaults to 15 and Trend Levels to on.

zlsma.text: Fits a least-squares regression line over the window, fits a second one over that result, and adds the gap between them to the first, which cuts the lag of the smoothed line. The ZLSMA line draws on the price pane and follows price more closely than a plain regression average. Length is 32, Offset is 0 and Source is close.

zone-shift.text: Builds a band around the average of an EMA and a shorter HMA of the close, with Top and Bottom set by the 200-bar average range. A low crossing above Top starts an up trend, a high crossing below Bottom a down trend, and Trend Initiation Level is drawn. Length 60-200 defaults to 100.

zvol-z-score-volume-heatmap.text: Converts volume to a z-score against its average and standard deviation, then colours the Volume columns and background by zone: below Low Threshold (σ) 0, up to Medium Threshold (σ) 1, High Threshold (σ) 2.5, Extreme Threshold (σ) 4, and beyond. EMA 21 and EMA 34 of volume are drawn with a fill. Moving Average Length and Standard Deviation Length default to 100.
